comments:
Emma and Ian seem like wonderful people. They were very warm and welcoming and have set the suite up well with amenities, etc. The location is good and even though King Edward is a busy street, the house was well insulated from noise.
I’m sorry to have to say because I really liked them and could tell they went to some effort, but their place has black mold—not unheard of in older Vancouver garden suites, and maybe for most people for a few days this wouldn’t be an issue but for me it really was. I have a rare blood disorder and black mold is immediately noticeable to and problematic for me, as it would be for anyone with autoimmune conditions or in weakened health to begin.

The apartment location was fantastic. Linda was helpful in allowing me to get into the apartment early, though when I arrived there was no one available to let me in. I had to follow someone else into the building then get someone else to swipe their resident pass in the elevator so I could get onto the apartment floor.

The apartment needs a very serious refresh. While it was clean, literally every piece of furniture, door, wall, and window was chipped or broken. Giant crack in the living room window that is covered in packing tape (seriously). Broken doors, grungy living room rug, dirty blinds in the bedroom. The shower curtain was especially gross - moldy with no plastic liner. Window broken in the bedroom so the room was drafty and loud.

With a good facelift, painting, and replacing the broken things, this apartment could be beautiful.

Cam and his wife Caylee were the worst host I have ever experienced. I don’t recommend this place to anyone.
As a guest, you would hope your host will be helpful when you encounter problems or at least offer words of support, but Cam and Caylee rubbed it on my face and made it clear that since they have pocketed my money, they don’t really care.
First, this was my first international travel since the COVID pandemic started. I was to travel on a Sunday but realized last minute that the Covid test I took was the wrong one. I took the correct test but the result will be out on Tuesday, two days after my originally planned travel date.
I informed Cam of my predicament and his response was to blame me for it.
Secondly, the weekend before I planned and left for this trip, I checked and learned one can travel to Canada (with proof of vaccination and Covid test results), but when I got to the Port of entry (with my visa, proof of Covid vaccination and test result), even with my visa, I was denied entry into Canada because they said “at this time, we are allowing only citizens, permanent residents and essential travels.”
I contacted Cam and informed him of the latest development and my inability to make this trip. Cam and Caylee his wife were nothing more than cruel in their responses. Again, they blamed me and rubbed it on my face, and decided not refund me.
Just like Cam and Caylee, I am also an Airbnb host, and I will never treat anyone the way Cam and Caylee treated me. It was in humane. They are the worst.
Read below my conversation with Cam/Caylee and judge for yourself.
September 24, 2021
“Hello Cam,
My original plan has changed due Covid related circumstance beyond my control. I live in the US and part of the requirements to enter Canada is to get tested for Covid-19 within 72hrs of my travel date.
I just realized today that the Rapid Antigen Covid test I did will not be accepted at the border. They will accept only a PCR Covid test. The result of my PCR Covid test will not be out until Tuesday. I was going to travel on Sunday but that’s is no longer possible
I still want to spend the same number of days in Canada. If possible, Please could you alter my reservation, Tuesday, Sept 28 - Sunday Oct 3. I still want to stay at your place the whole time I’m in Canada. Thank you”
September 25, 2021 Cam responded:
“Hi Anthony, Unfortunately my unit is booked so I won’t be able to accommodate you. Since it is last minute I can’t offer you a refund. I am sorry”
September 25, 2021:
“Cam, I would have been there on Sunday, the Canadian immigration Services will not admit me into Canada on Sunday because of Covid.
I understand that your unit is booked but won’t you at least refund me for a couple days due to this circumstance?
I’m host Airbnb too and make accommodations for guests in circumstances like this. It will be a big help to me if you can refund me just for two days.”
Sep. 26, 2021, Cam responded through his wife Caylee:
“Hi Anthony, we understand your position and I hope you can understand ours. We will not be able to fill the room at the last minute and it will become our loss. This is unfair because the requirements to enter Vancouver have not changed. Had you looked at the entry requirements you would have seen that only a PCR test was acceptable. We would have been happy to refund you had the change happened at the last minute and it was out of your control and in this circumstance the information was available to you and we should not be in the loss position due to the fact that you could have prevented the situation by referring to the government site.
I do apologize but we can not issue a refund.”
Sep. 28, 2021, I updated Cam/Caylee again:
“Hello Cam and Caylee,
I just wanted you to know that I was just denied entry into Canada, reason being that I am not a permanent resident of either US or Canada and also not an essential worker. I just drove back home to the US. I’m beyond disappointed but there is nothing I can do now. I wondering if you could refund me.
Meanwhile, in response to your last message, I’m not an anti-vaxxer. I was vaccinated as soon as the vaccine became available, I wear N95 mask at all times and I have worked very hard to get many people vaccinated. I never wanted to travel anywhere until the end of the pandemic, and my trip to Canada was planned to be by land with my car (which I think is the safest). I take the pandemic very seriously. To dump blames on your guest in a circumstance where you could have helped or at least offered some support, is not the best response or approach. To kick someone who is already down just because of money, is not the best of humanity.
Sep. 29, 2021 Cam through his wife Caylee was obviously excited that I couldn’t make it and responded:
“Hello Anthony. I am very sorry to hear about your difficulties travelling, only the rules of entry to Canada have been very clearly laid out for a long time. There was a lot of flexibility in the first year of the pandemic and now even airlines say to make sure you check entry requirements as they will no longer refund your trip. This is not about helping someone who is down it is about one of us taking a loss. We offered our accommodation with a clear refund policy and it is out of our control if you do not have your proper travel documentation

The place is as advertised. Location is great. Check in process was easy. Would have rated 5 stars except for fact after we checked out Host messaged us saying that we need to pay $180 for sheets/towels that were dirty and an "unexpected cleaning" fee which was absolutely absurd. We stayed there for 4 nights with a baby and there was nothing out of the ordinary. there was nowhere we could clean outside of leaving dirty towels in a corner. We knew there was not maid service which was fine but asking to pay is unreal.

Beware... this place is NOT clean. Ran is super nice, but he does not clean well between guests. All the furniture was dusty, there were black hairs on the comforter, and the bathroom was filthy!!!! Although the bed was very comfortable and Ran provided us with a map of the area so we could walk downtown, we NEVER would stay there again because it was downright dirty. We shared a bathroom with him and he left dirty clothes on the sink, the toilet seat up, and scum/dirt/hair on the toilet and shower. Im a clean freak so I used the lysol wipes I brought from home to clean the sink and tub myself. I feel bad writing this but my husband and I were sooo happy to leave for our cruise and actually have a clean place to relax. His washer was sooo moldy I cleaned that too before using it. Grossed us out that our bedsheets and towels were washed in that thing!! Sorry Ran, but if your going to rent your home you need to clean it for your guests.

Perfect location, accommodating hosts, warm space with nice furnishings. The sheets and duvet were covered in fur or some sort of hair which affected my allergies/asthma. The foam mattress had an extreme valley in it and was not comfortable at all. The towels also had a terrible smell and the coffee machine was very dirty and the filter was broken. The neighbours beside the unit also were very disruptive coming in and out at all hours of the night being quite loud. Not the best week for getting a good night's sleep but the location was perfect and the hosts were very friendly and responsive, the bath was also amazing!

Don’t consider this listing if you want to stay more than a few days (The owner himself confessed to me that it’s not good for a long stay, even though he accepts guests). The refrigerator is outside of the unit and my foods and ice cream were corrupted because it’s not working correctly.
There is a rude old man who handles stuff on be half of the owner (one time he was interrogating me what I am doing in front of the house!!).
On the other hand, the house is like an army base. You can not watch TV (Netflix in my case) because there is other (seems permanent) tenant that goes to work at 5:00 am and he punches the wall whenever he hears the TV or when you speak.
One night the house ran out of power (because of owner fault), and he didn’t even bothering to answer not my calls even AirBNB support calls, and that ruined that night for me.
Not recommended for a stay more than 3 days.
The only good thing about this listing is the bed (it’s a good one).

The place mostly matched the provided pictures, but it had a disappointing cheap feel. Considering the price we paid, we expected better. The lack of uniformity in provided products was noticeable, with mismatched plates and a feeling that everything was discarded items.
The furniture was subpar, especially the small bed in the closet which was uncomfortable and hot, even with the fan running. The absence of central A/C and the taped vent of the portable unit diminished the overall ambiance and made it feel even cheaper.
There was Keurig/general coffee machine with no complimentary pods provided, which was a letdown.
The main view wasn't as great as advertised; the real view was off to the side a bit.
The location was central, but the presence of numerous homeless people in the area made it feel a bit sketchy.

Pros:
Lois’ place is in a great location- close to public transportation, restaurants, and coffee shops. It’s definitely an eclectic crowd but we never felt unsafe in that neighborhood.
Lois was very responsive. Her husband was nice and showed us around at check in.
She even left us some little treats for our stay-very nice touch
Had shampoo, conditioner, body wash, lotion, and a blow dryer.
Value- couldn’t find a place for this price anywhere near Vancouver!
Cons:
The place was extremely dirty. Like no one was expecting us and hadn’t cleaned for six months. I’m not exaggerating; it was the dirtiest place I’ve stayed at. My husband and I spent an hour wipe everything down.
There are cats and she doesn’t allow them in the guest suite, but it smells like cats and when I was looking for another blanket for the bed, the stack of blankets smelled like cat pee.
Overall I would recommend Lois’ house if it were cleaned. It was a nice size for a couple and in a great location.

Tamar's suite is in an amazing location, very close to Commercial Dr which was great to find food within walking distance. The suite was a nice size, the ceilings are low so I wouldn't recommend it for folks on the taller side. Keyless entry is great and you can come and go with ease. Only negative was the noise. It is a garden/basement unit so you can hear everything upstairs. We were mostly only there to sleep but I wouldn't recommend it if you needed things to be quiet.

We stayed at this Airbnb for a total of one month. The location is quite good, very close to the skytrain station and the house is very clean. However, I would not recommend it unless you are looking for a short-term stay in a quiet place. The owner has many rules and reminds you of them through post-its all around the house which will also constantly remind you that you are only a guest and have no freedom. While some of them are more than reasonable, I agree people should always clean after themselves and separate the rubbish for recycling, others are a bit less so, such as the no cooking after 8pm which might be hard if you are working evening shifts, and some are just ridiculous such asking the “gentlemen” to put up the toilet seat. In any case, the main reason why I would not recommend this Airbnb has to do with a day when the owner (in her own words) “almost blew a fuse”. I don’t think we were supposed to witness this and maybe she didn’t realise we were in our room, but that doesn’t make it ok; one day she just started screaming from the top of her lungs, slamming doors and throwing things on the floor, cursing all the guests and calling us idiots. She went on for like 30 minutes before stopping and since this event I just felt extremely uncomfortable in the house and around her. She seems kind when you talk to her and even on the last day when we checked out late due our own misunderstanding she was very nice. To me it seems she doesn’t enjoy having people staying there after all, you have to do everything as if you were renting and living there (like take out the rubbish) but you have not the freedom to participate at setting the rules.
For the recycling I would suggest to put different container in the kitchen to make it easier for newcomers that might not be used to recycling. She takes care of a child at the lower floor which is very nice but occasionally might be a bit loud.
Small appartment in a nice neighborhood. We were however disappointed by the quality. We found it dark, old and dirty. Very limited contact with the owner.

Sandy's apartment is located at downtown. From the nearest skytrain station, you need to walk for10mins without luggage. The nearest bus stop is 5mins by foot. The supermarket IGA(expensive)and the liquor store are very close (1min). You also have Korean supermarket in 3 mins which is convenient for Asian people who wants to cook. The apartment has two rooms (living room/kitchen and bedroom)and very very small room with desk. I was staying at this apartment for 3 weeks and I felt that this apartment is ok for short term stay.
When I checked-in, the room was dusty so I vacuumed the floor but it was still dusty. I found out that the old vacume emits more dust than it vacuums. The bed has two mattresses and the mattress which was below has black sheet and it was so dirty with full of dandruff and hairs of previous customers. So our first thing after check-in was cleaning the floor and sheets. Even after cleaning all the bedding, I smelled something dirty and it was from pillows and bed headboard. I could wash pillows but couldn't wash headboard so it was difficult to sleep comfortably.
Utilities in the apartment were nice. Washer and dryer are big and work well. Dishwashers, stoves, microwave, oven also work very well. Sandy is friendly but before check-in, we haven't received any answer until last minutes so we were worried. I appreciate the flexible check-in time and check-out time.

Everything was terrible except for the location.
The apartment was totally dirty and unmanaged as the previous review.
The host was unable to communicate.
I told the host about dirty condition the day i checked in
but the host said his apt was perfectly clean and i made it dirty with putting dirt in the house.
He threatened me to leave in an hour if I didn't like it.
I had to buy the cleaning tools and clean the apartment by myself all night. because that was 4 week- long stay with 2 kids during the summer vacation and i had no choice.
I bouht new shower curtain because of the mordy shower curtain.
The host told me there were more than 30 channels but we could never watch TV during my stay.
I asked him to fix it but he didn't.
The air conditioner filter was covered with layers of dust and it smelled like piss.
I asked him to change it but he asked me to clean it by myself. So i didnot use the air conditioner anymore.
The worst of all, this accommodation is not authorized.
I have all the evidence photos and conversation record.

Bre’s location was quite central, the building had secure entrance, however the building is dated. When I returned to the apartment in the evening I was taken back  as the door handle for the front door was coming off on both sides. Whilst Bre was responsive and quick to fix the issue, it initially made me feel unsafe. In addition, the shower curtain was quite dirty and the edges of the bathtub was somewhat moulded. I also couldn’t get the lamp in the bedroom to work which Bre came back a second time to help with - this was very nice of her.  Bre left special touches around the house to make it easier to find things. Thanks Bre!

I’ve been an AirBnb user since 2012, I’ve stayed in dozens of AirBnbs, and I’ve never left a review less than five stars until now. It takes a lot for me to leave an even partially bad review.
Breanna was responsive to our messages and polite but otherwise we had a bad experience with this booking. We were meant to stay at Breanna’s place for 2.5 weeks but ended up cancelling within a few minutes of arriving because the place smelt very strongly of cigarettes. The location is good but I’m afraid the unit itself is a bit more rundown than the photos suggest: a window on the balcony was broken and taped together, a cupboard was broken, the walls were marked, etc.
We ultimately received a refund from Airbnb but not directly from Breanna. Despite the fact that the place clearly had issues and we left within minutes of arriving, Breanna only initially offered us about 15% of what we’d paid as a refund. We were prepared to cover some of her costs but we found her offer unreasonably low and disappointing given the circumstances. Breanna says she helped us get the refund from Airbnb (which was a complex process), and if that’s the case we’re appreciative of it.

The space is lovely open and bright, and I very much enjoyed napping on the red velvet couch during the afternoons. The tub...love the tub!!! Jozi and her partner Derek left several little touches including snacks and a bottle of wine during our stay, and were very responsive to texts. The building itself is quite secure with no less than three coded locks between you and the outdoors (the surrounding street is a little sketchy but I never felt unsafe). The location is perfect if you’d like to walk the city, including Gastown and the stadiums (we took in a Canucks game with 15minute walk!). I will definitely book the loft again on my next trip to Vancouver.

The short version: It's a totally awesome place and well worth the money; highly recommended, as long as you don't plan to do a lot of fancy cooking.

The long version:

Host: Michel was perfect host: super nice, low key, very respectful. 5/5

Location: ~3min walk to an absolutely stunning view of the Vancouver skyline and mountains across a bay full of sailboats and anchored cargo ships. At low tide, got down the steps and scramble along the rocky short. Supermarket ~3min walk as well. Beach ~15min. Neighborhood quiet, pretty, and great for walks. Close to good bus lines if you want to head downtown. (5/5)

Interior: Absolutely awesome. Super clean, really cool modernist vibe. You can't exactly tell from the pics, but there are pretty much no interior walls or doors, which makes the place really open and spacious. The shower is epic: 5 showerheads, open on one wall...pretty impressive. (6/5)

Cooking: Good, not great. No hood on small stove; mini-fridge, no microwave. Minimal cupboard space (not such a problem, though, since it's easy to walk to the supermarket every day). Plenty of pots/pans and dishes. I cooked like 25 of 30 days there, so it can be done. But if you're super into cooking, you may be disappointed. (3/5)

Price: It's really expensive (at least for a graduate student like me). But if you want reasonable prices, Vancouver is Not For You. The housing market here is insane; looked for days and couldn't find any non-sketchy place cheaper. So I feel like I actually got a pretty good deal, considering. (4/5 subtracting one point for general absurdity of Vancouver housing prices).

Overall: This is one of the coolest places I've ever stayed at, and I travel a lot. Michel is a great guy to work with. Wholeheartedly recommended. Feel free to message me with questions.

The pictures of this apartement are older and don't represent the current situation. When we arrived, the apartment was very dirty, with lots of spiders, dust and spiderwebs literally everywhere. Since Michel was absent, we needed to contact his daughter. She came and cleaned the place for over 90 minutes. However, later we noticed that it was still not clean and I needed to clean and vacuum all corners and the whole ceiling as it was still covered by spiderwebs.
After telling Michel about our discomfort, that we needed to do efforts to get the place fully cleaned and therefore could not enjoy ouf first day in Vancouver, he adviced us to now enjoy the beautiful day in Vancouver and go to a museum (?).
Depart the issues with our host and the cleanliness of the apartment, Kitsilano is a great neighbourhood which we very much enjoyed!

Overall, a good stay.
Pros- the location is fantastic, the suite is spacious and well laid out, very quiet, and Yi was quick to bring supplies that were needed, when asked. He also allowed us to check in 30 minutes early.
Cons- It was HOT in the suite the entire time, making it difficult to sleep. His listing said he had a/c, which he did not. When we asked about it, he indicated that the thermostat had been broken for a few weeks (which he did not tell us until we asked). However, the suite isn't even vented for central air. The upstairs suite has an electric air conditioner for THEIR suite. AirBnB had to refund us for part of the stay since he refused to do so, despite his false advertising.
Supplies were sparse. There were 2 towels & 2 hand towels for 2 people for 6 days. When I asked for washcloths to wash our faces, he brought 1 and said that was "plenty" since we had 2 hand towels. He made no effort to check in with us to make sure we were comfortable nor did he provide any instructions on check-out. Basic kitchen needs were missing or dirty- no wine bottle opener, sugar for the coffee, etc. The silverware, coffee cups and cutting board were all dirty and the cutting knives were rusty.
Despite the fantastic location and space, I would not stay again since he is not communicative nor considerate of his guests.

I loved this apartment because of the rustic vibes and open space. The location was magnificent and so close to everything. The bed and sheets were so soft and cozy that I even looked up the brand to see if I could buy some for myself! The homeless/troubled population that people mentioned is really no problem, they're not aggressive or rude in any way and I never felt unsafe walking around Gastown, day or night. Having laundry machines inside the apartment was so nice and we utilized them a couple times. The area can get noisy, as mentioned in other reviews, but I brought along my white noise maker and that covered up any noises that could've been bothersome. So I'd suggest to bring one along for any of those that are light sleepers! Tammy was super responsive and helpful and very kind. It was great to stay at an airbnb that actually looks LIVED IN again since so many nowadays are very sterile, cold, and bare feeling. The homely touches made it very cozy and comfortable. I look forward to staying at her home again in the future!

Place was as described and does what it says on the box. Restaurants and supermarkets nearby. Short walk to Gastown itself.
Numbers of homeless can make you a bit uneasy, but just avoid the worst areas.
Host accepted and refunded a last minute cancellation which she didn’t have to which we greatly appreciated.

Here’s a shortened version within 1000 characters:
I booked this property with my elderly parent and special-needs family member, but it was a major letdown. After a 12-hour trip, we arrived to find a property that didn't match the listing. The furniture was old, smelly, and uncomfortable, and the entire place had a strong moldy odor. The windows were poorly insulated, so any wind made it noisy and impossible to sleep. We left within 45 minutes and checked into a hotel, but were still charged for one night. Despite messaging the host immediately, there was no response until Airbnb followed up on our check-in. Only then did the host respond. Additionally, this property isn’t truly waterfront, with most of the view blocked by containers, and it’s over 30 minutes from downtown—not the advertised 10. Overall, the listing’s description was misleading, resulting in a disappointing experience for my family.

Well first of all when we booked this place we immediately messaged the host and let them know that we were coming down for one night and was looking forward to staying at their place, however the host never responded to our message at all.
Secondly, on the morning of traveling down to Vancouver, we checked the weather and it’s was pretty bad with snow storms on the highway and was completely unsafe to travel. We then decided that it was best not to go. So we reached out to the host and explained to them about the situation, not expecting a whole refund or anything, but just to see if there’s anything that they can do. We were hoping to hear something back from the host but again they ghosted us and never responded all!
So overall, even though we didn’t get a chance to stay at this place, I would honestly say that I just think that the host didn’t really care to communicate with their guests or anything all.

David is personable, allowed us a 1/2 hour early check-in. Was available when we had to go back to unit a few days after checking out to bring my husband some books he’d left behind.
We availed ourselves of the tea, fruit and OJ. That was a nice touch.
The exterior of the place, i.e. the garden to the main house, is lovely. And the AirBnB is in a good neighborhood.
However, the unit itself isn’t clean and modern as stated. There are serious mold issues around wash basin and tub surround as well as shower tiles. One is forced to always leave the fan on in the living room and bedroom to clear air of a persistent, musty smell.
In general, a deep clean is needed in the unit. Should that be done, the space has great potential.

I would not recommend this place to anyone, unless you like sweating all night while leasing to loud traffic noises on a poor excuse for a bed with smelly sheets. The place was advertised as an apartment but it is a very small studio with a sleeping area smaller than most hotel rooms. There is no air-conditioning so it was hot and you have to sleep with the windows open, and is next to a four lane street with very noisy traffic. The traffic noise goes on all night. The host was not available and her mother was not very helpful. It was not very clean and the pillows  and bed sheets smelled. Also there was no assigned parking so parking was always a problem.

We acknowledge that Paige and Grant were very upfront about their loud children, though it didn’t make the experience any less frustrating. The noise carries very easily from the upstairs to the basement unit. For those who plan to sleep in, there was loud banging noises starting from 7 am onwards daily. We also noticed that there were a few spots that were unclean when we got there. We also found that sometimes finding street parking near the unit was difficult. The neighboring streets seemed a little unsafe, even going on a short run. We would recommend bringing a car rather than using public transport. Overall our stay was fine - though we wish we had known these things prior to booking.

I would pay the extra money and stay away from this area. It’s not the hosts fault but you are literally one street away from the worst kind of homelessness/ drug addicts I have ever experienced. We had to take taxis everywhere we went as we did not feel safe walking in the area. The accommodation was clean but the furniture was very uncomfortable and the tv needs to be bigger.
We did not visit any restaurants locally and preferred to take taxis into downtown due to the above reasons.
We did research this area prior to arriving and what we read did not match the reality of what we experienced.
This listing does give notice of the noise from upstairs so we were prepared for this however the listing should have a caveat about the surrounding streets.
The one time we did walk to the waterfront (only 20 minutes) we had to dodge the filthy streets and we did not feel safe at all.
The hosts kept in contact throughout our stay.

On checking in there was a really dirty bathroom - soapy floor in the shower and hair everywhere.
There was zero heating - after being sick recently with the flu and moving over from Australia to the Canadian winter I needed a heater over night. I decided to leave and communicated with Louis that it was too cold to stay - he was unable to turn up the heating with minus 7 degrees outside. Louis communicated that he would give me a full refund and never did.
Avoid staying here at ALL costs and live a happier life! What an awful awful experience.

1 star for the perfect location
1 star for the good maintenance of the accommodation and the room
The disadvantages:
1. The landlady is very erratic in her behavior- in the beginning she was super nice, then later short tempered and very sharp in her tone, varying daily. She is also not resistant to stress.
2. The worst experience was the conflict over a broken fitting in the shower. The landlady repeatedly insinuated that I had caused the problem on purpose and with brute force, which is not true. I took care of the defect anyway and within 24 hours the shower was repaired (costs of $200)- Pirike´s shouting at me wasn't acceptable at all - to this day no apology received.
3. For the first two weeks I had no working wifi in the rented room and I found Pirike's answer to the problem that I could work in the kitchen during the day outrageous.
4. Watering can principle in communication with the tenants
5. The pictures are not 100% correct, because there are rule sheets everywhere

Our host was welcoming only via text messages at the start of our stay but never phoned or visited once we mentioned the problems with the property.

The neighborhood is fine, we know it well. Unfortunately the house next door is really run down and there were two nights with no sleep as they had parties until 3am! Not the hosts fault but still a problem.

The house is beautifully 'staged' with furniture, artwork, flowers, accessories etc....but scratch beneath the surface and you will find that it needs a really good spring clean! The photographs we took of dirty cups/utensils/crockery, cupboards. The toilets had hairs and dirt. There were cobwebs and dead insects, debris underneath the sofa cushions. Most cupboards and drawers are full of the host's personal clothes, paperwork and so much clutter that should be tidied up. The fridge was half full of jars/cans/bottles of produce many of which were out of date and taking up space. The freezer had half eaten ice cream! The worst area were the windows, dirty inside and out and many are covered in mold, the worst affected window is behind the bed in the master, this is a health hazard for anyone with asthma problems. We took photographic evidence and sent this to the host and Airbnb.

The cats were a problem. They are beautiful animals but they have no cat flap or litter tray. We were woken two nights by the smaller cat wanting to come into the house. The following night we kept her in but were woken by scratching on the bedroom door as she wanted to go out. The owner removed them on day three.

The owner did offer to send a cleaner in for a few hours but this would not have solved the issues of the windows and personal clutter. The house needs a week or two of attention from the owner to be fit for purpose.

This house charges a premium price and for that you expect premium quality in every respect.

It will seem incredible to Airbnb users that this is the first negative review of this house but we are truthful people, seasoned travelers and the photographic evidence cannot lie. We spoke with an Airbnb resolution case manager who could not have been more helpful and we were provided with a suitable refund.

A Waking Nightmare! Our rating of this property had to go down from 2 stars to less than 1 star due to how it was misrepresented. The description does not mention that there are 3 sets of stairs (the first outside set being unlit and impossible to see after dark), making the property inaccessible and dangerous to anyone with mobility issues and a genuine hardship to everyone else. (Aren't there local regulations about this sort of thing?) Only 3 days before we arrived, were we belatedly informed that the street and sidewalk all around the house are being totally replaced in a months-long process, necessitating that guests park two or more blocks away. There is a port-a-potty next to the front entrance, ruining photos of the view from the window. Jackhammers and dump trucks begin making all sorts of house-shaking noise at 7 a.m. daily. The internet line goes out, too, possibly due to the construction. While the construction is obviously not under the control of the renter, had we been properly informed in advance then we would have made other arrangements. Disclosures of the stairs and construction are exactly the sort of circumstances that the AirBnB Accuracy guidelines for hosts are designed for. Between not being able to park near the property and the undisclosed multiple stairways, we had to find last-minute separate accommodations for my partially-disabled mother. We couldn't risk her taking a fall, and the outrageous cancellation fee the owner offered us was impossible for us to accept. Our very first AirBnB dissatisfaction turned out to be a real doozy. If you're the right clientele for this rental, it might possibly be adequate (if you don't mind mildew, a literal hole in the wall, blood on a pillow, and other jaw-dropping evidence of disdain for guests). Contrary to how it's advertised, the property seems equipped for at most two adult parents and one to two children, none of whom have any accessibility issues. As there is only one small bathroom, a party of mixed adults (like ours) is bound to feel cramped. The fact that two of the three sets of stairs do not have hand rails will make accessing the property VERY difficult for anyone with mobility challenges (and risky for children). We were taken by surprise by the stairs, as the description of the rental did not include either the word "stairs" or "steps" or even suggest that the space is actually a self-contained third-floor attic conversion. We reasonably understood we were renting an entire house. When we mentioned this to the owner minutes after we arrived, we were essentially scolded for not having asked HER in advance about stairs. Apparently WE were at fault for taking the property description at face value. It is this mentality of blaming the person with disabilities that finally created laws protecting people with disabilities. The owner's attitude is shameful and horribly offensive. The kitchen short-circuits if you use more than one appliance at a time. This could be...

I start by saying this home is in a good location – basically not more than 30-45 minutes from any sightseeing locales. Walking distance to stores and 15 minutes from the airport. Thankfully parking was always available out front as the back space was usually taken.
Hosts were very kind and easy to deal with. Accommodated our request for early check-in. They did however provide an incorrect cell number resulting in our not being able to contact them for some assistance with the tv leaving us to resolve it on our own, which took almost an hour to figure out. I suggest they update their welcome notes.
The home is in fact their home which proved to be too much for me. Every cupboard and closet were packed with their belongings. Our groceries had to be kept on the floor/countertop due to lack of space. Had to hang our clothes next to theirs. They left a toothbrush in the holder of the master bathroom and a personal loofah in the shower. Had a dresser in the Master however the drawers did not open easily, I lived out of my suitcase. Master toilet runs continually – need to jiggle the handle and it rattles every time one gets up from it! House had a bit of a funky smell when coming in from the outside.
The kitchen is very well stocked, and they generously allow renters to use their spices/etc however this was not needed in our case. They did provide coffee beans which we very much appreciated.
We had four adults and that is enough for this home. While it can sleep 8 the common areas are not suitable for 8 adults as it would not be possible to comfortably all sit to watch tv or have dinner at the table. Also, only one shower in the home, located in the main floor bathroom (only a soaker tub with a handheld in the master upstairs). It was quite crowded on the main floor with 4 adults and when we had two additional visitors, they had to sit on a kitchen chair to converse/watch tv.
The couches are very tired and quite dirty – uncomfortable. With COVID we spent many evenings indoors and this was extremely painful on our backs and hips. Suggest getting some new furniture – or at the very least clean covers for the existing.
The main floor bedroom was not overly inviting – had extra chairs in it, clearly used for storage and a huge tv looking ready to fall over. Very basic.
Was surprised that the bed pillows provided appeared to be their own – with no protective hypo-allergenic covers. Found this to be unacceptable in this current health pandemic we are in, and more care must be given to the area of bed pillows provided. (thankfully we brought our own).
We were asked to be mindful of the tenants downstairs however this was not reciprocated and my guests sleeping on the main floor were kept awake one night by tenant activities until 1:30am. And also during the day when they played some loud music.
Netflix is provided however again this is their personal account and we were bumped out several times not able to watch movies because of others accessing the account. This was a definite issue on New Year's Eve.
We were in the home for 10 days and given only one shower it would have been nice to have a mid-week clean of the kitchen and bath. No extra kitchen dishcloths were provided – the one there was well used and soiled (could not find any others).
Did not use the backyard – we were there in December during the cold snap and unprecedented snowfall. Appears to be a nice size and would be a pleasant space to enjoy in better weather.
So, all in all, the home is in a great location but needs some definite improvements.

Excellent communication from Katie and the included parking was a blessing. Very walkable, being just on the outskirts of downtown and at the gates of the original old Chinatown but would probably not recommend for a family with younger children as the dehoused and substance-using population very heavily occupied the sidewalks and alleyways around the apartment. That said, it rarely felt unsafe.
The apartment was very well stocked with bedding, towels, and kitchen glassware and a great kitchen if you want to stay in and cook up a meal or two. The bathroom was clean, the bed was comfortable, and the building was quiet. We enjoyed our time here!

Based on the location. The price was a little too much. The host was good at giving instructions to get into the place, but unfortunately, a week before, I tried to cancel, and the host was very rude. I decided to still commit to the location to not lose any money. As she did not want to give back the full refund. Once we arrived at the airbnb. it smelled like BO. On top of it, we pay a cleaning fee of 80 dollars in the 311 dollar price. She sent us messages asking us to take out the garbage to the parking garage downstairs. Before heading back up to drop off the keys. Very unreasonable. What's the point of paying cleaning service if they expect you to do most of the cleaning.

Jay's place is great to stay in Vancouver. The place was very clean and had everything you would need for a couple of day's stay - including washer/dryer, blowdryer, Apple TV, body wash, shampoo and conditioner. We stayed 4 nights and there was enough space for the three of us. Jay's place is close to Chinatown and we didn't make use of the parking space. It was easy to catch buses to wherever we needed to go. Jay was super responsive whenever we had questions or comments when we got to the apartment.
Some of the other reviews mention that the area can be sketchy. Jay's building is in a safe area, and overall Vancouver does have a homeless problem (especially if you go east of Hastings and Main). But even walking thro' there late at night (we didn't realize it at the time), it didn't feel overly un-safe, dirty perhaps, but not unsafe.
Some tips:
1. Rent bikes from Spokes and ride around Stanley Park, its an easy beautiful ride - takes about an hour.
2. If you have time, visit the Aquarium. We ended up spending 3-4 hrs there. Spoke for quite sometime with their marine biologists and trainers. Especially the dolphin and sea otter trainers.
3. If you go to Capilano suspension bridge, get there early morning. They have free shuttles from the city and we took the earliest at 8:30 AM. Made a huge difference. The bridge and park was crowded by the time we left around 3 hrs later.
4. Restaurants: Vij's (it was ok), Union Bar (Asian Fusion - good cocktails), PureBread (get their chocolate almond croissants and regular croissants), Tuc Crafts (good food and cocktails). Gastown is good for food and drinks (tho' just know that late night on Hastings there are a lot of homeless folk - pretty harmless tho).
5. Whatever you do, you must have the coffee at Revolver. Great ambiance and coffee!
6. If you have a good group, go to Pizzeria Ludica near the apartment. They have the most amazing collection of board games to geek out on. It was a lot of fun.
We also ended up driving to Whistler (before Vancouver), and it is an easy 1.5 hr drive from the city.

I don't recommend staying in this basement, I stayed here for six days and these are some of the problems I faced.
1. The toilet bowl will regurgitate water, which was very disgusting.
2. The whole room smelled like formaldehyde, even with the windows open, the air was bad.
3. The dust in the basement is causing me allergies. I have a rash on both arms.
4. The internet signal was very poor, get stuck after swiping through a few short videos, and even couldn't see the comments.
5. You need to though stairs to enter the basement. It's very inconvenient to go in and out of the basement with a big suitcase.
6. The floor in the bathroom is slippery when it's wet, so be careful.

Beautiful apartment in a fantastic location! Tatiana's place is located within walking distance of lots of great bars, restaurants and cafes. Her suggestions of places to go were really helpful and we weren't disappointed by any!
The apartment itself was very clean and well stocked with food basics / toiletries etc. The bed is one of the most comfortable we've ever slept in!
Communication / arrival / checkout was all very easy as Tatiana is very responsive to messages and gives very clear instructions.
As a couple of people have mentioned, this part of Vancouver does have an issue with homelessness, however as many others have said at no point did we feel unsafe walking around either during the day or at night. We would highly recommend this place and urge you not to be put off by something that is a sad fact of most urban areas.

The flat looks pretty much exactly like the pictures and was extremely comfortable and in walking distance to a lot of great bars, restaurants, etc. Tatiana was an exceptional host, checking in on us and making sure that we had everything we needed. Loved the little paper-wrapped soap she left us :)
Three things to mention (that wouldn't have kept me from booking here): There was nowhere to unpack our suitcases. The flat is small and Tatiana does a great job of utilizing the space - to satisfy the OCD neat freak in me, it would have been nice to have a dresser or someplace to put our clothing.
The parking (not Tatiana's fault!) was a pain. You have to either pay for street parking 9AM- 10pm and take your chances of your car getting broken into, or shell out 20$ for all-day garage parking (adds up fast). The garage was close, but the payment app didn't work and I had to get up at 5:50am every morning to walk down there and pay for the day's parking (as it expires at 6 AM).
The other thing I will note is about the location. It is right in Gastown, a very hip and vibrant neighborhood. However it is also right on the border of some pretty sketchy territory (hence the worry about car break-ins). Walk outside to the right and head to restaurants, bars, nightlife - but walk to the left and I felt unsafe at times. Lots of people living on the street, lots of garbage and needles on the ground, lots of sirens all night long. Spending 3 days there definitely gave me a different impression of Vancouver.
All around, it was a great place to stay!

The location was great, walkable, with great restaurants and markets. The place for the price point needs a good deal of updating. The furniture was tired (dining rooms chairs sagged, bench was stained). The bathrooms were dirty with moldy curtain and hair in the tubs/showers. The towels were smelly so we had to run them through the wash before use. Had a hiccup with some furniture removal during our stay. It was an inconvenience but it was figured out and settled.
Place was ok.. bathroom was dirty ( bath had hair everywhere + mirrors very dirty)

I do not think this was worth the money. The positives - good location for getting around Vancouver, good transport links, gym and pool on site, well equipped. Bedlinen and towels were clean. Negatives - the check in procedure was very complicated and you need an app to unlock the door, so out if you dont have a smartphone. Check-in instructions also changed, I think this was because of a broken lift, so out of the owners control. It is looking very tired - shelves falling off walls, one fell down whilst we were there. It wasn't very clean, quite dusty and mirrors were filthy.
The area is very noisy, though this is not surprising based on the location. Avoid going east on W Pender street or around the park esp at night, lots of drug use going on in this area. Would not recommend for families.

Shania was a good host and very responsive. I wasn't a fan of the phone app required to unlock and lock the apartment. The location is a bit sketchy but nice that it's close to a skytrain station. The apartment was super cute but it was not clean. Hopefully the housekeeper was just having a bad day.

Shania’s place is perfectly comfortable. I was a little disappointed as it was not quite as nice as the photos. But it was a cute cozy space.
It definitely wasn’t disgusting or anything, but it could have been cleaner. It just looked a little lived in.
Overall a nice place though, great location to downtown and trendy neighbourhood. Especially good is you are going to a hockey game!!!

Very tiny unit, no balcony. Smells foul, smelled like rotting garbage upon our arrival. Rotten vegetables sitting on counter in kitchen. Not clean at all. Waited for 15 mins outside for host, took 4 tries to get her to answer. Overpriced.

Location is great but I would not stay again. Host accepted the booking based on a 3pm check-in time but then said it wouldn’t be cleaned until 6/7pm. She managed to have it ready for me to arrive but it was not fully cleaned. There were several dirty dishes in the sink from the previous booking. She offered to stop by later to “touch up” a few things but I declined as I was getting ready for an event and did not feel comfortable with someone coming into the place. The place does not feel homey at all, furniture is worn and covered in protective fabric/cloth. After removing them, I discovered a disgusting sticky coaster stuck to the headboard, and several other stains being covered on the couch. Not up to a standard I would want to stay in again.

Wouldn’t recommend this place at all. Lots wrong with, not super clean, dated furniture , awful smell ; just full on bad end-to-end. The building and location are great, the rental unit is plain horrible....
The reviews about the host are true, unpleasant check-in, lots of attitude , unwilling to be comprising to resolve poor stay experience. She likely will respond with some snarky commentary , however as a community you have the right to know what you’re getting yourself into.

Loved the location, very walkable for what I required (stayed for a week for school) and I loved being so close to Roger’s Arena and the city-life feel of overlooking the street and people watching. Unfortunately, the kitchen was not very well equipped for cooking. We had mould in our coffee maker, mould in the lid of the trash can, the oven was not sufficiently clean so we set the smoke detector off while cooking EVERY time, and the toaster was so full of old crispy bread that it also set the smoke detector off every time we used it (after we cleaned it as well). The kitchen could use some more items as well, like a baking tray for the oven, salt and pepper would have been nice as well. The pillows in the main bedroom also had a funky smell to them as well… if you’re looking for a place with a terrific location and affordability then this is a great option, but if you will be cooking the entire time like we did, be prepared to be buying a lot of extra items

The apartment is good size but the maintenance is poor:
1. Kichen faucet is terrible
2. Not inlcude enough pot and other utensils for a unit with a kitchen
3. Instruction to locate the parking is terrible
4. Can't easy to messegethe host
5. The place is noisy with the train.
Overall: 3 stars

The place was a bit overpriced, but Alex herself was wonderful!
Overpriced because while the building did have good amenities, we were in Vancouver for the first time so we were there to be out & about. Only one of us used one amenity one time, & when we did attempt to enjoy the patio & the courtyard, there were hornets all around. Location-wise, it was at least 30-60mins away from everything we went to do.
It was also more expensive than renting a whole place to ourselves was when we shared this space with the host (we had to unexpectedly switch AirBnB’s at the last minute & this was one of the only ones left available).
But pluses— Alex was kind, welcoming and very responsive! & the room/bathroom were super clean :)

If it weren’t for the location, I would recommend this place 100%. The apartment is spacious, functional, and very clean. Carmen was very responsive and helpful throughout the stay.
While Carmen was very transparent about the location in the description and by message, the neighborhood can be very disturbing. The living room window faces balconies that are often occupied, so privacy can be limited. I never felt unsafe, but walking around the area, particularly at night, can be uncomfortable. There are many buses nearby that can help you avoid this.

The place was very nice! Super open and cute and comfortable. There is no way for Netflix, if your looking for a night in like we were. And the fridge was not clean. There was actually a mouldy glass of wine and someone’s juice in there. For us it wasn’t a super big deal. It smelled bad but there was a place to clean. She does charge 2.50 per wash & dry. A totally of $5 per load of laundry. We are away from home for 14 days so it was hard because we wanted to do laundry and upon booking we didn’t see anywhere in the add that she charged for laundry. So maybe just add that somewhere very clear in the description. And as someone renting this space, read carefully. I may not choose to stay again due to the laundry but we were only looking for a place to lay our heads as we passed through. For that it was awesome!

The place is exactly as advertised. Super clean, well stocked with utensils and very comfortable. As others have mentioned the area is a little sketchy but if you're used to city living it's nothing too out of the ordinary and I never felt unsafe or worried about anything.

Mandi was extremely responsive in all of our communications. Unfortunately, this apartment is in a very rough neighborhood and it is not well represented in the description. There were several things about the apartment that were just a bit different than we expected. On arrival, the apartment appeared a bit worn and beat up. It was clean but there were no towels, no toiletries items in the bathroom and a large crack in the window. We tried to look past some of these discrepancies assuming it was the neighborhood. At check out, we were contacted and almost accused of breaking the window. I hope this isn’t some sort of scam situation they put every renter through. I was overall pretty disappointed with our experience here.

Mandi was a great host and replied very quickly, but I wouldn’t recommend the place for a stay kinder than 2-3 days. The cleaning supplies offered were not that useful (no mop or dustpan). The oven was very dirty but she sent someone over to clean it right away. Also there’s a lot of homeless people in the area so don’t go out at night alone!

We don't feel the place is ready for us to stay.  Location is ok . But the facilities in general not what we expected. We found the laundry room is filthy and still have previous tenant clothing inside the washing machine. There were dust and garbage on both sides of the gaps of the laundry machines. No laundry detergents available even host said they have . Blame the cleaning lady mistake . There were only a little paper towels available in the kitchen and no replacement. Dish washing sponge is old and dirty. A bit of smelly when first get in . Furniture in general are very old . In general the place doesn't seem clean at all.

My initial impression when walking in was great. The place matched the pictures and they had tea/ coffee available. The bathroom had soap, lotion and shampoo if needed. However, there were a couple things that were overlooked for a place people are paying money to stay. There was mold on shower curtain. The fridge door had what looked like mold on it as well. The washer and dryer were dirty. There was only 2 wash cloths available.
The location was great. It was near a bus stop and there is a train station within reasonable distance if you didn't rent a car.

The location is unique and highly desirable. It's walkable to some of the best spots in Vancouver. The roof top deck is fantastic on a summer night. The overall vibe of the place is pretty cool.
It was a total disappointment to discover that the home did not appear to be cleaned prior to arrival. We spent the first day cleaning. Bathrooms were especially bad having to clean toilets. The kitchen was covered in crumbs and the fridge and microwave were filthy. A mouse appeared in the kitchen the second night and were told basically to deal with it. The dryer ran for hours and wouldn't dry the clothes. One of the children's beds had crumbs under the covers and we had to dust the sleeping areas. Near the end of the trip we found mouse droppings behind the toy bin in the corner. We expected a basic level of cleanliness upon arrival.
Ashley and Jarrett were highly responsive hosts and apologetic for the state we found their place. We did come to a fair agreement in the end.

Maria was very kind and offered us a refund for days we didn’t stay when we ended up leaving early. She was great at communicating and had lots of info on the area to share. At the time we booked the listing looked a bit different. It did not clearly state that it was a basement suite (that I could see, and I read the entire listing multiple times over multiple days. If the info was there it was not obvious). As a young woman travelling with her teenage sister it made me uncomfortable to not be able to lock a door between us and the space upstairs which is why we left early. Seemed kind of dusty and dirty in some spots but not terrible. The listing does mention low ceilings but doesn’t mention the significantly lower doorways (I’m 5’8” and had to duck). Don’t count on the futon bed either. Very uncomfortable. It’s a decent place if you’re a lower maintenance person but personally I’d stay somewhere else if I’m ever in Vancouver again.

This suite is very basic.  It has been inexpertly renovated and the furniture is shabby.  There was a strong, damp and musty smell when we arrived and it remained for all 3 days of our stay, even though we opened windows and tried to air it out.  The couch is stained but is covered with a faded, stained,  bed sheet.  Pros:  bed was comfortable, location is great, Lisa accommodated us with an early checkin, communication was excellent, good wifi.  Damp, musty smell is odd because the place was very clean.  We do not feel that this rental provided good value for the price charged.

Good price, however I wasn't as comfortable as I had hoped to be. The space was clean and well decorated and I appreciate Johnny's great communication, friendliness and ease of check in,  but the strong mold smell, climate control issues and the noise ruined the experience for me, unfortunately. The space is clean, well decorated, comfortable bed and in a decent location,  however the  fireplace was non functional (which I wasn't told about until I asked for an additional heating option in this cold basement unit) and the kitchen didn't really have a stove- merely a rusted out hot plate.  Although there was a wall mounted heater in unit, the space was cold and drafty as the heater didn't work well in distributing the air. It was also EXTREMELY noisy in the unit at all hours of the day and night which woke me up several times (I'm a heavy sleeper) during my stay with loud clanking of pipes doors slamming, loud talking and crashing sounds as though things dropped or loud rain on a metallic roof. Street noise was also very loud. There is absolutely NO soundproofing in the space which makes things very challenging.  Overall, the space is cozy and looks just like the pictures,  but maybe visit during the warmer rain free months where temperature & mold won't be an issue as well as bring earplugs to help block out the noise.

airbnb review
host is responsive and helpful, answer your questions promptly. Close to skytrain (15mins downhill), massive supermarkets (10-15mins downhill), bus stop right outside. But the overall experience i would rate it below average.
There are rooms for improvement. Cleanliness is not satisfactory. Silverfish and spiders are often spotted in room and the shared toilets. Unfinished food and uncleaned utensils left from last tenant(s). Floor was not clean when i first moved in. Strongly recommend you clean the room yourself before you start living here
Noise is another big issue. Room above is constantly making loud noises, dragging furnitures from 10pm to 1am, and then again at 6am everyday. Old fridge in your room buzzing all time. This house has really thin walls, you can hear the host family argues and yell (often) in your room (two doors between your room and their kitchen wouldnt help). It's big no for a remote worker like me who is often in the room trying to focus.
The room has everything you need but definitely overpriced for what it offers.

Sadly the shower curtain and bed sheets were dirty. Found a lot of hair at the bottom of the sheets, one was def not mine due to the color of it. I have photos/videos of everything but I didn't want to waste my time with Airbnb on my trip. It's a hassle to deal with; I had to report this stuff before. I realize I'm outgrowing Airbnbs, the instructions and rules get longer while you're not even getting a clean place. I'd be mortified if I let a friend, family, or guest stay in a dirty bed, and I wouldn't make them take the trash out. Chesky said last year guests shouldn't do unreasonable tasks; why else would we pay a cleaning fee? Airbnb is not what it used to be; hosts used to know true hospitality; now you're strictly a financial opportunity to be maxed out. The condo itself is nice though; (can be a lot of wait time with elevators since it's a high rise.) There are many competing Airbnbs in this building and surrounding areas so hopefully one is clean. Hotels are a better bet though
Very nice accommodations with a great view. Host very helpful. Neighborhood a little sketchy. Local Tim Horton’s not recommended. Bedroom needs outlet multiplier to plug in TV.

I was very disappointed with my stay, to start off with the bathroom does NOT match the picture description given on the website. Comparing the pictures given to the actual bathroom I it very wrong.... and in the reviews when being called out about the difference in the bathroom there was a statement in which the countertop was just replaced and that’s the only difference where it is not. The whole structure of the bathroom is different, therefore false advertisement. Not only was that an issue but we did not appreciate not knowing how the laundry room was connected to the spare bedroom which also led to the upper portion of the house. Frustrated with the fact that we were also not able to get into the air bnb until 4 pm because of cleaning but when entering the venue how could it take so long for such a little area to be cleaned just for it to still be messy? And it clearly was not properly cleaned seeing as there was random shoes at the front door on the rack, hair in the bed, crumbs on the counter, a random loofa in the shower that did not belong to us alongside dirty used soap. The pictures make this area look much larger and nicer but when arriving it looked like a shoebox. I will not be booking here again after this stay and I HIGHLY advise everyone to read through the reviews before considering to stay here.

False advertising! And horribly rude host! We stayed there for 2 and half months. When we first arrived at the place on time, our room was not ready, as the place was full of dust, the bed was unmade, the carpets filthy, nor were kitchen utensils put back. The curtain shade adjuster was loosely held with one strip of tape and was bound to fall during my stay. We repeatedly tried to contact the host, we waited for 33 min until she arrived. She then forced us to wait outside for 5 hours while she start to clean the whole place herself. Despite the listing stating it has 2 beds, the place only has one. forcing one of the guest to sleep on the floor. We did not complain out of common decency and shrugged off the false advertising at the time. During the time she cleaned, she asked us to cut her grass to get a discount on our pet fee, which we obliged only to then get scolded on how the results was not up to her standard. The blame of unprofessionally cut grass falls on her shoulders, not ours, as she should hire actual gardeners instead of random people she just met. The house itself is very old and badly kept, as the nonexistent soundproofing walls allowed us to hear every toilet flush and laundry every night. The lack of soundproofing also easily arise noise complaints which the host often uses as ammunition to threaten and scold other guests rather than acknowledging the bad quality of her walls. One particularly bad night at 11pm, she waited in her garden and decided to kick out me and my guests as they were coming in, without any prior warning and prior complaints, she evicted us on the spot in the dead of night through complaints that was never stated in the house rules such as “using too much hot water” and pulled out the noise complaint card which we were never aware there was any. She refused us to take back our own property, such as our own legal documents and passports, from the home until we had to convinced her that we would pack fast. Even so, she refused to let the only person of color guest back to retrieve their property through racist and discriminatory reasons. Definitely do not pick this Airbnb unless you like unsolicited scoldings and instantaneous evictions without prior warning or knowledge of why.

This was clearly the worst Airbnb experience I've ever had !
Not because of the flate which was nice actually. Seems smaller when you are in it than on the pictures but appart from that: good location, you can really live in it, rest, prepare food properly...
The problem here is the host. Because he is not a host, he is a professional renter who doesn't live in the flate he is renting.
First: we had the worst welcoming I've ever had on a Airbnb experience. Because he had to wait half an hour for us (I've done some Airbnb, I know about waiting guests), Jorge was clearly pissed off and offered us the fastest check in I've seen : "the keys or here, laundry card here, all the informations on the fridge. Bye bye" !
Not the best first impression of a country you've just made a 13 hour flight to visit....
But the worst part was that we had a water leak in the bathroom one night. Jorge reacted but the problem took a really long time to be solved. We rented the place a thousand dollars the week, one of our night in Vancouver was ruined by that (we could only go to sleep at 2 am because of the waiting) and it was only solved the day after.
I asked for Jorge a gesture of 15% of the price we paid because of that, so around 150 dollars. He said ok but I've been insistant about that because I didn't trusted him and had no answers from him 48h after the check out.
I launched a procedure on Airbnb to get that money and he said I was pressurizing him, threatening him to get my money and he made a wire transfer of 47 dollars without a word... probably thinking it would be enough but it's not. Not to get a good review anyway....
DO NOT STAY HERE! Bed bugs infested in upstairs loft bed. We had to transfer to a hotel. Aside from that, the apartment is dated and unclean, and the check in process was a major hassle. AVOID!

BED BUG INFESTATION!!!! This apartment was infested with bed bugs. We did not find them until our final day and therefore the host is refusing a refund (offering only 30% off to stay there again - you couldn't pay me to stay there again). We did receive bites earlier in our stay. On the last morning we found bed bugs in all three beds. We took pictures of the bugs and provided them to the host. We then found out the host had been aware of the situation previous to us staying there. The apartment had been treated a few weeks earlier but not properly inspected before having guests as it was not hard for us to find bugs once we knew they were there (tapping the couch cushion led to them running out of couch). We were very disappointed that we had not been given any warning of this situation. We ended up having to spend our vacation time cleaning our belongings and inspecting them so we did not infest other locations or our own homes.
The home is well located but was very hot and stuffy in the middle of the summer. The a/c did not reach the bedroom. We were only provided one key which made it difficult when our group wanted to split up.
I would avoid staying here based on our experience and the dealings with the host after finding bed bugs.

Location is ideal if your trip includes taking in the Granville street entertainment.  But there were bedbugs in the apartment...  I provided pictures and video for Airbnb.  I made my reservation 7 months ago.  And at that time, he had nothing but positive reviews.  But in June, August, and now October, there are reported complaints of bedbugs.  I'm writing this review so that the problem gets addressed and hopefully corrected for good.  I don't want to put anyone out of business; it's a good location and can be an awesome place to stay.  But the bedbug issue cannot be corrected without removing all the recycled furnishings, exterminating, and replacing with new furniture.  As I have now learned, if you experience something like bedbugs, contact Airbnb immediately to get alternative lodging arrangement.  Do not wait for the property owner to respond.  In our case, he didn't respond until our last night when it was clearly too late to do anything to help.

Very dirty with hidden fees.
This was a very disappointing stay. We had to come for a funeral and reserving the place was fast and easy.
However that was probably the highlight of the trip. We checked in but couldn’t find the parking pass right away which was unsettling because there are signs everywhere saying they will tow vehicles with no pass.
When we finally were able to reach the owner he informed us that parking was an extra $60, which we had no choice but to pay. Once we had checked in, we started to notice how dirty it was. The fridge still had food in it and stunk like Clamato. The floors were not cleaned, there was dust everywhere, the beds were full of sand and not properly cleaned, there was candy wrappers and garbage and a build up of dust under the couch, there was no hand soap only dish soap in bathroom, cobwebs found in the bedroom, and it smelt old.
Check out was unclear and was not as described in the check in/out instructions.
Like I said we were here making final arrangements so we had no choice but to continue to stay there but I would never go back or recommend to anyone. Location was great though.

Great location and clear communication around checking in and out.
However, I wouldn’t recommend this place for four adults as the sleeping arrangements do not work. In addition, there wasn’t enough cutlery for four people so we couldn’t even get a takeout.
The apartment is also in need of a freshen up with the carpets and furniture all a bit tired and in places broken. Sleeping was also challenging as all the blinds were partially damaged which let in an awful lot of light.
When we arrived there was a notice indicating the property was being inspected for bed bugs between 8 and 12 one morning. This meant we had to be around. We would have liked the hosts to let us know about this in advance.
In summary this was one of the worst AirBnB experiences I have had and we all left disappointed. I would recommend the property has a substantial upgrade before it can be advertised as a stylish executive condo.

I don’t usually leave negative reviews, but this was a terrible experience and future guests should know. The host reminded me three times to lock the door. In China, it’s not common to lock the door every time we go in or out, so I forgot. After that, she spent about 30 minutes complaining in a very negative tone. I sincerely apologized seven times and explained the cultural difference, but she kept repeating the same accusations, which made me feel uncomfortable and stressed. On check-out day, I stayed 40 minutes longer to take some photos. When she returned, she got very angry and told me to leave immediately. I politely asked her to take a photo for me in the living room, but she said no and kicked me out. It was raining and I had nowhere to go. The room also didn’t provide slippers or some basic amenities. The host is extremely strict and not understanding of cultural differences or small mistakes. This was a terrible and unpleasant experience.

We had a very disappointing stay at Kinuyo’s place. The host was unresponsive to messages throughout our stay. The property had a very bad smell and the fridge was unusable. On the second night, there was no power in both of the rooms, forcing our family to sleep apart. The breaker/power room was locked, and despite reaching out, the host did nothing to resolve the issue in a timely manner. Overall, the experience was frustrating and uncomfortable. I would not recommend this place. We were about to leave the place but airBnb customer line was also very helpful

I booked this unit for a month and due to some unfortunate circumstance had to leave only one week through. The host agreed to post the unit back up on Airbnb instead of refunding me the money and even the Airbnb representative mentioned that it he should have... Oh well.
That being said the place is beautiful and exactly as shown in photos. The location on the other hand seemed a bit dangerous as it was extremely close to a notoriously sketchy crack head area.

I could not get in to the unit as the door would not open, even though the electronic lock seemed to be working
I could not get a hold of Richard.
After over an hour Richard called me but I could not hear him. This happens several times of either me calling him or he calling me, I could not hear him.
Richard finally texted me after more then 1.5 hours but I had given up and arranged alternate accommodation. I respectfully asked for a refund.
Richard emailed me the next day saying the door worked fine and somebody had stayed in the place and he would not agree to a refund.
After 3 days Richard agreed to a refund on the understanding that I would give him a good review.
This has all the hallmarks of a scam, and could happen to you. I am really considering not using Airbnb in the future as a result of this experience.

When I checked into the 1st unit it was very dirty, dusty and did not smell fresh. I called and ask for an air freshener but the response I got took me by surprise. Marika responded by saying that she could refund me if i didn’t want to stay, I was shocked at her response. I didn’t reply and she sent another message saying “I want you to be happy so if you need a refund let me know’ I still did not respond because all I asked for was an air freshener. Eventually after not getting a response from me she came & met me in the hall way and gave me another unit that was clean, smell fresh, and was a wayyy better unit. We settled in and all went well

Apartment and description is accurate, however, I was a little disappointed to find out the sofa bed was broken on the day of check in although it appears to have been an issue for at least 2 weeks based on other reviews. The replacement bed was a very light mattress on the floor which was not ideal, for this reason I'd say the apartment is only suitable for max 2 people sharing the bed.
Unfortunately, our checkin was delayed for over an hour as it looked like the cleaner had only started when we first arrived. Katherine did try to get in contact with the cleaner when we said we’d take a walk and come back, but we ended up just finishing the last of the cleaning ourselves as we were tired from traveling and just wanted to get settled. Katherine offered us the extra hour for late check out.
The apartment is in a really great location and the balcony is nice and spacious. Noise from the upstairs apartment does travel though so I wouldn't recommend for light sleepers.

A bit pricey but of course you will get a good location and a bonus parking!
Tricky check-in because there’s two different keys. You will have to go back en forth upon check-in and out, a bit of a hassle as to why the keys has to be separated but what can we do.
Although outside of the building seems dirty and looks like there’s bed bugs, the unit itself is clean.
Overall, it was a pleasant stay! Perfect location!

The place was a comfortable, beautiful, and in close to the restaurants we wanted to visit. We walked most places and while there are sketchy spots the sketchy folks kept to themselves. We’d definitely stay again.

Great apartment and host. It is a very nice space, central and clean. The host is very nice and super responsive.
However the area is described as safe but a little unsettling. I think that is not accurate. The apartment is at the edge of the street where all addicts and homeless stay. I would not recommend for solo female travelers. I had trouble getting close to the front door one late afternoon as an addict was trying the com and hanging at the door. Nothing may have happened but as a woman that felt very unsafe

I had asked for a room for 3 people and had even messaged beforehand to confirm a mattress. Having arrived fairly late at night, we found there to be no mattress and no alternate space for the third person and had to make other impromptu arrangements. Extremely disappointing despite having been given a refund for the one person

Barry gave me the wrong room number and code. I walked in on a past-out guest in a filthy room up to some suspect activity. I called airbnb and cancelled - it took forever because the host was being unresponsive. Shady spot.

This place has a good location for those who plan to travel by public transportation. Parking is limited but not awful.
If you have a small child or infant, this host has nothing to accommodate your child such as baby tub or crib.
Be aware that the host is slow to respond and can be completely unresponsive.

I had high hopes for this place as Miriam had explained there would be many amenities, fresh flowers, milk/cream etc. The pictures indicated a big, well-lit space. However, the pictures were misleading (smaller, dim space), few amenities were missing, cluttered areas, spider webs were in the living room and it wasn't explicitly mentioned that other people would be staying upstairs. This wasn't a big issue for me and my family but I thought I would bring it to Miriam's attention. I sent her a message without asking for any refund/discount. Her response was inconsiderate explaining that if she were a guest the spider webs would have been a plus for her. This left a negative impression for the rest of the stay. She also said we could leave early and issue a refund instead of fixing the problem. Definetly not worth the price and would not recommend it. If the pictures were more accurate to what the space was like and the host was more considerate the stay wouldn't have been disappointing.

This space is not as advertised! We were sharing the space with others and only had access to the bedroom, dining room and were restricted in the kitchen.
Upon arriving 30 minutes after the host said we could check-in, she was still cleaning the bathroom. We waited 10 minutes for her to finish cleaning before she responded to our questions and showed us around. Then she spent 20 minutes telling us how to recycle. When we asked about sitting in the living room, she said we are not allowed to due to COVID and it's harder to clean the fabric. Under the impression that she is conscious about COVID-19 precautions, we were under the impression we'd have the space to ourselves and not have to share with others. Upon trying to explain the situation to the host and negotiate a partial refund, she got angry and altered what she had initially said to us. We walked out after being in the space for 30 minutes.
