The host then followed us out, picked up the key from the mail box and went back inside. Didn't bother to clean the key or door handles.

Do not stay here long term, the host is incredibly rude and unprofessional.
Pros:
- great location
- good bedroom, lots of space and big window
- big kitchen
- patio with nice greenery
Cons:
- owner literally said she hated me
- Garbage is an open diaper box and whatever bag is lying around for recycling, incredibly gross and unkempt. She sorts through the garbage very loudly between 12-3AM (up to an hour at a time, I counted, from my room across the house)
- she will accost you for messes left from other tenants (example: she yelled at me multiple times for someone else using my sponge (#2) and leaving it wet in the sink)
- oven is broken, toaster oven sparks dangerously, old dishwasher leaks brown stuff (she claims I “put something in it”)
- she kills fruit flies not with a swatter (which has “chemicals”) but by slapping a wet rag on the kitchen surfaces, again loudly and after midnight
Short term stays are fine if you’re just sleeping here, but expect a 15-20 rant about other bad tenants (I witnessed each new tenant’s intro, where she introduced me as “annoying”)
I spent 2 long months here, and this barely covers all my complaints (yet they keep coming as she harasses me on airbnb messages with nasty words (“my 5 star guest” then “coward”, “unhealthy”, “filthy”) and lies that I’ve damaged or stolen items and left the place filthy, which I have photos to prove I left in perfect condition.
Avoid if you can.

Location is about a 5 minute walk to the sea wall, choices and shoppers are both close by! Tons of restaurants of all variety near by! Robson street is also super close. However, the place was very dirty and messy. It wasn’t cleaned at all, was super dusty and not cleaned at all.

Firstly, this is NOT a luxury home. It’s getting closer to a Motley Crüe flop house and has NOT been properly maintained In the slightest.
The furniture needs a deep cleaning as it’s dirty and disgusting.
There is carpet in the upstairs Bedrooms that are stained dirty and look like they haven’t been shampooed in a very long time which is concerning.
Overall the homes condition is average with some of the rooms having spray paint to cover old wallpaper.
The most concerning of all is the giant gaping hole in the ceiling above the dinner table that the owner decided to cover with a piece of cardboard and thumbtacks so every time someone showers or flushes the toilet water flows significantly from that hole in the roof through the cardboard onto your meal… Positively disgusting.
Upon trying to bring this to the owners attention, we were blamed for not having a walk-through where they can point this out? It doesn’t change the fact that time of rental the condition and stead of the home was not actually were accurately reflected In the rental status or brought to our attention those are things any renters should positively absolutely know when advance as they are unacceptable for the amount of money we’re being charged.
The pictures of the home or not the Home now and grossly miss represent what it is. I would never spend $1000 plus a night for this house ever ever again stay away!!!’

Don't stay there, the host communicate in a very aggressive and disrespectful way to the guests, she even insulted me.
The host provided me a basket to put my recyclable items in and they told me to leave it by room's door on Thursdays and they will take it out.
One day, when I threw out my garbage in the non-recyclable bin, I found her sending me a message containing photos of some recyclable items that I put in the wrong bin combined with aggressive words on how the recycling process is very clean and that I shouldn't have missed it.
I decided to keep every paper box and plastic container(after washing it) in the basket they provided and told her that I'm going to check with her before throwing it away.
At my day of checking out, she wasn't home, I left her a message that I kept the recyclable items so that she can check and make sure no non-recyclable items there. I did that with the intention of avoiding having them fined or anything like so. Also, that's aligned with the instruction they provided me in the first day.
When she came home and found the basket, which again contains only paper boxes and clean plastic containers that I washed, she sent me a message insulting me for that!!! I'm very disappointed, will never stay there again.

The location is the best part of this place. Quiet yet an easy 7-10 minute walk to commercial drive, which has plenty of shops and restaurants. Getting downtown was more of a trek, but the city has bike rental stations nearby the BnB. The space itself was quite crammed and in the basement, with no air flow. This results in growth of black mold in the shower, which was concerning to say the least. There is only the one window in the main area that can provide limited airflow. The bathroom is incredibly crammed with little to no counter space and cannot have the door open and be able to get in the shower at the same time. Overall however the room was clean besides the mold. As others mentioned the noise level was sometimes loud upstairs mainly with footsteps but it was few and far between and did not disrupt us much. This is a nice, decent space to spend a few days in if you are only using it to sleep.

Lovely apartment that’s very central to everything. Area of the apartment is quite sketchy and wouldn’t recommend to anyone travelling alone.
Enjoyed our stay :)

A contemporary apartment in a very rough neighborhood. There is lots of drug use around the area and we did feel unsafe walking around. The apartment was unfortunately very unclean. When we arrived the sheets had not been cleaned, I went to wash them myself. As I took off the sheets, the mattress was full of blood stains and did not have a mattress protector on it. There was garbage left in the kitchen drawers. As well, the bathroom shower had not been cleaned. Overall the space is nice but needs a professional cleaning service to maintain it.

I stayed in this condo for one month. I chose this place after seeing so many good comments... I was really disapointed when I got there and it was so dirty. Body hair in the shower, the toilet was super dirty, as well as the floors and the kitchen. There were no towels to be found and the closets were full of stuff... Really messy.
I have to say Michael was really reactive, as soon as I messaged him saying that it was dirty he answered and sent someone while I was at work. The cleaner emptied the trash can... and that's it. I had to go buy cleaning products and do the cleaning myself. Pretty upsetting considering that you pay cleaning fees.
The ad says full kitchen... They barely have forks and knives. I wasn't able to cook properly as I tought I would.
The ad says hair-dryer... again... it was nowhere to be found.
The sofa is all ripped, the bed makes a whole lotta noise.
The building is new and well located but I wouldn't stay here again.

Lee is a great host! Very receptive to questions and offered great suggestions of things to do in the city. The apartment was very clean. Only thing is that the apartment seems to be located in/near a sketchy-ish neighborhood...lots of people walking around on drugs at night time. But, they generally leave you alone and I never felt unsafe at Lee's place itself.

I was expecting an awesome property because of the photos and reviews but I was very disappointed seeing the cleanliness of the entire place especially our bedroom. It appeared as though the sheets/bedding had not been changed since the last guest and there was dust and surfaces that could have been swept/wiped. Decor and linens were different than pictured and specifically the duvet was paper thin like a sheet and no other blankets were provided (thankfully I brought my own comforter) The location is great if you are needing the LRT or going to a hockey game, concert or football/soccer games since the stadiums are steps away... but in terms of safety I feel like the area was pretty sketchy. Host was pretty quiet except for the last night when it was past the quiet time hours and the front door was slammed a few times, waking us up. We felt out of place using the common areas so when we were home we were just in the bedroom (which wasn’t a problem) Another complaint would be the cooling and lighting situation in the bedroom, it was super hot due to no air conditioning and there was no overhead lighting, just two small, very dated lamps. Lastly, the listing lacked the proper information for getting into the building and using the fob/parkade remote. We had to figure out most things on our own even with asking the host directly. The concierge and two strangers helped a lot. We also felt a tad awkward having to keep asking questions.

Unit was clean and well maintained. Security was good and felt very safe inside. Some of the amenities could be updated/upgraded (e.g., old iron that stains, broken sliding door to closet). Very convenient to metro. Lee had good, proactive instructions and was overall quick in response to questions. Description was accurate and Lee was kind to offer a bag holding service
Main disappointment was the neighborhood. Significant homeless population right outside the unit and blocks away from DTES/East Hastings Street. Came to learn this area is a well-known open air drug market with IV drug use in broad daylight. I didn't feel personally threatened walking during the day, but this was not a neighborhood I felt comfortable being out at night. Would not recommend this area for anyone travelling with kids/families.
While the room is a good deal for easy access to downtown Vancouver & Lee was a fine host, the area is a real negative and visitors need to be aware of this prior to staying.

The location was convenient, and the host was very responsive and helpful. He provided a useful video for parking and quickly assisted when we had trouble entering.
The space is a shared apartment, and the master bedroom is right off the living area. The host spent a lot of time in the living room, which made it feel less private, especially with the TV on late at night. The apartment had a musky smell, and the sheets didn’t feel freshly laundered. But, the host provided body wash, shampoo and conditioner - in the bathroom - which was a thoughtful touch.
The area is quite noisy, which the host noted, and earplugs were provided. However, the surroundings near the building and parking garage felt unsafe due to the presence of homeless individuals, although we felt safe once inside. The entrance to the garage was also a bit unclean and had a persistent smell.
Overall, the host was kind and communicative, but the shared setup and location may not be ideal for everyone.

Amazing location, check in was easy, apartment is well furnished. Lee was very responsive and helpful. We noticed some mold in the master bedroom and were refunded the cleaning fee. Overall it was good value
Apartment was not clean. Old food personnel belongings, dirty towels, bedding felt unwashed.

Host was very helpful, just needed better check-in instructions (photos of entry an its keypad, and garage parking (you need the following key to activate the garage gates as well as the secured elevators and garage stairs). Great location for restaurants and sightseeing. Not as clean as photos shown on listing (dirty fridge, bath trash, dirty flower vase, cleaning supplies left out)--bought towels to make sure they were clean--and owners had personal stuff left out. I'm also a host so maybe I'm extra picky with cleanliness. (It's more like visiting a friend who's out of town, only you don't know if the towels and bed sheets were properly cleaned), maybe use white towels and sheets. Thought apartment would  be more tidy and pristine and better shape, more Iike the photos. Also, 2nd bedroom need a nightstand and table lamp. Good city views, no noisy.

I cannot recommend this place. The area is awesome, the check-in was good. But the communication was terrible! First we had a long discussion about the costs of the apartment because I refused to pay more than the official price (after communicating with Airbnb we solved it and I did not pay more, but it was very annoying!). I did not get Information about how to get to her place and I could not reach her because she was in Portugal during my stay. The kitchen and the tub was dirty. The room was clean. I would not recommend it and will certainly not chose this place again!

If you are looking for a great location this a great location.
If you are looking for a secure room I would go elsewhere. There are no locks on the room doors.
If you are looking for a clean modern place this is not the place to go. Cleanliness was not a high priority.
Lastly, photos of many places including this place are very misleading. Makes the place look better than it really is.
I overall would not recommend.

Location is great!! However room is not. I stayed here for a week with my girlfriend the room was not the cleanest and was run down. The worst part was not having any sort of cleaning service as it's part of a hotel and the room is basically a hotel room. We were initially given only two towels and I asked if we could get new ones daily and he said you only get to swap them once during my whole week stay so bring your own towels. This was the same case for the bedsheets so we had to use the same sheets for half the week and the same towel . If your staying for a long time I wouldn't recommend this place instead I would book directly through the hotel as it's the same price and you would get daily maid service. Not impressed or happy with this place but we still made it work half way through the week we had to place all our garbage outside as there was no place to bring it. Would not stay here again.

Based on our recent stay, we feel confused by the high ratings this property has on Airbnb. The unit is basically adequate for our family but not what I would expect in the Kitsilano area and at this price point. It felt a bit rundown and dingy. It was as if someone had just checked out 10 mins before we checked in.
The unit was clean-ish. Floors and counters were clear. However, my son accidentally pushed some of his toys under the media unit, and it was pretty disgusting with dirt and hair and a whole wack of previous guests junk left underneath. Same for the bedrooms. Bunkbed had broken slats and loose rails, was gross underneath and there was some random clothing and other items left in the closet by previous guests (?)
The kitchen was stocked with some basics like peanut butter and salt/pepper but also a whole variety of half used and discarded items we can only assume were left by previous guests (eg. tupperware with 3 dried dates inside, a ziplock baggie of random coffee grounds, half eaten tub of ice cream). The bathroom was the same, stocked with some decent shampoo and conditioner but also a mess of junk left in the cabinet (crumpled pouch of wipes, partly used travel sized toiletries, and a filthy box with some bandaids).
There were also some unusual things missing from the unit (eg no Kleenex, no lids on any garbage cans - problematic if you have young kids in diapers) and despite it being listed in the ad, there were no beach towels / toys. There were some books and puzzles for kids available which was appreciated but almost all were missing pieces.
Finally, the unit was quite noisy. We understood from the listing that there would be some kid noise until 7 or 8 pm however, on the night of our arrival the owners had a party upstairs. There was tons of banging and furniture being scraped along the floor until well past midnight. It was not the kind welcome we were expecting.
Overall the property was basic and adequate but rundown / dingy and not what we would expect to see in this neighborhood and certainly not at this price point. We would not stay here again.

BEWARE of the Parking!! This is only allowed in a Visitor garage that has a 6-hour limit. I messaged Dave after paying for the booking telling him that we were driving into town for our 2-night stay, so he knew we would need access to the garage. No where on the listing did it state that overnight parking was not included - also, none of the 3 public garages we tried nearby had overnight options (only hourly until 10pm or monthly).
Upon arriving, we were not given any information about the required parking pass (does not waive the 6-hour limit) and repeatedly tried calling Dave for AN HOUR before he finally answered. He suggested we try moving the car to a different space each night, as if we were children trying to get around the rules. There was no way we were going to risk our rental car being towed (the garage was almost empty, so I doubt they wouldn't notice a red SUV with a California license plate staying there longer than 6 hours!!). He gave no options to resolve the matter and flippantly said we could just cancel and get a refund. It was already close to 7pm (thanks to waiting around for an hour for him to respond) and so we had to book a hotel room for twice the amount I had already pre-paid Dave.
Also, the room was sparse as the pictures show, but was much more run down than I expected. The thermostat was broken with no cover, and the bed was disappointing to even sit on. I'm glad we didn't stay there. We would have been cold and uncomfortable.

This place was a disappointment to us. Firstly check-in was a complete debacle. The intercom registry name given in the Airbnb advert did not match any in the list! We eventually were able to contact Dave (after getting wifi from Starbucks across the road) who told us the right number to contact Stella only to find she didn't answer the phone!! We waited outside for about an hour before Dave eventually found a way to let us in. So not a great start after a long journey from Vancouver and hold ups at the border.
The place is very simple and quite stark however it is in a very good location. However the blinds need fixing as they let in too much light in the morning and the sheets looked disgusting.
Dirty & tatty and hugely over- priced. The towels were old and filthy as was the flat. The only good thing was the location.

Overall poor host communication and check in/out. wouldn’t stay here again.
Checkin required coordinating timing to meet up with a person and be handed the keys, which is a bit inconvenient. It’s even more inconvenient if your travel plans change or are at later hours. We had to ask a family member to go get the keys at the last minute, messaging the host as our flight took off because the listed number on the Airbnb page didn’t work.
Similarly, there were no checkout instructions for what to do with the keys when we left, and we didn’t receive a response before leaving the morning of checkout.
During our stay, the host had a cable repairman come by in the morning unannounced to fix the TV, which we weren’t even using. We checked our phones and the host had sent a message 10 minutes beforehand telling us the repairman was coming (and offering to cancel if we didn’t want him to) but we didn’t see it before he arrived. So we let the repairman in, confused, and had to wait for him to finish before we could leave for the day.
We asked for a slightly later checkout than 10am so we could enjoy the one day of nice weather on the patio, but they denied the request saying there were other guests arriving that day. But there weren’t. We could see the wide open availability in the Airbnb calendar. We asked again, pointing this out, and they said they would consider it. We just chose to change some plans and leave on time.
The condo was clean, tasteful, and seemed new. but we generally felt was overpriced for what it was — the common area hallways smelled smokey/musty, the living area was quite small, and there were some quality quirks (like the dishwasher tipping entirely out of the counter when the drawer was open and had dishes in it.)
The location is awesome, between kits beach and all the great food and shops on west 4th. and the little bit of time we got on the patio without rain was very nice.

Not a place I would stay at again. The host outsources management of the Airbnb to an outside company. Check-in process was very poor with no instructions provided until we were at the apartment and had to call the management company to find out where the lockbox was. No information was provided in the apartment about check-in or check-out.
The apartment was stuffy and had a musty smell the entire time we were there. It's a two bedroom apartment meant for 4-6 people yet we were provided only 4 bath towels and 1 hand towel. There was no bath mat. The towels provided were damp and left lint on your body. There were also dirty, used towels left in the closet. There were also old stains on the pillowcases and bedsheets, and there was dust on the shelves and headboard.
The apartment was advertised as having a washer and dryer. However, it's actually a building washer and dryer in the basement where you have to pay to use. The laundry room required a key to enter and the host did not provide this key. Numerous calls and messages to the host went unanswered and we ended up having to drive our laundry downtown to a laundromat to wash.
Overall, not a comfortable stay. On the plus side, the apartment had underground parking included and is in a good location.

We would not stay here again. The condo was in close proximity to Kits Beach & very walkable.  It is beautifully remodeled & the sleeping accommodations were very comfortable.  After booking the unit, we realized it did not have air conditioning (our fault for not reading more closely).  We messaged Sean prior to the deadline for a partial refund to inquire about fans in the unit or another property with AC, he did not respond. A school and an apartment building were under major construction on the block, not disclosed. On the first floor with a backyard shared by several others, there were no screens or locks on the windows which did not feel safe for us or our two young girls. Heavy footstep noise from the upstairs neighbors started by 5:00am, even on the weekend. When my husband called Sean to discuss our concerns,  he was argumentative, rude, & not helpful - stating he was busy, wasn’t going to do anything for us, & hung up the phone. We were there to honor a deceased loved one. 😔

Sean was awesome. We came from a nightmare host and he made everything easy. I’ve stayed at a handful of airbnbs and never had any issues with any hosts since we always follow rules and respect our hosts (except the one aforementioned nightmare host). Thanks to Sean and the other good hosts out there. After we had to vacate the other home, he let us in early then had his cleaner come as well. Could not have asked for anything more or better from Sean. Thank you again, Sean!!!

The first few days of our stay were pleasant — the space was comfortable and conveniently located. However, on the last day, the host became extremely rude after a noise issue due to office calls in the shared area. She was extremely rude even when I apologised. There were also some unexpected house rules, like restrictions on towel changes and dishwasher use only at the end of stay, which weren’t mentioned in the listing. The open kitchen compost attracted flies, and my concerns about it weren’t addressed. Overall, while the stay started well, the experience ended on a negative note, so future guests should be aware.

I’ve never given a place a bad review and I’ve been with Airbnb since 2017. If the place isn’t good, I just don’t leave one.
The day I get here, the room is dirty, the beds looked like someone slept in them. I sent pictures to the host and he didn’t answer. He lives in Malta. A late reply saying “it’s probably the cleaners”. Food items stolen. The shower head doesn’t work. The host didn’t still reply. Cleaners only 1 time in the 30 days. The worst is the power gets shut down as the host hasn’t paid the bills. We sleep in the cold with no heat, lights or hot water. He replies after 16 hours saying “should be back in an hour”. Gas gets shut down with a notice on the wall. The jacuzzi doesn’t work, house carpets are stained & dirty, The kitchen is just ok. Pool table works. The room is dirty under the bed frame, stained carpets, bathroom is bad, the bedspreads are dirty. Concept is make money, don’t maintain and don’t respond. $2500 is not worth for this. Same for the other rooms.

This is a tight, commercially run Airbnb with four separate rooms and a common area. You enter with a code and then the rooms are numbered and individually locked.
It's a decent arrangement if nothing goes wrong.
If anything does go wrong though, you are on your own.
In my case the power went out in my room and the heating was not running so I was left freezing in the pitch dark.
I tried reaching out to the hosts but they were not able to fix anything until after I left in the morning.
They also ignored my requests for a partial refund.
I wasn't rude or abrasive and I gave them
many chances to reply, they have just decided to ignore me entirely so now here I am writing an easily avoidable negative review...
Tragic really.
Hopefully they fix things up a bit and learn t communicate a bit better?

-had to walk through cigarette smoke with INFANTS upon arrival with no apology
-failed to warn about serious construction directly in yard
-no hot water in mornings
-dodgy wifi and cable
-very loud thumping late at night
-ticking from branches in main room and also a loud ticking from upstairs often
-floors got socks and babies clothing dirty and greasy?
-to grab my fallen phone I had to move the couch which revealed solid DUST and a large not clean area
-Marias complaint towards us with our 2 one year old was yogurt spread on the table and dirty linens from a SUDDENLY sick child
-tried to explain on the phone after Maria messaged me ‘appalled’ and she swore and hung up on me after saying we have not taken care of our children because there was a mess in her Airbnb

I have to say this was my worst Airbnb experience so far! Reservation was cancelled on the day of check-in, or to be accurate, two hours AFTER the specified check-in time! Called, emailed, and texted the host multiple times while waiting outside of the house with my luggage (no one was home,) but received no response. Two hours later, a message from Airbnb came saying that the reservation was cancelled. I understand that we all have other priporties in life, but the lack of communication was really disappointing!

This listing is quite dirty (stains, unfinished flooring, cobwebs on light fixtures) and has an off-putting smell. I checked out shortly after checking in and Chris only offered to refund half of the cost after negotiating with airbnb for 3 days.
Its in a good location and the neighbourhood felt safe, but I unfortunately cannot recommend this airbnb to anybody.

NOT WORTH IT.
I have never had a negative experience with any host or airbnb. Thank Goodness Airbnb refunded this expensive reservation. In order of importance:
______1. Host was unwilling to work with us on problems we encountered. Seemed their location and decorations were being overvalued and there were other issues that needed attending to which I will describe here.
______2. SOMEONE LIVES IN THE BASEMENT. Not disclosed on initial profile. *After payment* they send you a "House manual" and under "Suite" they list that someone occupies the basement. In your living room/kitchen area there is a staircase to a doorway, where someone lives. Where you park your car, is next to their kitchen window, as it is UNDER your living space. You share the entire property with them, and they walk up the driveway to their entry as you sit on the patio they show.
- He told us it was not misleading as we could have read the manual in full and cancelled within 24 hours after.-
Why isn't this disclosed BEFORE payment under "INTERACTIONS WITH HOST"-???
______3. NOT CLEAN!!!
KITCHEN- EVERY SINGLE CABINET OR SHELF--NOT 1 AVAILABLE!.... PANTRY: Every single pantry shelf had OLD condiment bottles(EASILY OVER 50), jarred spoiled food, live bugs crawling over and under it, as well as dead bugs under all of it as we tried to remove it. The entire fridge door was taken again by old food.
Host Response: You can remove it, as long as you put it back.
The amount of work it would take was too much to clean as it was similar to moving into an occupied dirty apartment. Not move in ready. There was nowhere to put all of it due to the amount and also just the bugs and dirt that needed to be cleaned just to use 1 shelf at a time... we stopped after the second drawer, and called the host. We sent pics to Airbnb of the dirty conditions and amount of food. (expiring in 2016) Why are we keeping that?
______4. No storage, 3 day stay fine. Not cooking or unpacking. 17 day stay, we have an issue. Every dresser and cabinet is locked (saying cabin effects). We actually did not have anywhere except 1 cabinet downstairs, and a few shelves upstairs to put clothes away. Bathroom, no storage, all locked including vanities. 2 drawers available over a heat duct that will melt anything in it.
Host Response: "I don't want you stealing my booze!"
______5. Shades in the listing: False unfortunately IN MAIN LIVING AREA.
Living room faces a busy but beautiful view, full of people strolling daily. Rods there, No shades. No privacy .. Huge windows. Least of our concerns obviously.
______6. Host was only willing to compromise if you can call it that in this area: You can remove my stuff ( Old food) if you put it back . I am not refunding your money. (No other compromise on any other level.)
We called Airbnb, asked for a refund, and provided pictures. The backyard was not happening for relaxing or using at all! Due to the amount of junk from the basement person. Not surprising that there are NO photos of this on the listing. GUESTS_____Beware of nice photos, and pretty furniture in a log cabin. Cabins are fun! BUT______Practicality and real cleanliness, as well as a host who is willing to work with you when problems arise and cares about your comfort level IS IMPORTANT. What a shame as it is a beautiful location and home with so much potential.

Absolutely amazing stay in Vancouver! Amazing View, Communication, Location, Decor, Amenities, Nearby Restaurants, etc.
Check in was easy!
We traveled as a family of 6. The 3rd bedroom is a small room with just a bed, but it was perfect for my group.
The neighborhood could be a little sketchy, but we never felt unsafe. We were so close to the Canucks Stadium and Whitecaps Stadium, so my family enjoyed walking to the games. Also, 2 grocery stores (Costco and T&T) were less than a 2 minute walk! Also, a 1 minute walk to the Skytrain station!
Thank you Klay for your hospitality! What a beautiful place you have!

Mona's place is well located, close to buses and shops in a quiet neighbourhood with little through-traffic. The suite itself is small but quaint and is well furnished. The desk is particularly useful, as we were working during our stay - the chair is deceptively comfortable.
The kitchen is small but workable. The most disappointing part of it was the fridge situation - instead of one medium sized fridge, two (rather dated) mini-fridges were stacked on top of each other. Its size and compartments made it difficult to store many groceries or to meal prep (the freezer was also unusable). Towards the end of our long-stay, one of the mini-fridges also stopped working which reduced the usable capacity even further.
We did have a few problems during our stay, most notably the bed had a steep dip in the middle. Thankfully when we contacted Mona about it, she arranged a spare bed from upstairs (another Airbnb in the same property) to be brought down as a replacement. Hopefully the bed will be permanently replaced for the next guests.
There is a beautiful garden shared between the two suites, and we noticed there was a garden table but no chairs. We were disappointed that there were no garden chairs available (after having enquired about this) especially as the weather was particularly nice.
As mentioned earlier in the review, the upstairs is also occupied by Airbnb guests. Unfortunately when we stayed the guests above had a hyperactive toddler, particularly at some unsociable hours. Worth noting for guests planning on staying who want peace and quiet.
Overall, the suite was comfortable but could do with some improvements to make it more suitable for longer stays.

I was a bit disappointed when I arrived at what the unit looked like compared to photos. I felt that there was maintenance required (many outlets didn’t work and were distorted in the socket, bathroom door had damage, mold next to the shower), the washing machine was broken when I arrived but was quickly fixed within a few days. Otherwise it was quiet and felt safe.

There were a few issues with our stay, but Erica was very responsive, respectful and helpful. She was lovely and did her best to make it up to us.
We originally booked the place for four, but last minute changed it to three people. The Airbnb has 3 rooms, two double beds and a single bed. Would have accommodated the four of us fine, however there was an issue with one of the double bedrooms. It had this unpleasant smell, to the point we couldn’t sleep in the room. We opted to sleep in the other double room and single room. The single bed isn’t the super comfiest, but the other double was good.
I informed Erica the next day, and she offered to come in and clean the room. We felt like it was coming from the bedding/bed, so she cleaned all the sheets and foam on the bed. The room still lingered so we didn’t use it for the stay. Erica was apologetic and quick to respond. She genuinely felt awful about it and did her best to help.
She issued a partial refund (the cleaning fee) for the issue without me even asking which I thought was sweet.
We noticed a bit of a musty smell from the main bathroom, especially the towels inside, but we thought it was likely from being damp in a basement suite. We informed her of that as well and she also washed the towels immediately.
Besides these things, the Airbnb was fair for the price. It didn’t affect us too much as we had three people, but may have been a bigger issue if we had our original four.
Otherwise the location is good, it’s in a fairly quiet neighbourhood even though it’s close to the bridge. It’s easy to get around. There is parking but only enough for one car. The suite is quite spacious and there’s a full fridge/freezer. Another plus is there’s two bathrooms (one shower), tv with Netflix and a good area to eat. We never used to the kitchen to cook so I can’t comment on that!
Overall wasn’t the stay I was quite expecting but Erica was very accommodating and helpful and would recommend her as a host! Might have been a one off for us!

I am sorry, but I Will not stay here anymore!
1) Room is small and smelly; including the sheets and the beddings;
2) my skin started to itch and have lump after two nights stay;
3) the lady host is nice but the man host is so difficult to talk with and negotiate the changes and he ignores my uncomfortable situations and only cares for his own profit.
He give me a hard time, I will not recommend this house.

Without any doubt, the worst host that I have ever seen. I would not recommend this loft at all. The guy was so rude and unprofessional. After waiting for almost an hour for checking in, at night the guy just walked in the house without any knocking or warning. We literally didn't have any privacy there. After coming to the house, he started screaming and swearing at us that we were noisy. I would recommend you to find another house if you want to have a good time in airbnb.

Overall I had an okay stay at Pri’s apartment but unfortunately I have to express a few of my concerns. I have never had a bad experience so it is a little disheartening to have to write this. There was a foul smell coming from the washrooms which is expressed in another review before and when I went to approach Pri, she had blamed my sisters 8 year old small dog that was over a couple times, for the smell that was coming from underneath the sinks. I was disappointed that rather than being a concerned home owner, she was defensive and allowed me to spend the duration of my time very uncomfortable in the smell and it felt very unsanitary. Also, in a review before there has been troubles with the washing machine door and I told Pri prior to the end of our stay and she was understanding at first and than when we left, she is now charging us $200 for an issue that other tenants have had.  I felt very nervous to approach her with any problems because I felt attacked to say the least. The back door does not lock so every night I felt very unsafe. Anyways, it is a beautiful space, needing of a little love and attention and is fine for short time stays but I would not recommend staying for longer durations of time.

I felt there is like a basement.  Due to located by walk side, must use blind, no sun come. Many ants will show. WiFi will soon  and often disappeared and weak. I read reviews I don't understand why it's so high.. also clean fee was twice of one day price..kind fraud..and after dry laundry, your clothes get totally stinky.. . And the sofa was also sticky.....totally disappointed..it's terrible review, I know but it's true.

This airbnb was cozy and had what I need. Great location with 2 bedrooms. Kitchen that works with a spacious living room. Wifi speed was decent for the most part and the shower pressure was great.
My biggest issue was the sound insulation from above. The airbnb is situated in a basement type space. Ive stayed in plenty before but this one has the worst soundproofing. Every step which honestly sounded like stomping was a bit of a nightmare as I was home for a day or two working.
I did bring it up with the host which they said they would be more mindful but my god that didn't happen. It was pretty unbearable and I was in disbelief how long it would go on for to the point that it made me wonder what was happening upstairs that there was that much walking.
Aside from this not so great part, I was really happy with the location. The neighborhood seems safe, downtown was too far and I was close enough to richmond and the airport!

Our stay was disappointing. While the location is central, the area felt unsafe with constant noise and people loitering nearby, and parking added to that unease. Inside, the suite was somewhat clean but had clear maintenance issues—stained headboard, broken blinds, and no proper way to block sunlight. The biggest problem was the lack of air conditioning. The space was unbearably hot, and the two small fans provided did nothing. We weren’t allowed to use the AC unit we purchased, leaving the nights so uncomfortable that we even spent most of one night in our car. The TV had nothing to watch. Communication with the host was slow and unhelpful, and attempts to compromise went nowhere. Unless you’re visiting in cooler months and don’t mind unresolved issues, I wouldn’t recommend this stay.

I was visiting Vancouver from Ontario and unfortunately chose a hotel that gave me a horrible experience. (For those visiting I strongly suggest staying away from the Hotel on Hastings Street downtown. )
I found Elsa’s place in a haste and she was responded almost immediately after my booking request and accommodated a last minute check in despite having her own busy day! Her and her husband were friendly and informative with how to access public transit. Their house is in a beautiful, quiet residential neighborhood. The room was very clean and the bed felt like a cloud after the horrible experience I had the night before. The ensuite bathroom was also a huge plus for added privacy. Overall 11/10. Would definitely book with them again when I return to Vancouver

Quick walk to Skytrain, nice self contained unit, coffee and everything you need to cook. Would have been perfect....except the bed bugs. There is a trap there too so the host must know about them. A bit disappointing and the only thing keeping it from 5 stars.

I was excited to stay on this place because I read almost all of the reviews and there was written it’s a cool place it’s clean … it’s not clean, I opened the bed I saw hair inside, I asked her to change the sheets, I opened the fridge there was something sticky everywhere, there was a dusty everywhere, I told her than she cleaned up, the floor was dirty, the bathroom was too, she didn’t check before me and my mom came here I’m very disappointed. There was a peanut butter open…
Im very disappointed I’m stayed on this place just because it was new year and to find something at this time it’s impossible!

I was unhappy with this stay. The communication about getting in was horrible. I ended up standing on the street for half an hour at midnight in a strange city, because he didn’t respond.
In the room, under the bed, there was dust and plastic which made it seem rather nasty.
You couldn’t lock the door in the room.
There were no towels for me so I had to look for those myself. I finally found some but I’m still unsure whether they were dirty towels or not.
The room was listed as Aarun’s and Nish’s. Some of the other reviews refer to someone else. And when I had to be let in, I had to call someone called Eric. This is so confusing and doesn’t make you feel very safe.
I cannot recommend this.

BEWARE most of the reviews & ratings are pre-pandemic. On third night, remote wouldn’t open garage so I had to park on street. Nishal attributed to user error. Later it worked but then we had trouble getting out. Eventually stopped working altogether, and couldn’t open gate when we needed to get to an important appointment. Had to repark and hurry to take Uber. Nishal still refused to simply provide a replacement remote and kept trying to force me to go test it further. He then tried to discourage me from contacting Airbnb and then was retaliatory once I did, saying we could check out immediately even though we had broken no rules. Eventually got some refund from Airbnb, but this host is terrible - speaking as a landlord, and as my wife has been an Airbnb host, this host is bad.
Other issues: didn’t send instructions in advance as promised; when I arrived there were three people working on the place (was not ready for arrival), no ironing board, stained topsheet, dust bunnies underbed

This house is being operated as a hostel, but the host doesn’t tell you that. In the basement there are 4 bedrooms capable of sleeping 10 people. One bedroom has a private bathroom. The other 8 people are required to share one small bathroom! It would be hard to share one bathroom between 8 friends- one bathroom among 8 strangers a is insane. Also, the unit is not cleaned nearly enough to manage this. Not only did we have to wait forever to use the lone bathroom, when we finally got access to it- IT WAS DISGUSTING!! There were hairs of other guests EVERYWHERE, the floors were wet, the shower was nasty and the toilet paper was almost gone. Upstairs sounds like the same predicament with noise and footsteps being heard at ALL hours. Very disappointed with this experience.

A detriment to mental, emotional and physical health. Upon check-in, the tenant, Philip, without asking or my consent took my umbrella and put it in with the abandoned looking umbrellas and said, "Umbrellas go there." The room key was missing. Philip lifted one of my bags off the desk to see if it was there after I said to him that the key was not in the room. The washroom window was wide open and a big black fly sat on the toilet seat. There was an overwhelmingly awful stench since the shower drain was full of matted brown hair mixed with black mould, which I cleaned with my time and money. Not listing that a major multiplex apartment building is being built right next door is deceptive. The room directly faces the constant heavy traffic. Philip microwaves/cooks at all hours of the night. The smoke alarm was non-functional,  which wasn't resolved for 15 days despite follow-ups. The place smells bad all over. Mary accused me of taking the cleaning supplies the day after New Year's. No.

The host/ agent was helpful and quick to respond, thank you!
You may or may not own these units, as we met a building owner/manager and maintenance guy too.
I’m leaving you a ton of feedback and suggestions. Keep what you love.
The toilets water in the bowl most times when you’re using it is high enough to touch your booty and it starts to gather mold and mildew within hours of it being cleaned, and since we are in the middle of a pandemic it was cleaned daily.
There was no hand soap in the pump in the bathroom when we arrived, and one side of the towel rack was not attached, something you think they would have noticed.
I had to ask for a lamp for the bedroom, a can opener, oven mitts so I could make pizza and had to buy my own foil, saran wrap as well as recycle bin, laundry soap and dryer sheets.
The bed is made up with very dingy thin sheets and there’s a thin duvet between two sheets that look decent enough when you arrive until it starts to unravel and you find out that it was an illusion, lol
This unit needs coasters so that the wooden dining table, coffee table and night tables are protected.
Definitely more than one tea towel and better sponges that last more than two uses in the kitchen would be amazing.
The dishwasher kept having an error msg and not washing the dishes very well so we hardly used it.
For a monthly rental these should be provided, and only two garbage bags for the unit under the sink with a monthly stay booked was not sufficient.
All units at this time of everyone working from home should come equipped with a desk and proper office chair for the cost charged here.
There should be more hangers in the bedroom closet and at this time a couple of masks, small hand sanitizer and some gloves to get people started would be helpful.
These are our suggestions and I do hope you implement some of them, it just makes guests happier and they stay longer. We left and now are renting a unit fir 4 months, income you lost due to this unit’s shortfalls.
The unit isn’t awful, but there’s definitely much room for improving here.
And unless you’re a young party couple and can handle the loud traffic, police and ambulance noises sounding like its coming from your TV at volume 30 I’d rethink a stay at this listing.
It was very hard to sleep at times because there seemed to be no barrier to the sound, paper thin windows and super loud area of town, across from a hospital, need I say more?
The host was helpful and the maintenance guy was a real help and friendly too, but when we texted him that the sink in the bathroom wasn’t draining, he said “yeah they’re all like that, there were new ones installed and this is how it works”.
My husband got fed up the following week and plunged it and now it drains in seconds, lol
All in all, I’m sure it could have been worse, I’m glad it wasn’t. The host suggested great places to take our dog and the maintenance guy loaned me his vacuum to keep my unit clean a few times as there is not a vacuum in the unit, that was much appreciated.

My experience at the apartment was really bad. The place was really filthy, the furniture stained and the appliances really old and gross. Also had issues with shelves falling off the walls. The host made an attempt to clean the place but the crew that came - in my opinion- did absolutely nothing. I had to buy almost 80 dollars worth of cleaning supplies to make the living room, the bedroom, and the bathroom at least presentable. Plus, 50 dollars in candles and air fresheners to manage to stay there. When I talked to the host about leaving she denied any refund -I had booked the place for almost 3 months. I have to mention at this point that I couldn't bring myself to use anything from the kitchen and the dryer/washer machines. Thankfully, I had contacted the Airbnb support team on the very first night to assist me and was able to leave the place with a refund after the first 30 days. But ONLY because Airbnb support assisted my case after providing proof such as photos and receipts. All in all, I would strongly discourage anyone from booking the place.

The place was nicely appointed but very dirty and mouldy upon my arrival. The bathroom in particular was very much in need of maintenance. The sink was clogged on my arrival and the baseboard on the wall behind the toilet needed to be replaced because it was rotten with black mould. The caulking around the sink was also covered in mould and needed to be replaced. The ceiling in the bathroom had recently been patched but not painted. There was a large part that needed to be painted. After I requested that it be painted, it was. The tile and grout on the floor were black and no amount of scrubbing could get it clean. Eventually, the grout was covered with fresh silicone to make the floor cleaner. The baseboard behind the toilet was replaced on day 6 of my stay. I asked for a partial refund given that the bathroom was so smelly and having maintenance people in and out interfered with my work. The same request was denied. The baseboards throughout the apartment were very dirty. The floor had not been vacuumed or mopped before I arrived. The kitchen had grease all over the cupboards and walls. The kitchen chairs, which were fabric, were filthy and needed to be shampooed. This was only done once I brought the dirtiness to Ishtar's attention, who admitted that they should not have gone out in that condition.  I did a lot of the cleaning myself. Admittedly, Ishtar and Jasper were responsive to requests to make the place cleaner and more comfortable, however, the state of the place the first week was very disappointing. Once it was clean, however, I very much enjoyed my stay. I asked for cleaning supplies and was provided with them very quickly. Additionally, I found the decor very pleasing. The building was quiet and safe. The apartment was large. The bed was a king, not a queen as described, which was a pleasant surprise. A disappointment was that there was supposed to be a den and dedicated workspace, according to the description, however, neither was available. I would recommend bringing extension cords and power bars since the outlets in this place were in strange and inconvenient locations. When I requested an extension cord I was told that this would not be provided. There were no outlets in the entrance or bathroom at all. This made vacuuming very difficult. The listing also mentioned weekly maid services. These are at an additional cost and not readily available.

Location 5/5:
Location is central to everything. Very convenient location
Noise 1/5: many students were throwing parties every weekend. You can hear street noise very clearly as if there are no windows. Overall the noise is very bad and I would not recommend this place if you are a light sleeper
Comfort 3/5: the bed is terrible and not conducive to sleeping.
Host 5/5: host was nice and responsive
Overall it is a good location, however the entire building is full of students partying and signing all day long(it is next to a music school). Don’t expect to get any sleep(if you are a light sleeper), but at least there is plenty to do at night in Vancouver.

Disappointed in the cleanliness and quality of the home. Upon arrival, we did a clean of all surfaces  because of noticeable dust and crumbs. The home also had a dirty/smoke smell. Not sure if this is normal for the older building or if the previous guests smoked but we aired it out by opening the windows.  The elevators also stank of urine. Michael had good communication, check-in was easy and location is great. Just overall poor cleaning - not a super host stay.

Young as a host was extremely unhelpful and very very rude. After circumstances that were beyond my control, I was told what an inconvenience I was at check in and he even made comments that offended my nationality which was extremely offensive and uncalled for.  Due to these comments, I felt very unsafe in his apartment and even went as far as locking my bedroom door. WOULD NOT RECOMMEND!

The host Linda is very undependable. Here is the list:
1) There was no clear directions/instructions on how to retrieve key to the unit
2) It took Linda over three hours to return our urgent calls/Txt/and emails
3) The unit was dirty and not safe to occupy
4) There was no running water in the bath sink
5) There was no instruction on how to connect to internet
So we arrived at Vancouver after 4:00PM and it took Linda “The agent” over three hours to return our urgent calls/emails and txt. There were no clear instructions on where to park, get the keys to the unit. Anyway, when we finally got inside the units, we were disappointed there were crumbs all over the floor and on the couch. The oven was filthy/sticky dirty. One of the bathrooms sink has no running water. The towels were dirty and still damp. So we called Linda immediately again and after many txt and emails/calls all Linda could offer at first is to send her pictures if we are not satisfied with the condition of the unit. So we decided to take pictures and send them directly to Rb&b and not to deal with here since its pointless and just a waste of our time. Next day Linda emailed me and asked when we are available so she can send a plumber and cleaning person. Since we are on vacation and our time is limited plus we did not pay top dollar so you can wait for plumbers and cleaning crew to fix issue with the unit. The contract state that units should be Functional/Safe/Clean, the unit and service from Linda did not met those requirements.

It’s like a baking oven if you choose to stay here in summer. The host won’t refund due to the poor condition and descriptions not matching the list. Only allowed to get the key after 4:00pm, the host did not respond to our request to cancel the reservation and very late in responding, we were too late to find another hotel to stay, AirBNB customer service could not help us resolving the problem. So we had to end up stay there at first night. It was hot as hell, and we had to open all the widows. We felt like sleeping on the street with all the noise and hot air. On the second day AirBNB eventually got hold of the host, but she only agree us checking out but we have to pay 1/2 for the night we did not stay. We could not sleep well there, and GOT to move out. So we had no choice but agree for this unfair price. So we end up paying over $1400 for only one night. This was a horrible experience. I hope you take lessons don’t come here, at least in summer.

When I arrived at the cottage it was not cleaned, bathroom was a mess, garbage left & looked like previous guests had not left yet. I called Brian and he said he would get right back to me. It was raining and cold out but I had no place to go so had to wait. Another person called me back to tell me there was a room in the main hotel as the room was not going to be ready that night. Back I went with luggage in tow into the rain.
The main hotel is very old, creaky stairs and loud. I could hear everything from the other guests. I booked the cottage specifically because it was separate, quiet and quaint. The cottage was made available for the next night. I requested a partial refund from Brian to which he responded with a much lower amount and has yet to refund me back. Brian is not trustworthy or reliable and takes very long to respond.
I will not book or stay with this host again.

The location was amazing! We were able to walk everywhere we wanted in downtown. Also other than the first day Brian was very responsive over text when we needed something. Unfortunately this was the only good part about it. It was smaller than expected, it smelt like sewage and mold. We had to ask for new towels and the ones we originally received smelled like they had not been washed. The place is older, which is fine, but it does need an upgrade inside. There was no air conditioning, which is fine, but there wasn’t proper ventilation and windows into the unit so it would be extremely hot in the unit which caused the musty and sewage smell to increase. Also they had a fireplace which happened to be on so I did need to ask for that to be shut off. I also came home with a bunch of bites on my legs and they did look like bed bug bites which made me extremely nervous.
We wanted to like this place but for how much we paid, and now having stayed it in, I would definitely not recommend.

Expect the worst. Honestly this was the worst experience I’ve ever had with Airbnb.
The place looks nothing like the pictures. It’s actually set up with the bare minimum, it’s kinda depressing honestly. The pictures looks good, the place doesn’t, at all!
Expect bugs/spiders in the foyer/bathtub and bathroom (I have pictures and videos that I wish I could post). Absolutely gross.
Expect small unbranded shampoo/soap, unclean bathroom, very small and uncomfortable bed and generally unwelcoming space. There was nothing about the place that I liked.
Also expect extremely nosey/intrusive hosts that keep an eye on you the entire time. This made me extremely uncomfortable.
A third friend hung out with us who is from Vancouver and the hosts asked for 40$ Extra a night. Keep in mind there is no space for a third person. I wouldn’t have minded paying if she actually could’ve stayed with us. But since there was no space this wasn’t a possibility and I chose not to pay 40$ extra a night so she could hang out with us. The method they chose to corner us was extremely uncalled for. They messaged us on Airbnb which we didn’t see (no Tom we weren’t actually avoiding you, we were on vacation and didn’t bother checking your message). We got back to the place close to 11pm. Tom came knocking 11 at night. This really couldn’t have waited until the morning?! You clearly saw there’s 3 girls since you made it a point to not give us space. We clearly look relatively unthreatening. I’m sorry please don’t be a creep and respect our privacy just a little bit! We decided to leave and cancel our reservation with everything we had experienced.
The hosts seem nice enough, but I would not recommend this place to anyone. And I hope to God I never have this experience again.

I have to be honest and say that it was a really too expensive for what you got. The positives were that it was easy to check in. The apartment was super quiet and the neighborhood was quiet as well, I rarely heard sirens even though it’s directly across from the hospital. It was a good location too, close to shops, supermarkets, restaurants, gyms, and public transportation... The hosts were great in communicating and accommodating. The bed is super comfy and the washer and dryer is a definite selling point. However some things you should be aware of is the fact that if you go in the summer the apartment is smoldering. It is super hot and because there is no AC however Jasper did bring me a fan when I asked for it without a problem. Another thing is that the windows don’t have locks so as a single woman staying alone I never felt quite safe enough even though the neighborhood is safe. For the price you should also be aware that the building and the apartment and furniture are dated. The apartment entrance and hallways are dark as is the apartment itself. The sink in the bathroom and the bathtub , though clean are scratched, stained and chipping paint. And the place has a musty smell to it, almost a stuffy odor that may come from windows being closed over time, not sure. Once you open the windows and air it out it helps. Again, I don’t want this to come off as a negative review but an informative one. Hope that helps.

pros: friendly host, great location, lots of space, wi-fi, restaurants nearby. cons: very, very, very dirty. mold in bathtub tiling,  cobwebs and dust throughout,  cat hair under beds and in-between cushions, refrigerator full of old food and spills, trash full on arrival, dirty sink sponge, hand wash just full of soapy water and not soap. major fail for level of cleanliness.  we were charged for cleaning fee but did not receive professional cleaning. by day 2 we were all coughing and had sore throats we believe caused by amount of dust and cat hair.

I don’t recommend this house and I would never rent it again.
I will only state facts about my experience:
- The house was very dirty: plenty of dust and spiderwebs. We found also used underwear in the master bedroom and dog,s poop in the deck. My wife had a allergic crisis because of the dust and she had to leave earlier. We asked the host if he cleaned the house professionally and he replied he did a two hour cleaning. Finally, we asked for a vacuum and a mop to clean ourselves and he didn’t refund us for the cleaning.
- The house had a strange odor. We thought it could be the hens in the backyards or the recycling center near by, but it was the whole house that needs a profesional cleaning.
- The stove was clean but the kitchen itself was not well equipped. There were no glasses to drink water, not mixer and the dishes and utensils were incomplete or damage.
- There are no wash and drying machines. When we asked the host about this, he said he could do the laundry for us. We think this is unacceptable during COVID times.
- The internet was not stable and the last two days it didn’t work.

The location of the house was great and it was walking distance to the sky trains. However it was a very dirty and smelly house. The leather couches were so dirty, there are dust, hair and dirt everywhere. The bed in the purple room was uncomfortable and you can feel the springs on the old bed. There were no curtains on the back door/window despite the picture on the listing. The worst thing was when we complained about this to Robert, he said “As a physician, I am concerned about OCD, anxiety, depression or something worse”. Great, instead of assurance we got a diagnosis on our mental health, which was completely inappropriate. Lastly, there were bugs everywhere in the washrooms. Don’t expect cleanliness but the location was very close to transportation.

wonderful location and Robert is a very kind host.
the place was not cleaned well. we had to thoroughly scrub the kirchen counters and had to clean dishes from the cupboard prior to use. Dust and cobwebs in every room corner and on furniture, dirty floors, and hairs in the bathtub and sink.
Most of the blinds are broken and stained and unable to be opened.
The upstairs room must be used for extra storage since there was an empty tv box and what looked like large drawers.
Great location, but would not stay again.

This listing and its "Plus" status are totally misleading. It was so bad we left without even spending the night. I was travelling with an infant and therefore, in the hot summer months, AC was a priority. Vancouver units rarely have AC, but this one said it did. There was a loud AC unit in the living room (which itself was in poor condition) but not in the bedroom so the bedroom was a hot box and not safe for an infant to sleep in. The owner said to turn on all the fans and place them in a strategic position to angle the air towards the bedroom. My husband had to work while we were there so we were going to have to close the door to the bedroom while our daughter slept, which would have suffocated her! We couldn't even open the windows to let air in because the stench of garbage coming up from the alley was awful (also making the balcony unusable). So we were basically left with having to keep the incredibly noisy AC going all day and night, while not being able to close the door while baby had a nap - not comfortable to say the least. In addition, the listing said there were blackout curtains but they were so poorly fitted that light came in through every crack making the room very bright. In terms of cleanliness, this place also left a lot to be desired. There's a strange runner in the bathroom, which I was going to roll up and get out of the way - bad idea! When I picked it up there was all kinds of filth underneath - hair, dirt, ugh. Disgusting. Finally, there are signs printed on paper randomly stuck all over the apartment with reminders for guests - very tacky. For $200/night invest in some properly made signs if you're going to do that. All in all, the listing was incredibly misleading - this is definitely a party pad. Right by the Granville strip I can't imagine anyone other than someone coming to party wanting to stay here. To top it all off, when I let the host know we wouldn't be staying I never received a response. A horrible experience all around.

Worst Airbnb experience ever!
Stayed at this place over the weekend, couldn't sleep at all. The street below is filled with bars which play loud music till 4am. Coming from Toronto, I never experienced such loud noise living in DT area. To make matter worse, heater in the bedroom sqeaks all night long.
Host didn't offer any help and refused to do partial refund.

⚠️ WARNING! I WOULD STRONGLY RECOMMEND NOT STAYING HERE. ⚠️
Unfortunately, this property was nothing like we expected from the listing.
• The host was completely unresponsive after we immediately raised our concerns.
• The photos do NOT accurately represent the current condition of the apartment. It felt significantly more worn and poorly maintained.
• The sofa was extremely dirty, with large, very noticeable stains.
• There was a strong nicotine/tobacco/smoke smell throughout the entire apartment, which was immediately noticeable upon entering.
• The apartment has a very unpleasant outlook and directly faces a large amount of garbage/waste, which made the overall experience even worse.
• The key collection location was extremely unpleasant and uncomfortable.
We had to leave after approximately one hour and arrange alternative accommodation at our own expense.

Comfortable, good east-side location, easy to get to from airport (train from airport, then one bus ride). Cleaner was late so it was dirty when we arrived, but cleaner arrived within an hour, and host refunded one night in compensation. A few things had been stolen - the microwave among them but it was replaced right away. The shower control had been broken for long enough that there were directions on how to get it to work, but it was broken! We couldn't figure it out, and there was no response from host until two days later. We figured out a way (using a screw we found on the street!) to get it to work with the help of a friend.
All in all, despite the few problems, this is a pretty nice place to stay.

The place was spacious and roomy and at a very good price! We visited with 7 adults and two toddlers and had a pretty comfortable time here. My only issue with the place had to do with the cleanliness of it. The house is a bit older and had some stains, cobwebs and a bit of a smell to it. Most of it was tolerable but I brought up my concerns about the bathroom because I thought there might be mould, and Sunny was great! She sent a cleaner the very next day to clean it up.
Overall, it's a pretty good place for just adults to crash in. I wouldn't recommend it for younger kids or older adults. The location is also great! We were super close to Stanley park, queen Elizabeth park and even downtown Vancouver! We had a great time since everything is so closeby. Thanks Sunny!

**Disappointing Experience - Avoid This Property**
Rented this Vancouver house for two nights with friends, expecting proper rooms for all. Instead, one “bed” was a mattress on the floor—unacceptable and uncomfortable. Another was a box spring with a mattress but no frame, unsuitable for someone recovering from knee surgery.
The host said the previous renter wet the bed, and the replacement “upgraded” mattress was over $1,000. She added a day bed in the living room, calling the house “fully functional,” but refused a full refund. The host should have disclosed this and offered a cancellation option.
We spent 30 mins there and left, we were unable to stay due to the discomfort. Airbnb should not consider a mattress on the floor to qualify as a proper bed. According to them, there was no violation from the host. We wasted half a day of our trip finding another property. Despite our efforts, she refunded one night, losing $170.
Avoid this listing—the host’s standards for “upgrades
do not stay here this place is very dirty and unkept. whoever wrote the other reviews must be friends of the owner because they are totally false

The building is very dated. The carpet is holding a strong unpleasant smell when you walk in. But the room itself has no carpet and a big window that I opened immediately. I had an issue with the blinds but I was too tired and frustrated and the host is on site but only sent me a YouTube link that wasn’t the same as blind but I have that blind. The noise started at 5:30 am; birds. 7;construction workers talking. 8 when they turned their machines on.
The ceiling in the bathroom is really dirty and the vents are dirty so the cleaning needs a more thorough. The bed 6/10 for comfort. The bedding,nice. The pillows were perfect. Oddly I was text within minutes of arrival for what time I was leaving. That was strange. All that said she reimbursed without being asked 😊. I will be back for sure.
