I've never written anything negative about a place. It was generally fine. But the directions were complicated, not written very clearly, and when I called, the guy who answered was quite rude as if I was the idiot for not figuring out the directions. For context, you had to pull up in front of the place, dial to get in, go up the elevator, code to get in the room, get they key, go back to your car, key fob into the garage, the key fob has three buttons which you have to press in order to make your way through the labrinth of a garage. Then you realize you have to get your luggage out of the garage. But the elevator was closed so we had to walk the labrinth with luggage. And I can tell you the directions tried to explain most of this but it ended up being confusing. So I assumed they provided a phone number so I could call it for clarity. But when I called they were super rude. Horrible way to start the stay.

This place was awesome! Conveniently located to public transportation and exactly as advertised. We were able to take in all that Vancouver has to offer very easily from this location. The pool, spa, and sauna were also very nice to be able to use after a long day of visiting the attractions. Only negative which is no fault to Ryan is that it is close to an area of town where there is open drug use in broad daylight on the street. We ventured down Hastings and Carral to get back from Gastown on the first day. It was like a zombie apocalypse. My kiddos were a bit shaken by the experience. We just avoided that area for the rest of the trip. It was strange because I did not particularly feel unsafe even there because the streets are still very clean and they did not seem aggressive. It was just sad and sparked a lot of conversations with my boys about drug use which was probably good. But I digress, Ryan and his place were awesome overall, just stay away from that area.

beautiful condo in heart of Vancouver. the space worked out great for me the hubby and my mom. Had everything we needed. nice gym and pool area too. the area is also good, just some sketchy people walking around, but that is all over Vancouver. I never felt unsafe. the baggage hold worked out great as well as we had 5 hours to spare to explore after our flight arrived. while I have no plans to visit Vancouver again, If I did I would definitely stay here again.
If you expect a clean place with clean sheets and bedding! And at least lights to see than don't stay at this home! I had the worst experience ever! Dirty....I would not stay again!

We weren’t sure what to expect at first because the description in the listing and the photos are unclear.
When we got to the house we found our room to be very humid with a strong smell of detergent, musk and food.
The bedsheets did not fit the bed properly and we ended up tossing the bottom sheets off the bed In our sleep! We woke up directly in the mattress which had visible dirt, crumbs etc.
The curtains had mold on them, the wall to wall carpet had dirty edgers and corners. In the bathroom there was trash in the basket when we got there as well as used sponges in the drawers. The corners and the area behind the toilet seat were also dirty.
The common area posted in the photos was definitely not the same. the table was covered in candy wrappers and toys and the sofa pillows were thrown off so we weren’t sure if this space was accessible to us in the end.
A man scurried down the hall and responded « hello » to after I had greeted him but no other host was there nor did anyone else approach us.
The whole situation was very awkward.
We stayed there for one night with our two young children and found it unsettling.

This was the badest thing that we’ve experienced with air bnb. The place was very dirty and the host just not reachable. The kitchen was so sticky and dirty .. the other persons living their recommended us to wash every dish befor using it ... disgusting!!! And there is mold in every room ? Very dangerous for allergic people. Really don’t go their it’s very bad. And also the hole house smell very weird .. I red this also in a review here ... it’s the mold!!

Roberto’s Grand room is alot like a hotel room. The shower is huge and really nice,
location is pretty good, parking is a big plus, and the microwave and dishes left for us were really useful.
Not having an en-suite toilet is a con (although it was private still and very clean). The room obviously has some weird layouts. The sink in the room is in a shoulder sized nook and has no mirror.
Cleanliness in the house was a problem. The hallway was dirty and had a musty old smell. The bed was questionably clean, someone elses clothes and things were in the drawers underneath and closet (which was alarming for cleanliness). The bed sheets didnt smell fresh upon arrival and as we checked out someone was waiting to enter (hope this wasnt the next airbnber as sheets hadnt been cleaned, makes me doubt if they were clean before I arrived).
The room cost us $300 a night with all the fees, which is alot. This was a more budget friendly option and still Id expect a higher level of cleanliness

Noisy, unkept. Grounds awful, trash ,building materials , entrance way dirty & general disarray.
No coffee maker , tv but no place to plug in . Closets but no hangars. Mi I sinks almost impossible to use.
Parking adequate but insecure .

very dirty smelly location.  feet were black from her dirty floors.  her dog smells awful.   dirty old dishes.  i have photos to prove how flithy this location was.  the description does not match the location.  do not stay here.

We always book a stay based on the feedback and as this property had one negative feedback from last year we weren't sure at first but booked it anyway as all the other feedback sounded very positive. And we are so glad that we stayed with Lyn for 5 weeks because the apartment was not dirty or smelly and the property is also directly on Kitsilano Beach as advertised. Me and my boyfriend had a very nice and cozy room that looks exactly like the pictures with a large private bathroom too. The kitchen also has everything you need for cooking, you can use the washing machine and dryer and the location is really great. You can be in the city center in a few minutes, but there are also many shops and restaurants just around the corner. The beach, parks and free tennis courts are right on your doorstep. Lyn is a wonderful person with so much positive energy that is really infectious. You are very well integrated into Lyn's life (her family, neighbors and friends are all wonderful and lovely people) and you still have your privacy. Lyn was always so helpful with any kind of issue. So all in all we had a wonderful stay, we felt right at home. We really didn't miss anything, except Charlie Girl who unfortunately passed the rainbow bridge a few months ago. But it was still nice when Lyn showed pictures or stories of her beloved dog. If we are in Vancouver again, we would definitely stay again at Lyn’s home😊
Disappointed, even for this part of van and the price a little misleading for quality.

Photos are an accurate description of the unit. 15 minute walk to the train. Quiet neighbourhood was nice for walking. Unit is is fairly cool despite not being air conditioned. Unit was clean overall. Floors were swept, though likely not mopped between guests as they were not clean to comfortably walk around barefoot.
Unfortunately sound travels very easily from above. Steps were very audible. My husband and I were very mindful of the 10 pm quiet time - however loud activity did wake us up on several occasions - even as late as 1 am. Be mindful if you’re a light sleeper.
Marina was a lovely host and very accommodating. Easy to contact and prompt to respond. She even allowed for a refund for the extra guest fee when one of our family members was unable to attend last minutes
Overall, good value for money.

At $250 per night our stay was disappointing and I regret not opting for a hotel. The accommodation was 17-min walk from Canada Line with key pick-up and drop-off at a sketchy 7-Eleven (not ideal with children).
The building required fob access and the unit key was regular and tricky to use. Upon entering the bathroom, there was an unpleasant urine smell, which I eventually traced to the shower curtain. I had to remove it and wash it myself.
We requested a second key but had to follow up with the owner the next day to find out where it was kept. The owner was out of town, responded quickly but his replies were often curt and not very helpful. On checkout day, the cleaning lady was outside the unit when we were leaving (15 min before checkout time). I asked her if she needed the key - she said no. But after 4 hrs owner messaged me that she couldn’t find the second key. I informed him that we returned both keys, but received no response, leaving me anxious about being falsely blamed.

Though we didn’t get to meet in person, Gen was friendly and easy to communicate with over text and through airbnb. Their place is located in a great area of the city. The upstairs patio is super massive and highly enjoyable during good weather. The condo was cheap but could use a major facelift (The furniture is ripped and heavily stained from use) but at the price this should not affect your stay. Unfortunately, when we arrived the bathroom and kitchen area were filthy. Gen was quick to act and had the cleaners come back to deal with the moldy shower curtains and tiles, a clogged bathtub, dusty surfaces, uncleaned kitchen sink and used dish scrubbers, chocolate sauce covered table, among other things. It was a hassle and made us second guess whether we wanted to continue our stay seeing as Covid safety was not at all taken into consideration. We did end up staying the rest of the nights to enjoy the city but really think the place could still benefit from a further, very deep, clean and upgrade.

The location I booked seemed to be on a quite street but after I paid it was clear that the location was actually on a very noisy busy street. Host did not share the location before The booking and when I confronted her she told me that Airbnb was to blame. I cancelled the reservation and even though she said I will get a full refund she kept over $500 . The whole experience was not good and felt like a scam. Terrible experience

This host is very rude and disrespectful called my personal number and being very very rude but being nice on the chat that air bnb can see.  Threatened to enter the unit without my permission a bunch of times.  I complain to air bnb that there was an ant problem in this unit and once the host heard about my complain then became very very hostile.  Wouldn’t recommend booking this place at all

Do not stay here on the weekend! This being described as a “lively area” is very misleading - the loft is on top of a bar and it is loud (partying + bass) until 5am. It is far beyond a “lively area”. The building is dingy and the value was just not there. The coffee maker was broke also. I was refunded for my one sleepless night but the host was unwilling to let me out of my reservation even though I was very unhappy with the accommodations. I think it is overpriced for what it is and would not recommend this place.

communication was quickly. the house is close to city center. I requested early check-in as we didn't expect to cross border quickly no probs. Some pillows need update as there were marks. The front load washing machine has moulds and smelly needs disinfection. The older Maytag was cleaner good and still functional this is what we used on our stay.This is the very first Airbnb that  doesn't a hair conditioner in shower. And the very first kitchen I with rusty scissors and can opener please update for safety reasons. There were 2 shower the smaller bit mouldy we didn't use it. We were 7 and expecting 2 shower but only 1 is functional. I'm not a Karen this is my straightforward experience. Hopefully all will be taken as positive feedback for improvement and for future convenience of paid customers. Thanks again.

We booked this place for a family trip of 7, including elderly members, and it was a highly disappointing experience. First, there was a severe cleanliness and health hazard—we found thick black mold built up inside the washing machine's detergent drawer and rubber seal, rendering it completely unusable. We also found insects (spiders) in the shower. Second, on our last night, the hot water completely stopped working. Our entire family was forced to stay awake and queue for showers until 2:00 AM. When we raised these critical issues, Alex was dismissive and attempted to downplay the situation rather than taking proper accountability. I cannot recommend this place

What a nightmare staying there! Sarah asked us to leave her house because we asked her to raise the temperature through central heating. When we arrived in the evening, the room was very cold. There are two portable heaters in the room which would take a long time to warm the whole place. We requested her to turn on the central heating to warm up the room quickly, she did. She said that she did not turn on the central heating for us as it’s noisy and that she could give us more portable heaters. Then we said: we are fine with the noise and we don’t need more portable heaters as it will only use more power and was not safe either. Then the next morning, she got quite paranoid and said she couldn’t allow us to use the central heating all the time. If it’s not about saving money, what else could it be about? It looked like we did not pay for the power. Her extremely strong desire of taking control was also reflected in her house rules which I did not pay enough attention when I book it. Otherwise, I would have booked somewhere else! We had no choice but to read her rules very carefully before check-in, but still got lost as it’s very dark at night and google Maps led us to the other side. As her reviews show, other guests also complaint about it sometimes. It’s just pretty common. BUT she took it as we did not read her rules so we were not suitable to stay there... Another interesting thing was that one of her house rules says: if you don’t turn off the lights and heaters when you go out, she will do. How would she know if it’s on or off? The only way to find out is to go inside and check everyday. Think about it, it’s just so creepy. Do not expect you will have your privacy, as she could tell our room temp when she asked us to leave. It’s just so weird! If she does care so much about her house, she doesn’t have to run this business, just keep it for her own families. Some of her reviews also mentioned it’s too cold in the room. Her response was always: I will use a Chinese instruction next time for the heaters. To me that was very rude and quite racial. It seems that she thought they felt cold because they did not how to use the heaters. How hard could it be to turn the heater on?! She’s never thought if the issue was from her end, if the heaters were really adequate for cold nights especially in cold times, if the heaters were really as powerful as she described, if people from other countries will get used to this temperature. No room for negotiation, no choice, just follow her rules. The most ironic words from her was: She set the room temp to 22 degree, lower floor is 20 degree. Most Canadian homes did the same. But she forgot she was catering guests from other countries, where people might feel 20 degree was enough. I guess this temp was indeed fine for locals but that does just justify the fact that we could not choose at all. And when we arrived there, the temp was well below 20. I’m a Chinese running a motel in New Zealand. I live in New Zealand, but I will never forget where I’m from. So show some respect to people from other cultures if you do care about the business. The only comfort came from her Husband Paul who called us afterwards to apologize as he also disagreed with his wife.
But this awful experience did not spoil our trip at all due to Air BnB’s great service. The case manager issued the full refund due to the cancellation by the host and offered us a decent amount of allowance so we booked a much better place in the city center.
中国人不要订这里，房间冷得要死，房东不开中央空调，只给两个小的取暖器，还不承认是为了省电。没有隐私，规矩一大堆，对中国人感觉还有歧视。崇洋媚外！说我们房间温度过高，让我们搬出去。你想象一下，在外面住酒店还不能自己控制温度是什么感觉？房东还要自己进来检查有没有关电器是什么感觉？大家喜欢这种酸爽的话，可以试试。

An absolute nightmare, the host lives upstairs and watches you from your arrival and throughout your stay without you knowing. She has a camera installed as you walk in facing the entrance door and every time someone comes in she asks why is this person there? how long is that person staying and all.
Most of the night I spend there it was wasted by me responding to her texts.
I had it reserved for 4 nights and only stayed one night. I got another place for the rest of my stay that turned out to be the best.

Despite all that she still kept more than half of the cost to stay there for 4 nights, even though we only stayed one night.
It’s very restricted as far as what you can do. She has restrictions on using the stove for certain things, you can’t take a shower at certain times, if you make the slightest noice after 10pm she will send you a text, at one point we heard someone rattling the locked door that leads to upstairs.
This night spent there made my stay very stressful and uncomfortable. I do not recommend this place to anyone. I wouldn’t stay there if they paid me money, as I think it’s unethical for someone to watch you come and go on camera and possibly from the window and ask you every time a friend shows up for a cup of tea she asks why that person is there and for how long.

We are extensive users of Airbnb as guests and hosts, and have given and received many positive reviews. Unfortunately, we can't recommend this one.
Things didn't start off well as the check-in guide in the listing was inaccurate and Zena didn't send correct information on how to unlock the door until 6:20pm. More problematic was the fact that there was bedding for only two of the three beds. At 8pm we sent a message asking where the bedding for the sofa bed was. She didn't reply until after 10pm, at which point she asked if we really needed the bedding (?!?). When we responded that we did, she said she would provide it the next day. We requested a partial refund since the unit wasn't ready for our arrival (i.e. only two of the three advertised beds were useable, making for a very uncomfortable night). She ignored our request and instead, without knowing anything about our personal circumstances, told us that two queen beds should be enough since we were a group of four. She added that we hadn't requested use of the third bed in advance. True enough. When we asked where in the listing it says that use of the third bed must be requested in advance (answer: nowhere), she accused us of "playing with words". We have since shared our experience with Airbnb, who consequently gave this listing a "violation". When they contacted Zena about the partial refund, she actually lied to Airbnb and told them extra bedding was in the closet.
Additionally, there is little in the way of kitchen equipment. E.g. no sharp knives for food prep, no grater, colander, or even cups for that matter (but there are 4 mugs).
On the plus side, the basement suite is large and conveniently located.

Total absence of cleaning. Ryan's accommodation does not meet the basic cleaning standards, there is dust and dirt throughout the house. There is not even a closet in the room to leave your things. The sheets and towels were clean but touching anything else is disgusting. The location is good and Ryan was friendly but I don't recommend staying here since the dirt is embedded in the carpets, sofa, kitchen... very unpleasant stay.

Ryan and I got on splendidly. Me being an old female fart and him being a handsome young gay man.
I think this place is perfect for someone not coming from so far away. I was visiting from Ottawa.
The location is right close to Davie St.
He allowed me to smoke cigarettes but it really smelled up my room, lol, I don't usually smoke indoors but there was no balcony.
I was also able to smoke my pot. In fact Ryan and I had a great talk over a beer and a joint several evenings that I arrived home.
Ladies, you have to take everything to the bathroom with you, including a towel, the shampoo was awful and I looked terrible for a week! I didn't manage to make it to the drug store for samples.
The bed was divine!!!! I am not a techno dork, so had to learn from Ryan how to use the light dimmer and televeision.
I caught him at a bad time, just after surgery, so if he is that nice then, the next stays for people will be hosted even more nicely.

The house needs a deep clean. Lots of dust on the walls. An old disgusting sticky dirty rag with cobwebs above the kitchen counters we found.

Beautiful home, great quiet neighbourhood. One fan in one bedroom barely worked. Insufficient pillows for how many guests (just 1 for some guests).
Overall decent stay. But please clean the unit before renting it out again. Would have also liked access to a broom so we could have swept up our own mess. Future guest upgrade, please have an actual coffee maker available also, so we could make a pot each morning. An old k-cup system is inconvenient.
Beautiful backyard but no patio furniture or seats for guests. Missed opportunity.
Enjoyed the stay, still beat a hotel. But some enhancements required to earn a higher r

Hidden Gem, 5-star PLUS! Jamie was super to work with. The home was beautiful, comfortable, and everything we needed. We were able to walk to the grocery, coffee shop, down by the water, and explored many trails.
Additional comment - Originally, we had found a home on Airbnb, with Moaad. When we arrived it was filthy, moldy, carpet stained, food in refrigerator and freezer. A man came to the back door with a knife. We knew we could not stay.
Jamie helped us, genuinely cared! His home was exactly as expected and MORE.

Terrible experience staying here. After investing the 2.2grand to stay here. I was subject to multiple
False accusations by the Airbnb owner. She continued to torment me through messages. & basically decided at some point during the booking that she would kick me out onto the streets In a city where I don’t know anybody. She changed locks at 5 am to leave me outside with nowhere to go. And even once barged in to the Airbnb while I was sleeping, woke me up while I was naked. Violated my privacy tohave discussions. This Airbnb Owner and this experience was judgemental😞. I faced racism, and bias. This was by far the worst experience I had with renting on Airbnb. I am a great customer with this company and everywhere I stayed previously I have had great reviews on my character and respect for peoples properties. This was a shocking experience for me. I have been struggling to get the remaining money, they owe me aswell.

Room was sparse. Nothing but a bed and a bathroom. No TV, only two towels, no coffee maker, toilet paper in awkward place, over sized pillows,  no face cloths, very noisy drain pipes, holes in walls, rough plaster patches on walls,  bad neighborhood, bathroom light switch in awkward place. I could go on but you get the picture. STAY away from this place. 1 star out of 10.

This place was nothing like the listing and felt like a complete catfish.
The moment we arrived, there was a strong odor, dim lighting, and the entrance through the back gate of a garage looked abandoned and messy. The unit had no privacy, right next to another rental, with a flimsy door that felt unsafe.
A giant retro air conditioner was awkwardly connected to the outside, blasting both noise and smell into the space. The overall condition was dirty, uncomfortable, and far below what was advertised — the photos were clearly photoshopped.
We didn’t even stay the night and had to scramble to find another place because it was impossible to stay here.

Could not recommend more! The hosts are lovely and kindly offered us a free stay after the road to our ski resort collapsed the first time we booked. They were extremely helpful with local tips and giving things to do around Vancouver and they even offered us cookies! The place is in a perfect location- close to the train line, great cafes and restaurants and bus routes to get you anywhere you need. The bed is super comfy and very private living space. Could not recommend enough!

Normally I don't write negative reviews but this was the worst Airbnb experience I had (we do a lot with friends and family). My partner and I booked a few months in advance for 8 nights.
First day, we entered the house and it was around 25 degrees inside. We changed the temperature to 20 degrees as that is "room temperature" and we purposely selected this based on the air conditioning in the listing.
After changing the thermostat, we got an immediate message from the host saying not to change the temperature. I mentioned I get frequent nosebleeds when it gets hot. The host did not care at all and gave very rude and hostile comments. Here are comments directly from the host: "My other guests have complained the whole house is too cold. Keep at 24 and do not set my ac any lower again. This is a shared house. You are causing my other guests discomfort by changing the thermostat. The outside is colder than 20 so open a window instead. Do Not change my thermostat temperature again."
For the whole trip the house was 24-26 degrees inside even with the windows open and outside temperature ranging from 16-20 C when we were there. It was cooler to be outside and we were sweating everytime we were inside the house.
Another big concern was with the surveillance cameras. There were cameras all over the house. The most invasive camera was right outside our room upstairs. They had cameras in the living room, kitchen and all over inside/outside the house. We counted around 4 cameras inside the house. There may be more hidden cameras that we were unaware about.
This made our stay very uncomfortable and uneasy as we felt like "walking on eggshells and the host was watching our every move inside the house. We ended up not using any of the downstairs or kitchen amenities because of this.
Also, the pillows and bed were very uncomfy. For a place with like 7 units, it seems like they went the most cost effective options. Plus the windows did not have any screens so there was a lot of noise and bugs coming directly into the room. The walls were very thin so you can hear others easily and with the windows open there was no privacy at all.
Overall, the experience was really terrible because of the rude host and multiple cameras that were not properly disclosed to us. It was our first time in Vancouver and this really soured our experience. Only good thing is the location and area seems nice.

A tiny room with a balcony very conveniently located in downtown. Accommodated my last min booking. The host became very disagreeable and threatened to call police over a dispute that could have been solved together: issues with my credit card and bank. I had initially extended my stay from 1 to 2 nights. With my belongings still in the room, he told me he had booked out the room and gave me 1 h to remove things and said he had a booking at 730 pm. This was a rude awakening as I thought I was heading to the bank to try to solve the credit card issue. While this is fine if we had agreed this was the best resolution, in my eyes, this is very un-community minded behaviour: To threaten police as someone is packing up as per requested to leave. He also became verbally aggressive and rude during what I endeavour was hopefully going to be a calm conversation. Despite the great location, I would never stay here again. This host seems to have given me a reason to host again myself and actually truly honour the guests I choose to let into my home.

I had a terrible experience and would not recommend at all. I had booked a 30-day stay, and cancelled shortly after checking in and inspecting the place.
Firstly - the check in instructions were unclear - there were directions to the room. There were 2 entry codes listed - one in the Airbnb listing and one in a message from Haidy - and both were wrong. Haidy's husband assisted with my check in, and initially didn't have the key to my room, and later didn't seem familiar with how the room lock worked (which was subsequently fixed), and the keychain broke.
Secondly - and this is the BIG issue - the room and the common area (kitchen and laundry room) had a terrible smell that was quite strong (a mix of smoke and some other chemicals that I'm not quite sure). I see a few previous reviews have also mentioned the smell, so this issue is not new.
The positives - the room itself was well equipped with everything mentioned in the listing, and Haidy was responsive to my messages.

The unit is terrible for someone who needs to stay longer than a few days. Doesn't have anything for cleaning, except a Broom.
The bedroom had a lot of dust behind the furnitures, the shower drain was clogged (which made me unable to take a shower the day I arrived), insects in the bathroom... For this price, this is unacceptable.

This is the most difficult review we have had to write. If it were a review of the owner, Mustapha, then it would be 5*. However, it is about the apartment. We stayed in several apartments in Canada and this was the most expensive but the worst. It is not awful but it does need a total refurb. Also, Mustapha lives here and so the main bedroom wardrobe is full of his own clothes. The other bedroom wardrobe has only 1 door and the other door is broken. The bathroom has a strange arrangement which is dangerous for tall people. As mentioned by other reviews, there is a strange musty, smoky smell. On the positive side, the location is great being on the edge of English Bay and opposite Granville Island. Mustapha was very friendly and helpful throughout which makes this review difficult.

Pros - This place is GORGEOUS! Well stocked with amenities (appliances, washer/dryer, gym, TV, WiFi) and easy to get in/out of. It is also very close to Downtown which was great! Leonard is also very easy to communicate with which was a great help.
Cons - Parking isn't a perfect situation but manageable. On weekends, it is much easier to parking on the street right below the complex than it is during the week. The neighborhood surrounding also was a little dirty and seemed unsafe at night, I didn't like parking there. The complex itself was beautiful and nice but the area around it did not make me feel comfortable walking around at night.

Overall a great, stylish condo good for two people at an awesome value. Was incredibly clean and had everything you could need. Bed was comfy and the views from the balcony were awesome. Definitely loved that Strathcona Brewing was less than a block away.
Leo was incredibly communicative and responded quickly to any questions we had. Can't ask for a better host!
One note - The condo is on the edge of a not so great part of Vancouver. All cab drivers told us we were staying in the worst part of the city. However we never felt unsafe in the couple block radius around the unit as it seems up and coming. You will pass by E Hastings on your way there so be prepared to see open drug use. As someone who lived in Chicago for 12 years this didn't phase me too much. Just use common sense and don't walk around at night.
Would definitely stay here again if I come back to Vancouver! Thank you!

Leo’s place was one of the most stylish apartments I have stayed at in all of my AirBnB experience. It was an absolute delight and every amenity you’re could think of was there ready to be used. In terms of the location, I know some people below have commented that the area can get a bit sketchy but I did not feel this at all. Many blocks down the road it does get a little sketchy but the area of this apartment has absolutely nothing that should make you worry. Leo was also wonderful at communication with very quick responses! Overall, it was an absolute pleasure and I hope to be back in the future.

The place looked just like it’s pictures.  Easy check in, It was decently clean.  However location was not as expected.  The ad made it seem like it’s close to downtown but it’s not.  It’s a 7-10 min drive (30 min walk)  to waterfront and 15 min drive (1 hr walk) to Granville island.  It cost us $15-30 Uber one way depending on the day to get downtown.  If you do want to walk, you can’t as you’ll have to pass an unsafe area in east hasting where the homeless population resides.  Ask any local and they will tell you it’s unsafe to walk on that street.

It is my opinion that Jag is a poor Airbnb host. While initially responsive, ultimately we found ourselves without a place to stay,  late at night, in the rain with our 2 year old. We didn’t get to stay at this accommodation. Jag agreed to issue a full refund & then became unresponsive & failed to follow through. In the end Airbnb remedied the situation. I believe this host is untrustworthy.

I would not recommend
Staying at this place if you want a clean and updated place to stay. It had mould, no heat, sticky floor, was not furnished very well, no tv and not trimmed on the walkway in. We were ducking through the hedge to carry in our luggage.

Ishtar worked hard at getting this place clean for me when I let her know I had concerns. But it’s really hard to feel good after the first impression. She even offered to refund, but it just wasn’t enough time to find a new place to stay without costing thousands more, so I stayed. For example, bathtub was dirty and the bedroom ceiling fan had an inch of lint build up on the blades, walls and baseboards had hair and dirt on them, floor was dirty, coffee table had cup rings and the sofa is very matted / scratched up. There were centipedes on the floor every morning. It was all liveable…just uncomfortable and Ishtar was very willing to make everything better by sending in cleaners the next day. The bed was very comfortable parking underground was nice and it is on a busy street but the location is great.

The place was absolutely filthy there were stains on the floors, walls, pillows and ceilings. There was hair on the counters in the bathroom, debris on the floor and black mold all around the door. There was also tape covering doors and spider webs in all of the corners. All of the baseboards were also not cleaned at all. There isn’t much of anything to do in the area either. Tried to get a refund but Linda was not very helpful would not recons staying here to anyone.

Positives: Excellent location. Walking distance to the restaurants and marina. Views are spectacular. Host is responsive.
Negatives: Unit is dated. The “AC” is a fan in both of the the rooms that did not cool the unit when temps were in the high 80s. Some minor issues: Fan vents are filled with dust, ceiling vent in bathroom is not secure, blinds are dirty and don’t work, mold in master shower curtain, and refrigerator/freezer had food left behind. For the same price, you can get a hotel with AC that is cleaner and more modern. Overall, it was a decent stay and our Vancouver experience was enjoyable.

The bathrooms are contaminated with black mold and pink bacteria and are gross. The entire place smells like mildew and this triggered allergies. The kitchen is dirty and filled with food leftovers. We had to look for another place as we couldn’t even use the bathrooms properly. I tried cleaning them, but that didn’t help. This resulted in more costs to us and ruining the travel schedule. We stayed one night because we arrived late at night and left the next morning before 9:00am. It was a booking for 4 nights, but got reimbursed for less than half of what was paid. The place is much smaller than it looks. Beds mattresses are very hard and it seemed like the sheets were not changed as there was some “glitter” or debris under the pillows. Towels are stained, overall this place needs to be entirely remodeled. The owner was responsive, but didn’t recognize the fact that his place is not maintained properly.

The place is in a nice location & walkable from everything. Loved that Jimmy recommended restaurants & was very responsive ❤️ After booking Jimmy sent instructions through the AirBnb messages that were very detailed & specific. Beware that the key booking link Jimmy sends the instructions are not accurate with address. The 7-Eleven address is a bit off but still easy to find. I had to go off the address in the Airbnb messages that Jimmy had sent and/or the address listed on the AirBnb. The apartment building is called "Orca Place" which would've been very helpful when finding the parking garage. A picture showing what the parking garage looks like wouldve made things so much smoother 🚘 The apartment was nice I like that it had so much windows with views, the outdoor Balcony is only big enough to stand outside. Both bathrooms did have mold & the master bedroom had some mold in the roof corner by the window. The fans & AC machine were a life saver, really appreciated & used them ☺

This is the first time I've not given a five star rating for Airbnb. In the past my experiences with Airbnb have been wonderful.
My husband was feeling stressed with work and life and wanted a get away for quiet meditation and stress release. We booked a night at Joanne's place because her photos looked perfect for that with a charming enclosed back yard in a quiet neighbourhood. We told her we live in the same city as her and he just wanted a quiet retreat. She took our booking and didn't mention that her back yard is at present a construction zone. When he arrived he learned she is building a laneway house in her yard and the construction noise would be going from 8 am to 4 pm.
Needless to say he didn't stay there. We asked for a refund and he came home and slept in our own bed. Not even a partial refund was given. He paid $165 in rent, $40 in cleaning, $26 in service fee, $22 in taxes. That's a total of $254 to sleep in his own bed. I've invested hours of my time to attempt to come to an amicable resolution with no success.

this isn't a luxury stay. far from it. you'll receive a PDF with instructions on how to use an espresso machine that doesn't exist. you'll open the door and be greated by a fireplace that doesn't work. The living room chairs have arm rests that have ripped. one bedroom is great. the other one is cramped with no ventilation and a cheap sorta broken lamp illuminating a bed that has metal slats that have fallen out of place. There were no cleaning supplies really to take care of the place with. really hoping that there's a cleaning service that brings their own dishwasher detergent because otherwise they're just washing dishes with water I guess. even the furniture that isn't broken is just really cheap and uncomfortable. the walls are scuffed. one bathroom has a big hole in the drywall. it genuinely looks like the place was recently robbed. I think the "luxury" ad was extremely misleading and it was a disappointing yet expensive experience for me and my family.

My husband and I are currently in arbitration over false and contrived claims made by this host. We are shocked and want to warn potential guests of Sara's extortion attempt amounting to $3,000. She accused us of stealing, breaking things, leaving the place dirty and she included misleading photos (like a photo showing a couple of dust bunnies on the floor and claiming them to be stains). She claims we stole Sofa Cushions, Bath Towels, Blankets, Bedding Sheets, and Pillows: We did not steal sofa cushions, in fact we saw no such cushions. We did not use any of the large towels as we brought our own from home. We used one small face towel, one hand towel and one kitchen towel - all of which we left in the apartment. We did not take any blankets or bedding. We brought our own duvets and pillows and sheets from home. A number of items seemed to be crammed into the bedroom cupboard and the closet shelf above. I know this because I cleared a few shelves in the bedroom cupboard in order to store our clothing as there was no space on the shelf above the closet and only 3 hangers. Perhaps, all the so-called missing items are there. We did accidentally break one small melamine plate that costs around a dollar at Ikea, which was not part of a set, there was only one in the apartment. Sara also claims we broke a small speaker: We did not break it. From the photo, it looks like the cover came off and revealed that the frame was broken, but this was not our doing. This speaker was already on the floor on the bottom of the unit, pushed to the back. We did not even use the entertainment system or any speakers, except to watch TV at night after work. The host also claims we left the apartment dirty. We left it just as we found it. We do actually think it requires more time and attention to clean the apartment properly. We only wish that it had been done prior to our arrival, but instead we arrived to a very superficially cleaned place. As soon as you opened any cupboards or drawers it was disheveled and disorganized and ill equipped. We ourselves cleaned several drawers when we arrived to feel comfortable – for example, there were hairs from shaving all over the bathroom drawer, it was quite disgusting. For the sake of the next guests, we hope the place is in proper order before they arrive. We should have taken photos. We feel so naive to believe that if we act honourably, so will others. To conclude, we feel completely stressed by these accusations. We had to come to Vancouver during a Pandemic to work - this was not a holiday for us. On top of arriving to a very cold and disorganized and completely impractical apartment, the bed was very uncomfortable, the couch was filthy with stains as were the dining chairs. Thank goodness we brought our own bedding since the bed had only one twin cover on it, clearly not big enough for two people and we ended up sleeping separately. Now my back is aching from that horrible futon and I will need to get physiotherapy for it. The apartment took 3 days to warm up since the thermostat was very slow and programmed to go down to 9 degrees every night. We tried to turn on the “fireplace” and only the fan turned on, but no heat. The kitchen was not properly stocked, there was no pasta strainer, no can opener, and some of the pots/pans could not be used on the gas stove as even low heat would cause their handles to smell of burning plastic. It seemed as if the apartment was fitted with all of the discarded items from another home without any thought of the needs and practicality of a small place. We didn't complain because we took care of it ourselves and had work to do, and were worried to find another safe apartment in this Pandemic situation. However, a couple weeks after arriving we also saw a sign in the elevator which stated that the building condos should not be used “as a hotel”. Does the host have the right and permission to offer this place through AirBnb? After dealing with all the issues in this place and feeling like we might be breaking the law by staying there... and after working 12 - 16 hour days for the past 5 weeks… we now find ourselves being extorted. What a shame! Beware a wolf in sheep's clothing.

My husband and 2 toddlers stayed here and i think it was just enough space. I felt unclean the entire time we were there, just because it looked clean didn’t mean it was. There were dirty towels in the hamper and dishes in the dishwasher. It’s like they only cleaned what was visible. Obvious mold in the shower and the knob for the shower was falling off. We only stayed here because there was a room close to the bedroom but there was absolutely no walkway if the bed was down. I think there needs to be a bit of a rearrangement. We didn’t use any towels or dishes because who knows what was cleaned. No broom either for kids crawling.
Anyway, I just got creepy vibes everywhere we went. The room itself was fine but the parking lot was creepy and the pool was as well, especially the showers. We didn’t even swim because of that.
Communication was great, very responsive but poor directions even in the original description. Will definitely not be staying here in the future.

Unfortunately, we couldn't give Kelly a 5 star review, there were great things about her place but there were a few things that made our stay uncomfortable.
*Here's the good:
Amazing location, I grew up in East Van, very close to Kelly's house, I know the neighbourhood inside out so it was great to be located there.
If you're not familiar with the city, it's very close to Main st where you can find many shops and restaurant's, easy to walk.
The home itself was very cute, we really liked the space, the kitchen is fully equipped, we did a lot of cooking, this home has the space and the equipment you need to have meals at home.
There's lots of additional towels and I think bedding if needed.
We really enjoyed pulling out the sofa and watching Netflix at night, it was relaxing.
The place was fairly clean, except for a few things; bedding was not properly washed and bathroom had an awful (pee like) odour.
*The bad:
Let me just mention that Kelly lives right behind the house, as soon as you open the back door you're literally are in her patio.
We were OK with this, although I don't think this is mentioned on her listing and I think it's important to mention this.
The issue started when one day Kelly looked through her garbage bin and started criticizing us for not separating the garbage. We were watching the whole thing as she was talking very angry about us. Shortly after she send us a few messages about the garbage.
Kelly is super particular about her garbage (if not obsessed) and no people in Vancouver are not like that...
We travelled about 8 hours to Vancouver so we had garbage with us, this was way before we read in her manual that you have to separate every bit of your garbage. We weren't going to separate old stinky and nasty old garbage so we followed what she requested in the manual on day #2.
Kelly went on and on about this and sent me a link to learn more about the garbage, I thought it was funny and excessive that she couldn't let go a bag of garbage in the garbage bin.
The other issue was that when we hung out some of our clean laundry in our tiny patio (Kelly does it, as well as the neighbours)
We had another message from her asking us to remove the dry clothes because apparently "it doesn't look good for the neighbours "
Our laundry would take days to dry because that patio gets almost no sun.
In another occasion we watched Kelly angry when she found out that we put out the patio door the shower mat and toilet brush. We did this because as mentioned above there was a very unpleasant smell in the bathroom, the smell got better once we removed these items.
Kelly lives in such a close proximity of the rental property that we felt the rest of trip that she was after us and that made me uncomfortable.
We are very clean people, we take pride in how we maintain good cleaning and good care of the Airbnb's we stay at.
We understand Kelly too but I think she could've handle this situations a lot different.
Due to her attitude we wouldn't recommend this place nor stay again. Pity because it's a great property.

Allison’s place is better than pictured. The bed was heavenly. The kitchen is well-equipped. Allison recommended an amazing Indian restaurant that we enjoyed. We were somewhat disappointed that a terrace fire pit shown & mentioned in her ad was no longer available. But Allison assuaged our disappointment with a small refund that we used on a dinner out. Great host, nice place.

My words of advice is to read all of the reviews and believe the feedback about the bed(s). One of the beds is a box spring with a thin egg crate mattress on top in an attempt to add some comfort.  The bed is awful and it is unreasonable for the host to expect guests to sleep on it.  When we contacted Airbnb costumer service it took the host over 24 hours to respond.  We ended up going to Walmart to buy blow up mattress to sleep on.  The second bedroom had the mattress on the floor. This is different than the photos on the website.  Other furniture was also removed that was in the website.  The sheets on one of the beds had dirty/stained sheets. There was an issue with noise from the residence upstairs.  The children were playing in the stairwell that connected to the Airbnb, it was noisy at night. Additional trash bags and other needed supplies were not provided. In my opinion the host  puts very little effort into the comfort of her guests.

This place is in a great neighbourhood with lots of amenities, and in close proximity to downtown Vancouver. The space itself is reasonably furnished, however it is a basement apartment that is not sound insulated. This meant there was a lot of noise experienced from the family upstairs and the separate tenanted apartment within the subdivided basement.
While the host was quick to address the issues initially experienced during our stay (general cleanliness, unclean sheets, loud music played into the night), we were subjected to unacceptable levels of noise and partying from both the host and the tenanted property until 11pm and 2am on two separate occasions. This far exceeded the stated 10pm “quiet time” advised by the host. For this reason, I couldn’t recommend this place to people looking for a quiet place to rest, relax, and enjoy.

The place didn’t work us for us due to my allergies and no cell reception for our phones which is with freedom mobile and my husband needs cell reception for his job. However the hosts were fair and nice enough to refund us most of our money minus cleaning fees / air bnb fee which is fair and understandable. We only stayed in apt for less than 2 hours so I can’t give it a good assessment but the hosts were fair with refund so I give it mostly 5 star ratings for most categories.

I would have given this location 5 stars, but for one thing. At the end of my 1-week stay, I woke up with insect bites on my arm. I don't know what from, and I worried about bed bugs. I sent the host a private message, (because you don't want to raise the specter of bed bugs without cause), but I never got any kind of response back. I waited two weeks to post this review. Nada. It's not like I was asking for a refund. I just wanted some acknowledgement of what happened to me.
Other than that, you could not ask for a better location in Vancouver. 1 block from public transit and THREE grocery stores. All the kitchen supplies you might need. Fairly quiet. I mostly had a wonderful stay. But if something goes wrong, you shouldn't expect to hear from this host.

This air bnb was okay, but definitely not up to par for the price paid. I will say that Sarah was very good at communicating and she was good at resolving issues when we had a parking issue and getting inside, etc.
The pillows for the pull out bed were very dirty and had visible stains. The side tables in the main bedroom were dusty and dirty. The pull out bed in the living room had a dirty sock stuck in it and dirt and such underneath. We were surprised by that. Cleanliness is definitely a major area for improvement. The blinds in the master bedroom were also visibly broken. The pull out bed mattress was also visibly stained and old and dirty. It is need of replacement. The pull out bed was also very hard to pull out.
The location was great. The location is close to the sky train and bus lines. Overall, the place was OK.

Patio had a lot of cob webs and nature debris. Countertops were dirty.
The table was very sticky.
Couch extremely uncomfortable to sit on. No real comfortable seats in the entire condo.
Very low uncomfortable bed. Toaster very dirty inside. Overall unsatisfactory conditions.

Thanks for the stay! Host was easy to talk to despite not wanting to refund our stay because of Covid. We were supposed to be there in 2021 (but couldn’t make it because of Covid). After long conversations between the host and Airbnb, she wouldn’t refund us and our only possibility was to postpone our stay to this year. We had to plan and include this destination on our 2022 trip around the exact same date (because we had to choose the date a year prior).
Despite this frustrating event a year prior, the Airbnb was nice, but being more than four would’ve caused space problems.
Checking in was a bit confusing for us at the beginning as it wasn’t working. Otherwise, it’s really easy to come in and out of the building and apartment after that.
No A/C during summer time was a surprise for us. It was really hot inside and made our stay less comfortable. At least there were some fans, so that was nice.
Otherwise, lots of amenities for your personal care, that was appreciated!

Very dangerous area many people sleeping out on the pavements taking drugs police car sirens all night.
We we’re scared to go out at night
Apartment in dirty condition needs completely redecoration holes in walls window blinds didn’t work ,no air conditioning,fans were inadequate
Apartment was like a greenhouse.
in general are very unpleasant stay
The worst Airbnb I’ve ever come across

The location is amazing. Walkable distance to lots of restaurants & attractions. However, the cleanliness was terrible - kitchen appliances were sticky/dirty, thick dust on shelves, etc. The linens provided for the pull out couch were awful - falling apart quilt with fuzz coming out of it, and yellow stains. The pull out couch that was advertised as a place for a person to sleep needs to go to the landfill. The pleather was flaking off, and the metal posts in it made it unbearable to sleep on. Needs some TLC - coffee maker didn’t work, bulbs burnt out in the light fixtures, one of the bathroom fans didn’t work, the wood panel under the dishwasher kept falling off … just lots of little things.
The pool, sauna, and hot tub are a great feature.
The view from the balcony was stunning at night.

The location is great! Super good restaurants nearby. The parking garage is.... interesting. The view from the condo is amazing.
The place itself was not clean. There was hair in both bathrooms. The floors had dirty spots all over. They needed to be mopped and it was very obvious. The kitchen was pretty yucky. The oven and microwave needed to be cleaned inside and out.
The condo wasnt gross but it was really clean either.
Je was a great communicator. He provided clear and thorough instructions. And he also gave us great food recs.

We wanted to enjoy our stay here. We really did. However, this AirBnB was a disappointment from the moment we arrived. The parking garage instruction was very misleading and thoughtlessly constructed. The amount of time that we wasted on finding the spot to finding the actual place ruined our vacation mode. At first, we thought the host was nice. But not only was she extremely rude to her guests, she also caused us a lot of stress. She made false accusation to scam us to pay her an extra $100. Don’t recommend this place to anyone, her host status should be reconsidered.

You don’t get buzzer access so you have to wait for the host to buzz you in the building when you arrive, which wasn’t reliable.
I could hardly breathe in the suite as it smelt very strong of bleach from the time I arrived to the time I left (2 weeks). Someone smokes next door so the scent was bleach and cigarette for the entire stay. There was no fan or air conditioning and the heat was unbearable during very high temperatures. The bed is very old and uncomfortable with flat pillows and minimum bedding, I had to sleep on the couch because my back couldn’t handle it. Towels were old and crusty over saturated in bleach. No screens on the windows so if you open them flies would come in. Host completely ignored any and all requests, she simply just chose not to respond. I paid way too much to stay here for two weeks for the quality. They’re doing construction in the back which has been going on for a while apparently, and it is hard to drive back there, a nail went through my tire. Not the host fault they are doing construction but since I have been going on long term a notification would’ve been nice as I probably would’ve chosen not to drive down that back alley to go into the parking. Days before my check in I had a call that my surgery that was postponed was going to go through a few days earlier so I asked if I could change my checkout date she didn’t respond, when I repeatedly asked her she told me Airbnb wouldn’t allow it. I contacted Airbnb and they said they would refund me partial which was still over $400 for the three nights that I would not be staying there if Natalia agreed to it. She told Airbnb she would not agree to it and continue to ignore any updates from my end. I paid three nights and four days for this condo that was completely empty. I felt scammed and lied to. If she didn’t want to change the couple days for me she could’ve just said so instead of lying blaming it on Airbnb and then ignoring me for my stay.
I wouldn’t recommend this host or stay with her again. For the same price you can rent a fully furnished suite for a whole month which I have done and it was nicer with more professionalism.

We were disappointed with our stay at Natalias. This suite is a bare-boned suite. Not geared towards someone that wants to spend any time there. To use the kitchen... No sharp knives, no kitchen linens, very limited utensils, the oven still had a pan in it from a previous tenant.
We only had a partial roll of toilet paper... Wait... What?!
We hoped to spend some time on the balcony, which we did. After I moved a stack of vehicle tires out of the way.
Sorry... I hate giving terrible reviews. That's not the kind of people we are. We'd love to love... but we can't this time around.
Not staying here again.
Natalia, I wish you the best, and I hope you are able to improve the customer experience going forward.
Cheers.

she provides wifi & a TV with roku but nothing to be able to watch on the roku. We were visiting from the US and we aren't allowed to log into our own streaming devices because we're not in our own country. You should offer SOME sort of streaming abilities for guests staying in your unit. The pillows were flat as a pancake on the bed. The blinds are falling apart, there are tires on the balcony when you can get passed the TV on the stand covering half of the slider door to the balcony. There is zero sharp knives to be able to cut anything unless you use a butter knife. There is no air conditioner nor a fan to cool the unit down. The building the unit is located in is safe, however the area outside of the building is dirty and I felt unsafe. We literally walked past someone shooting up heroin at the TD bank almost next door to the building and another person smoking crack. If you leave the windows open during the day or at night because it is too hot in the unit, you're inundated with sirens and construction. The blinds do not go all the way down so that people in the residence Inn (I think that is the hotel directly across the kitchen sink) can't look directly into the unit. The construction work and sirens prevent you from enjoying any peace and quiet yet it was too hot to keep the windows closed. Definitely not a place I would choose to stay in again. The cabinets next to both sides of the bed prevent you from being able to put clothes in the cabinets because she has boxes and a suitcase and door dash bags stored in the cabinets. The lamps were barely standing they're just old and falling into the blinds or windows. Sadly I didn't feel safe enough in the area to go out after sunset even with my husband.

Not a very good experience.
homeless people shooting drugs right on the doorsteps, noisy construction nearby, with construction workers literally looking into the apartment windows, just generally sketchy area.
the stay itself was also mediocre. late check-in and early check-out (4pm and 10am respectively), excessive "house rules" (for example, prior to this stay i have never been asked to remove bedsheets before leaving), that sort of thing.
not horrible but not great either.

Fox was really friendly and accommodating but the whole place was unfortunately a let down for how much I had to pay. The place was very dirty including the bed and pillows, thick dust on the bathroom fan blower, and clutter everywhere. Would not recommend for a female unless you won't mind having two male roomates sharing a kitchen and bathroom. The building in itself was good and had a gym, pool, and other amenities.

This Airbnb appears perfect with a great location and top amenities, but our experience left us feeling like we were invading someone else's space. The bathroom and kitchen were dirty, with no towels for guests and restricted kitchen hours. We had to eat on the bed because of the lack of seating. Although the host compensated us for the lack of cleanliness, the experience made us uncomfortable. The host didn't acknowledge us by the end of our stay, and we wouldn't recommend this Airbnb due to the state of the apartment and the host's behavior. While the location and amenities are fantastic, the unpleasant experience is not worth it.

From the perspective of a loyal AirBnB user who has not stayed at hotels for any long vacations in many years, this particular ABnB is the worst I’ve ever stayed at. The prompt communication from my host is the only reason I’m giving it 2 stars. Do yourself a favor, book elsewhere.
For us, this booking was a last minute change forced due to cancellation of our original booking by previous host, and poor handling of situation by AirBnB team. I wish I could also rate ABnB team as 1 star for that and bad handling of our complaints, below.
Location: this ABnB is at the junction of two very busy streets and you constantly hear the noise of vehicles slowing and accelerating, despite the windows. The walk score is poor and it’s at least 25-30 minutes from any decent restaurant or grocery / convenience store.
Cleanliness: The bedsheets and the bathrooms were clean but both cooking and serving dishes were unclean with stuck-on food. The kitchen floor was sticky and laundry room had both mud and mold. The garbage bin in kitchen had no lid forcing us to leave garbage open, and throw in larger trash can every night. The larger trash can at the back of the house by the garage was full of rotting, previously thrown garbage bags.
Comfort and amenities: the main living room had the most uncomfortable single couch and two dining chairs that served as additional seating. The larger primary bedroom had poor ventilation and poor climate control. We could barely sleep there because of how hot it would get. On contacting the host, we were told that only way to address this to open the window (which meant even louder noise due to traffic). The TV in the living room had no cable connection, or any apps on the TV itself. Chromecast option was available that only worked for certain apps. The bathroom supplies were of poor quality.
Our group of 4 was surprised at the high ratings this ABnB has previously received. It certainly doesn’t has any amenities or qualities to justify a 560$ a night charge! All it has are 5 spacious bedrooms so maybe it’s a cost effective option for a big family or large group of college students - but I can’t see any other redeeming quality in this listing to justify its prior reviews.

We give one star for the beautiful, clean apartment. We give one star for the central location of the apartment. We deduct three stars for communication with the host. That was a disaster. He forgets us on our day of arrival. It wasn’t possible to reach the host. We had to wait 4 hours after 15 hours of traveling. Only after we called Airbnb, he answered. The key was missing. The combination lock only applies to the front door. Not for the entry door. Even if "independent check-in" is indicated, we strongly recommend to contact the host in advance. There are also star deduction because Netflix and the TV didn’t work, because there was no description for the stove, the fireplace and the TV. In the end we were accused of breaking in, although the combination lock for the front door and the upper apartment door was the same. In our desperation we have tried all possibilities.

We overall had a good 1 month stay in this accommodation. They had all the necessary kitchenware and provided cleaning supplies which was very nice. We were a bit disappointed when we arrived and noticed the fridge and some pots and pans were a bit dirty. Also, most condiments in the fridge were expired. The place was very comfortable and in a great location with many restaurants, groceries stores and a laundromat within walking distance. We were working at Vancouver General Hospital and surrounding clinics which were easy to get to.

I had to cancel my stay with Nelson days prior to check in due to the coronavirus outbreak, to protect myself and my family. Nelson refused to change his refund policy due to this global outbreak and stopped responding to my messages through the app, which I found both offensive and extremely frustrating. I am sure his condo is nice, but beware of his refund policy as he is unwilling to work with you despite a global pandemic. I had to contact Airbnb about 20 times to reach a supervisor and get a partial refund as well, so beware of their customer service as it is the worst I have ever experienced.

The location of house was about 20 minutes distance to dowtown, airport and University Golf Club. We were 4 couples and we needed 4 separate bed rooms and 4 baths, which was important reason to select Jason's house (stylish 7 beds).
House was relatively new and well maintained. However, we cound not sleep well in two rooms among three rooms in basement due to noise from freezer at night.
There was no TV in the first floor, and TV room in basement was close to washing machine - hard to enjoy chatting to close the day.
Kitchen facilities such as flypans, pots, kettle were too dirty or rusty which we could not use. Wine openers were broken. No kitchen towel and no Kleenex tissue. Worst experience ever.
We were asked to use 'the prepared wet facial tissue' to remove the make-up to protect white towels. However, the quailty of the facial tissue was very poor - probably cheapest one.
I will not stay at Jason's house again until he improves what I described.

Kathy’s place is exactly as the pictures, she is prompt in responding within reason and also very approachable with concerns and questions. She was very accommodating when a concerned happened and she was quite proactive in helping us out. The place is older but gets the job done, lots of room and allowed all of us to have a nice home to get back to after long exhausting days. One thing we didn’t realize how close of a bus ride it is to metrotown, not that close to sky trains but buses to sky trains were accessible. The Airbnb is quite central in terms of commuting to all places of MetroVancouver such as not terrible to commute to Richmond, close to Burnaby and not terrible to get to Coquitlam. If you have a car it is really nice to commute to all places! The home itself is comfortable enough to get through sleep, and spacious enough for basic needs. I will see the best point of this airbnb is Kathy and how she will be responsive and proactive with your needs.

Bad Experience:
Booked 3 nights but left after the first night. Poor sleep on springy mattress with a single old stained pillow.
Then there were issues with the refund:
Steve said he would ONLY refund if i left him a good review. Then he refunded me less than 1/2 my money when i was owed 2/3. He made some excuse how it was airbnbs fault that he was ripping me off.

This is the lowest rating I have given and I am not giving it lightly. I think this location has amazing potential and Minsung was very helpful when we reached out to him, however be advised. The problems come from poor description and the low rating is mostly due to cleanliness.
1) If you have a vehicle you will need to take everything out of it and the trek from safe(ish) parking locations to the building requires you to cross the street. The parking under the building to the right of the apartments is gross and at the time of our stay had a number of homeless
people inside. The parking across the street is much better but again farther away and if you have more than your bag in the vehicle it gets to be rather cumbersome.
2) the area is not the safest, it was dirty and a number of homeless people were around, this is understandable but there are safer areas for sure.
3) The noise pollution level is fairly high, this is particularly true due to the alleyway behind the building.
4) the apartment has great potential, and I greatly appreciated that it is a locked building. However, it wasn't clean. The couch bed smelled strongly of BO and the shower had hair on walls. The kitchen dishes were filthy, there was a glass with a literal dirt ring in it and the pots and pans were very dust. Everyone expects to wash down their dishes before use but there is no dish soap provided so we had to go buy dish soap in order to use the dishes. You could run anything you plan to use through the dishwasher but again, dishes should at least appear clean. The bed did not have a top sheet and the blanket provided had an odor. The ceiling fan was very dirty, and I can imagine if used would likely drop dust. The washer and dryer did not have proper knobs and instead a pair of pliers was placed next to the device for you to start the machine. All in all the place needs better tending to.
5) On the plus sides, the gas stove is lovely and after washing, the pots and pans are as well! Yaletown is a funky little area and there is a great deal within walking distance to be enjoyed especially for the younger crowd. If new cleaning staff are employed and you don't have a vehicle it would be a lovely little spot!

Broken fridge, strong smoking smell, and windows facing a noisy, dirty alley left us a little disappointed with Minsung’s place. However, the layout of the unit was nice, the windows allowed for a lot of light, and the building is very decent.
Very dirty, instructions almost illegible. I was locked in the parkade and couldn’t get to my car due to the faulty instructions and Minsung replied with “Have a wonderful day!” Nightmare!

This stay is an excellent location. The place itself is in a very old, sketchy building and the condo is definitely outdated (bathroom etc) and in need of a refresh for sure. The bed was definitely the bare minimum (just a fitted sheet and a comforter with no top sheet). It feels kinda dirty and like the absolute bare minimum is done. The condo is a cool loft though and looks like the photos, but if you are looking for something newer and have higher standards, you will not like this place. I am not one to leave a bad review and this isn’t a bad review even; I just want people to have an accurate understanding of what this place is.  Minsung is easy to contact and is a good, friendly host so if you are just looking for a cheap place to crash right downtown this is a great choice!

Some positives: the bedding was clean except for a rubber band in the bed. We appreciated being able to bring our dog, and the hosts left a bag of fruit outside our door. Kind, although a little unusual.
The unit needs a deep clean. The walls were dirty, the microwave roof was grimey, there were ant traps in the bathroom, and there was a damp smell. No AC, some ceilings were only 6.5 feet, the dryer lint trap needed emptying, and the appliances looked smeared. The couch was dirty and slightly discoloured.
The photos made the space appear much brighter than it was. The walkway light shines into the bedroom, and if the other unit is occupied, guests can use the backyard table facing the kitchen, limiting privacy.
A big issue was repeated requests for five stars: notes on the walls and a message. We were only there 36 hours, so we chose not to raise these issues during our stay. Had we stayed longer, we would have left and found alternative accommodations.
The apartament and the host are very cool, no problems at all. The location is good for explore downtown but the building street is noisy, dirty, smelly and full of strange people.

I have never left a bad rating on AirBnB before but I could not let this one go. We had to walk through trash to get in the gate. The bedding consisted of a bottom sheet, a comforter with matching shams. No top sheet, no pillowcases. Ick factor here huge. Old used scrubby sponge in the "kitchen" and mold in shower. There is NO TV in this unit! No air conditioning but couldn't open windows because it's right on a major highway, too noisy. Total lack of kitchen implements, including no glasses. Two coffee cups (no coffee) period. Place was so small that a teeny microwave was in the "bedroom" area. This place was a total fail. He did refund $21 back to us (really?). Would definitely not recommend. This place has no business being on AirBnB.

We had a 6 month stay booked with Max. The place flooded and he put us up in a hotel. The work took longer than expected and he had to prolong the stay beyond his initial projection. Unfortunately, after moving into the unit, it was still not ready. The washer and dryer weren’t ready, and more work needed to be done. We were in the unit for only 4 days. We asked to cancel and were forced to pay fees despite the terrible experience.
There were also stains on the couches which weren’t reflected in the images. Airbnb also did a TERRIBLE job of providing support for us as a result of these issues.

Disgusting!!
good price BUT
Mold everywhere in the bathroom and around sinks and bathtub, heater not working and everything is out of battery, broken and super noisy beds that make sleeping impossible, smelling food all day and night, broken walls and doors and shower head, dirt on all window blinds.
Be Aware!!

This place is a do not recommend. The place was filthy, stained sheets, bodily white fluid on the walls, the shower handle was hand on by tape, the floors under the couch were disgusting and the freezer and frozen blood from meat all along the bottom. The check in process was very weird. You want in to this persons house to get to the air bnb.

Stayed at level and was simply unsatisfied. The check in staff was rude and unhelpful to me. For example, I requested early checkin via app, they said will text me when ready. Then, I requested early checkin in person, they said they would call and did not. Then when check-in came around, a $500 deposit was required and additional contract had to be signed outside of the airbnb app. This to me defeats the point of using AirBnb. Additionally, the pictures do not match the suite you get, the pictures indicated a balcony, new HD Flatscreen and glass shower - It was a regular bathtub, no balcony, and older TV. For this place being more expensive then surrounding hotels, I do not recommend. You are better off staying at a hotel!

DO NOT BOOK HERE
I arrived at 830pm as a solo female on a business trip attending a conference. I was denied entry because my credit card would not work to give them a $500 deposit despite having prebooked and paid for everything on the Airbnb app and a solid Airbnb rating. The attendant provided NO assistance (would not manually enter my CC) and sent me to the streets of Vancouver at 9pm alone as a female. I have actively used Airbnb for the last 10 years and I have never had such a horrible experience. The manager phoned me the next day to apologize and offer me a refund/airbnb gift card, which was nice gesture, however the gift card for $100 which wasn’t even a quarter of how much a last minute hotel cost in the city. To say I am appalled by the way this was all handled would be an understatement.

Great location. The mattress was horrible and should be replaced.  The hot tub was a nice touch, but very small and it was disappointing you couldn't have a hot tub before 10am.  Overall, we would stay here again.   Convenient walking distance to arenas, seawall, Stanley Park, etc.

great gentleman working at the desk was both happy and happy to help. location was close to the event I was visiting for which was a plus, but very noisy area was the cost of this proximity!
the space was pretty great, had a big comfy bed and lots of curtains for privacy. I liked that I could watch TV from bed! my only complaint is that the island in the kitchen was visibly dirty from prior guests, drink rings all over and had not been attended to by the cleaner. this made me feel skeptical of the cleanliness elsewhere so I was careful about where I placed my personal items.
but! a huge plus was the onsite washer and dryer. and even a little packet of detergent. this really was a fine place to stay. I only bring up the island because I was disappointed, especially when an early check in couldn't be accommodated -- if check out is at 10AM and check in is at 4pm, one would expect that's plenty of time to deep clean.

LEVEL is a perfect location with everything within 5 min walk. We asked them to set up two more chairs in our room and for a late check out. They kindly helped us with both. The hot tub is small is great for relaxation. The gym has a lot of equipments and spacious. We did have to ask for housekeeping to clean our room floor because it seemed like it was not cleaned. The cleaner came with a sweeper mop with dirty cloth to wipe our floor in dirty shoes. I kept finding different person’s hair inside my clothes after I used the bed (definitely not our hair because it was blonde and we have black hair). The cleaning needs a lot of improvement. But overall the amenities are great and its good for short stay.

How was our experience in this Airbnb? Not great at all... The location is pretty good with the different bus lines, but that’s all...  We didn’t expect this by seeing the pictures of the room on Airbnb. We think that the owners aren’t living here, there is no decoration in the whole apartment and it’s a bit smelly... We are not sure that the sheets were washed and on top of it, in the morning we had to help the next guest to enter in the apartment!! We wouldn’t recommend...

honestly the place it self was nice however one of the guest was so rude they banged our wall at night even though we r being quiet and just dropped my apple watch once. we were VERBALLY ABUSED MULTIPLE TIMES. (even after checkout he open the window and said rude things about us)  He also snored so bad, he does not know how to flush toilet and put fully poop covered tissue in trash can which was VERY STINKY. This guy came home very late at night and keep on making noise as well. But host agent was so nice everything was clean and she even gave us MERRY CHRISTMAS CHOCOLATE. Overall, we would like to stay again but hope this guest is not here anymore it was such a rude person

First of all we agreed before the reservation was made that we would check in at 2 am. The day before the host denied the check in time and after a big discussion she agreed to rent a place for us. When we arrived in Vancouver around 1 am we had to pick up the keys in a 7 eleven in the middle of the night riding a cab after a really long flight. When we arrived at the place she got us two of us  had to share a small sofa bed, that was really bad.
