The next day we had to took  another cab to the real Airbnb place that we rent and when we got there, there were empty bottles on the kitchen table and the dishwasher and the fridge were very dirty. The laundry room was not inside the house, like we thought, it was in the backyard and had a restricted time to use it, really bothered us because at night was the only time the we had to do the laundry and it was not allowed after 9 pm. The bikes were not exclusively for us, were shared. The host said that if we were gonna use the bikes we should lock them all the times or not let them alone she gave us the keys for the bike locks. Unfortunately, we locked them in front of a restaurant to dine there and one of them got stolen, the lock were cut. I immediately called the police and then informed the host and gave her the police report number, because only her, the owner, could continue the investigation with the police and ask for surveillance cameras footage. She got complete mad about it and said that bike was the most expensive one and that was our fault and that we had to pay for a new one at that right moment. We tried to explain to her that was really not our fault and that we sent a message to the Airbnb explaining what had happened and asking what we had to do if we had to pay or if it had an insurance. The host stopped being polite and said bad things to us and when she charged us through the app, the Airbnb denied it. I was only waiting an answer from the Airbnb, but the host was completely rude and unprofessional. I wouldn’t recommend the place at any circumstances.

I got scammed! I book this place for my daughter for 2 nights only to find out on check in instructions she couldn’t check in because she would have had to have my credit card match her id. I emailed the place and got no timely response and then requested a refund and got half the money back. Absolute scam!

This suite is not suitable for children. I had to move the bed to fit the pack and play provided which smelled very musty (indicator of mold). They provided a baby chair that was also covered in mold. The barking dog woke the baby. The male host entered the suite without knocking when the keys were accidentally left in the door on the second night. The host declined a partial refund for our experience. Airbnb become involved and covered the reimbursement.

It would be hard to say how my stay was because I never stayed here but was charged for 1 night. I walked in, it smelt like dirty dog blankets, there was no power, no TV, very small, and it felt like a dungeon, so my wife and I walked right back out and had to go get a different hotel room. All this after a long awaited and anticipated time of planning. I should have a complete refund. Whoever else stays here, great luck. I will say that the host is very informative and communicative, seems like a very nice person. Overall I would Not give it a rating. Zero Stars!!☹️
Great place, terrific location, very homey and well appointed.  Unfortunately the bathroom shower stall was very disgusting with mold and mildew.

This place was very misleading. I stayed here for 2 days with my boyfriend and his parents and was deeply disappointed. First of all, the pictures on the website are all pictures taken from a website when the place was purchased. It's completely changed and all the furniture is different than the pictures. I do realize that all the way at the bottom of the page it says "TV's" are excluded, but there is a line going through the word "TV's" which led me to believe there might be atleast 2, based on the pictures. There were none, and the cable that gets connected to the TV was jutting out of the wall, which gave the rooms a bad look. Then there were these nightmares listed below. I have used several Air B&B's and my boyfriends parents have used several around the World, but this by far was the worst one. There was such little effort used in making this place presentable, it felt like a joke. I'm going to email Air B&B to get my refund back, but I would recommend not wasting your money on this place.
*Lightbulbs in the restroom were broken
*The air vent in the Master Bathroom was not working
*The cupboards in the guest bathroom were broken and I almost dropped one of them on my toe when I opened it.
*The Shampoo and Body Wash bottles were close to empty
*The Blinders in the guest bedroom were broken and almost cut my boyfriend
*The washer and dryer were filthy and there were several hair on the washer.
*There was no trash can and when I texted the host about the situation, she said that there were trash bags and all we found was an empty box.
*The oven in the kitchen can only come down so far because it hits the side of the refrigerator when you bring it down.
* The pepper container was empty
*The window latch was broken in the main bedroom so you could not open it for some fresh air.
This was just ridiculous over all and I'm surprised that Air B&B even supports such establishments.
Thank you,
Vichitha Comfort

I have been using Airbnb for years and have not yet written a bad review... until now...
The home advertised and pictured in the ad are not for the home we stayed in. The layout looks the same but as for the furniture and amenities themselves, it is not the same home. The pictures had a clean and comfortable furniture and listed things that were not present in the home (grill, coffee pot, high chair, crib) which really inconvenienced our stay.
Aside from the false advertising and items not being there, the home was extremely dirty and did not include any cleaning supplies so I could make it better myself. There was so much dirty hair in the carpet of the bedrooms that we had to wear shoes during our stay. the bathroom vents had dust accumulating (and also did not work), baseboards of bathrooms were filthy nor were there trashcans present in the bathrooms. The soap in the bathrooms were watered down and even worse, the bathroom sinks did not drain. The beds did not have fitted sheets and bedroom window locks were broken.
Finally, the "third bedroom" did not have a full box spring under the queen bed so 1/3 of the mattress hung off of the base, making it impossible for two people to sleep on. Not only was it uncomfortable and look bad, a couple could not sleep together in this room.
The location of this space was extremely convenient and was the one perk during our stay. Being that it is on the edge of Chinatown, it is extremely close to bus stops and the train station which was great. Since there was not a coffee pot (as listed) having a Starbucks less than two blocks away was also extremely convenient and appreciated but overall, I would not stay here again.

Good communication with host. Cleanliness was not up to standard. Wet/smelly dish towel and cloth, dirty & wet mats/rugs, surfaces, chairs, and floors not cleaned properly. Some appliances for cooking didn’t work properly so not suited for making meals as described.

We had a wonderful stay at Natalya’s apartment. It was clean and well kitted out and the few things we needed extra Natalya got them for us straight away. The views are amazing and the location is very central. It’s close to shops, pubs, restaurants and public transport. It is in a slightly sketchy part of town with a lot of homeless people around but at no point did we ever feel unsafe. The apartment building itself  is very secure. Natalya was a brilliant host. Very friendly, attentive and responsive, nothing was too much trouble. All in all a great stay, in a great apartment with a great host.

Excellent accommodation.
Cannot recommend enough. Place was extremely clean, everything you could need in the house.
Hosts went above and beyond to make our stay excellent.
Great location close to bus stops and excellent restaurants in close proximity.
Cannot recommend enough

I really wanted to love this airbnb place, but when I stayed here with my family for a week-long vacation, it seemed like there was something new to discover everyday (and not in a good way).
Pros: self-check in process was smooth and location is great.
Cons: The listing pictures are misleading as they haven't been updated and they are much better in the pictures than what we walked into for our stay.
Cleanliness was clearly an issue, similar to another review from a couple years back from another guest. The sofas seemed to never have been vaccuumed or cleaned, as the blue one had crumbs on it when we first arrived and the brown sofa was extremely dirty from directly sitting on the floor. The refrigerator wasn't properly cleaned out either when we first arrived. There was leftover expired ice cream in the freezer and an opened kombucha drink in the fridge. We ended up cleaning out the fridge before actually using it. Some further things that we noticed was that the master bathroom had mold growing on it as well as a half of the sliding shower door and handle were missing. The other bathroom's shower curtain was completely mildew-laden on the bottom and I had to change it out myself. There were also various holes in the wall around the home left from a previous long-term tenant, as the host stated, but they didn't bother to fix up before listing it on the airbnb and renting it out.
During our stay, we thought that the entire home was to us as indicated in the listing, however, its a two family and you get the upstairs unit. So it should really be changed along the lines of "entire apartment" instead. The downstairs guests had accessed our home one of the days as well as the cleaners coming over without warning another day, with no prior communication from the host to let us know that they would be entering. The neighbors were not friendly, and stopped us one of the mornings saying that quiet hours were until 11:30am, when legally on the weekday that we encountered them, quiet hours were until 7AM. Whenever we would walk around the floors even to use the restroom if it was early or late in the morning, we would hear knocking on the floor from them hitting their ceiling to tell us to be quiet, which made us quite conscious.
If you are going to be booking with this host, please be clear in your communication. We asked for a late check out and confirmed if it would be okay for us to be there while the cleaners came. My family and I didn't think it was but the host confirmed it was okay for doing a late-check out and when the cleaning time came, as we were still in the home, the cleaners came, refused to clean and told us that they "didn't care what we discussed with Peter (the host), that most people check out at 11am and it was 1:30pm, so we needed to get out".
The only thing is the location of this listing; it's convenient and close to everywhere. However, I would not come back and stay here at this place again when I visit Vancouver the next time unfortunately.
the place smells terrible, stains on the roof, dust on their the beds and the pillows had a awful smell. the dryer did not work and the worse is to found a used condom under my bed.!!!!

I wanted to leave a positive review, however, I cannot.
The pros are that it is easy to find, there is street parking, the directions are clear, the photos match the place and the garden is lovely and fragrant. The place was very clean, except for a few black hairs on the chairs and a bug in the tub. The reason for the low review is the things that pictures don’t show, which is that the trim of all the windows is moldy and has been painted over. The place is damp, smells moldy and is cold. I worked in construction for a decade and you can't paint over mold. It will continue to grow. It becomes airborne and gets into everything that is porous. It is also a known toxin for humans. If I had another place to stay, I would have left, forfeiting the non-refundable cost. All the great features of this place were affected by the air quality and mould issue. If you do stay there, bring antihistamines and charcoal. If the mold issue was fixed, it would be worth much more.

Rachel was very friendly and responded quickly when I let her know the unit was out of coffee! Her place was spotless and a good size. Our only complaints were that the bed was very soft and that there was a musty odor in the living room. Rachel was concerned when I spoke to her about the musty odor and tried to problem solve the issue with me. We did not have a car, but public transportation was very close. However, we ended up spending a lot of time on buses and trains since her unit is not that close to downtown. On the positive side we were able to see areas of Vancouver we wouldn't have seen otherwise!

We had an ok stay at Peter’s place. Its located near public transport and it has street parking in front of the house.
The room itself was ok. However, if I was Peter, I would replace the bed. It fits 2 people, but really uncomfortable to sleep in. It was the worst bed during my 3 week Canada trip.
The rest of the place was ok. (Although the bathroom was not clean).

1. Parking Issues: Despite the listing mentioning street parking, it was not consistently available. We often had to squeeze into tight or inconvenient spaces, which was frustrating.
2. Cleanliness Concerns: There were spider webs at multiple locations throughout the house, indicating poor upkeep. Additionally, I found a small spider on our bed, which was alarming and unacceptable.
3. Kitchen Limitations: The kitchen was very poorly equipped. There were only two cooking utensils available, making it difficult to prepare meals for more than one person.
4. Dirty Cleaning Supplies: The dishwashing scrub provided was extremely old, dirty, and unhygienic. It should have been replaced before our arrival.
5. Safety Hazards: There was no proper lighting or motion sensors for the walkway to the basement at night. This posed a safety risk, especially when navigating in the dark.

The host/owner do not take the business seriously. We had to wait outside for three hours before we got an access to the unit. They did not respond to our calls and messages. We assumed we were scammed by illegal guys. We found dust all over the bed frame and underneath the bed. We soaked our clothes into the washing machine a night before we left but the machine was not working. We called the host and he said he was out of Canada. We brought our wet clothes in a cooler which we took with us to carry food and drink to our small kids all the way from Vancouver, BC to Portland, Oregon. I talked the owner about the washing machine and he promised to refund us at least the cleaning fee but he never did it.
Generally, it was a frustrating experience and a total ripoff!!! I feel sorry for every guest traveling long distance and ended up in such a terrible situation in the hands such irresponsible and greedy people.

TLDR: smells, not very clean.
Small cozy place, not a lot of space for luggage’s though. The place smells like mold, it’s a wood house but still shouldn’t smell like mold. And the small portable heater also smells like old hair dryer. Tried to air everything out by opening the window but still smells. So it was choosing between the smell or being cold. The bedsheets didn’t feel clean, mostly because there’s no laundry smell to it, which is fine and all but then the pillows smell like old, boys dorm pillows, so having no laundry smell to mask the old pillows makes the cleanliness very questionable. You can tell that the pillows and the mattress are old because the pillows has no fluff and the foam mattress just sags. Oh and the towels smells like the house, moldy. Good thing we stayed during New Year’s Eve, so we got too drunk to even come back to the airbnb.

Great location and nice view, but that's where the positives end. The suite was not clean, hair everywhere, urine on the bathroom floor, and a blanket with bodily fluids on it. There was a musty, mildew smell throughout the unit which made it unpleasant to stay in.
We also had an issue at the pool when a tenant confronted my young daughter for simply being there. It was uncomfortable and clearly driven by resentment toward Airbnb guests.
The dirty unit and the unwelcoming atmosphere, I would not recommend this Airbnb.

This has to be one of the best located and most scenic Airbnbs in Vancouver. It’s a wonderful location beside the sights, shopping, and incredible restaurants of Granville Island. The views of the city skyline, False Creek and the mountains are unparalleled, and self check-in was easy. We were very disappointed that we couldn’t stay for our three-night booking. Unfortunately, there was a strong musty/mold-like smell throughout the unit that triggered allergic symptoms. We arrived late, so stayed the first night wearing N95 masks, including while sleeping, but checked out the next morning and moved to another Airbnb. After Airbnb spoke with the host, we received a full refund. It’s a beautiful setting in a fantastic location, but unfortunately we could not comfortably stay.

This was by far the worst and most stressful Airbnb experience I’ve ever had. The host is manipulative and dishonest. He pressured me into signing a lease outside Airbnb, demanded extra payments off-platform, and even tried to invent fake fines under my name. He also filed a false $50 reimbursement request (which Airbnb thankfully declined).
When a normal repair issue with the shower came up (not caused by me), he blamed me and used it as an excuse to threaten eviction. Despite confirming an extension in writing after taking payment, he suddenly tried to cancel it, harassed me with messages, and even involved the police to intimidate me.
This host is not accommodating, respectful, or trustworthy. He knows how to play the system and uses intimidation, lies, and pressure tactics to exploit guests. I would strongly recommend avoiding this listing at all costs, staying here was a nightmare and no guest should have to go through this.

You will have the service room at the side of the kitchen. Very humble space, with a small cot, with a foam rubber on top of a board,  VERY noisy and not very comfortable. The carpet was dirty, the room had a bad smell. The kitchen was ok, but I didn’t use it. You can expect some noise in the morning due somebody making the breakfast and washing dishes. The shower drain was clogged with hair, I wrote to the owner and she said they would check it as soon as possible, I stayed for 4 days and had to clean it myself. The shower was moldy. I would not recommend this place for more than 1 day.

The location is convenient, free parking a plus, and the hosts communicated well.
Unfortunately, our stay was not comfortable, and I wouldn’t recommend this Airbnb without major updates.
The biggest issue was climate control—during 80–90° weather, the old portable unit couldn’t cool the apartment. Cleanliness was also lacking: sticky floors with hairs and footprints, giving the sense it wasn’t properly cleaned.
We also faced multiple maintenance problems: refrigerator failed within a day, lights above the bed didn’t work, toilet seat nearly detached, and linens were stained and worn. A strong odor from the bathroom sink required remediation, which the hosts handled quickly and refunded us for, but it was still unpleasant. The building elevator also broke during our stay, adding to the difficulties.
Overall, the apartment needs a deep clean, refreshed linens, reliable cooling, and repairs before it’s ready for guests.

Overall well decorated interior, just like the pictures.
However, I had unbearable issues with cleanliness.
First impression: As soon as I opened the door, I noticed dusty and dirty rugs and a damp, moldy smell.
Floors: The floors were so sticky that my socks literally stuck to them.
Bedding: The bed sheet and pillowcases had a very sour, sweaty smell. I messaged the host right away. They quickly suggested using the alternative linen in the closet, which was fine and saved my first night.
The next day, the host arranged a re-cleaning while I was out. I appreciate the quick response, but overall it was not a pleasant experience. I strongly recommend changing the cleaning service or reviewing the washing methods to prevent this from happening again.

The place looks as the photos and both hosts are quick to respond. They did check in on me during my stay.
Unfortunately they forgot to send the instruction to get in which led to a delayed checkin after an international flight, but human errors happen and I doubt that happens for these hosts often. As they seemed kind and on it, otherwise.
The location is great and I really enjoyed the area!
The apartment does strongly smell of mold/damp in the bathroom underneath all of the perfume sprays therefore I would strongly not recommend this accommodation for anyone with allergies.
I was unlucky as there were several parties during my stay that kept me up or woke me up. The residents I spoke to casually in the elevator commented on the sound after an evening of partying and did remark that the noise for the past week was unusual and also disturbing their sleep.
If this was a hotel, I’d be asking for a discounted rate for my stay because of the noise and mold/damp smell.

I was very disappointed in my experience at Robin's air bnb. The place was tidy and check in was simple but her understanding and consideration was extremely lacking. I was pregnant when I stayed at Robin's with my husband. I was grateful that she allowed us early check in. I ended up going into early labour after about an hour of spending time in the suite. We left for the hospital not long after that, I ended up having my baby that night. The following morning we contacted Robin asking for a refund under "extenuating circumstances" assuming that a woman going into labour unexpectedly would be covered under this and according to air bnb she declined our refund
according to "cleanliness issues". We left the place spotless, since we had only spent 1 hour there. The following morning my husband went to suite to get our remaining belongings. I was only requesting a refund for the one night (we had reserved 2 and of course happily paid for the first). The communication I received from Robin after telling her of my labour was careless and when I tried to understand how she could deny a refund, she has only ignored my messages. As someone who has used air bnb primarily for travelling and have stayed with wonderful hosts over the years, I am extremely disappointed in this circumstance.

This place has optimal views of the city/harbor/ mountains and the location is ideal, plus there’s even parking! We greatly enjoyed cooking and having dinner with those views. Upon checking in, we were disappointed to find basic cleaning (wet laundry, dirty dishes) had been overlooked. However, Thomas was very responsive and kindly worked with us to address the situation. He made arrangements to ensure the rest of our stay was great! I bet he’ll have a thorough cleaning procedure in place for future stays. We will always remember those views, enjoy future guests!

The place is described in the headline as a two bedroom.  It is NOT a two bedroom.  This is false advertising.  There is another bed which is in the kitchen/living room.  We were renting this with another couple which rendered the public spaces useless.  Also, the master bed is awful.  it sags terribly.

Pros:
-hotel-like beds & comforters in bedrooms; lots of pillows
-beautiful location with easy access to main road
-quiet street and very quiet for a basement suite (NB: no TV)
-lots of storage in massive laundry room
The Cons:
-musty smell in living area
-owners do not speak english so some of my questions and concerns were misinterpreted or not answered
-the kitchen does not have a lot of standard items you'd expect to make full meals
-stovetop very dirty and kitchen cupboards greasy; microwave door has no front glass and signs of pieces glued together
-no cleaning supplies except for toilet
Although this location was quiet and comfortable, I am recommending to the owners a deep clean of the kitchen and stocking of basic items to cook. If you are just going for a night or two with minimal meals you'll find it ideal. Looking back at the reviews there has only been one since last summer, so a spring cleaning and refresh of kitchen supplies is in order for summer rentals.

Kai and Yannies place was very spacious, comfortable for a family of four. The neighborhood was nice and quiet. Great laundry room. It was very clean. If you are sensitive to musty basement odors, the back bedroom was slightly musty. Another important thing to know is if you have a lot to carry, it’s a long walk from the street through the backyard, which is very pretty, to the apartment. We didn’t mind this at all.  But it might be hard if you have mobility issues. We would definitely stay there again. The kitchen was minimally stocked with cooking utensils. We do take out and it was fine for that.

Joe had great communication before and throughout our stay. The suite was as photos show, which is quite small but fine. Unfortunately the whole suite was extremely unclean when we arrived. We had to clean ourselves until we felt it was sanitary enough to be there, especially considering we were quarantining for two weeks. Was extremely disappointed with this. We were left with an old ragged dish sponge, we were told Joe would replace it but never did so we had to buy our own. There was very limited cooking equipment and utensils. Overall, I wouldn’t stay here again.

Booked for the month of December. Cozy place, and spacious enough for 2 people. Kitchen was not kept clean when I entered- countertops were not thoroughly wiped clean, dirty cabinet shelves, old/used food that I assume was left from other guests before me. Amenities like the microwave was real dirty and there were stuck on spills inside. It smelled like years of microwave popcorn when in use. Luckily, I was prepared to bring my own cleaning supplies, soaps, disinfectant cleaner, dish sponges and paper towels and cleaned the space before settling in. Mattress in the bedroom was too soft for me and my partner so we chose to sleep on the futon couch/bed. Shower pressure was weak, and wifi was sometimes slow. We did enjoy the heated floors especially during the winter season. The location is quiet and we liked that it was a few blocks away from the train station. The price was affordable compared to other Airbnbs , so you do get what you paid for. Joe was very quick to respond to our messages.

Th suite is situated on the first floor, and basically it's almost a basement. It's an old house so when people walked upstairs, it was very noisy. Regular walking was loud, but sometimes it felt like people were jumping, and sometimes it happened in the middle of the night.
But the most upsetting part was that we found mold in the shower. At first we thought it was just the color had changed between the tiles, but when we wiped over it, it came off. This is a SERIOUS health hazard.
Another really upsetting issue was that there were several mouse traps in the kitchen which means that the place has mice and we were not informed about this. At night my wife would wake up from gnawing/chewing sounds coming from inside the walls and she was so terrified she went to check the whole place so that the mice hadn't gotten into our luggage or food and especially to check up on our child in case the mice hadn't gotten into his sofa bed.
This was not a safe environment. If a place has mold and mice, they should not be operating as an Airb&b.
This unit was no where near sparkling clean as described.  Bathroom walls were dirty. Stove was old & rusty. Kitchen linens and sponge were stained. This suite was not cleaned.
This is an old neighborhood, and they did a fine job cleaning. But the musty/moldy smell was extremely strong and overwhelming.

Lovey 17th floor apartment with amazing views especially at night time. Very clean compact apartment which had everything we needed for our stay. Very well equipped.
The building was very secure and we heard no noise from adjacent apartments. The swimming pool was great.
Sad to see so many homeless people in this part of town but they mostly keep themselves to themselves and we didn’t experience any problems. The sky train was quite noisy (it is the city centre) but the ear plugs provided worked well.
The air conditioning setup was a bit crude with wires trailing across the floor but we were grateful for it as it did get really hot.
Communication with Kiki was okay a bit slow at times and I was disappointed one of my questions on how to get to the apartment was not replied to but we worked it out anyway.

This place should NOT be rented to anyone!
This house is a run down. The kitchen fridge doesn't close properly, the microwave is from 1950s and makes so much noise, no utensils for cooking.
The coffeemaker had molds in it.
The bathrooms were dirty with no hand soap.
Most Importantly, we found ants and mice in the house. I am pregnant and we have small kids, that was a serious health risk to all of us.
On top of that, there was a construction going on next door 7am to 5pm even on the weekends! So disturbing.
The pictures are deceiving and so are the ratings.
Ryan was communicating well with us, but there was nothing he could do to fix this awful house

I would not recommend this place. There’s something fishy going on. The property appears to be up for sale (realtor sign posted), though not publicly listed. There was cultural and language barrier with the host. For example, when I said the floor was dusty, she told me use the vacuum cleaner in the closet. I didn’t want to open this closet because the door was made up of cracked mirror and I didn’t want that breaking any further. There was a family living downstairs (without security door) even though it was listed as “entire house”. I think they actually changed the listing after I booked it but before my stay. I complained to Airbnb and they claimed no complaints for this “long listed property”. They only had 12 reviews. Obviously they’ve deleted their bad reviews so doubtful anyone will see this but doing my duty of warning people. I asked for a partial refund but ignored by the host. Apparently they didn’t believe me because I didn’t report it at 10pm and waited until the next day

I have to tell the full story here. We were impressed by Ken’s superhost title and good reviews of the place, and we book the place. Since we are planning to work from the unit for a week, we politely asked Ken whether he can help us set up a additional desk and chair in one bedroom and got positive answers. Then we book for a week.
But when we arrived, it’s definitely not ‘blasting clean’. The carpet has obvious debris, we tried to use a plate but finding out there’s some food stain on the back (yes they don’t have dish washer in unit). The worst, we don’t see any additional desk and chairs apart from dining table. I tried to contact Ken by Airbnb and phone and email asking whether we could bother him to bring some over, but no response until the next day.
What we appreciate is, Ken made an exception for us to refund the rest after 1 night. But we feel deceived as we would no way book for a week if we can’t work there. The place is OK and quiet but think twice on it

The apartment was absolute stunning. But as for stanislav absolute disgrace to air bnb. We chipped the skirting board on accident with our case which stanislav asked for money which we give £175 (for a 2m skirting board) with no argument. Then 2 days later he’s asking for more money for noice complaints and water damage. We didn’t stay up past 10 clock one night as we had busy days seeing the wonderful city. His attitude before hand should have put us off his stay. Never mind maybe I’ll report him to the apartments for air bnb and apartment that isn’t allowed to be air Bnb’d. Disgusting behaviour avoid at all costs

My entire stay at Stanislav was horrible to say the least. The location and view is spectacular.
The place NEEDS a proper cleaning. The apartment was dirty. There were things spilled on the floor, the bedsheets, pillows and towels smelled as if it wasn’t washed at all.
I contacted the host and the hosts assistant got back to me. She said she personally cleaned it herself clearly it wasn’t the best cleaning job.
They offered me a refund which wasn’t the best considering I spend the first day cleaning.

The apartment is quite nice and was very clean. Small but workable for us (two couples), and nice to have two bedrooms with their own bathrooms. Eric was really pleasant to deal with, and super responsive when we had a couple of questions. Nice views as well. However, I just can't recommend the apartment, as the location did not feel safe. Definitely would not recommend staying there for anyone who feels vulnerable, or is traveling alone. Vancouver has a terrible, sad problem with homelessness and drugs. Unfortunately, and we heard that this is very recent, there is a large tent city just a couple of blocks away on East Hastings St, and the effects extend to the area of this apartment. We didn't know about the tent city and accidentally walked through it at night, and felt pretty stressed out even though there were four of us. (I would definitely avoid walking there in the daytime too.) We love to walk and appreciated the ability to walk downtown to the various sights, but we would have enjoyed our first visit to Vancouver more if we'd stayed in a better (safer) neighborhood.
The only other thing worth mentioning is that the apartment doesn't have AC and has a lot of windows. That makes for good views but the apartment gets hot on sunny summer days. We weren't there much during the day, and it cooled off just enough at night.

We had great difficulty getting in with his electronic system. Eric berated me for not getting it to work and kept saying I wasn’t following instructions though I was. We ended up just yelling each other. No one available to one help.
Now credit where credit is due: he let us in at 2 instead of 4 which we appreciated as we were traveling w my 83 yo MIL.
Hardly any closet/drawer space. Worst was police sirens all night long. So loud, like being in the middle of grand central station all night long. Could not sleep solid—woke up every few minutes with sirens literally! Unless u live in New York City I would not recommend.

In general, this place was fine. And Anna was responsive in communicating. The place was clean enough. I’m not sure it was the right place for us. I felt the neighborhood was quite sketchy. I also found the place to be smaller than expected, and did not realize that the shower was connected to two bathrooms, which I felt was a little misleading. Also, the train noise was quite excessive. And the second bedroom did not have any AC which made it quite uncomfortable. Unfortunately, these were not really things that the host can change about the place. I tend to stay in hotels which are a lot more flexible in check in and check out times. But in all fairness, the reviews have been good in the past for other people, so it may just be that it wasn’t the right place for us.

THE OVEN WAS DIRTY. THE REFRIGERATOR HAD NOT BEEN WIPED OUT.  THE BATH TUB GROUT IS MOLDY AND THE TILES, TUB AND SINK NEED REGROUTED. THERE WAS NO TOP SHEET ON THE BED, ONLY A DUVET.  THE LOCATION WAS REALLY PERFECT.

The space is pretty much as shown in the pictures. A big pro was the location and the big, comfortable bathtub in the private bathroom. A big con was the visible mold in the corners of the shower unit and the terrible smell of mildew that permeated the whole unit, which we are having to wash out of our clothes on return home. I appreciated Makayla's communication, but the unit needs full mold remediation.
We paid a premium due to the FIFA World Cup…place was dusty, hair in bathroom, cabinets are unfinished, stained/ dirty baseboards, tile is dirty and cracked, etc.

The good-
The place is as described as the ad. A smaller location, no living room or TV.
Good location, cheap to Uber to various activities we were wanting to do.
The bad-
Place was very dirty. I had to wash my hands after opening the freezer due to the amount of grease and dust on the handle. Stove was filthy. Bathtub was gross.
Place was over 30 degrees inside. No way to cool the place down resulting in poor sleep both nights. It almost appeared that the heat was on (other reviewers mentioned this as well).
The door lock (keypad) seemed to only be working some of the time, resulting in us not being able to lock the door behind us.
Several of the plugs didn’t work. This included the plugs within the bathroom so my partner was unable to straighten/dry hair in front of a mirror.
Back (where you enter the suite) was filled with garbage and interior furniture creating a less than ideal appearance to the property.
Other info
Early check in not possible. Poor response time.
Smelly, dirty, and falling apart!

Yvonne and Michael were very welcoming and left a very thoughtful welcome gift - we appreciated their kindness! That said, I can’t recommend this place, mainly due to circumstances outside their control (train noise & area homelessness problems).
The Skytram train and nearby roadway were horrifically loud/constant at all hours, preventing us from sleeping hardly at all, even over the loud A/C unit.
Sadly, the Gastown area has turned into a very filthy and unsafe feeling place due to pervasive homelessness, drug use, and seedy areas block by block - very different from when I was here in 2019. We felt very unsafe and had to be alert for danger on every walk, even a short one to dinner. It forced us to go anywhere other than where we were staying and to drive everywhere to feel safe. It was night and day different (safer/cleaner) just a few blocks out of the immediate area.
Hopefully Vancouver and deal with this as it really negatively changed what we thought this stay would be.

I was disappointed with my stay. Firstly, it was dirty. With covid, I expected a much cleaner place. I wiped the surfaces in the bedroom and bathroom with Lysol wipes -- and they were black with dirt. Clearly, suggesting that they have not been cleaned for a while. It also got pretty loud at random times of the night, such as 3am -- disrupting my sleep and waking me up.

We were not able to check in as our competition was cancelled due to COVID-19.
I contacted the host and asked if we could get even a partial refund and received no reply.
Very disappointed.

Not ideal if you have a bad back. The bedding is generally very uncomfortable. If anything, I learned buying a sofa bed is not a suitable option for my own place when considering places for family and friends to stay. I was concerned about it going in, and when attempting to get a refund though within a week before going, I wasn't given one i.e. the refund for 5 nights was less than a single night I could get anywhere else, so I felt a bit ripped off. Otherwise, decent for basic basic basic. If you're not planning on staying at the airbnb beyond a pretty crappy sleep and a decent shower, this is good-ish. Rach was very good for communicating. I'd say I wouldn't go back, but it could be your style. No offence to Rach.  The thing though that got me was going to shower and finding a towel hung up that was clearly used... it was a bit nasty and concerned me about the cleanliness of the entire place. Not the darkest room and you can hear every car drive by.

Horrific.
I booked this place for 2 adults and 1 infant. Prior to booking, I messaged Joe and he confirmed that there is a crib available at this place.
When I arrived I couldn't believe what I saw. Joe had set up some linens in the bedroom closet and called that "a crib". I messaged Joe right away but he insisted that the set up was perfectly fine and that a few families were happy with the set up. I explained that sleeping in the closet was not safe for my 10 month old son. He said he did not understand how sleeping in a closet is unsafe for my son and that it was my fault because I did not specify that my son is 10mo (even though I indicated in my reservation that I have an infant) and I did not specify that I required a special crib. Joe did not try to resolve the problem but instead blamed everything on me and said he was signing off because it was getting too late.
I was extremely furious because my son had nowhere to sleep. I contacted airbnb immediately and sent them pictures of all angles in the room to prove that there was no crib anywhere. The case manager was quite shocked and said Joe has possibly violated the agreement. She arranged a hotel for us right away and in the end my son did not sleep until 3am est. The case manager has also refunded the money for the bad experience that we had.

Gurleen is a fantastic host. She was very helpful in ensuring that I was able to check in even though it arrived hours before the check in time. She kept in touch with me and ensured that the flat was ready for my check in, despite the fact that she had guests check out the same day. So grateful for this.
However, I was disappointed that I couldn’t fully enjoy the experience because of the street the apartment is located. After arriving at the apartment, I realized that the street has the highest amount of junkies and homeless people I’ve ever seen, it was very difficult and uncomfortable to walk around the neighborhood or to downtown which is like 30mins away from the location. Later, I read online that it was the most most notorious for serious drug use in VC.
For a first time visitor to Vancouver this was a real shock and wished this information was reflected in the listing and the pricing. Also I think the apartment is overpriced considering it’s location.

We were only staying one night so safety, cleanliness and location were important. We felt safe but it was not very clean. It almost felt like someone lived there full time and left when it was being used for Airbnb. We had to wash the sheets and pillowcases before we were able to go to bed. There were very nice amenities but we weren’t able to enjoy them because we had to wash our sheets and clean up a little bit because it was dusty and dirty. We messaged Gurleen about the sheets and she apologized. I don’t feel like it was worth the amount of money because it was dirty.

The listing itself is OKAY but it is located by a large unhoused community. I witnessed large amounts of drug use in broad daylight. I felt very unsafe and have never felt that way in a foreign country before. The place was very overpriced for the location and quality. There were broken mirrors, door jams, and windows. The place was also not very clean… I found hair all over my bed and the floor. The carpets and towels also seemed extremely old and used. There was also no AC and the neighbors were smoking weed/cigarettes, so it was hard to leave windows open. All in all would not recommend.

The host was responsive and friendly, but the description of the location being central is misleading. While it's not far from downtown, it's on one of the unsafest streets in Vancouver, so definitely do your research, and plan to have a car so you dont have to walk down the street.
The airbnb itself was not as clean as expected, there were eyelash extensions left behind on the floor, the mirror in the room was broken and there were no lights in one of the rooms beside a bedside lamp with only one working electrical outlet.

I rented this place for my parents who stayed there for a month. The apartment was great but there were some cleanliness issues and issues with the host’s communication. While she was responsive at first and brought over missing items/replaced broken/dirty items, she became heated, rude, and crass when we asked for the cleaning fee to be refunded. She refunded us $30 (Airbnb refunded the rest). At $4600 a month the full refund would have been appreciated. I wouldn’t recommend this place to anyone as I wouldn’t want anyone to have to face the wrath of Ada.

Dreadful experience-not Superhost material. While the host was polite in messages, the in-person interaction on our first night was unpleasant. We politely raised concerns about upstairs thudding noise in messages first but received no response, so we respectfully raised concerns verbally, but we were met with a rude and dismissive response: “This is our house. We can do whatever we want. This is the kid that is making noise.” The experience became more uncomfortable and unsafe witnessing the way the child was treated in front of us, and it left us concerned about the overall atmosphere and level of respect shown toward guests. On top of that, the listing felt misleading—it is at the back of another house and was not disclosed during time of booking. Combined with a strict non-refundable policy, we felt trapped and still chose to leave early and pay for alternative stay ourselves. Definitely would NOT recommend and advise future guests to exercise caution when booking.

Dhruv was overall a very nice guy. Gave us lots of suggestions on places to eat as well as  things to do. Although when we got there we had a few questions for him and when I messaged him with the questions about the airbnb I was ignored as he responded with something completely unrelated. The photos of the balcony that are shown are very misleading as the balcony at Dhruv’s place was roughly 1 foot away from the building at max, and there was no mention at all on how to get to or where the one in the photos is. The view is also not as described in his listing, it is neither city or mountain view. More alley way and back of building view.

We had a terrible stay at Dhruv’s place because his description that the unit is cool in summer and has air conditioning is not true.
The sun hits the west facing windows for several hours in the afternoon during summer, which results in the loft getting extremely hot. There was one portable air conditioning unit which was not nearly powerful enough to provide any cooling effect in the space. It was really poorly installed through an open window which just let me heat in. The great lingered through the evening and the plug in fan was quite loud.
Dhruv handled this situation with a bare minimum response. He agreed to refund the second night after we requested to cancel. He pressured us to leave as soon as possible despite knowing we would be getting a medical procedure done that morning. There was no offer of a partial refund for the first night, which was directly correlated to the false information in his ad. We had specifically chosen the loft because it supposedly had air conditioning.
We also noticed a bit of a mould smell that seemed to source from the bathroom.
The location is excellent and the price matches what you get.

The apartment was very clean and beautifully kitted out. The area however was completely unsafe - we did not feel comfortable leaving the apartment even in the day.
A few days prior to staying we were warned about ‘homeless encampments’. This however is not an honest picture. People were openly doing drugs outside the apartment during the day and night, regardless of which way we turned.
Things we experienced:
- drug taking all times of day and night around the apartment, throughout Gastown and surrounding area
- several people collapsed on the pavement in the ally way behind the apartment - we saw other people buying, selling and taking drugs and then checking the pulses of these individuals (can view from the windows)
- a ‘detox centre’ a few doors up from the apartment building
- tons of people walking round in a ‘zombie-like’ state, weeing openly in the streets and taking drugs openly in the streets
- we could not grab a morning coffee without seeing any of this and certainly did not feel safe leaving at night
- our cab driver told us that this is the worst part of Vancouver to stay in and that we should avoid it

Pros- This was an absolutely adorable and tasteful space. Easy access, secure building. Very comfortable bed and clean, beautifully and thoughtfully decorated. Good host communication.
All establishments in the area were great with awesome food, drinks, and service.
Cons- unfortunately the drug and homeless problem in this neighborhood specifically was so disappointing. The streets were filthy and stinky and there were needles and pipes everywhere. We were so glad we didn’t have our kids. But we never had any problems it was just not an ideal environment.
The apartment was wonderful, but I’m not sure we will ever make it back to Gastown.

We really enjoyed our stay. I’ll first say what others have said in that this location is very near to the worst area in Vancouver for fentanyl overdoses and homelessness. HOWEVER!! We felt completely safe in the building.
Those on the street never approached us or bothered us. They very much keep to themselves. We walked mostly everywhere and never felt unsafe; it was just very sad and a bit of a shock even though I was warned by other reviews. I would never bring young children, but the owner put all that information in the listing.
I would totally book this spot again. We got to stay like locals, sleep in a comfortable bed with windows up feeling the fantastic breeze, enjoy the large collection of sweet house plants, and view snow capped mountains from the bed. The place was clean and well done! Book it and just be prepared!

As others have said, the apartment and building are beautiful, the host is very efficient and attentive and facilitated my last minute request for a later checkout, she didn’t need to do this, but did so without question when my flight was delayed. Thank you 🙏
To the west, the neighbourhood is gorgeous and I felt at home instantly.
To the east, you really see the worst of modern society, I never felt unsafe, I just felt sad.
An opioid epidemic is not overstating the issue. I saw countless people in a desperate state, the sheer number was alarming.
However, overall I absolutely loved my stay, and would 100% stay again if I found myself in Vancouver. Thanks again 🙏

This is a great place in a great location! The building is not too noisy and elevators work well with a spot for loading/unloading. The massage chair is a real bonus if you like that. The tv system is nicely set up with great channels and is easy to operate. Adam is a great host and is very helpful with anything you may ask him for.
On the down side, although the apartment is clean in terms of sinks, counters, bathroom, the floor was absolutely filthy and I did wash the fan overhead as it was so dirty I didn’t want to turn it on. There is lots of clutter in kitchen and night stands as this is where Adam lives.
So if that doesn’t bother you - this is a great place!

If I could give 0 stars, I would give 0 stars. This is the worst airbnb I have ever lived in. The photo shows a very big house, but it ’s not the same as the photo. It ’s actually living in the basement, and very small, and the air not good.
The bathroom is also very small, and the shower cannot be turned at all.
It is highly not recommended to live in this airbnb,

This place is located in a quiet neighbourhood which is nice and it’s only 20 mins to the airport.
Kitchen is not what it looks like on the pictures. It’s definitely past its best days. Toaster and microwave had faults which could potentially be harmful.
Especially the bathroom sink cabinet, which was moldy should be replaced immediately as it is a safety risk for everyone.
I would not recommend staying here, not worth the price

This is not a great or really safe location. Drug addicts everywhere and smells terrible. The condo was nice looking but had issues with parking a larger vehicle, had to park elsewhere and pay. The sofa had pull out but had stains and was not great and had issues with fob and elevator and issues with television. The condo was also extremely HOT. There were 2 portable air conditioners and some fans but they werent on until we turned them on when arriving and never got cool the whole stay. This was put 1st visit to the area and was disappointing and overwhelming

There are Pros and Cons for this airbnb.
Pros:
The location cannot be beat.
The building amenities are great especially Fresh Market and Long Drugs at the bottom of the building. Many options for restaurants. The pool, spa and gym are great but I did not use them
The views are breathtaking.
Cons:
Not a true one bedroom but is a studio and very small under 400sq ft.
The unit faces the highway which makes it quite noisy when the doors are open.
There was no furniture to sit on the balcony and it was not cleaned for my arrival.
Only two towels were provided. No hand towels or face cloths as shown in the pictures.
The sofa is very uncomfortable. Luckily the murphy bed converts to a comfortable sofa.
There’s no dresser and nowhere to put your clothes unless you hang them. I purchased extra hangers.
There was no toaster, bath mat, extra linen, condiments or extra garbage bags.
The unit is overpriced for its size. An attention to details for longer stays is warranted.

Renter beware: You need to like it HOT!
TL;DR
Rented 9 days, stayed 2 days due to excessive heat in the unit. Owner kept all the money and gave no refund. Expensive lesson to learn to find out a rental has no air conditioning.
This place is in a great location. Right across the street from Rogers arena. The view is spectacular as well. Grocery store 1 block away. Check in was great and quick. Nice little office area and also separate small room off of the kitchen with pocket door that can be used for a private phone call room. Upon arrival we immediately noticed the unit was warm and all the windows and sliding doors were open. Temperate gauge in the unit showed 28c/82.4F. First night was pretty miserable but we made the most of it with the inadequate small fans provided in the house. Communication regarding the heat was great with the owner and huge props that they went and bought and delivered a small AC unit and dropped it off the next day. I got the AC unit setup in the main living area and vented outside and set the temp gauge to 17c/62.6F. After running the AC all night, we woke up at 6am and it was 22c/71.6F which was wonderful, and short lived. When the sun comes up, the sun rays just bake the unit all day long until about 630pm getting the unit up to 30c/86F! That's just not comfortable at all. I have measured temps on the metal mini blinds of 33c/97.5F in the late afternoon. Owner claims there's nothing he can do about the sun yet hasn't put on window tint to help with the radiation heating from the sun. In order to save our remote work/vacation time, we made the decision to leave and get a hotel room so we could enjoy the rest of our time in the city. After escalating to airbnb, they could not do anything to help me because "air conditioning" is not listed as being offered in the listing. When I made it clear to the owner that we were no longer staying in the unit due to the excessive heat, he was not phased and offered no refunds of any kind, even with penalty. I paid for 9 days, stayed 48 hours and learned a very expensive lesson. I know some things were out of the owners control but some kind of refund is squarely on them and they choose no mercy.

Great location and prompt responses from the host. The condo is much older than the photos he published…especially the outdoor spaces that had mildew and mold stains all over the furniture and umbrella. It was a nice view but dirty so none of that space could be enjoyed. There was a lot of stuff piled on the deck right outside one of the rooms creating an unappealing view. The building was not marked well and the host’s instructions to get in and out of the garage were confusing. The condo was pretty clean and the space was comfortable- just wish it was as advertised and easier to navigate. I also did not think that storing our bags next door (which was convenient) was worth $10/bag USD. Overall, not somewhere I would stay again. But Vancouver is beautiful!

Binder in kitchen left for guests, was a bit much....verbage indicated threats to loose your security deposit. Both bottom and upper decks were dirty with paper garbage and leaves on the upper deck. Kitchen floor and toe-kicks in the kitchen were filthy dirty. We were early for cjeck in and were not able to enter due to the cleaners still being there. Dirty mop water was still in the closet.

Disappointed. Location & view are great. However , the bathroom is falsely advertised as two full bathrooms , when it is in-fact 2 toilets separated by a glass shower- no wall dividers. The amenities were advertised as open, however they were not . Host was unresponsive when trying to resolve these issues.
Do not recommend.

Warning – watch those cancelation rules!
This was the Airbnb booking out of a nightmare.
I made the booking 5 weeks in advance, this was to be the big trip of 2020, I was going to Vancouver for 4 days to stay in what looked to be a luxurious 2 bed, 2 bath apartment in the heart of the city and close and convenient to what we wanted to do and who we wanted to do things with and then 3 days before the trip the province issued a health order against travel in or out of Vancouver.
I tried to cancel, was informed that there would be no refund and that the time frame for a full refund was only for 48 hours after making the booking.
I tried to change the reservations to a date in 2021 where the unit was available, the host (Trevor) refused the change of dates. He told me he would get more money if he kept mine, and then booked with someone else for those dates in Jan. (so dont be that person...)
I talked to Airbnb and they said the cancelation policy that was “chosen by the host” was the strict set of rules which meant no refunds even for (or especially for Covid-19 travel restrictions). So be aware the Hosts can choose how much of an ass they want to be. The Airbnb guy went on to say they would try to assist with negotiation, but the host(Trevor) would not return their calls.
I called the credit card company and they said there was no way for them to get involved as the cancelation policy was well documented.
I refused to leave the suite empty, so my cousin used the suite as a get-away for her and her husband and here is what they found: This is not a 2-bath unit at all, instead an odd arrangement with 2 toilet areas, one on either side of shower with glass doors, so no privacy at all, certainly no protection from bathroom noises or smells...
Here is the list of other issues and deficiencies:
- Broken hall mirror
- Broken kitchen tap
- No Cable, so No TV
- One open bathroom with shower between
- No hot water in ‘guest’ bath area
- No ability to adjust heat in apartment
- Mold on back of sink in “master” bath area
- Dirty Dryer
- No evidence of the promised 'enhanced cleaning'
- Big hole in ceiling where a fan should be in “master” bath area
- Drywall had some holes and broken pieces
- Overall apartment was not well maintained and does not qualify as Luxurious.

Rafaela’s place was beyond amazing! We were looking forward to a much needed respite from work and the pandemic and her place did not disappoint.
Her 2 bedroom, 2 bath condo was perfect for our 2 families and the little personal touches was greatly appreciated. From the very beginning in helping us out of the other bogus place, to answering promptly all our queries up to the day of leaving, Rafaela was on top of things, even making sure that the places we were visiting on our itinerary were open.
The condo was walking distance to everything, from the grocery store to the Aquabus going to Granville Island, to the train station, everything was right at your doorstep. Sergio, her hubby, was really nice in showing us the complicated twists and turns into the parking lot. The washer and dryer was a god-send with kids dirty clothes and the fans in each of the rooms kept the condo cool during the really hot Vancouver afternoons. The kids loved the courtyard where they were able to run around relax after a busy day sightseeing.
We would surely book again with Rafaela. Her place is highly recommended! Keep up the great work! Muito obrigada!

Checked in around 10pm and when we arrived to the apartment building, the machine to enter the entrance code was either not working that day or broken so we had to wait around half an hour before we were able to flag down security to let us in. For 1.4k for a 3 night stay, I expected a clean and well maintained space but it was so dirty. The bath mat had big brown stains and the kitchen was dirty with the food caked onto the stove and the pans. The toilet had some urine stains, the towels and the bed sheets had tiny hairs and stains. Since it was late at night, we just decided to all sleep in one bed and used the clothes that we packed to lay on. It was uncomfortable to say the least. I notified the host and they said they would send a cleaner to touch up the place which was fine but my guests and I asked for a cleaning fee refund which was about $120 but the host kept dragging on about how they were having issues and after a week of waiting, they decided to completely ghosted me.

We appreciate that the host arranged for towels to be laundered during our stay—that was thoughtful. However, the overall experience was disappointing. The apartment was not properly cleaned—there were spiders, insects, and heavy dust on fixtures like the exhaust fan. The gravel pathway to the basement made it difficult to carry luggage. A constant smell of gas near the entrance (due to a nearby gas line) was concerning. The outdoor area was dusty and not cleaned once in 15 days. Exhaust pipes placed right at the entrance created an uninviting look. Being a basement unit, noise from upstairs was frequent and disruptive. While quiet hours were expected from guests, the hosts were often loud themselves. Additionally, when their washing machine ran, the noise made it uncomfortable to stay inside. We had higher expectations based on the listing and hope this feedback helps improve the experience for future guests.

There are a few things to appreciate about this condo: the hosts were very responsive in communicating with us; the living, dining and kitchen area was light-filled, and spacious with great city views, and the location in the Coal Harbour area is excellent. However, many deficiencies made for an overall disappointing experience. The apartment is tired, lacks upkeep, and offers the bare minimum in amenities: baseboards throughout were chipped and in need of repainting; light switch plates were yellowed, dirty or broken; window blinds were missing slats or broken; bathroom fans didn't work and light level was very low; the kitchen kettle was burnt and unusable; no obvious way to vent the portable AC unit tube through the window in a very hot bedroom. If you are not fussy about these types of details, the location is pretty fabulous, but if you are looking for something that offers greater comfort and amenities this might not be the place for you.

“So bad, don’t even know where to start.
So, there were so many things wrong with this place I will just start at beginning.
For one nite the place cost 350 dollars, a pool, hot tub and washer and dryer were advertised inclusive with the stay.
For that kind of coin we expected a nice clean space, (especially during covid times) with all appliances in good working order to and recieve what was advertised. This was not the case. Upon arrival besides the place just looking plain old dingy, there were damp towels in the laundry. Gross. Not ours obviously. There were no small individually wrapped soaps and shampoos, it was all used large bottles in bathrooms and sinks, again not what one would expect for nearly 400 per nite. Lightbulb in fridge and kitchen were burnt out. Super inconvenient when cooking for kids and tired at end of day. Oh and lots of pots and pans...one lid..
So we sucked it up and thought at least there is the pool and hot tub which was ADVERTISED on her profile, we walked down with the kids only to find it’s been out of service for some time!!! She could have let us know before we booked as this was the number one feature we chose it for. A complete let down. Our kids were so sad. We go back up, and I thought some of us could take baths, at least. Wrong again! The tubs plug did not fit properly! So the tub slowly leaked water when filled. Ok, we are so disappointed but at least there is laundry right!? As you know traveling with kids it’s a life saver to have washer and a dryer to use..wrong again!! The damp towels in the dryer upon arrival should have been the first clue, you guessed it, the dryer did not work properly and it took almost 2 hrs to dry one little load. We left with damp clothes!
Last but not least the parking is very VERY confusing in an underground parcade, and when you try and leave you need a special fobe to open the gate, but the host asks you to leave the fobe inside the suite! So how to get out?
The neighborhood is very sketchy, not family friendly and right over the street, so you get to hear all the crazy at nite. Not the hosts fault of course, but besides a not very clean place, dingy, with pieces of heater covers falling off and broken, appliances or not working properly and key features advertised not available, this place is not worth the money put out. Your better off renting a cheap motel because the quality would be the same or better.
We took pictures of all the issues and are waiting for a refund from Airbnb. “

unsafe place. the area is full of homeless. very old build. problems with the unit electricity. very noisy. aggressive neighbor. he attacked our car from the first dau. incooperative host. not recommended.
Clean place . Location terrible . Very noisy . Beds terrible . No air condition . A neighbour on the basement which was not mentioned . He was in the garden when we arrived . Not good at all

Egudio & Loretta's place was perfect for our group trip. The price is amazing for the value you get. Walkable distance to Chinatown & Gastown. Closest metro is Science World under 15min away.
The surrounding neighborhood has been warned as "not the safest", however we were perfectly fine walking every day. It's not as dirty or sketchy as the internet makes out the area to be. Have common travel sense & social awareness. Some sidewalks weren't paved all the way, and there was construction going on, so if you have heavy luggage, be sure to Uber/Taxi.
The place itself was well described, with 3 bedrooms, 1 full bath and 1 powder & 1 shower room. We had a lot of space to eat and chat. The owners also fixed a broken smart lock at our request. Note there is no AC as most older places in the Northwest don't typically include it.
I would totally recommend it to a travel group that's looking to stay slightly out of downtown Vancouver, but walkable to Chinatown for food every day!

Host and manager are terrible in communicating. Worst then terrible… host only replied when I reported the issues at AirBnB. That is not even the worst part: at a certain point somebody with a copy of the key entered the apartment while I was inside. This person was unannounced!!!! Couch is full of white stains. At night is is very very noisy. The neighborhood in which the apartment is located feels unsafe. Do yourself a favor and boot hotel room, probably cheaper and better service.

Sunny was a wonderful host, he was available whenever we needed and communicated well. The house itself was disappointing. The space was smaller than we expected, there are three other units already occupied in the house, so the photos are misleading. The toilet in the main bathroom upstairs is difficult to flush and the tub didn't have a stopper. The shower in the master bathroom sprays water out of the door, and cannot be moved to contain the water. The jacuzzi tub in that bathroom seemed dirty - when filled there was a film of grime in the water. The flush in the half bathroom upstairs also didn't work well.
In general the home seemed to be maintained on a very basic level, without much care for cleanliness or updating. There was no welcome book with house rules or information about garbage disposal. We did appreciate the bottled water and the chocolate was a nice touch.
It was surprising that the sink water wasn't good - in general Vancouver has great tap water.

The basketball hoop outside is completely broken and the yard was full of broken wood and nails - which could be really dangerous for children. Our toddler alsp found a few things at his level that were quite dangerous - a screw and a piece of razor blade from a box cutter.
There was a funky smell in the home, and in general the home seemed to be maintained on a very basic level, without much care for cleanliness or updating.
We booked the home as a place to quarantine upon arrival from the US, due to Covid-19 restrictions. For the purpose, the house was good as there was an outdoor space as well as spacious bedrooms and a living area for the children to move around.

This is NOT an entire house!
We were traveling internationally with 3 babies and wanted an entire home to feel safe, but there were tenants on the main level and in the basement that were not disclosed until check in. 2 windows on the main level did not close or lock and had tape covering the opening. We felt very unsafe and unsecure because of this. The house is also in need of repair and smelled like a litter box. It used to be a very nice house, but it hasn't been maintained in a long time. Many electrical outlets didn't work, the jacuzzi was broke, there was broken (and taped up) glass throughout the home and the hot water heater (that heats the home) went out TWICE! We were unable to shower for days after hiking and snowboarding and when asked where we could go we were told to pay $5 each to visit a community center to shower. Sunny was very responsive and accomodated our late check in, but we have never encountered issues like this.
Edit: AirBnB +Sunny refunded some $

This was by far one of the most shockingly disappointing and inaccurate listings we have ever stayed at. The walls were all dirty and stained black in every room, the windows and bathroom floor had mold growing and dirt in every crevice, there was a thick layer of dust on every surface and things were falling apart at the hinges. We took one look at the place and immediately called Airbnb for help cancelling, I provided pictures and video and they decided that the listing was indeed inaccurate and were able to work with the host who thankfully was receptive about refunding.
Note, the neighborhood is kind of sketchy as well. As noted in the listing you must take all valuables out of your car, as we saw some strange people lingering around.

Bryan's place is lovely. The photos are accurate and it's delightfully stylish and comfortable. The key fob wasn't where it was supposed to be in the unit, but Bryan was instantly responsive to messaging and showed me quickly where to find another. We were also arriving earlier than check-in and he said we could drop off bags while the cleaners were preparing the place. Very helpful and super appreciated.
Gastown is really fun and super hip, with lots of shops, restaurants and plenty to do. It's close to everything. You should be aware that it's two blocks away from Vancouver's sketchy area/street, but we never once felt unsafe, nor were there ever any noise issues. There unit/building is highly secure. Would absolutely stay here again if we're lucky enough to find it available.
The furniture and the bed had a very musty smell to it. The towels also smelt very odd and musty. But I guess you get what you pay for.

Check in process was horrible. Took over 3 hours to get in. If i didnt find a number for security i dont think we would have even got in that night. Garburator was smelly, said a plumber was coming the next day but then didnt hear anything for 2 days and by then it was to late as we left the next morning.
Good location and walking distance to lots.

The .5 bedroom is quite literally a storage closet that the host put a VERY high bed into with no kind of ladder to get in and out of. It’s not terribly usable. Our friend instead had to sleep in the main space on the couch which meant hiding out in the bedroom until they were up. This stay is for an adult couple and 1 child at best.
The surrounding area is REAL sketchy and apparently considered the fentanyl capital of the world with strung-out, homeless encampments all along Hastings and Abbot. I say this as a Brooklynite with 3 homeless shelters surrounding my apartment; it’s overwhelming. Yes, it is mentioned in the listing, but severely downplayed.
Most things in the unit feel cheap and not ed consistent with the high quality photos or price point.
The blinds are dirty, old and cheap with the cords all knotted up. They provide little to no darkness. When the sun comes up, you will be awake.
The shower has no lighting and makes it difficult to see with the curtain closed.

This place was exactly as advertised, which was great cause I hate surprises. JK y'all can surprise me anytime, my venmo is @jonathanfusco ha!
Okay seriously, check-in was super easy and the place was nice and clean. Plus, having access to the gym/sauna/pool/hot tub was an added bonus. Comfy couches that were nice to slide down into and watch the rain outside. The place is located nicely if you like walking to places as we do. The only thing is it's within a few blocks from some sketchy parts after dark, but we never felt unsafe. I don't mention this to detour you, only to inform. We are two fully grown adult male humans from LA though, so we've seen our fair share of tomfoolery. We were bummed the Canucks weren't in town cause we would have caught a game at the stadium half a block away! Plan accordingly, people.
Great coffee & tea options nearby. Ramen & sushi restaurants everywhere, and plenty of markets for food & supplies.
This was our first time visiting Vancouver and definitely won't be our last. Fell in love with the city. Make sure you see a concert at The Commodore!
Buhbye Vancouver... for now.

So… My husband and I booked Sam’s condo for the first 2 nights of our kiddos spring break. We booked it because of the pool. When we arrived, there wasn’t any hot water. This meant no baths, or showers for my kids or us parents after a long day at the aquarium and park. My kids we’re pretty dirty as they play hard. Sam responded to my inquiry regarding the hot water by stating that the building was working on fixing the issue. Fast forward to morning and still no hot water, so again no showers. We headed to the pool hoping there would be showers over there as the pool is located in a different building than the condo, only to read a sign stating the pool was closed for maintenance for the next 5 days. The entire reason we booked Sam’s place was for the pool. The look of disappointment on our kids faces was heartbreaking. I reached out to both Sam and airbnb to request a refund. What a nightmare. We paid 465 dollars for 2 nights for no hot water and no pool. Sam offered us 100.  Beware.

The Airbnb is very big and nice. Great amenities and options for kids. The kitchen had everything you needed. This house is shared with other guests in the basement, only heard them a few times on the main level but almost never noticed them. Not too many things are walking distance but very peaceful and beautiful view of the mountains. Linda was an excellent host, super friendly and great with communicating. I will say that 2/3 showers were not clean, mildew in the grout at the shower base and black mould, we had to wear sandals in the shower bc it was not clean. There was black mould in the kitchen sponge holder as well. Some of the kids toys were not very clean but otherwise the place was spotless- clean floors, linens, kitchen, living spaces.

1. To install the air conditioner, the window was left open with an exhaust hose placed outside and the gap sealed with paper, resulting in excessive noise (from the nearby tram stop and passing cars) that made it impossible to sleep on the first night.
2. The bedding had stains, which made it feel unclean.
3. The air conditioner’s vent was so dirty that it was difficult to use, and the unit itself was very noisy.
4. The water reservoir of the coffee machine was so dirty that it was unusable for making coffee.
5. Upon check-in, the power in the rooms was not working, requiring a video call with the host to resolve the issue ourselves.
6. Only one key was provided for accessing the apartment entrance and elevator, which was inconvenient.
7. The location is convenient for walking to nearby attractions and accessing boat taxis.
8. The T&T Market right in front of the property offers a wide variety of groceries, including dungeon crab and lobster, at affordable prices.

Absolutely filthy. I originally booked 1 month, but checked out after the first night. Had to contact Airbnb for a refund but was still out a few hundred dollars. Grime on the stove, drawers stunk when opened, debris on the floors, human and dog hair everywhere. Shower was uncleaned, hair and soap scum everywhere and all their personal products still there. Smelly food in the cupboards. Totally disgusting and a waste of everyone’s time, I don’t what they are thinking listing a place like that.

This place will certainly not disappoint!  The hosts are very efficient answering any questions you may have concerning the parking, the keys or the condo.  The views are beautiful and the location in downtown Vancouver does not disappoint!

The apartment was great and had everything we could need!  Beds very comfortable.  While the location was good because we could walk everywhere, it's also a little sketchy with homeless people begging for money and people openly using drugs close by.  While it never felt unsafe, it was more so uncomfortable at times, especially at night.

All linens and mattresses were moldy. Visible mold on bathroom wall. Washer smelled like mold and left the same residue on clothes washed. Low space, poor light, minimal cleaning supplies and decoration. Great location.

This listing requires a minimum 3‑month stay, but the apartment itself is extremely small and poorly maintained. It was dirty when I checked in, hair on the bathroom floor, coagulated shampoo and conditioner, and barely 2-3 rolls of toilet paper. The kitchen was in bad shape, with hardened sugar, no coffee provided, and cabinet edges patched with tape. Even basics like dryer sheets were almost gone, which makes no sense for a long-term stay.The bedroom shades were useless against sunlight and gave me headaches.
Also, building key given was barely held together by tape on the inside. it broke during 2nd week of stay by merely dropping down from the couch.
Overall, the place felt neglected, understocked, and far below what’s acceptable for an extended booking as required by the host/strata rules - deceptively misleading for any guest staying long. Simon also became uncooperative after the cancellation, lying to avoid issuing even a partial refund, validated by Airbnb support.

1: No private parking or garage.
2: shared kitchen so you have to shared all the dishes with other renters. You have to keep the kitchen door lock, laundry machine included. I also saw cockroaches in the kitchen.
3: The place was old and needs some attention.
4: If you like coffee and tea, make sure to bring them with you cause they don’t provide.
5: No dining table.
6: Over all 200$ a night is totally waste of money, they also don’t refund if you cancel.
