While the pictures on the listing were appealing, they omitted a lot of wear and tear that was apparent in person. For example, there were duck-taped holders in the showers, a dirty shower curtain, and an extremely worn-off chair (replaced later by the hosts). In addition, we found that half of the light bulbs were not working, and many of the dishes were chipped or had dried food or dirt stuck to them.
This level of neglect is unacceptable given the price asked and the high rating that the listing had received. Although the hosts did fix some of the obvious issues, such as light bulbs and missing door handles within the first days of our arrival, the overall impression of the place was not improved afterwards. As a result of these issues, our stay was not as comfortable as we had hoped.
The hosts were friendly and communicative, and it is a great location to explore Vancouver from; however, improvements are required to make this place truly comfortable.

Pros
1. Very safe, clean neighborhood
2. Pacific Spirit Park directly across the street
3. Beds are comfortable but very firm
4. Clean bedding
5. Good layout of bedrooms (with washer / dryer between rooms)
Washer / dryer
6. TV set up to utilize your own apps (ie Netflix, Hulu)
7. Good water pressure in shower
8. Clean towels + sheets
9. Amanda very responsive + sweet
10. Easy street parking
Cons
1. No light for the stairs leading down to flat or light above door which was not safe given the steep stairs down to basement level
2. Door handle very difficult to open
3. Muggy in flat / does not have good ventilation other than 2 room fans
4. Appliances not clean - especially the exterior / interior shelves of fridge
5. Noise from upstairs unit starts at 8am - 10:30pm - if you are sensitive to noise, this will impact sleep
6. Generally worn down (handles, floors, bathroom ledge behind counter) needs a renovation - quite disappointed it did not look like images on site

It was not disclosed that it’s a Basement not the whole house. The inside was nice and clean but the outside looks really bad. The stairs going to the basement is dirty and needs painting and cleaning. The front door area is dirty and looks like an abandoned space. It needs a little TLC to kind of match the inside.

Fantastic location - close to transit, restaurants, and shops, with a small view of the water. Checkin/out instructions were very comprehensive and easy to follow. It was nice to have a parking stall available.
The suite has quite a bit of wear and tear compared to the photos - a couple of windows had large rips on screens, bathrooms had mold on the caulking, shower curtain had mold (it was too long), bathroom fans weren’t working well (very dusty), kitchen faucet was loose (appeared to have been a leak underneath that wasn’t addressed), fridge wasn’t cleaned, and the walls could really use a fresh coat of paint. Dishes and kitchenware were scant - hardly enough for our family of 4 to have breakfast, and certainly wouldn’t have been enough for cooking. The queen sized mattresses only had twin sized duvets; luckily it was a warm summer and we didn’t need much covers. Overall, the quality was comparable to a 2-star hotel, but with its location, I’d give this place 3 stars.

Pros:
- Location. Can’t go wrong with Main Street.
Cons:
- Very dark unit, particularly around the dining table. It is darker than it looks in the photos. If I had known how dark this unit was, I wouldn’t have booked it based on this alone because I simply need more light. There’s a window next to the dining table but you hardly get any light because the house next door is so close it blocks all the light.
- There is a toddler running around upstairs, in a wood frame home, so it can get annoying. Sometimes he runs around for hours throughout the day.
- Running out of hot water in the evenings. This happened more than a handful of times when I was trying to give my daughter a bath and I couldn’t.
- Going all around the block to take out the garbage and compost because the backyard gate is locked.
The stay could’ve been better, but the post-checkout experience was terrible. We usually do a thorough cleaning before we leave, but we only did a light cleaning this time because we ran out of time (but I paid a $100 cleaning fee, isn’t that supposed to cover… cleaning?), but Andrea got aggressive and immediately slapped us with additional fees. She claims she was only requesting an additional $400, but I also got a second email from Airbnb that the host was requesting $525, which either way is $500-$625 in what is essentially cleaning fees, which is beyond excessive and extortionary. She claims my family and I “absolutely destroyed” the unit, which is simply untrue. My family and I would never destroy property. Luckily I had documentation of the unit right before we checked out to prove that nothing was destroyed. She’s confused dirt & grime and normal wear & tear for absolute destruction, when the unit didn’t even come with a floor vacuum and mop (there was a vacuum, but it only came with a crevice attachment). Most of the photos she complained about were things you’d expect a cleaner to clean (like drippings on a stove, a dirty toilet seat). Also, I really didn’t appreciate how she left a review for me before I could even respond to see if we could work toward a resolution (which I did happily compensate more for the extra cleaning, and AirBnb didn’t request additional fundss, so it was more than fair). It’s been stressful to say the least.
So if you want peace in your life, make sure you clean the unit spotless before you leave even though you already pay a $100 cleaning fee, or just look for another listing. And make sure you document the unit before you leave, just in case.

Honestly the house was very dirty. There were toe nail clippings on the beside table, what looked to be roach poo behind the couch (which I have pictures of) there were rats where they left the garbage and recycling bins outside,  the hallway where the stairs are is completely filthy with stains.... not happy with the stay at all.

Beautiful location next to amazing trails. If you want shops and restaurants close by this isn’t the place. We had to keep the windows open at night for air and you can hear every word from people outside. Attention to details with the cleaning between guests was a little lacking. The fridge was a little dirty and there were dirty utensils is the drawer. Very sparse in terms of kitchen items. Not enough cutlery for the number of guests this place is supposed to be able to accommodate. Overall comfortable and nice

This apartment is in a lovely building and in a nice neighborhood. Things were mostly as represented. The only big issue we had, was the lack of cleanliness. Kitchen drawers & cupboards were dirty (crumbs, bits of food, spills). As a result it made us feel like we needed to wash everything before using. Under the coffee machine there was a dried spill and the fridge had bits of food left-over from other renters. The towels had a terrible moldy smell which would not come out even after several runs through the washing machine. The bed pillows were also in need of replacement - yellow-brownish and smelly. Those things said, we enjoyed our time at the apartment. It is well-lit, nicely appointed and very convenient to many things in the city. The difficulty we initially had accessing the garage, was because there are two garage gates in the alley and because the 2nd gate was not specified, we chose the wrong one. No big deal. The owner was very responsive and pleasant.

Super location downtown, but old dirty feeling building saved by a little decor. With a ok host.
Clean inside the appartment. But
has a dated bathroom and kitchen. Dining, living room and bedroom was well decorated modernly making it feel a little more put together.
But the dated poorly maintained building itself doesnt feel clean.
Buildings is much older and a little sketchy then expected. But the decor in the appartment makes it feel higher quality then it is. Great location downtown IF you can figure out which address it is. The Incorrect address did throw us off, being on foot walking between the twp places a few blocks apart. Including through dirty allyways trying to locate the lock box at the wrong adress with luggage was not the highlight if the trip.
The host was very short and derect response, not as friendly as most hosts have been thorugh airbnb. But did respond quickly.

DO NOT BOOK HERE!!! Checking into the condo was easy however once inside, it was apparent that the condo was not clean.  The floors were visibly dirty with long hairs in the bathroom attached to the bathroom mat.  There was also a semi-wet load of laundry in the dryer, there was water dripping from the fridge (ice and water built up under the trays at the bottom of the fridge) and the dish washer was not bolted into place and tipped over whenever the door was opened. We contacted Russ right away and made him aware of these issues, as I did not want to start off by adding a bad review (I told him on the call that I wanted to give him the benefit to fix the issues).  Russ indicated that he would have to look at the fridge and that the new house keeper must have not left things up to good standards.  Due to COVID, I purchased Clorox wipes and then spent the first part of my vacation wiping down the whole condo, and then swept, vacuumed, and mopped the entire condo.  I also had to wipe down the cupboard surfaces and knobs, as they were also visibly dirty. I followed up with Russ the following day, and he asked that I send him pictures, which I did right away. Since that time, we have NEVER heard back from him to this day!! We tried calling, left voicemails, sent emails, and there has been no response. Not only was this the dirtiest condo I have ever stayed at, but Russ was also the most irresponsible and negligent host I have ever had to deal with. I've never placed such a negative review or had such a bad experience. Please reconsider if you are thinking of staying here.

Never would I stay here again, this has been the worst host I have had in all of my travels around the world. The loft is ok, not as bright as the photos represent, but the host and I got off on the wrong foot and I have been accused of leaving the loft in an unacceptable state and being dishonest.
I'm not dishonest, just a tired dad trying to work my 40hrs with a 14 month old baby while we have been stuck in Canada because of COVId for the past 10 months! 7 different homes in 10 months, we are TIRED. I mistakenly only booked for one and didn't notice, she did and I paid the extra for my wife but didn't mention that we had an infant because we have never been charged, anywhere, for him previously. It was my mistake
The list of Winnie's grievances include:
1) One baby item left behind. We should actually be commended for only leaving one behind. We were on our way to the airport and had 10 pieces of luggage to repack and get under 23kg. I have lost numerus items just going for a walk so I am quite proud of this one
2) Leaving garbage in a garbage bag and in the bin. Also our recycling was left in the area designated by the host. There were no rules or requests asking us to take the garbage out to the building bin. We washed the dishes and wiped counter and tables.
3) 2 wet towels on the floor. whoops. Normally I would start a load in the machine but In our rush to get to the airport, they got left forgotten
4) Toilet plunger on the edge of the sink. ya, gross! but better than my baby licking it.
5) 2 door mats on the patio angled askew and half-empty planter pots that were randomly placed when we arrived, were moved neatly aside. I think I am 1-for-2 here.
And for all these horribly disrespectful things we did, Winnie demanded that we pay extra for our baby to be there. Which I did and I sent an honest apology to her. She accepted both then told me that our mess was still in-excusable.
We did pay a cleaning fee as well that does cover all these petty complaints
If you are going to stay here and don't have a photographic memory...take lots of photos. There is no rule book nor welcome book but don't eat anything in the cupboard!

While the location is great and the bed is indeed large and comfortable, overall we were disappointed with our stay; so much so that we had to leave early, as my partner had a reaction to the smell within the unit (musty/covered by cleaning supplies).
Winnie was extremely responsive pre-check-in and kindly helped us reduce our stay once we were in and having issues, so we wish her nothing but the best moving forward. But we felt like we were misled by the listing, as the bathroom was not 'newly renovated', but instead was in a bit of disrepair (and likely the source of the smell we encountered). With appropriate care and repair, this unit *could* match the listing, but it definitely fell short; I anticipate Winnie will take this feedback to heart and make this a better stay for future guests.

Amanda's place itself was great and she was very responsive. I don't want this to seem like a negative review because the apartment itself was great, but the area smells constantly of urine in the block surrounding the place, lots of homeless people on the street and the location feels sketchy, especially in the dark. But we didn't have any issues other than having to ask folks to move out of the way of the door, which they did without any issue. We wanted to be by gastown and this was walkable.  I wouldn't recommend this for a single person who might feel unsafe or a family because of the visible drug use directly outside and in the park across the street. (And I'm from a city, I'm not talking about smelling pot smoke.) Better to be aware of what you're getting into with the location, Amanda isn't overstating it in her listing. Also Nelson the Seagull cafe is great and their baked goods are amazing. Right across the street and good way to start the day.

After renting this place we received an email about the fact that there would be homeless people around the neighbourhood. We are from the Netherlands and are used to some problems on the street. What we experienced in the street and area of this AirBnb was of another level. During the time we were there we saw addicted and homeless people everywhere in the street.  It felt unsafe. We got advice to always (as a rule of thumb) go right when leaving. However, we arrived in Vancouver from the train station (on the left). We saw people dealing and using drugs on all sides. Okay, most people didn't bother us except to ask for the time or some money. Inside the Airbnb, most things were as communicated. We had a hard time coming into the building on arrival. All the addicted people around us caused unrest with our children. Cleanliness was good except for mould in the bathroom and dirty sheets under the sheet covers. We were used to cooking and breakfast amenities which this place didn't have

Norman is a great host. He's very communicative, the AirBnB was beautifully decorated and everything was clean. It was able to fit the 6 of us nicely. Overall, I enjoyed my stay at the property!
One negative is that the property is located at the edge of a bad neighborhood (Downtown Eastside). If you go one street north or more it gets a quite sketchy, especially on East Hastings Street. I thought I would put this out there just in case. Definitely wouldn't recommend walking around there at night.

Good, central location in historic Gastown. Nicely decorated and everything you need for a short stay. Amanda was very responsive and helped us check in earlier than 4pm. However, the flat is really small for four people. Feels unsafe outside as there are many homeless people as well as drug addicts outside at all times. This creates uneasant smells and noises during day and night. Wouldn't recommend for a woman travelling alone.

While this tastefully decorated apartment was reasonably clean, I would never stay here again. The neighborhood is awful; sirens at all hours, homeless people everywhere. We were greeted upon arrival by a man eating out of the dumpster in the alley and later my kids got to learn what a crack pipe looks like as we walked past a couple outside the building. Our initial impressions of Vancouver were horrible until we ventured far outside the neighborhood.
The unit is ok and we felt safe inside. A few things need maintenance; I now have a huge bruise on my shin from the dishwasher door falling on it. The washer/dryer takes forever to complete a load. Other than that, the unit is fine if you don't mind all the noise.

Kellan was an amazing host. Communication was very consistent and immediate. Her instructions were clear. The condo was clean and you can see she takes pride in ensuring her guests are comfortable. Good value overall. The neighborhood wasn’t the greatest a little sketchy but we didn’t feel unsafe. Thanks again Kellan we would definitely stay again if ever in Vancouver 😀

We were a group of 4 girls who stayed in the 2bdr suite for the three months of summer.
Initially we were moved into the coach house as requested by the host, as renovations were still being completed in the 2bdr suite. All began smoothly with our stay ; however, it wasn't long until we felt uneasy here.
As girls in our 20s we felt we were spoken to and treated as children, and not as the adults that we are - it honestly felt quite patronising. We did not give any cause to be treated like this. We feel that the host would not have treated a family / older tenants as he treated us.
If you're looking to have some pals around to your accommodation, I would suggest reconsidering. We were never made feel comfortable having friends over. Having had 3 friends around one early evening we were told we could look for an alternative location as it was not the “party scene”. This came as surprise as we never caused havoc or hosted parties / contravened the rules. We were made feel unwelcome on the property.
Furthermore it felt as though our every move was being monitored, this feeling was strengthened by the ring camera on the doorbell, which footage was used at a later date as a threat against us.
One singular key to the coach was accidentally mislaid and the host was informed immediately , a cost of €254 to replace it was applied. Thankfully with air bnb's help and support we did not have to pay such an amount.
The accommodation is a good size and well equipped and it’s location is superb. However the windows on the property that could open were very small, and did not open the full way. This resulted in poor ventilation and a stuffy house. On one occasion we left our front door open to improve the ventilation but we were subsequently told that it must be kept shut.
The Neighbouring tenant complained constantly about noise that we were making; never noise at an unacceptable level and generally such noise was made before 10/11pm. The noise was never exceptional as mentioned previously. We already felt uncomfortable having guests to the house and were threatened that is a 'party' was to occur we would be looking for accommodation some place else.
The neighbouring tenant would bang on the wall for example when we were watching tv, or even hoovering. It took us several days to figure out why they would bang on the wall - we did not go to the host to complain, however the host then came to us and was quite insistent that we keep the tv to a miniscule level and that music was not to be played loudly. We felt that he never listened to our side of the story and always took the other tenants viewpoint above ours, and we got the phrase that “this is the final warning” , “this is not an acceptable answer” and "she's a long standing tenant" - whatever that's supposed to mean, perhaps we were not as important as her.
Perhaps more settled /older tenants would be more suited to this property. It felt to us the host had formed his impression of us before getting to really know us and thus carried a constant chip on his shoulder for the duration of our stay. This property in our opinion is certainly not recommended by us to younger people, but perhaps older couples and or families may have a more positive experience

This place should be great, it's spacious and private in a great location. The problems are, it is not cleaned well or maintained. The place is quite grubby and run down. My bed sheets were not clean and there were hairs and some stains in the bed. Great potential but very poor hygiene.

During our stay, the towels and cushion sheets were pretty smell (they all look clean and wash but smell). I sent the message on the 2nd day. The host did receive the message and reply with new provision but I didn’t see the actual change (old towels still in the bathroom, the bed in second bedroom wasn’t tidy up).
Also, on the 4th day, we found the coke we put in the fridge was gone, as well as one man passed by in front around 9AM in the morning. The house was in the end cut, needs to pass by the parking lot and one unit currently on rent. But the wall of the house with its neighbor was broken in the vertical side so idk if there’s someone sneak in from there. That is to come with some notice of the light in second bedroom was turned on when we back even though we ensured to close all the lights before leaving in the morning.
The host replied to all the message with good manner but give very general message like please ensure to lock your door..
We left to book the last night in other place because we feel it’s unsafe. Even nothing valuable gone, but the feeling of maybe someone has come without notice (as not for cleaning up the house) is very sketchy.

We actually were not able to stay at the apartment in this listing because of a pipe burst issue on the day we were supposed to check in. However, I can vouch for Mauricio providing great customer service.
Mauricio was in touch with us about an hour before our check-in in order to discuss the issue over the phone, during which he offered to either provide a full refund or transfer us to a different unit that he managed. We chose to transfer to a different unit because it was late at night and it would be difficult to find last-minute accommodations. The new unit was very comfortable and clean, but we decided the next morning that it was not a good fit for us, so we called Mauricio again and he was able to promptly offer us a full refund again through Airbnb. We were given ample time to check out at our convenience that afternoon in order to connect smoothly to our new reservation elsewhere. Overall, we had a good experience with Mauricio's service and would recommend to future guests.

There was no hot water the entire time, one shower was not working. The area felt very unsafe and there were no restaurants as the listing specified. The homeless population had taken over. I would absolutely not stay here again and it was a terrible vacation because of this

I had a mixed experience at this Airbnb.
Positives:
Great location, very walkable to good restaurants and shopping.
Close to transit stops.
Very responsive host (Wei is the host, not Veronica, in my experience)
Unit is generally clean. No shoes allowed inside.
Negatives:
All towels were smelly and musty. There is no in-unit laundry so fixing this would have required taking the time to wash the stinky towels downstairs during our vacation activity time.
The fold out bed in the living room appeared to have mold in the foam underneath.
The street noise is very loud when the windows are open. Unfortunately, without AC, the windows being open in the summer is necessary all night long. There was only one pedestal fan provided.

The apartment looked in line with what we booked. Sleeping coach is a bit small for 2 people, so would not recommend to come with 6. Unfortunately it was not cleaned (there were still old bed sheets, towels in the bathroom and trash was not taken out). Jean-Michel was not able to resolve these issues during our stay

The location is perfect, very clean and we were happy to see bunch of flowers put there for us.
One star was dropped because it was very noisy (not host’s problem) but since there is no air conditioning there the window was always open and you hear all that noise all the time.
One star was dropped because cleaning fee was 175$ and when you put it next to house rules (you have to do lots of things) it doesn’t seems fair to me.
Overall if you want to stay near downtown, the location is great and the place itself is good.

Artur and his mother were very kind and quick to respond. the space was lovely, except I did have a few issues with the following: tub/shower had some black mold, curtains were not blackout curtains as listed in description, air infuser was filled with black mold, and the air conditioner was not installed when I arrived so I had to keep windows open and have a fan on me at all times, as I was not used to Vancouver heat and humidity.

The room was functional and clean.
I was disappointed by the wifi- had a meeting planned but had to reschedule as it was all but non-functional for maintaining the connection.
Would not recommend if you need parking. It’s not much of a spot and it’s a pain to to get to

This stay was completely unacceptable from start to finish. The moment we entered, the entire place smelled strongly of old, lingering food, and it was shockingly untidy. It was obvious that the space had not been properly cleaned or maintained. The condition of the unit was so bad that staying there was not an option -I left immediately.
I contacted the host, Carolyn, right away to explain the situation. Not only did she fail to resolve the issue, but she barely responded at all. There was no acknowledgment of the problem, no apology, and no sense of responsibility. Being ignored after raising such serious concerns is extremely unprofessional.
Charging guests for a place in this condition feels like daylight robbery. This listing is misleading and does not reflect the reality of what you arrive to. I wasted time, money, and energy dealing with this situation.
Save yourself the stress and disappointment. This host does not care about guest experience
It’s a good place to stay. However, the towel is a little bit smelly and dirty. But the host replace them immediately with fresh new ones. Bet passionate and responsible host.

Be warned. While this studio is very up to date and clean, the neighborhood is absolutely not. Footsteps from the door there is an immense homeless encampment that looks like Skid Row. There are tents lining both sides of the streets, blatant drug deals and drug use, and hundreds of people. As finding the parking area was rather confusing, we ended up going through the area twice. Crack, heroin, you name it was happening in broad daylight. Even pulling into the back alley to try and park the car, there was a man shooting up. As a first time visitor to Vancouver, we were appalled and did not feel comfortable staying there, especially as we walk everywhere and would be coming in late at night. Needles are just left on the street.
We went into the studio and it was extremely warm. The place does not have AC and only a small fan. The windows can be opened but there is noisy construction happening right next to the building. As we did not end up staying, this wasn't an issue, but be warned in the summer months.
As far as the key pick up goes, I'm glad there was two of us. My husband dropped me off at the 7-Eleven and had to drive around for awhile as there isn't parking. This would have been a huge pain solo or with luggage.
Lastly, communication was not quick. After checking in the place and deciding we couldn't stay there, I messaged Connor. His response took 3 hours. What if the key didn't work? When I explained that we are not comfortable, he explained that it was a big city and that there are some homeless just like in any city. His response felt very condescending as if we have never been to a large city or seen homeless before. I messaged him again the next day and it took 8 hours for a response. He refused to give us even a partial refund and only agreed to refund the 45 dollar cleaning fee.
We loved out stay in Vancouver, but this experience was awful and put a huge dent in our wallets. I guess we learned an extremely expensive lesson.

The location of this place is in the ghetto. Tons of drug addicts and homeless all around the building, no AC. Unit was boiling hot in October. More than half the lights did not work inside the unit. And shower was extremely dirty. Went to cancel and couldn’t get a refund so stayed the night. One of the worse Airbnb experiences I’ve ever had. Wouldn’t go there again if it was free

Connor is a very good host and provided clear information to access the building and its amenities. He was very considerate and allowed us to check in a little bit early too. His place is very nice, clean, and suitable for a couple. However, I don't recommend traveling with kids as the location itself (Chinatown downtown) is kind of sketchy.

The host was very friendly and responded quickly. It’s close to many different points of interest, which was nice. However, there were a few issues. The area is unsafe and has many sketchy people outside the complex. However, they did not bother us in any way and kept to themselves.  There is no a/c but the host has provided 4 fans, which helped a little bit. The pull-out mattress was dirty and so were the pillows. Overall, it was an alright place to stay and as long as you don’t mind the unsafe area, it’s a decent place.

This was a mixed bag. On one hand, the owner was nice and a great communicator, the property was well decorated, and the place was within walking distance of a lot of places downtown. On the other hand, there was no bedding for the sofabed, there were only two towels for two people for a three-day stay, there was food left on the floor, there were dirty dishes in the dishwasher, there was hair on the couch, the sound on the TV didn't work, and the area of town was pretty sketchy. I saw a guy loading a meth pipe by the garage entry gate, the area outside the entryway smelled of urine, there were numerous homeless and substance users right outside the property, and the process of getting/returning the key was a hassle given its distance from the property. I selected this place somewhat last minute after another Airbnb was canceled and should have done more research on the location. The price was reasonable but I would not recommend this place if traveling with kids or alone.

Connor’s place was convenient and comfortable for our trip (Eras Tour)! We ended up getting an uber from the airport to the key pick-up location and got our key quickly! If you also uber and decide to add a stop from the 7-eleven to the place, that will be a little difficult. I recommend getting two separate ubers! Finding the place was easy and the area was not as bad as some of the reviews stated… yes, it was a little sketchy at night walking to a nearby market but we did not see a lot of unhoused people and we definitely didn’t feel unsafe during the day or together as a group. The locals we met did warn us to steer clear of certain streets. The place is right next to Chinatown which is AMAZING if you love good Asian food! Connor was very responsive and provided us with extra towels when we needed them! The place was also clean but the cleaners could have done a slightly better job (that’s not the hosts fault). Overall—it was great!

The location was ok but then had trouble finding parking before picking up the keys - it was a hassle.
Bathroom was dirty and didn’t look like it was cleaned.
Picture frame in bedroom was broken and dropped on the floor.
Lights in bedroom were poorly setup. Table and floor fans were extremely dirty.

Would have more comfortable at a Super 8 motel. Every piece of furniture was worn and dirty. The apartment has a moldy smell to it with little to no air circulation. The curtain lack any black out capacity. Truly an investment to make money with little owner involvement. Unfortunate because it is a good location but far from Luxury.

Overall we had a great stay. We loved the location and neighborhood. We wished the furniture (chairs and couch) had been more comfortable and higher quality. Our backs were not happy working from home or watching tv at night. The bed was comfortable but all the other furniture could use an upgrade. Also the cancellation policy we felt was a bit misleading. We tried to shorten our stay by 20 days during the period of free cancellation and they were only going to refund us $300 due to a different discount level if we shortened the overall stay. So just be aware of that. It wasn’t a 90 day minimum when we booked and then it changed to that, but that shouldn’t have affected us. We loved being so close to a nice market and farmers market and able to walk to broadway or 4th easily. Kits is a fantastic neighborhood! Also 10 mins to off leash dog trails which was awesome.

I was quite disappointed with my stay.  The place was not that clean - there were several hairs on the bed sheet and hairs all over the floor.  There was also a lipstick stain on one of the coffee cups that I almost used.  The area was smaller than expected and is quite noisy during the day as you can hear the owner and his family, who live above.  It is located near a metro station, but the station was quite sketchy at night and the house itself is surrounded by many boarded up houses. It took around 20mins to get to Waterfront Stn. The owner wanted to charge us $40 to use an extra bedsheet and duvet cover. He also accused us of leaving the alley gate door open, which we didn't even use.  But worst of all was the value of money to stay at this place.  At $196/night, this place is highly overpriced for what you get. The service charge is also extremely high.  Next time I will pay a bit more to stay in a hotel but in a much nicer area.  Overall review: Okay location, fast communication, dirty place, over priced.

Host didn't disclosed there are people living down stairs and there are stairs going to the space. Those two are big issues that I try to avoid when I chose a place. I think when you offer non-refundable booking, you should have tell those two in your description. But none of it. So we were trapped with that doesn't work for us.
Condition of the place is poor. There are no draws provided in either bedrooms, super inconvenient. Bed is not comfortable, and so the does the sofa, not comfortable to sit on, not to say if someone needs to sleep on it.
Not a place I would book for the price if I knew all the above ahead of time. 2 of our guesses didn't come due to not liking people downstairs. Host agreed to refund before we checked in, but the next day, she only refunded a part of what she agreed claiming we are half way thru.

Our family stayed 3 nights at this suite. It was in a quite community in a convenient location. The suite has 3 bedrooms and 2 bedrooms which worked very well for 4 family members. The hosts were proactive in sending us reminders and instructions. This is a guest suite beneath ground level, so the air circulation was not good, and the beddings felt a little damp. The bathrooms were quite new and clean, but all other furniture and utensils were quite old.
There were quite some details which concerned me about the overall tidiness and cleanness of this suite: side yard with empty black plastic planters and a wheelbarrow with weed, 1st floor balcony filled with unwanted furniture, stairs to the basement covered with dark green dirt, the outdoor chair with stains and dirt, teapot with rust, coffee maker with dust, chipped plates in kitchen, used and dirty sponge in kitchen, shaky lamps on night stands, old and dirty sofa etc. This suite has all basics, but does not seem very pleasant.

First the location: easy walks to Yaletown and Gastown are a highlight. It's in the middle of everything with regards to driving. The neighborhood is ok but a little sketchy at night - but we felt safe. Vancouver was not nearly as sketchy as areas in Portland/Seattle where we visited this trip as well. The apartment was clean and neat. The layout was a little funky but not an issue at all. The shower was good, but not great - definitely better than average. The bed was very comfortable. We were there during a heat wave and the AC unit (a standalone portable unit that's not actually portable) struggled to do more than keep things cool (we like it cold at night). It's located in the living room so that room got cold but the bedroom off to the side not as much. Thankfully there was a large portable fan in the room that we used so we were happy. There's a great view from the apartment - very nice sunrises! The communication was solid and instructions were excellent. 4.5 stars. Thanks!

I’m sorry to say we had to cancel our reservation after 1 night because this house has sanitation issues. We are sad to have to report this as it’s clearly a family home with lots of lovely artwork and family photos and wonderful outdoor spaces but unfortunately there seem to be a few infestations presently. We found dead bugs in the stacked dishes in the kitchen, and clothes moths coming from the couch in the living room. There are Moth traps all over the house with dead moths in them and a mouse trap underneath the TV (which apart from suggesting mouse issues, also wasn’t safe for our puppy dog). The carpets are visibly dirty and musty. We were worried about our exposure to both clothes moths and fleas and vacated the home. I can empathize with the fact that infestations can happen to even the most vigilant homeowners, but it's not fair to then rent a home out to travelers while it's in that state. This house needs a deep cleaning and extermination work before it's safe to rent for commercial purposes.

Front and side and back. Looked like a slumlord rental. Worst house on the block. Lighting was also terrible causing tripping hazards. Basement floor super cold and no adequate floor coverings. Only had  two tea towels and 1 extra roll of toilet paper . Had to get another roll from my daughter. No top sheet or full bath towels provided. No recycling or green waste container provided. Above tenants were horribly loud after quiet time stipulated in the Airbnb listing We could hear not only them using the bathroom (and yes everything in the bathroom) we were totally caught off guard by the stomping in shoes around the house at 5 am followed by the child stomping around at 8am and again at 5pm. Fridge is in middle of living room. Needs to be moved to the kitchen. We were there for a week so wanted something to settle into for the week The couch is the most uncomfortable thing I’ve sat on. Holes all over the walls that weren’t fixed and towel rails were falling off the wall. The bed was the only nice part of our stay. Great job at picking great beds.

We stayed for two nights in Vancouver. Check in was a nightmare and took over an hour to get in due to building codes not working properly. After getting in, we bought food for the bbq, only to find there was no propane tank present. We contacted Kreesan about the issue but received no reply.
The balcony is only big enough for the bbq... you cannot sit outside at the property.
The 3rd bedroom is a bunk bed placed next to the refrigerator at the end of the kitchen, not really a room at all (although there is a door dividing).
Total lack of cutlery (3 knives, 5 forks and spoons) for a property that sleeps 8 guests! No bowls at all.
Ensuite shower had broken handle and broken toilet roll holder. The shower didn't drain, pooled up around your feet and was mouldy around the bottom as a result.
The location was central, but apart from that, a poorly equipped rental.

There were many inconveniences that were not dealt with and made our stay unenjoyable. Firstly, when we arrived, all of the towels were dripping wet in the dryer and we had to dry them ourselves. Then, there was no power or light in one of the bedrooms. The host sent an assistant to change the lightbulbs on our second day there, but they bought the wrong bulbs, and never returned to fix it, so we had no power in one of the rooms for our whole stay. The breaker kept tripping during our second night too, so we had no wifi. Lastly, there were no bowls in the kitchen, and some of the “clean” glasses in the cupboards still had lipstick stains on them. The host refused our request for a partial refund for the inconvenience. I would not recommend staying here.

Pros:
-easy check in
-good option for when you need to be in Vancouver for a few months but can’t commit to a year lease
-good kitchen supplies like pots, pans, coffee machine, rice cooker, Etc.
-I never felt unsafe in the house or neighborhood. I had limited communication with the host (mainly because I’m shy) but he seemed very nice.
Cons:
-quite dirty. We had to deep clean it the day we moved in
-very humid. We had issues with condensation accumulating on the wall closest to the outside and getting our things wet
-limited space is taken up by things like an ironing board (good for short term stays, but not long term) and other people’s slippers.
-far from pretty much everything. Closest grocery store is a 15 minute walk and everything else is even farther away.

When reading others reviews before commenting some people had said parking was difficult as well as the area of town didn't feel safe. So I went in expecting both those things. I honestly had no problem parking. Kwan gave very detailed instructions and the parcade was easy to find. I also didn't find the area unsafe or sketchy in anyway. I stayed here with my partner and two children and felt just fine. The hot tub and pool were great to have. The kitchen has all the basics. The view from the large windows is amazing. The door is a keypad so it was easy to get in. Honestly no complaints!  We went to a concert and rodgers area is basically next store. There is also a starbucks, a blenz, freshslice and subway all within a 2 minute walk. My only reccomendation if you are staying with more than a couple people or with kids, is to bring towels from home, especially if you are planning to go swimming.

1. The hosts are heartless, and everything is about money. We recognized the rental was non-refundable, but we were faced with a family emergency that led to an Emergency Room visit for my mother. Since we are from the United States, our visit was cut short because we needed to return immediately to the USA for care. After we shared this with the hosts, they declined to meet in the middle or issue a partial refund. We stayed in the rental for one night and paid for seven despite numerous attempts to ask the hosts to have some sympathy and relieve some mental and financial stress around a really scary and awful situation.
2. The place was not well cleaned. There was an open garbage bag left once we entered. It smelled terrible, and we immediately needed to air the apartment. We shared these concerns and a photo with the rental company, they told us that the cleaners always send them proof of cleanliness and suggested we were lying about it.
3. BEWARE of this money-sucking business!

Unfortunately, the property did not match the listing or the photos. The house felt much older and was in significantly worse condition than advertised. There was also a strong unpleasant odor throughout the home that made our stay uncomfortable.
One of our biggest disappointments was the backyard, which looked very different from the listing photos. Several pieces of outdoor furniture were broken, making it impossible for our family to comfortably use the outdoor space.
After arriving, we contacted Airbnb, who reviewed the situation and approved a refund. We decided to leave after the first night. Based on our experience, we would not stay here again.

First off the positives.... Incredible views, great location, comfy bed and bedding and well stocked kitchen with plates, cups and glasses.
There were some negatives however. There's a pub right next door and once they close there is a lot of loud talking, swearing, laughing etc.... We were not expecting this and it woke us and kept us up. Also, the deck although wonderful was dirty. Lots of cigarette butts and generally unclean. The blinds on the windows are either bent or broken and they need to be replaced along with the torn curtains. Furnishings could also be updated.
Overall I'd say location is a 4.5 and property is a 2.5.

Location is amazing. Absolutely beautiful. Decor is inviting. Our last minute booking and late check in was accommodated. Smell is the first thing that hits you when you enter. It smells of dead rodents and the bathrooms of urine. Cleanliness is repulsive. I felt dirty getting out of the shower and scared to rub against a filthy walls in the bathroom. I took the mop to the baseboards and walls in the one bathroom. And stood on the bathmat to shower. They were next level. It’s unfortunate photos can’t be posted of the conditions of the bathrooms.
I did a ton of laundry as there was only four towels and four face cloths for our family of six. No hand towels. A large heavy mirror fell out of the frame onto the floor while nobody was near it. It could’ve been deadly had one of the kids been under it when it fell. Cobwebs in the corners. At the very least the home needs a proper cleaning and the area rugs need to be shampooed. If you don’t value cleanliness this place would be suitable.

It was very dirty, we left the place cleaner than we found it. I spent my first 2 hrs cleaning. There was food from previous guests in the fridge. The bathroom smelled like urine and stains on all the carpets. Definitely an overused space. Did not feel clean. Bed was uncomfortable old bedsheets and comforter. Towels spelt of mildew. After a shower you still smelt like it so I dried with paper towel. Not worth the money. I expected a clean and tidy space. There are cords in a tangled mess tucked in corners dirty furniture. The glass on the staircase had hand prints and smearing. The worst thing was that something must have been in the washing machine bcuz I bought a 350$ new sweater. I washed it and it came out of the machine with hot pink stains all over the front. Totally ruined. I saw these same pink stains on the white leather stool on the patio as I washed the sweater on its own without anything else in the load. I’m disappointed totally dissatisfied and would not recommend.

We have stayed in many airbnbs all over the world and have never left or received a negative review. This is a first for us. Watch out for these people: Scam-man and Robbin' with their luxury "one-bedroom" (there is no bedroom), and modern bathroom (complete with leaking and flooding sewage included at no extra cost). After being assured a plumber would be called, they finally did it 9 hours later at 8 pm, and then refused to refund us for the three nights we didn't stay. I started to wonder if these were real people or property management bots. Watch for the folksy corporate-speak in their rebuttal.

I was disappointed with this rental: The condo is 'tired'; needs some personal upkeep & maintenance (baseboard heater falling apart, poor aircon, tangled blinds, dirty stove, etc). We assume it just gets flipped at the end of every rental. The concierge refused to hold our bags for a couple of hours after check out (we were led to believe we could leave them with him).
But, great location. Downtown Vancouver very walkable.

Great location, but that's where the positives end. The listing photos were misleading — no sign of the three portable AC units. The bathrooms needed obvious maintenance, both bathrooms were in poor condition (peeling plastic toilet seats, poor water pressure, broken shower knob). The "AC" units required open windows, meaning SkyTrain and traffic noise and light disrupted our sleep throughout the stay — never disclosed.
When raised, Kiki responded quickly, acknowledged the issues, but deflected — claiming she couldn't be expected to fix them before check-in, despite her cleaners being present between stays. The bedroom AC repeatedly tripped the breaker; the proposed fix was an extension cord from the kitchen, which felt unsafe.
We were asked to alter our plans or allow access while we were out to address problems that should have been caught through routine maintenance. If you're considering booking here, keep looking.

The pool is broken, and so the descriptions is misleading. I hope it gets fixed soon, but the host was inconsiderate and did not notify us of the fact before, nor did they apologize after being notified.
The fan in the bathroom is also extremely loud, the bathroom is small and the water stream in the shower pulses and is uncomfortable.
The bed and den are great, and the kitchen is clearly good, despite not getting to use it.
I wouldn't recommend this place, mostly because of a poor interaction with the host.

We have stayed at Devorah’s before and found it fabulous. We have tried to book it again in the past but it is popular. Luckily we managed to book it again for this trip and we weren’t disappointed. Devorah is a wonderful host, available but also she doesn’t intrude on your privacy. The accommodation is so comfortable and provides every thing you could want for a stay away from home. The location is peaceful but close to shops, cafés and restaurants. Lovely for walking but close to transport. Hopefully we will be able to stay with Devorah again.

- The place was very dirty and there was a very strong and unpleasant smell throughout the house
- The was dust all over the baseboards, toilet seat
- The shower curtain was stained on the bottom as if it was years old
- The towels were also smelly, we thought about washing them before using them but there was no dryer as mentioned in the listing
- There were no dish/hand towels as well as no hand soap in the kitchen
- Paper towel rolls were stored under the kitchen sink area, which was dirty
- Casually checked under the couch cushions to see if it was a pull out couch, but all we found was an old pair of nail clippers and food crumbs.
- Had to wash the silverware since they were spotty and the silverware holder was dirty
- The entrance was also very uneven, someone could trip and get hurt
- There was no temperature control system, and the host would crank the heat up at night, which made it hard to sleep because it felt like we were in a sauna
Should not charge cleaning fees

Good location. However the place was not clean appropriately. Some pots were very dirty, and no soap left in the kitchen or in the washroom.
The entry of the house (backyard) was cluttered, and somewhat dirty, a lot of bugs around.

Owner was easy to reach and able to provide information needed to check in. My reaction staying at the place and did not expect how dirty in some areas and maintenance needed to be fixed around the house. When we got inside the house, there was no airflow. Thermostat was not working and we have to open the window in order to keep us cool. We tried using the equipment around the house such as pots and kettle, but we noticed that most were rusty pots and uncleaned kettle. Going around the house, we notice the house was not cleaned properly. There were dead bugs behind the couch and ants inside one of the bedrooms. Charging for cleaning fee place is still dirty. We also run into lack of equipment provided for us such as toilet paper and paper towels. The tiles inside the washroom were broken upon stepping inside. It’s hazardous and people can slip and cause an accident. Overall stay. Place was safe but I don’t know if the price is worth.

Unfortunately, this stay did not meet our expectations. Although the photos are genuine, they don't reflect the property's actual condition. The entrance was cluttered with paint buckets, old tyres and other materials. Inside, the apartment was much darker than expected and cleanliness was below our standards. We found dust, mould and dirt behind the toilet, and a dirty shower curtain. The apartment showed significant wear, including unfinished repairs, expanding foam around electrical outlets and wobbly bedside tables. The hob was worn and dirty, the kitchen towel appeared to have already been used, and basic utensils such as a colander were missing. Only two bath towels were provided, and when we asked for hand towels, we were given disposable paper towels instead. As the hosts live upstairs, footsteps, running water and other household noise were clearly audible and woke early in the morning.

This rental experience has been disappointing due to several issues. We had to escalate our issue to Airbnb due to the host not budging on cancelling/refund or partial refund on our stay. The space was noisy, with sounds from upstairs walking/chairs moving. The fan is always on when the bathroom light is on and loud for nighttime bathroom visits in such close proximity. No hooks for towels to dry.
The extra pullout bed is NOT acceptable for an adult to say the least. It is extremely uncomfortable, with hard ridges and no padding. There's inadequate closet space for two single people with no hooks or hanging tree for the 2nd or 3rd guest. The ceilings and bulkheads are very low compared to the description in the listing. The host locked us out, claiming Airbnb reported the reservation was cancelled. Anthony was responsive but very passive/ aggressive towards our request to cancel / shorten our stay. He told us that the situation was very trying for him. Just not a good experience

the location is fantastic, lots of restaurants and stores. And the view was amazing from the balcony especially at night.
The condo had everything we needed as far as kitchen items and towels.
The skytrain outside the condo was loud, it seems to run all night? it wasn't unbearable, just a little annoying. (I'd suggest earplugs or a whitenoise machine)
It was fairly clean inside, except the shower had some mold in it and the floors were pretty dirty - my socks were dark on the bottoms within minutes. It definitely needs a decent deep cleaning done in there.
I also noticed the sheets had alot of hair on them and visibly used, they definitely hadn't been changed/washed.
overall I wasn't too disappointed, I'd definitely stay here again.

Stayed 3 nights for what we went for which was a concert. Do not recommend walking around at night. Sketchy areas with lots of homeless people and paraphernalia. Otherwise the unit itself was very secure and the bed was very comfortable. There is a sky train but it didn’t disturb our sleeps.

The pictures didn’t match reality at all. We arrived an hour after check-in and were hit with a strong smell. The unit was clearly uncleaned. Dirty, damp towels were piled on the floor, with recycling and open garbage scattered from the entrance to the kitchen. The bed looked like someone had just rolled out of it with twisted sheets, and pillows. The bathroom was the worst: visible fecal smears on the toilet, trash can overflowing with used q-tips and other unhygienic items, and long black hairs stuck to the sink and tub. The pillows and bedding had yellow rings and disturbing stains, and the kitchen had dirty cutlery mixed in. I tried cleaning but eventually had to buy new linens and pillows just to feel safe sleeping there. The host apologized and offered a refund, saying the cleaner didn’t show, but later withdrew the offer. If you can tolerate a place left in someone else’s filth, this might work, but I strongly recommend staying elsewhere else. Gross!

The positives are that the place is clean, particularly the bathroom. The described view is only seen from the small balcony. If sitting inside, you are looking at other buildings through dirty windows.
Unfortunately, the negative aspects far outweighed the above.
The lounge is very worn and bare in places. I’m not sure how this apartment could accommodate 4 adults in the living space.
The bedrooms were extremely noisy at night, with the metro trains running until 1.00am and starting again at 6.00 am. Ear plugs are a necessity.
The blinds in one bedroom did not close properly, meaning the room was bright for the night. Eye mask recommended.
That same bedroom could not accommodate suitcases - there was no room to open them on the ground. We finished up with two bags on the bathroom floor.
The glassware is poor - some plastic and the rest odds and ends.
In terms of value, this is terrible. Very expensive for what was poor accommodation. I’m surprised at the number of good reviews!

The owners are responsive, but the apartment is disappointing and leaves something to be desired. When we arrived both of the bedrooms had hair all over the bedding. Even after the owners changed the bedding, there was still hair found among the sheets. Also, it was very hot when we arrived and we had to ask the owners how to use the portable AC unit in order to figure out how to cool things down. Additionally, the balcony door must be left open in order to properly use the AC and funnel out the hot air. The shower had mold/dirt in it, hair in the bathroom, crumbs on the counter, scuffs on the wall and the blinds don’t function well plus no curtains. The apartment was overall just okay and somewhat unclean/unkempt throughout— it needs to be updated. What most people mention about the view is true, it’s good, but not worth the general untidiness.

The apartment was located on the 31st floor in downtown, couple of restaurants, supermarket, costco, skytrain, liquor store were walkable and the view from balcony was good.
That being said, we were 4 people and had couple of issues -
The microwave was dirty from inside, pots and pans were scratched non stick ones and basic condiments like salt/ sugar were not available. Basically the kitchen could not be used for any cooking.
The two rooms had a connected shower room in which the shower head was broken.
The couch in the living room had a very dirty coverup with white hairs here and there.
We kept getting automated replies and none of our queries were addressed. Getting in and out of the building for the checkin and checkout was like a treasure hunt with soooo many instructions to follow.

If you were looking for a nice day at the suburbs to visit in Vancouver, this is the B&B to go. The Airbnb sits at the bottom of a private residential, but it does not disappoint. Everything is clean. The kitchen holds tons of utensils and cookware bathroom is clean and has a build in heater to keep you warm while taking a shower. Every room is spacious and very quiet. Once you enter the B&B, there are coat hangers and shoe racks to put your shoes. (since Vancouver is a rainy city and boots tend to be dirty and coats, tend to be wet). The entrance is located to the back and is protected by a auto lock door, which is great in my opinion since some of us are forgetful. I had a great time in Vancouver and also in this Airbnb I will be back to book at this humble home.

The place is in a great location, convenient for shopping, downtown and the beaches. The flat's layout is nice, the main bed was very comfortable, as was the sofa. However, we found that for the cleaning fee paid, the cleanliness of the place was not great (dirty utensils, coffee machine, crockery and glasses, dirty light switches, cobwebs and a dirty shower).. Sadly, there was no welcome folder or personal touch, which we've probably been spoiled with, from our experience at other AirBnBs. There is a distinct lack of storage for food in the kitchen - one little cupboard was provided. There were lots of utensils in the kitchen, but many of the basic cooking tools were missing. If you're planning on mainly eating take out, the kitchen is great, if you're planning on doing some cooking, then you'll probably find the kitchen lacking.
Note: although at the time of our stay, the listing said there was parking "on the premises", there wasn't. Instead there was on-street parking (be careful as much of the street has restrictions).
The neighbourhood does feel safe, and close to W Broadway for great restaurants and grocery shopping.

While Nicole’s place is in a good location, 20-30 minutes out from most tourist spots in Vancouver, I was very disappointed to see that her place wasn’t true to her pictures and that the place wasn’t cleaned. There was hair EVERYWHERE (in the bed, the bathroom, the common area, etc.). The soap and bathroom decor was removed as well as some other things displayed in the listing. I had to request another sponge as the one left in the unit was moldy just to clean the areas I used. When I let Nicole know about the hair she apologized and other issues, she was apologetic but when I requested a refund on the cleaning fee, as I cleaned up the hair and other things, I was denied.
My only advice is to just be careful! When you are booking an Airbnb, you are hoping that the pictures match the listing and you are getting what is advertised. It is extremely overwhelming and inconvenient whenever a problem arises as it can leave you very uncomfortable and at worst cases, displaced.

The host is very friendly and responsive and the location is great as it is close to downtown and the sky train station.
The suite was cleaned but the only issue was that there was quite a bit of black mold in the suite, especially in the bedroom around the windows and in the bathroom. We were unable to open the windows to let fresh air in for any room which I think combined with the mold made us both feel a bit sick.

AWFUL. Theresa was absolutely awful. Check in ANYTIME after 5pm. We followed instructions & retrieved the key. late flight from NY. After being at the home for an hour, my wife was putting our son to sleep close to midnight (3AM NY time), a loud alarm went off for several minutes. I called Theresa repeatedly until the alarm finally stopped. I was upset about the alarm but not over the top. She rudely blamed me for checking in too late (even though anytime after 5pm permitted, blamed her cleaner for mistakenly setting the alarm and took 0 responsibility, said it’s not her fault since she was not in Vancouver. I sent follow up that this was wild for her to take no responsibility and even to blame me, after we followed HER instructions. Said she was not “safe” with us staying and harassed. I sent brief video that we just intend to sleep there and will take care of home. She insisted to kick us out and harassed us til we left, threaten to call cops & sound alarm without Airbnb cancellation

The check in was unusual, Don help me to take my bags and enter to the building from parking, this make me feel not very welcome, No amenities in building for airbnb users, I asked to Don how to throw the garbage in the building and never get an answer back, for my last day I had tones of garbage in the apartment, I was following the instructions for the “check out” to take leave the keys in the KeyCafe but Don at the end told to leave the keys on the Airbnb and I had to get back with my all my bags walking the street to do it. Horrible check in/check out. I don’t recommend this place to stay in Vancouver, I stayed in 3 different airbnbs on my vacations and this definitely was awful. It is a shame, It is a nice apartment.

Host was nice and helpful but the accommodations itself were not clean. It is much smaller then I expected from pictures, it's basically just a hallway to a bedroom, no TV and just a small beer fridge, not the full fridge as shown in pics.
After a few hours of back and forth I did receive a partial refund from AirBnB since the host was not in Canada.

The home was easy to find and the instructions to enter were clear. The room is small and the kitchenette simple but they do the trick. Extra points for a bidet on the toilet! Very walkable area, decent street parking available, and it was very easy to walk 10 minutes to Nanaimo Skytrain station. I only had 2 issues. First the futon was described as a fold out couch which is different and the futon was not comfortable to sleep on. The bed was good though with no issues. Second, while the bidet was a nice feature there was a clear ring of mold around the bottom of the shower. This would be relatively easy to clean but it made me wonder about the rest of the cleanliness (no decernible issues though, the unit was very clean looking otherwise). Overall it was a good experience. If not for the mold I'd have rated 5 stars.

My review is similar to the previous review.
We needed a large space that accommodated our family. This house is basic and overall suited our needs.
However the house does need TLC. There were broken kitchen appliances (toaster oven had issues, one stove top burner didn't work). There was no toaster or keurig. There wasn't enough bowls or spoons for the amount of people staying. Toilet paper ran out quickly. Living room furniture, rug, dining chairs should be replaced. It was clean but needs a deep clean. Main floor bathroom door doesn't close. A cupboard door fell off it's hinge when my daughter opened it. The stove was dirty and when we preheated the oven it became very smoky. That's when we noticed there are also missing smoke detectors. The one smoke detector in the house was secured with a plastic bag over it. Also there is mold in the showers.
The back yard isn't a welcoming space. Only street parking. No instructions on garbage.
It was good for sleeping lots of people.

Unfortunately, our stay was very disappointing. Upon arrival, we found visible mold in the master bedroom’s restroom, the water control room, and the basement restroom — a serious issue since members of our group have allergies and asthma. The musty odor worsened by the first night, disrupting sleep and forcing us to rearrange sleeping arrangements. We also suspected mold on the black-painted basement wall. One family member got sick after two nights in the basement bedroom. Maintenance issues added to the problem: broken washer/dryer, missing cord loop on the kitchen blind, a broken door lock on the first-floor restroom, and an uncovered electrical outlet in the basement. Relocating wasn’t realistic after a long trip. The host’s partial refund offer didn’t fairly address the situation. Had we known about the mold and maintenance problems, we wouldn’t have booked. I cannot recommend this property.

We stayed at Jay’s for 1 night with 3 families and kids ranging in age from 5-13 years old. We were pretty disappointed with the condition of the home. The showers had mold in the grout, one of the bedrooms on the upper floor didn’t have a window covering and doesn’t have a window that opens, 2 of the bedrooms upstairs got very hot and not having a window that opens made for a sleepless night. The washing machine is very hard to operate and the dryer takes multiple cycles to dry clothes. The room in the basement with 3 beds is very crammed with 1 of the beds partially under a counter top. The home could use some general maintenance and deep cleaning. All smoke detectors have been removed and wires were left hanging from the ceiling where they were supposed to be. Jay was very responsive to questions and was a friendly host

I had an okay stay. Unfortunately check in isn’t until 4 pm ( which I knew ) but my flight landed earlier and the host texted me that there was no way to check in early . Which was fine until it took over 4 hours for them to clean, considering it took 4 hours you would think the fridge would’ve been cleaned! The bottom of the fridge was dirty. ( photo evidence ) everything else was cleaned but how did you take 4 hours to clean and not ensure everything was spotless? Most hotels even allow check in early, and the fact that it took 4+ hours for them to clean and still ended up with a dirty fridge ?! Is very frustrating! Considering I had to wait at a cafe, when I was tired from traveling all morning .
Also the hosted didn’t seem very friendly, or welcoming . He seemed annoyed when I asked him how to open the gate . It’s not like instructions were given on that …

1. Apt is too old so all the windows and doors are partially broken. Very different from the image shown in airbnb.
2. Unbearable noise from the road and neighbor. It is not occasional noise but daily. Cars and bus pass by only 5meters in front of the the apt for 24 hours. You will never get asleep unless you drink more than 5bottles of vodka before going to bed.
In my case, there were parties over night for 3 days which is whole period of stay.
I wished I had a gun in my hand.
3. Water pressure is too low. It takes forever to take a shower.
4. About hygienic condition… You will see all kinds of hairs of all races on the earth in a tiny little hole in the tub and a sofa.
My son had allergic reaction to the entire house so I had to clean the buckets of grey dust mass. My son still needed to take anti histamine for 5 days.
I will never stay a second with that dirty carpets, sofa and filthy floors.
5. No curtain no privacy no sleep.
You have to give up sleeping in the apt.

First of all, to be fair, the hosts are very responsive and seem like nice people. The rental is fairly clean, but also cheaply constructed.
It's important to note that this rental is NOT an entire home. It's a converted basement beneath the rest of the host's (occupied) home. The basement is directly connected to the rest of the home via a staircase with a (locked) door, so it's misleading to categorize it as an entire home. Based on the pictures online, we thought we'd be staying in the main house (pictured with a front porch) and have the property to ourselves. We were disappointed when we arrived, tried unsuccessfully to open the front door with the provided door code, and were greeted by the host who then told us that the entrance was around the back. We then discovered we'd be staying in their basement.
After raising the issue with Airbnb support, the host has updated the description for additional clarity, but it's still categorized as an entire home. Just be aware, if you book this rental, you'll be staying in the "entire basement" NOT the entire home, which will likely come as a surprise.
I wouldn't recommend this basement for older vacationers or young children because the floors are uneven with several short lips throughout the rental that are very easy to trip on. We also hit our heads several times on the low hanging and uneven ceiling, especially when coming in and out of the bathroom.
For foodies, it's also important to note that you'll need to drive at least 15 minutes, one way, to eat at a decent restaurant. Besides the grocery store, there isn't much to eat in the neighborhood.
There is a decent park nearby for young kids, which includes a small forest that's nice to explore.

Place had a great location and parking. The inside isn’t the worst, bed was cheap, but place is a good size and has all the stuffs ya need. Outside was not something i’ve experienced before on Airbnb. Deck on the second floor entrance has some soft spots which was scary and a shared space with the home which was full of clutter. Yard was full of clutter, trash which the overgrown vegetation didn’t hide. If ya can get past the junky yard the place isn’t the worst if ya need a place to sleep and want to be close to everything.

The location and amenities of this Airbnb were as described, and the host was responsive. However, I encountered a "bedbug" issue during my stay. When I informed the host, they promptly replaced the bedding, sprayed the area, and offered a partial refund if I chose to cancel. While I appreciate their quick response, I would recommend a more thorough approach to ensure the issue is fully resolved for future guests. Also, I suggest using normal photos instead of wide-angle ones to give a more accurate representation of the space

We had multiple issues and had to vacate the property, for another airbnb, after one night (of 7) due to these. Host/guest services, with airbnb support involvement, did issue a full refund.
Property has amazing views and such great potential, unfortunately it suffered from some fundamental maintenance issues. Marketed as beautiful and containing modern furniture was simply not the case. Broken sofa, wafer thin mattress in 2nd room and multiple broken chairs in dining room made it uncomfortable and in places unsafe to stay at. Plus other issues in kitchen and bathroom and with neighbours.
With these issues resolved the property has the ability to be exactly as marketed.
Detailed feedback provided to the host to enable this property to be improved to the required standard for future guests.
We wish the host all the best in bringing the property to the required standard.

The experience was good in general. The host was easy to communicate and there was a fast response. Overall the place was clean but not ideal clean , I had some hair in my bathroom, the bathroom fan is so dirty and dusty that you can feel that in the air. Some of the walls are dirty as well , if it’s place want to be “ luxury” they should take care of it . Also it was so complicated to turn on the shower, it’s tricky I’ve been traveling a lot, in Canada and in the world but I have never seen such a system, some detail instructions could help . One more thing the entrance to the building is by pressing a code, which will also allow you to use the elevator. Some cheap key could be a great idea and instead of using the cold every time takes about seven minutes. one more very important thing. The building is located not in the safest part of the city. there are many homeless people around the area, especially in the park which is right under the building. You can see it and hear it.

Overall clean place, great location for activities and food. Amar was quick to respond and check in on us if we ever need any help. However, wifi was slow and did not support or accommodate for the advertised 8 guest capacity. Lastly, there are people underneath who are EXTREMELY sensitive to noise. So we can not make any noise whatsoever at night. If you did, you would receive a rude banging on the door to warn you. My group and I would arrive late, and any walking or steps would send the tenants banging on our door. Despite us trying, being a full house of 8 people- there’s bound to be noise. If the tenant thinks your being to noisy, she will come to your door and threaten to call 911 and tell us that we are being unreasonable. We were also told that we were too noisy early in the morning, when our group would wake up around at 10:30 am - 11 am to prep our day. The woman who talked to us was extremely unreasonable and rude.

I would start by saying that the listing was in an area where there were a lot of people living on the streets, the streets were generally dirty and unkempt. Walking around and getting to downtown Vancouver was, at times, not for the faint hearted due to this. The apartment was pretty nice and as described. The blinds were really dusty and the microwave was dirty. The shower curtain arrangements were terrible in the ensuite with numerous signs saying don’t spill water on the floor which was impossible, the curtain stuck to you in the shower which was yuk. The weather was quite warm when we were there and the aircon didn’t hack it. This may seem like a very negative review but we actually enjoyed our stay, the gym, pool and hot tub were great. The faults were mainly cosmetic and fixable and we were allowed to drop our bags off early and given an early check in which we were very grateful for. The location was excellent as far as seeing Vancouver was concerned.

I do have to admit there were a few things that were disappointing during our stay, such as the overall communication prior to arrival, during checkin/checkout and the cleaning prior to our arrival.
Other than that, the apartment itself was very nice and cozy. Though I wouldn’t recommend walking around late at night near the apartment block, the best areas downtown are in close walking distance (10-15 mins). Thanks for the stay.

I had a very disappointing stay at this Airbnb. The room had a persistent moldy smell every day, which was quite unpleasant. The bathroom was even worse, with a strong and intense odor that made it difficult to use. To top it off, I found a large spider in the bathroom, which was quite alarming. Additionally, the house did not have a dishwasher or a washing machine, which was very inconvenient. I would not recommend this place to anyone.

The apartment was lovely just as advertised. It was very clean, the ac was great as it was very hot while we were there. Check in was extremely easy - we would definitely stay there again.
One thing marred the whole process was that Vick's AirBnB account was hacked and a scam attempted - there was an attempt to get us to pay a $800 damage deposit. I was very wary and Ksenia stopped us from being scammed. This is in no way Vick & Ksenia's fault, but entirely due to AirBnb's lack of security.

I scheduled 7 days and stayed overnight & checked out the next morning. There was no parking, the only view was of a filthy alleyway & homeless drug usage. The foliage on the balcony was dead and what was suppose to pass for a couch was a broken hard cot. The bath tub and shower drain was rusted and the plug had hair on it and was filthy. The floor unit air conditioner was connected through a board in the window. When I arrived asked Ashley if I could park in the lot next to the building even though it said that if you weren’t a guest of the Quality Inn Hotel you’d be towed at your own expense. Ashley replied: has security seen you? I answered yes… he asked did he say anything, I said no and he replied, you should be alright then! When I finally got upstairs and surveyed the entire place and the view, I told him I couldn’t  stay. Then after he had previously informed there was no parking, mysteriously now I could use space 23 in the underground garage. The next morning I checked out!!!

I booked this Airbnb as a weekend away from home for my friend’s birthday. Andrew and Tiffany were very welcoming and happy to help when it came to the surprised. I picked their bnb in particular because of the bathtub and it did not disappoint. She had a very relaxing bath! If you are socially anxious like my friend, they were very inviting and are not the type to intrude on your plans or anything of the sort. Which was a concern I had since I’ve only been to bnbs where the place was all to yourself, but Andrew and Tiffany have definitely changed my mind. I don’t love the area since it can be a bit intimidating at night but it is conveniently close to public transit (Expo line Skytrain). Thank you Andrew and Tiffany!

Milo’s place was cute, nice size, but could feel a bit sketchy due to the location (to be expected in this part of Vancouver) making it a bit overpriced. Over all it was a good space but im worried there is mold or something in the vents as sleeping there gave me a terrible cough.. which went away immediately when staying in a hotel our last night. I have a mold allergy so it’s possible it’s that or something else. There were also only 2 old bath towels and they were small and thin so I’d bring extra, and get a bath rug as all the tile made it easy to slip. I also kept finding dark curly hairs in the bath / bathroom which was icky.
Milos was really nice but the place needs a better cleaner, to sort out the mold, and provided towels for what’s being charged. Also there was a pile of old towels/rags just left in the dryer we found last day. Not a great look.
