Upon check in, we discovered the kitchen sink was clogged. Although Milos arranged someone to fix it that same day, it wasn’t the best start. In addition, the bathroom sink stopper was jammed causing it to clog, but we used a fork to lift it open as directed. Overall, this made me initially question the cleanliness of the place.
Two days before check out, we ran out of hand soap in the bathroom. There wasn’t any extra to be found and Milos said he would arrange someone to provide some. But no one came. It was ridiculous that I needed to purchase my own hand soap. As we stayed 1 week, I recommend storing extra supplies moving forward to avoid this.
Overall, the place was as described and the location wasn’t the best (I.e., homelessness), but it was still safe and accessible to multiple places. Milos was very responsive as well. But for the price, these mishaps were quite disappointing.

it was my first time visiting Vancouver, so it’s possibly my fault for not checking the location but i do feel like they can make it more clear, the location is honestly so bad. i was a little disappointed because the amount i paid, i feel like it should’ve been somewhere at least decent. the street right next to it is like pure crackheads, very sketchy. we never were out past 10pm because we don’t want to risk anything. other than that, i would say the airbnb itself is nice.

Honest review here, couldn’t find this place because address was not accurate.
We don’t write the address that way.
When I click the address, it sent me to the other place.
I texted owner and he keeps saying check the PDF that I already read multiple times. I asked tell me the cross street, or stores near by.
But keep sending me the PDF file that he is asking for 5 stars review already.
He can easily explain “it is front of the Chinatown gate, across from Macdonald. We lost for 40 min.
Location is sketchy, not recommended to stay with kids. Many homeless, dirty street.
Inside is ok, smells fungus in dishwasher and laundry, bathroom sink was clogged couldn’t unplug, unable to use that sink for 5 days.
No extra trash bags.
Leaking from dishwasher bottom.
Convenient for walking distance to store and transport stations, and overall it is a decent Airbnb but overpriced for sure.

Wow, the check in process was absolutely abysmal. Marks instructions about there being a cutoff time for the check in was not clear at all. When my boyfriend and I arrived at the apartment it was 11:30 because we couldn’t find any parking for over an hour, didn’t have gps or cell service because it was international. In hindsight, we should’ve downloaded offline maps but we didn’t think of it. Even if we had offline maps, there is no Ramada parking like Mark says. There was no parking around at all, so we ended up parking our car in the suburbs and ubering in.
When we used the call box, no one picked up multiple times. If it wasn’t for a lady who happened to live on the fourth floor, we would’ve been stranded. We would’ve had to get a hotel for the night which is unacceptable. Mark never responded or reached out about the calls the next day. Horrible host, I’m sorry that is just so unacceptable to leave your guests stranded. Apparently this isn’t the first time this has happened.

The parking instructions were innaccurate and the area is difficult to park around, to the point where when we first arrived we had to drive around an hour and a half before we found a safe space to park overnight. The original instructions said to park at the hotel next to the building or the parking lot behind the building. The hotel next door does not allow non-hotel guests to park there, and the parking lot behind the building was more like a very sketchy, dirty alleyway. No one parked there in the entire time we stayed, so clearly it is not used for parking.
We ended up parking at a different hotel a 5 minute walk away for $42 dollars a night which sucked to have to do.
The apartment itself was fine and centrally located, but the air conditioner was just duct taped to the window, and that fell apart before we even got there, so we could not use the AC. It was sweltering hot in the apartment, we had to be out early every day to escape it.

Was told by Mark parking was available at the hotel next door, it was not. Had to go 5 blocks away and the neighborhood is unsafe to walk, especially at night. If I knew this, I would not have rented a car.
Could not get to the 4th floor without an elevator fob-had to carry our luggage on the stairs.
Was told by Mark there was air conditioning, but it was a portable unit with hoses running out the window, secured by duct tape. This prevented the blinds from being closed and the unit was so loud you could not hear the TV with it on.
Ended up leaving the unit for a different accommodation after one night as sleeping was impossible with the "air conditioner" running.
Very disappointed.

Overall, it’s clean and as described. They have basic stuffs for kitchen and bathroom. This location is great b/c T&T super market next to conner and just 2 minutes walk.Only things I dont like is bread baker and coffee machine is old and dirty. The way to garage room is a maze, too long to get there. If you want to throw your garbage on your last day check out, you should keep the key with you, there has 3-4 doors if I remembered correctly. Everything is okay. Hosts is nice.
Location is okay to walk to Canada Place , water clock and CF mall, but I am not recommend it. You should take China medium station near the building, it will save time and avoid homeless stresses. I don’t know the name of stress, we walked down from Chinatown gate to the end of road and we were impressed there so many homeless events they did not bother us but feel unsafe at night walking.

The location is downtown and very walkable to Costco, the soccer stadium, hockey arena, a large park, and more. However, downtown Vancouver has a visible homeless and drug-use population. There was yelling at night, though we were never bothered while walking around. The parking space was a major benefit.
The unit was okay—not exceptional, but acceptable. I would not recommend it for families with young children due to the layout and items that could easily be bumped into. There is no central air, which Carlos disclosed, and while a portable AC unit was provided, it was not enough on warmer nights.
The main issue was cleanliness. The apartment was not cleaned to Airbnb standards. We found hair throughout the unit, stains on the linens, food left in the refrigerator, residue in the dishwasher, and floors that appeared only partially cleaned. Carlos was very responsive and offered to send a cleaner, whicappreciated, but it would have been inconvenient to move our belongings.

We had a great stay! The place was very comfortable. The check in is a little complicated but once we were in it was easy. We did really like the neighborhood - it gets sketchy a few blocks away, so you have to be mindful of which way you go, but we didn't ever feel unsafe, and it is awesome to have so many restaurants, bars and coffee shops within easy walking distance. We would definitely stay there again!

I’ll caveat the review with saying that we were a family of 3 (with a 6 year old child) and the apartment was definitely more meant for solo travelers and maybe a couple.
There is absolutely no storage. We had to use the tiny kitchen island as a vanity, and the stove top at a mini pantry. We couldn’t unpack our luggage as there wasn’t anywhere to put our things. There was a faux-leather chest for linen but we couldn’t put our stuff on it as the plastic was peeling and sticking to everything.
There were also cords running everywhere and the windows are not secured so we had to constantly tell our kid to stay away from the windows. The stairs, which looked great, were also a trip hazard (not great, when you’re going to the bathroom at night). The futon, once we figure out how to open it, was rock hard and frankly, not suitable for sleep. The upstairs bed however was fine. The apartment needed a good dusting and we had to wash the towels before use due to musty smell. Host was responsive

Not luxury at all. The place smelled of pet urine
It was dirty. Dirty bathroom, dirty sheets. Found hair on the sheets, dirty kitchen. Chewed gum on coffee table. Hair dryer had hair. You could hear the neighbors talking and leaving. The room had no window as it was covered up by stuff for a make shift cooling system. You could hear the people outside talking. He had us go to back of the building to get a key and then told me to act like a belong there. indicating that clearly he isn't supposed to be having an Airbnb. Don't waste your money stay somewhere else.

I had an issue opening the front door, and when i reached out I was sent straight to voicemail. it ended up being a very sticky door needing a bit of force to open. I chose this place because the reviews alll talked about how clean and quiet it was. Although very quiet, it really was not clean. I was in vancouver for an exam and thought maybe I would relax in the bath but changed my mind when I felt all of tub scum in the bottom and  pink mildew in the shower door tracks. it was also very, very dusty on surfaces and baseboards and door paneling and being a mostly white suite, there was quite the collection of very visible dirty finger prints on all of the doors and cabinets. For such a small place with such a high cleaning price I was hopeful that it would be clean.

The pictures are very misleading. They put a picture of the house featuring the main entrance but it’s actually half of a basement. They could have totally put a picture of the actual entrance instead of the front.
They say it’s for 5+ people when it’s actually 4. The couch (not sure if it’s a pull out couch because there is literally no place to pull it out to) is very uncomfortable.
The location is not convenient, it’s a residential area.
Overall thought it was quite misleading

Check in was the only easy part of our stay. We checked in and found some hair while my son (1 year old) was playing on his toys- stuff happens, we moved on. The next morning we looked around further and were disgusted. The clumps of hair I found were horrible, the bathroom was so dirty (brown water sitting in the bottom of the shower). My son had a clump of someone’s hair in his hands and was playing with it. I spent 30 minutes cleaning to try and make us more comfortable before my husband found ant poison outside in the green space and at front door where my son was playing. We immediately reached out to the host and Airbnb and said we are not staying any longer. It took several days to hear from the host, and airbnb was not much help. We ended up paying out of pocket for a hotel and all around a horrible experience. Host was unresponsive until asking us to cancel the reservation so she could accept new reservations. No care at all for our horrible experience. If i could add pictures

The house had garbage (empty cups, crumbled paper) at the front of the house and the suite door was at the back. By the entry door was an ashtray full of old cigarette butts. Although I could say the place was clean, and offered value, it’s an older building and we could smell mould upon entry which was tough for my husband who has asthma. The walls are quite thin also. That said, it was an extremely peaceful area and we could hardly hear the owners. I would have appreciated some communication but there was no checkin communication to see if we needed anything nor response to our checkout message. I wouldn’t recommend this place but if you’re in a jam, it’s safe and clean.

Very disappointing stay!!! The listing did not accurately represent the property, and there were not enough photos. The house was much smaller than expected. It had a terrible odor from the moment we arrived. We even bought air fresheners, but nothing helped. Two bedroom windows would not open. The floors and closets were dirty. The kitchen was poorly equipped with burned, warped pans, only two dull knives, and not enough dishes or utensils. We had to buy dishes, a sharp knife, salt, and extra garbage bags just to cook and store food during our 5-day stay. One towel per guest was not enough. The beds were hard, squeaky, and uncomfortable, causing back pain, and there was almost no sound insulation. Some chairs felt unsafe for children. The only positives were the quiet neighborhood and easy check-in/check-out. This property is seriously overpriced and not worth what we paid. We would not recommend it.

Terrible experience with this listing. First house number given was the main house and the suite had a separate number so a bit confusing. It was dark and raining and you couldn’t see the house number because the house lights were not on. The door to the suite was unlocked when we got there (says something about security but host said they can track door opening and closing so assured no one had been inside). Going into the suite there was a strong smell of smoke (but non-smoking listing), and we found a random drug pill (could be narcotic?) and a bunch of fentanyl urine test kits. Garbage bag was not cleaned out. Pull out bed was dirty and the bed slats fell apart on the top pull out bed preventing bottom from sliding back in. Closed bedroom door in bottom and was then unable to open it, evidently something in the door knob jammed and had to contact host who sent someone to come dismantle door. Security and safety issue if someone trapped inside (imagine a kid stuck!) Stay elsewhere!

Generally, the location and the suite arrangements are great. But since it’s by the knight street, it’s a bit noisy. And  the checkout rules is frustrating. The terms show 11 am. But at last day, the janitor came in at 9 am. And the host asked me to get my friend out at 9 am while I didn’t get any notice in advance, which is rude and disappointing. But at last, the host apologized via the app chat. That’s why I deducted a star.

The apartment is beautiful and in a great location. The host was very responsive of any questions and concerns we had. Parking was very secure and directions for check in/out were very easy to follow.
The problems we had when entering the apartment:
- A very strong smell when entering the apartment. It smelled like a dirty wet carpet, but once the apartment was aired out it mostly went away. We had to keep the windows open the entire time.
- The pull out sofa bed was broken
- The bathroom had no hand soap and there were no refill bottles or a starter amount, we had to go out and buy a bottle from the drug store across the street.
- The floors were swept, so there were no crumbs or hair, but the bottoms of my slippers and my bare feet turned black from dirty.
I let the host know about the above problems, he was apologetic and did state he will get these issues address for the next guest.

Noisy condo, checkin and checkout complicated, no indications on anything.
Good points: owner responded fast, well located in Vancouver, enough place for 2, high speed internet wifi, a parking lot.
I think we were the first airbnb customer on this condo, so this could be the reassign why our experience was not that good. We didn’t received any infos about the parking address, so we got a ticket fine of 80$. After discussing with the owner, she agreed to fully refund it, but changed her mind 2 messages later.
After contacting airbnb, she finally agreed to refund the full amount, because we never received any infos about the parking lot, except for a picture, without any instructions and any address.
Checkin was complicated. It was supposed to be a self checkin, but the key were in the condo, and we never got any fob to open the door building and to go in the elevator. We should have wait for people to open the door for us, and to scan the fob in the elevator for us. We never received the floor number, so we were kind of stuck once again in the elevator waiting for the owner to respond our calls and messages…
FYI: The level floor is PH
We never received the door code until being in front of it, checkin lasted approx. 35min… so long so for a place were it was supposed to be self checkin.
The condo was not that clean, bedsheets were ok, but floor, kitchen, and mirrors were not as clean as excepted for the price we paid.
We didn’t have any towels for the shower, but the owner brought us towels 2 hours after checkin.
The flat is located at level 13 (PH) but it was soooo noisy! We didn’t had a good sleep at all for the 4 nights we stayed there. So stressful, we could have hear the police and people screaming in the street. Lot of constructions noise behind the building too. Windows are not sound proofed.
We come 2 a year in Vancouver, and the overall experience for the price we paid was not a success, we wont choose this place when we come back.

A 5-star apartment, but a very poor checkin experience let Randy down. Checkin instructions were missing and after 3 hours waiting we were then given access to an occupied apartment. Then rather than checking that we were in and settled in the second apartment, Randy started complaining to me about the Airbnb app. Randy offered no apology for being unresponsive or for sending us to an occupied apartment. We were offer a full refund (we got 70% back).
In all a great apartment, but the host lacks consideration for guest's experience.

A great location for exploring Vancouver and i think generally places are expensive here to rent, but this place was a little bit run down - e g the slats on the bed broke almost every time i sat on it (I'm not particularly heavy!) but the second bedroom was what made the place not ideal for us because it was hot in there and the blinds were terrible so made putting the kids to bed extra tricky. Also the lifts were a nightmare for us and we very nearly missed our transfer because it took us 30 minutes to get out the building with our suitcases. Ed was super responsive and helpful though and I think for a couple it would be great. We loved the swimming pool.

Matthew apartment is impressevely amazing, I was not expecting so much care and confort. When you enter the apartment you get impressed with the natural light and the smart way the studio is divided. Matthew is a great host, he does a lot of details on the apartment that shows how much he care to provide you an amazing time. There´s absolutely nothing bad there, all perfect. The area is very central, is close to all the most amazing parts of Vancouver. It´s located close to an area that has some issues now, but I haven´t felt unsafe. Of course if you´re a woman alone, I would recomend to use uber to move around after 21h/22h, but during the day is very calm and I haven´t felt unsafe.

Least good value of all our AirBnB stays. Find another option. Place is dirty and SO MANY things are non-functional or broken. 
Mattresses terrible. Pillows are the super cheap. En suite shower is unusable and everyone used the shower in the second bathroom. No good places to put luggage or clothes. 
No one wanted to sit on the come-covered couch which fits three small people. TV connected to nothing. Rug filthy. So living room unusable.
Bathroom rugs not washed. Both toilets don't flush right. TP falls off holders. Set dryer to a short cycle and it was still going three hours later bc knob is broken. Several lights were out. Clock has dead battery. Hanging light so low you'll hit your head lots. Blinds broken. Closet doors need maintenance. Plastic dining chairs are uncomfortable. 
Kitchen not at all well appointed.
Parking spot is SUPER SMALL.
Host was very responsive, friendly. If the owners spent some money, this place could be nice. As it is, your vacation is not as nice.

The guest room is smelly of cigarettes when we come in.
The lock of the guest room and the bathroom were both broken.
While the condition is below our expectations, we also had an unpleasant communication experience with the host.
(The host texted a handyman will arrive in 15 mins to fix the lock once we reach out. However, we ended up having to wait for 40 mins with our luggages - given that we paid extra 20 dollars to check in early just so we can leave early, this is unacceptable to us. We decided to change place during the wait and left the room untouched. However, once we request a refund from Cora, she refused and then stopped replying our messages. We ended up having to ask airbnb to adjudicate the disputes which adds additional stress and take much time away from our trip)

On our 2nd day of a 1wk stay, we found a significant amount of mouse droppings when we opened a kitchen cabinet. We called host and asked for a refund for remaining days so we could stay elsewhere.  Host said no and would have a pest control service come in the next day. However this very unprofessional service disposed of the droppings in the kitchen trash, visible right on top and left them there. According to the CDC they should not be just swept/vacummed as that aerolizes and releases the mouse viruses into the air, increasing exposure/risk. CDC says they should be put in a sealed bag and immediately removed from the house. I am immunocompromised so this was a serious health hazard for me and my family. As a result we didn't cook or use the kitchen during our stay.  I do not recommend staying at Aaron's place because of the serious health hazard, not corrected, and made worse by how it was handled. Will provide pictures if able to attach.
Had a bad smell as soon as I came in, bedsheets was wet, stains on the floor, dirty and low maintenance. Don’t recommend it!!!

Beautiful property in a quiet neighbourhood. The interiors were spectacular. However, the hot tub was really unhygienic and unclean. Couldn’t get inside the hot tub because of how dirty it was. Apart from that, the host was very responsive, the property and beddings inside were clean and all the utensils were provided and easily accessible.

Centrally located large appartment with good potential for a great stay.
All comforts are there. Shower is decent and bed is good. Kitchen is well equipped and there is a washer dryer available.
Communication with Elise was smooth and she gave us great tips for things to do in the city.
That being said, cleanliness was sub par! By far! The place really needs a thorough scrub. Most surfaces you touch were not clean or very dusty/mucky. Looks like it was not cleaned properly after having recently been renovated.
The balcony overlooks a back alley parking lot where drug dealers and junkies go about their daily business. Unfortunately this might be the case in other areas of center Vancouver.

**** DO NOT BOOK ****
Listing misrepresented, host was abusive on the phone
We booked this apartment for a two-week stay in Vancouver. Red flags appeared before we even checked in: the host, Douglas, didn’t respond to our pre-booking questions. We went ahead anyway since the location and listing details seemed to match what we needed.
The apartment did not match the photos. We arrived to a dirty unit with mould, spider webs, and a couch that looked like it had been picked up off the street.
We called the host to try to resolve this — this wasn’t a minor issue, it was false advertising, so a partial refund wasn’t going to cut it. Instead of helping, Douglas swore at us and hung up.
We contacted Airbnb support directly, got a full refund, and used the money to stay at a 5-star hotel in downtown Vancouver instead — for the same price.
Avoid this listing.

Mick accommodated our request for an early check in and late checkout. They also provided local recommendations for us, and even left a welcome note and free drinks in light of the timing of our stay (Cinco de Mayo). The apartment was very tidy, with plenty of clean towels. The location makes downtown highly accessible by walking.
Check in is made difficult by lots of traffic and minimal street parking. Once checked in, parking is a nightmare. The parking garage is a labyrinth and the instructions provided for navigating it overlooked several key details and were overly wordy, and thus confusing.
Traffic and the adjacent light rail are very noisy. Earplugs are provided, which is good because you will need them to sleep.
The area is very sketchy at night. I was lucky enough to be with my partner, but we actually walked a local to the bus stop from a nearby bar because they didn’t feel safe.
As someone with ADHD, the constant loud noises and amount of instructions were overwhelming.

This is a tough review. Perfect spot for 2 people near gas town. Building was safe and secure. Apartment was cool and funky in its design but keep in mind that the shower is totally open to the rest of the space so you better be comfortable with your travel partner! One thing to note ( that was disclosed and was in other reviews) this apartment is literally one block from the worst skid row I’ve ever seen. I never felt unsafe and it is in a relatively concentrated area. If it will make you uncomfortable to see open and active hard drug  use this may not be a good fit. While you can try to “go around it” you still end up passing it 2-3 times a day just as you are touring around. Like I said, tough review because while I was totally satisfied with the space, I explored Vancouver a lot and just would not be willing to stay in this exact area again.

We have had so many positive stays in Airbnb that we were due for a bad one. This was it!
Arrived-area has a large homeless population likely from the drug crisis- we felt sad but safe. The elevator had constant marijuana odours. The inflatable hot tub hooked up by their “handyman” was not hot and the host said a breaker had blown and assured us it would get hot-it never got hot. The windows were dirty and the washing machine mouldy and musty. We turned on the fireplace it blew out the power to the internet, master bedroom, hot tub and fireplace all remained without power the duration of the stay. The host wanted us to go into the electrical box flick it back on but due to our fire concerns(circuit breakers save lives)we said we didn’t feel comfortable- he did not send anyone. The host became increasingly verbally not nice-consider this when booking if your not thick skinned.
Positive-The host did change the stay to 1 night so we booked a 5 star hotel and loved Vancouver!

We had a very disappointing experience at this property. The elevator was broken during our entire stay, meaning we had to climb six flights of stairs every time we came and went. To make matters worse, the only accessible entrance was through the fire stairwell, requiring a special key to enter the hallway. The host never provided this key, so we had to call the building’s security guard every single time we needed access to our own room.

When I reached out to the host, I initially received only automated responses unrelated to our problem. The following day I got a direct reply, but instead of providing a solution, they insisted there should have been a “gold key” which wasn’t there.
While I understand the elevator issue may not have been the host’s fault, not having a backup key on hand for guests is unacceptable. This situation severely impacted our trip, as we booked this condo for its location and expected the freedom to come and go easily to explore. Airbnb offered 30% off.

There was some significant quality/cleanliness issues with the property. Many walls were visibly dirty and damaged, as well as a terrible leak developed from the ceiling of the main floor beside the kitchen.
May was responsive regarding a refund, however the place is not ideal for cleanliness. Great for the price if you are on a budget, but you get what you pay for.

It is a shame because the size and the view are both great. This could easily be a 10-star stay if it were properly maintained, but the lack of basic hygiene made it impossible to enjoy.
​The Reality of the Stay:
​Severe Filth: We arrived to a filthy home and spent over 4 hours cleaning it ourselves. Every wall was stained and smudged with grime, the kitchen walls were coated in thick yellow grease, and the floors were incredibly sticky.
​Sanitation & Pests: All provided dishes and cups were dirty, and there were bugs and insects throughout the property.
​Maintenance Issues: Despite being described as "luxury," the furniture and beds are scratched and broken. The exterior doors do not seal properly, which is a major comfort and security. To make matters worse, the host had the audacity to request an additional $70 cleaning fee after we checked out, despite the state of the home upon our arrival.

The sink in the bathroom was wet and had stains. The towels were hung up and not folded like they were left over from the last person. Seemed as if the place was not cleaned in between guests. The floor was dusty and dirty and there was hair everywhere. Place had a lot of potential however it was clear that the apartment had not been thoroughly cleaned i between guests.

I was very disappointed with my stay at this Airbnb. 1st of all, an AirBnB should have a B (BED). There was no mattress on the bed, a Box spring is unacceptable to use as a bed. By 3 AM we could no longer sleep on the very uncomfortable box spring and had to leave due to it hurting my friend's hip so badly. Also, it was not cleaned properly. There were hairs in the sink, soap scum build up in the tub and the carpeting was not vacuumed. I truly believe a refund is in order.
This was very sad as it looked SO cute in the pics and seemed like a great deal.I will say, the neighborhood was lovely and safe and the water pressure on the shower was good, although it felt weird taking a shower in a dirty tub.

This was a very unideal Airbnb experience.
Check in was easy to follow and flexible. Upon arriving to the Airbnb, the cleanliness of the apartment was horrendous. The bed was perfectly made, but the sheets had clearly not been changed as they were dirty and covered in hair from previous guests. The kitchen table and chairs were covered in crumbs, the floors were full of dirt and debris, the sink looked as though it had not been cleaned in a very long time. The shower curtain was MOLDY. The counter in the bathroom was covered with what looked to be facial hair. We attempted to eat our food, and pulled out cutlery from the drawer that was filthy and had stuck on food on them.
Upon notifying Leon, he refunded us half of our stay, plus the cleaning supplies and extra blanket we needed in order to feel semi comfortable staying in this unit. This was very much appreciated, although the state of the unit is absolutely unacceptable.

TERRIBLE. DO NOT STAY HERE.
Booked and got a discount for being one of the first to book, after booking and receiving the exact address found out this host has been renting rooms on her property for years and had the WORST reviews... one recently claiming "fraudulent practice" and "lying landlords". Think -Horror Airbnb- and this is it! Anything that could go wrong did. It's not difficult to clean and maintain a property properly yet Yuns whole place was falling apart with no care at all. Yun lied to us saying she had taken over the care of her listing from relatives and that it had improved and wasn't what the reviews claimed, LIE LIE LIE.
From dead bugs, snots and pee in the bed, boarded up windows, rubbish(from dog bowels, masks, dirty laundry) all under and behind the bed as well as in-between any gaps of the wardrobe, dust on everything, mould, huge cracks in the ceiling, broken kettle, dirty fridge, not supplying a microwave, mystery rubbish bags on the shelves, dirty sock on the shelf, burnt out sockets... the list goes on. We even heard scratching in the walls... potentially mice.
It's such a pity because the property has the potential to be great but they do not care for it AT ALL. Yun does not know how to run a short/long term rental business.

It was a beautiful stay, the house was big enough, the rooms were good & the beds were comfortable.
Once we arrived there we noticed that there were people living in the basement at the same home, we didn’t know about that before coming which made us feel a bit of unsafe, but I directly contacted Charanpreet & he told me that the people in the basement are his friends, and they have a private entrance, we will not meet them at the same place at all, & he told me that it’s 100% safe no need to worry. He was right in everything he said, we never felt anything about them & they were great people.
The house was clean enough, not 100% because there was some dust in some places & some unclean stuff in the kitchen, I think it could be better easily..
but the most important the beds, sheets & bathrooms were fully clean & comfortable to use
I recommend this place so much
I would definitely come again if I visit Vancouver, especially because everything important you need is close to the home.

Cannot recommend this trendy, cozy, and comfy airbnb!
Susan coordinated a 5 hours early check in for me which was SO appreciated!! Thanks again
Place is stuffed with AMAZING art, on op of the stunning harbour and ocean view. Cannot recommend this place enough!
Note the bed is super comfy but is very low. Maybe 4 inches off the ground.
Can’t recommend enough!

Carmen’s place was nice and easily accessible to public transport which was nice. The only complaint I have is the lack of cleanliness: it was very dusty, with multiple stains on the bed sheets, comforter and bathroom. There was also a very strong scent we couldn’t get rid of no matter how long the windows were open or how much air freshener we spray. Though Carmen was accommodating and responded to many issues I just felt unclean and gross the whole trip because of this and didn’t feel like I could even use the dishes without washing them first due to the uncleanliness we found from the start. Hopefully she finds another cleaning staff that will actually clean properly.
Reasonable place, but host was kind of rude (-1 star), and kitchen is not equipped at all - e.g. only 2 coffee mugs - so you’d have to wash them every morning. (-1 more)

The apartment was great! Clean, close to a lot of restaurants and coffee. Luis was a great host.
Only downside is that it’s located in a bit of a sketchy neighborhood(lot of homeless folks, dirty, etc), but doesn’t feel dangerous. And you should know that already if you’re looking in the area, so not a surprise :)
Would definitely stay again.

Firstly, the home itself was well-decorated, clean and comfortable.
The AC unit was unusable. We left it running on the highest setting for 5 hours and returned to find that the temperature had barely gone down at all. It was uncomfortable and sweaty to be inside and would’ve been impossible to sleep in.
Our main concern was the area surrounding the home, which is of course out of the owner’s control. Regardless, it’s an elemental part of the experience of the stay and important to be aware of before booking.
The entrance into the building was smelly and fly infested (I found a fly in my waistband). A huge rat was climbing up the vines surrounding the home and nearly fell on us moments before I ran away.
The area is known to be the worst of Vancouver. I was followed to the building gate entrance and a disoriented man rattled it and said some nasty sexual comments to me. I was scared the gate hadn’t locked behind me.
We left on day one after the AC issue, rat and drug addict.

We parked in a nearby lot with security and someone still broke our window. When we arrived there were multiple blood stains on the duvet and when we returned from dinner we saw a rat scurry across the floor. Very loud area with lots of yelling and screaming into the night. We saw human feces on the street right around the block as well as trash all down the alley behind the building. There was a hole in the concrete stairs large enough to see through to the floor below which felt unsafe as well as the hardwood floors being in rough shape. My partner got a splinter in their foot. We needed a place for one night at the last minute and this place was available, I wouldn't recommend it and it was overpriced compared to others in much nicer neighborhoods in the area.

The space worked for what it was needed for, looks like it's photos and was overall decent. Would not recommend for a late night check in, it was hard to find in the dark, and the streets were chaotic, very loud and a little sketchy. There were at least 100 people on the sidewalk just below the window outside the place across the street. Loud music playing, laughing, talking and yelling. Police sirens going off, lots of homeless in the area, including someone sitting with all their things laid out in front of the doorway so it was difficult to get in. It was better during the day, so daytime check in would be recommended.
The partying going on outside was very loud in the apartment making it hard to sleep until about 5am. I only stayed one night though, on a Saturday, so perhaps it's that's not common.
Overall the space was pleasant and nice inside, a standard city apartment.
The host was very responsive and helpful.

For over $500 a night, this is not a safe or clean place. The noise from the street did not stop until 5am (when the police arrived and removed the issue outside). Seems like a very unsafe area. The air conditioning unit has a mould smell when used which is dangerous for health. Very disappointed in our one night stay.

What a gem! This place was super cute and full of personality. The bed was incredibly comfortable, the bathroom was lovely, and the balcony was such a nice touch. Having laundry on-site was amazing, especially since we'd spent the previous days backpacking in the Olympics with a serious pile of dirty gear.
The decor and vibe were so welcoming and chic. Carly clearly has wonderful taste, and it shows in every corner.
Some guests might notice the surrounding Chinatown area has a visible unhoused community, but we never felt unsafe or bothered. It really wasn't any worse than any other large city, and the location can't be beat. You're steps from incredible food (Phnom Penh Restaurant is right around the corner!), charming vintage stores, and great coffee shops, plus a quick trip to the Science Museum.
Carly was super gracious, and we truly hope to be back soon. Thank you for such a memorable visit!

Anita’s has a nice space that is fairly well located within the city. The duplex is updated and roomy.
The bathrooms were nice but one was noticeably dirty on check-in, with hair in the sink and tub.
The kitchen was a good size but didn’t have any paper towels. It was also dirty on check-in with cat prints all over the range top.
The floor was also pretty dusty and our socks got pretty covered in dust and cat hair walking around.
The king bed was nice. The second bedroom had one twin bed and one twin mattress just on the ground, which created a bit of an argument with our daughters.
The part-time resident cat snuck in the door the first night and we felt kind of bad kicking her back out, but we weren’t sure what else to do.
The duplex neighbor runs an in-home daycare. It didn’t cause any problems or noise, but there was some car traffic in the mornings (and presumably afternoons).
All in all, it was an ok stay.

Avoid this place at all cost. We had a six day stay booked, and had to leave after one night. The place was dilapidated and a complete bamboozle compared to the photos. There were hairs on the bath towels, and much of the furniture, floor and ceiling, and other stuff was literally coming apart. The best part was that when we wrote to Sea to Sky, they told us these issues had been there for 15 years and 8 years. There scam is to immediately pressure guests into leaving a 5 star review so as to artificially inflate their rating and bamboozle future guests. After leaving after the first night, we found another AirBnb that wasn’t even as much money, and literally felt like the Ritz Carlton after the Motel 6. I hope no one has to go through this type of experience in the future, and you avoid this listing at all cost.

Reality check.  Not a newly renovated condo with private entrance-a misrepresentation and a shock upon arrival.  An old house divided into apartments which has little sound proofing (because it’s an old wooden house) and smells of old musty wooden house (and drugs because young people living there).  Sadly the property was very run down, sofa and coffee table nearly broken, walls dirty and candle soot stained, bedding nasty, thin and bobbled (mattress comfy though)-borrowed bedding from family members.  Bathroom vanity doors completely water blown (shower great though). Badly lit with intense bright white LEDs  (think Police station interview room) Stayed for a month - didn’t move because my focus was on visiting elderly family members and I just had to get on with things.  Best suited for university students, no one else…Communication was excellent though and very polite.

Booked for 3 nights, left after 1 night.

Hair in the shower drain that didn't let the water out, sofa bed mattress with a huge yellow stain and so thin my 12 year old who weights 42 kilos felt the metal box spring, found a chip and a giant soda paper cup below the sofa bed when opening the bed. The electric kitchen was dirty with dry grease.

Bathroom: the toilet lid was a little cracked and stained/dirty, one light bulb was out.

Went to a supermarket 400 meters from the house, crossed more than 20 junkies drugged off their minds as I've never seen anybody drugged, not even in music festivals.

On top of that, when proposing a solution (to clean while we were in a day trip to Victoria) the hosts had long stopped answering my requests/comments, and told Airbnb they wouldn't fix it.

Impossible not to hear the air train. It starts operating at 5 AM.

Parking place ok. Fitted a van.
Check-in procedure lacks detailed definition. Confusing.
Not superhost material.

Jenny is an amazing host who made it easy for us to find her place and check in. When we asked for chairs and a coffee table she made sure to have them set up and available before our arrival.
Unfortunately, the walls and doors were dirty and badly marked, the kitchen is fairly well stocked but this is not a gourmet kitchen in any way. Also, there was one single hand towel, not enough for three people and our visitors.
I feel that given there is a hefty cleaning fee, it is inappropriate to ask guests to collect the garbage and put the towels in the laundry. I am a host and do not ask my guests to do the housekeeping, I charge a fee and hire cleaning staff.
The area of the vacation unit is seemingly in transition and I would not recommend an evening stroll, I would call it light industrial at this time.
All things considered and given we know Vancouver well, this unit served our needs reasonably well and Jenny was outstanding!

There were some weird stains on the walls and some spider webs on the ceiling and a bit dusty. The shower curtain was very dirty and moldy. As well as the ceiling in the bathroom. Location was great and easy to go around

It was a little bit misleading when the ad says you have the whole house to yourself- a better statement would have been you have the unit to yourself. There was no living room, and for 4 people it was very very cramped, it was almost impossible to have more than 2 people in the kitchen/dining area, and the only other option was to stay in your room. The toothbrushes and toothpaste in the bathroom was a lovely touch, and nice to have some snacks and bubbly’s on the table as well. Thank you. The bed in one of the bedrooms was terrible uncomfortable, it felt like you were sleeping on a piece of wood with a small foamy on top, and the bed was slanted so you felt the blood rush to your head while you sleep.
The location was good, close to the sky train, communication with the hosts was good, and we were allowed to check in early which was nice.
I think it’s suited for 2 people but not 4 comfortably.

I was very upset with all the velour bedding , horribly uncomfortable beds , flat pillows ! Musty attic smell dark smelly closets !
The velour pillows were stained !
Did not meet acceptable expectations, not what I have been accustomed to with air B&B !
The place needs airing out , a dehumidifier, new beds proper duvets with washed clean covers etc ! Paint closets … Basics !

This is a great location to anyone wanting to live close to downtown with access to great restaurants. The floor was dirty and greasy when we arrived and the stove was not cleaned. There was a leak from the ceiling that the host tried to have fixed while we were not on the house with our valuables left in the open.

The listing is inaccurate, it says it's "one of the few places in the area with free parking" but when we inquired we were told that the gate was not working so we had to park in the street. Inside you'll find that the place is well maintained, the hallway has a big area with paint peeling off,  there's 3 burntout lights, floating shelves in the living room are almost falling off. The couch is very dirty, my sons toy went fell in between the couch seat and when we removed the seat that's when we saw how dirty it was. There was a lighter, a pair of socks, candy wrapper and a lot of crumbs. Lighting in the living room is warm yellow so it's hard to notice how dirty the couch cover is but if you look closely you see that it hasnt been washed in a while. Lastly, after checkout, we were messaged by the host about 2 towels missing, and  charged us $15 for it, we just paid it to avoid the hassle, it was quite a disappointing stay, we hope the next person doesnt have the same experience

Overall the place is great and has 4 rooms and 2 bathrooms. The kitchen has everything you need. Very closed to the airport, it will be less than 15 minutes with good traffic. The only thing I would complain is the floors are quite dirty, and they don’t provide indoor slippers, so I don’t recommend walking around the house with your bare feet or socks. The washing machine was also leaking. I would come back if I have a big group visiting Vancouver again, but next time hopefully they provide slippers.

My daughter and I had a wonderful stay in Colin’s home. The best parts were the stunning views of the water and the mountains. We enjoyed watching the ships sailing by and the birds flying right in front of the windows. The home was extremely clean and well appointed with enough kitchen supplies to prepare meals. The beds were comfortable and the living room furniture was brand new. The building is very safe and secure and we felt very comfortable during the stay. There is a sketchy part of town to the west and don’t recommend walking through there. But this is part of being in a big city and can be avoided if that makes you uncomfortable. The immediate neighborhood and to the east and south is safely walkable and has cafes, restaurants and grocery stores all in easy walking distance. We stayed for 2 weeks, and I would have loved to stay longer. Colin is a very responsive host and I highly recommend Colin’s home and will stay there again when I next visit my daughter in Vancouver.

Great place to stay if you’re in town for a short visit or here for the sports. Rebecca is amazing! Couldn’t have asked for a better host. The only concern is the neighborhood. We didn’t realize that downtown Vancouver was as dirty and possibly unsafe as we found it. Good to know for future visits.

Fobkey moved. Host unresponsive. Left in rental car looking for a new  place to stay on day 1. AirBnB support called to help resolve problem.  Next day host contacted with apology and offer to checkin; but already inconvenienced and paid hotel in full. Unclear if AirBnB apartment was safe or clean to enter. AirBnB gave full refund. What a terrible experience!! Never again will book with this host.

The location is great! Walkable to Gastown and cruise terminals. Lots of coffee shops and restaurants. There is a grocery store across the street and Costco is around the corner.
There were four of us (all adults) staying there, and while it will sleep six, we were a little cramped with the four of us. Really not a lot of comfortable places to sit in the living area.
Per the description, there is no AC, but each room has a fan. Luckily we were out all day and the fans did an adequate job for sleeping.
The only thing that we found unacceptable were the rugs in the bathroom. They were old and worn and appeared dirty. I doubt that they were dirty, as the condo was very clean, but they looked terrible.
The parking garage is like a maze, but Samantha's directions were spot on and we made it to the assigned parking space with no problem.
Overall, I think the condo is a good value and the location and parking space make for a nice place to stay in Vancouver.

I don’t usually write negative reviews, but I feel it’s important to share that although Samantha’s place looked great in the photos, our stay was disappointing. It was a warm summer day (~78°F), and without air conditioning—and with direct sun streaming in—the apartment became uncomfortably hot, even with the fan running. The fans that they have are really ineffective. My infant and toddler struggled, and when I mentioned our discomfort, the suggestion to “go cool off at the pool at 8 pm” wasn’t helpful. Additionally, the unit was quite dirty upon arrival, so my husband ended up vacuuming and mopping throughout our stay to feel comfortable. There’s heavy diffusers everywhere to mask up the smell and it really gave us bad headache all trip long. Lastly, the queen bed in the small room was broken in two places. It’s a lovely location in a building I usually enjoy, but this specific unit needs better climate control, cleanliness, and maintenance before I could feel good recommending it.

Our arrival flight was delayed and we notified Vivian as soon as we could. When we arrived at 11:30pm she did not respond. Although some residents let us into the lobby, due to the buzzer system we could not get upstairs without her. Security was not helpful at all. AirBNB support also attempted to contact Vivian multiple times, then found us alternative lodging for the night after ~ 1.5 hours.
The following morning Vivian was extremely apologetic and explained that she had missed all of the messages/calls due to illness. She issued us a partial refund and was very responsive throughout the rest of the stay. After the initial incident I do believe she handled things as well as she could have. Based on other reviews it seems like this was an outlier hopefully one-time occurrence.
The space itself was clean and matched the advertised photos. There are many homeless individuals nearby outside but we never felt threatened/unsafe. Parking was tight for our SUV rental but good to have

Though Ryan was kind and responsive, we left his spot after one of two booked nights. We rented the place listed as an entire home, which it is not. This is a shared space that sounds like it flip flops between being listed as a room vs entire home.
My unfortunate luck of coming to Vancouver for the same weekend as Taylor Swift meant I rented this place listed as private (when it was not) for over $2000.
Ryan said he’d stay away after I complained but I still felt deceived and rather vulnerable so I packed up my family and left. No refund yet as airbnb is still “investigating” days later.
Nice house but it’s definitely lived in by the host.

I found out later it was a 113 year old historic house. It was in desperate need of repair it smelt very damp and musty couldn’t use the basement as was so bad . We were meant to have 8 guests staying but due to not being able to sleep in basement 2 people couldn’t stay fridge full of half used out of date items curtains didn’t fit windows sunroom was disgusting and old threadbare sofa with the sponge interior showing through was unusable.
Exterior garden furniture also unusable as very badly stained you wouldn’t want to sit on it . That is just some of the problems I had . I would never stay there again and I believe we were the last guests as host has taken it off of short term let and I am not surprised it needs a complete refurbishment

Host was hospitable and kind - just not very responsive. I asked for a refund in my 2nd night due to the noise but this request was not resolved
Place was not clean - floors were sticky
Place was way too hot
Long term guest (students) were not sensitive to other guest - were frequently loud outside of their rooms and closed doors extremely loudly at all hours.
As a result this was not a restful stay -

Never stay here especially if you have kids. Two of our family members arrived first and noticed the floor was very dirty they had to sweep and vacuum for nearly and hour after a 4-hour drive. While they were cleaning they found medical capsules on the floor!!! It wasn’t just one either, there were quite a few! There were also a lot beer bottles on the patio - it seemed like the previous guests had had quite the party. We had to watch our son very closely while our stay. It’s very obvious that they didn’t do a good job cleaning the place. Leaving something like medical capsules on the floor is unacceptable! We saw a lot of spider webs on the second floor and there’s no shower curtain so after you took a shower the floor was all wet and very slippery. The floor on the first floor is also very slippery even with just a little moist my son actually slipped when he went in to brush his teeth. For me it’s not a safe place to stay for many reasons.

The home had some nice features, especially the three bathrooms, but overall our experience was average. The cleanliness was disappointing, with dirty fingerprints throughout the kitchen and dirty bowls left in the sink when we arrived. We were also surprised that guests are required to remove their shoes and wear the host's slippers. With two young children, this was difficult, and had we known beforehand, we likely would have booked elsewhere. There were also no top sheets on the beds, so guests sleep directly under the comforters, which didn't feel very sanitary. Finally, parking is street parking only, and we ended up parking about a block away because the street was full. Overall, there were too many inconveniences for us to rate it higher.

Only used the place for sleeping while passing through Vancouver. It worked okay, but the place was not clean. I don’t tend to leave negative reviews, but I feel like I have to for this. The bedroom was dusty and full of clutter, it felt like I was staying in someone’s room, the closet had someone’s clothes and other personal items were all over the room. The sheets were clean, but looked pretty shabby. The bathroom was dirty- the vanity looked like it has not been properly cleaned in weeks, toothpaste stains, dirty mirror, used cups, stains in the sink. Kind of gross. The whole place had a funky smell. I never used anything else in the house as it felt like I was in someone else’s space with too many random personal items all over, so I wasn’t comfortable using any other room. The price was reasonable, but even at that price, I would still expect basic cleanliness. Never met the host in person.

Starting out with a positive comment, the location is awesome. That, and the cost was inexpensive. Those are the only positives. Azi is the mother of Masoud. Azi was not part of the equation. Clearly, based on the complete lack of a-n-y instructions and a dirty apartment, the host does not care about his guests at all.  I asked “why were there no instructions?” He said “the maid must have thrown them away.”  I stayed for 2 months and there were 2 rolls of paper toweling and 2 rolls of toilet paper. There was hair in the bathtub and crumbs everywhere on the kitchen counter. I advised the host and he said he would have a cleaner come in to clean (he owned a cleaning company) but 1 month later I asked why no one came and he just made excuses. He said he was waiting for me to let him know when would be a good time.  He was condescending, arrogant & smug.  He then had the gall to send me the power bill and told me I was using too much heat and hot water. I reported him to Airbnb. Stay away!

Think this ruined AirBnB for us :(
So much I can say... it's horrible to be out of your country visiting with small children just a few days and not have what you need, home is very scarce of basics. Kitchen, linens, bags, towel paper, even shampoo & soap only in 1 of the 2 bathrooms.
The location is local, great views but the host was not super. Very inconsiderate and although finally met our needs I was stressed, worried and felt unsafe. Took away all the fun out of our short stay. Would not recommend.
Btw: check out to do's are over the top and garage space is very tight. Small cars only

A terrible spot to stay, horrid location, parking is a nightmare, and you definitely shouldn’t book here because I want to live here. 😜
Thank you, Jessie. 10/10

I stayed in this unit for 2 nights with my family. The unit is in need of maintenance. The bathtub off the master bedroom had a leaky faucet and instead of fixing the issue the owner had piled a bunch of towels and disposable coffee cups behind the tub to catch the water. The toilet in the master bedroom also runs on and off throughout the day, without cause. Furthermore, the shower in the second bathroom had a broken faucet so the shower wasn’t functional. Lastly, when I reached out to the owner for instructions on how to access the pool area they didn’t reply until ~20 hrs later. The issue with the tap was left unresolved and we were offered a $100 discount for the stay and a late checkout. Which was appreciated, however the refund has yet to be provided and I’m not confident it will be. For the price, this unit is inadequate and unsatisfactory. I do not recommend staying here.

The property was reasonably priced, looked like the pictures and was in a good area. However, there is black mold in the shower of the upstairs bathroom, water damage in areas throughout the house and the unit smelled like sewage during our entire stay. The host tried to mask the smell with several fabreeze plug-ins however, this was not successful. I do think it is worth mentioning that we decided not to message the host during our stay about these issues because we visited Vancouver on an extremely busy weekend, didn’t have a back up option and felt these are more serious issues that would not be fixed during our stay. It is also worth noting that the entire block was under construction and while the construction appeared to be paused during our stay, this could easily cause a problem for future guests. Overall, this property has a lot of potential, but the black mold and overall terrible smell need to be fixed.

It was very difficult to find for us and Uber.  The house number is not readably visible.  It is not near restaurants or any other places you might need.  There was 2 flights of make shift (cinderblock) steps to get to 2 other flights of steps.  The wooden steps were unsafe, they seemed like they were going to break or fall down with each step.  We do not recommend this location.

We notified her directly about the unsafe stair railing, the mold, spider webs, etc.
There was also no powder cream for the coffee.

Stay was very horrible and felt like a middle of a worst nightmare!
We checked out in 5 hours even we booked it for couple of days! Not satisfied with the deal

Location is the best thing about the place. Unit as pictured and described. Check-in easy. Building secure and quiet. Front faces treed courtyard. Street side is relatively quiet for a busy street. Great access to public transit. Full grocery and cafes steps away.
Most of unit is OK, decently clean and tidy. Not sparkling, but OK. Laundry left in dryer, a few dirty dishes in washer probably overlooked. Signs of being lived in: coats, shoes, remote work area. Kitchen counters and sink, fine. Utensils and cookware, OK.
BUT. Kitchen cupboards and fridge / freezer were full and filthy. Worst I've seen in AirBnB. Food well past best before by three years, half eaten products, medications, unlabelled mystery jars, sticky, ... I have told Ahmed this is unacceptable for an "entire home" listing so hope this improves.

DO NOT STAY HERE
IT LOOKS LIKE A NICE CHEAP OPTION NEAR THE BEACH BUT DONT DO IT
I ended up needing to report host and left after 3 days with a refund.
The hosts mom is living in the common area in the first photo and has separated it from the kitchen with shelves and sheets.
The air bnb account says the host is Gabe, but it is actually his mom Lea who is using his account. She will refuse to correspond using the air bnb app, and sends angry multi-page rants over text.
The photo is completely inaccurate, junk all over room, bed is a mattress stacked on a couch.
Beware, she has created duplicate listings.
Other people enter the apartment without warning, at all hours.
There was glitter on the floor in the bedroom, bathroom and kitchen, and plastic car floor mats taking up half of the shower.

Apartment itself was great and spacious. Good value for the closeness to downtown. The only thing that marred the visit was the unit was dirty when we got there. Garbage cans were full, towels in the tub, beds slept in and uncleaned, etc.
The host was sent over a cleaner immediately and sent donuts and a gift card from compensation but I would have preferred the unit be clean from the start.

The location was great and Kate was very easy to communicate with. The views were also beautiful. Having 2 parking spots was definitely a plus as well. The downs were the dirty floors, noticeable wear on the carpets, and dirty rug in the living room. Additionally, there were no curtains that shut morning/evening light out making it extremely difficult to sleep. Overall, we made it work but I probably wouldn’t stay there again.

Overpriced for the interior and the comfort (or lack thereof).  The very worn off composite floor and the cheapest beige polyester carpet resemble motels from the 90s.  Pretty much all Ikea furniture inside with the most uncomfortable couch to sit on.  The bedsheets are unbelievably thin and the beddings look so wrinkly that questions its cleanliness. The blinds don't really block light in the morning and some don't even work.  The shower curtain was moldy.  Towels look very old,  feel like cardboard and had stains.  For the price it's charged, one would expect to have some cooking oil to cook eggs in the morning and maybe some better detergent to wash off stains clothes. The garage fob did not work for us and was not resolved during our stay. As a place that's supposed to be run "professionally" by an agent, she was actually "travelling for work" and only responded to our message 10 hours later.  No care was put in the place and it was run as cheaply as possible. Would avoid.

Catherine was responsive most of the time. She manages it for her uncle. The bathroom shower curtain had mold on it giving a bad odor to bathroom. That was replaced the next day. The en-suite bathroom sink had drain issues never remedied. The housekeeper put back the used soiled bath mats on the bath floors. I was told to take a pic and put them aside. Most of the vents in the unit were full of dust. The baseboards were filthy. The unit needed a major up down cleaning. She said she would tell her uncle who owns the unit. The mattress in king bed was like sleeping on cement blocks. We were given last minute instructions regarding entry and occupying the unit. Don’t tell anyone we were occupying through Airbnb as building frowns upon this. If I knew this I wouldn’t have leased for 5 nights. I inquired about a partial refund but heard nothing. Shame on them! Especially paying over $800+ a night. They don’t care it’s a little money machine for them.

The positives: great location, place to sleep and a comfy bed
The negatives:
poor communication, no kitchen (the one downstairs had a lot of bugs and the one on my floor was sometimes locked and sometimes unlocked while being dirty 100% of the time) no toilet paper, bug issue, stained walls, stained sheets, no towel, no washer and dryer (she claimed there was one but never showed me even after I asked twice) very loud, other guests aren’t considerate (door slamming, stomping, spraying Lysol in the hallways which are heavy chemicals)
I hope nothing for the best for Yun’s place. But, I do believe it’s important to warn future guest as it is not a cheap place. If the price was 50% lower I would not express my discomfort with all the issues as you would be “paying for what you get - bed” but this was a nightmare of a 30 days, expecting a medium to high quality experience paying such a high price.

Unfortunately stay was disappointing. I can appreciate that there are renovations & last details but it was definitely more than that. I stayed at a renovated airbnb just before this stay with no issues. Here there is a very strong cigarette smell, I would not recommend for anyone with allergies. Even though we tried to air it out, if those upstairs or outside smoke, it can be smelled downstairs. You will also hear those upstairs. One bedroom has a sweat smell and broken closet. Bathroom door sticks & handle is falling off, you may get stuck inside. There is a large TV but no cable. Don't bother with the wifi, it is not good. Part of the rules asks you to separate the garbage and recycling, in which we have no problem, but there is no garbage or recycling bins provided. What I wouldn't have given for a vacuum. The rugs leave a lot to be desired. The baseboards are covered in dust. I'm not sure if the space is up to code as half the outlets are cracked.

While Harry place matches the description, the 2nd bathroom shower was very dirty. There was trash left like K cup in Keurig. While instructions were clear, they were very complex, and it was difficult to park and take car out during check out since you needed fob. Taking the trash down to the trash room seems excessive and the people in the building working were rude and unhelpful. The area is conveniently close to Gastown and train station which is nice, but the neighborhood itself is a little sketchy. The furniture is slightly uncomfortable and the 2nd bed squeaky. The trash can was extremely small and there was no recycling in unit.
The space was nice enough and served purpose for short trip, but we will probably not stay here again.

Overall good stay. However, I do feel that guests should know that there is only one thin cover (no top sheet or blankets) on the beds with no other blankets available (we ended up buying some) and that the pool/hot tub are in a building across an outdoor courtyard. The shower was a bit bizarre (full length mirror inside and blasting pressure). As others have mentioned (so I was prepared) the multiple steps to check in and out were complicated and time consuming but we also happened to arrive when there was an event at the stadium and traffic and parking were a nightmare. We also didn’t care for the taking out of garbage check out step which it seems the cleaning staff should handle. Dirty and torn “throw pillows” but otherwise clean. The neighborhood is a bit concerning just a couple blocks away if you’re not used to a West Coast big city. But overall the host was responsive and the place was more or less as advertised.

The pictures are  false advertising. Add horrible noise and the worst neighborhood -- full of open drug deals and drug use  (we stayed here in part due to proximity to Gastown and the walk was shocking even for these Chicagoans). The bay windows in the living room were divided by a piece of flimsy plywood into which was connected piping for a very loud air conditioner. The installation was so poor the sliding door could not be closed all the way. The insulation strip was gone or loose, not that it would have made a difference given the gap between the door and the plywood. In the 1 bedroom with AC (nothing in the second bedroom), that unit was even louder. The install for that AC was an open window and plexi in its place that was velcroed to the window frame and did not say in place. Noise insulation was nil: This overlooks the screeching skytrain and the expressway. Host offered to remove the AC. Which would have left us boiling and still with train noise. Left after 1st of 4 nights.

Very disappointing stay – would not recommend.
The noise level is unbelievable. There is a train passing less than every minute, and it is extremely loud inside the apartment. Before booking, I specifically asked the host about train noise and was told it could not be heard from inside, which was completely inaccurate.
The washer and dryer are also extremely noisy and cannot be used while staying in the apartment. The blinds are broken and not blackout, making it impossible to sleep properly at night or rest during the day.
Overall, the apartment is in poor condition and clearly needs maintenance. We could not sleep or relax at all. I originally booked for one month, reduced it to 5 nights, and ended up leaving after only 3 nights due to the noise and condition of the place.

I booked last minute for two nights and there was an accident on road and a fire. We couldn’t make it at all and had to pay extra accomodation costs on road and didn’t get to use the air b n b I felt like we should of got atleast a 50 percent refund on the second night, even the cleaning fee as we didn’t use the place but owner was non negotiable and just taking advantage I wouldn’t want to use air b n b in future as it doesn’t suit last minute bookings as no funds back, so I wouldn’t recommend this as the owner had no sympathy Tommy situation, I paid near $1000 on acom I didn’t get to use

This unit was dirty, the furniture was very basic and uncomfortable. The host changed the check in/check out process causing us great difficulties, e.g. the keys had to be picked and returned up 4 blocks from the unit in a bad area.
The unit was small, the furniture was not comfortable and the shower/ bathtub had no grab bars or a grippy floor risking, for customers, the distinct likelihood of a serious fall. I could not recommend this "superhost". Save your money and look for something better on Airbnb!

The apartment is in a large block of residential flats which is secure and quiet. Location was convenient to explore the city, especially Yaletown but expect to be near a busy road.
The apartment was pleasant but unclean, we have pictures of hairs in the bath and on the bathroom walls. We did not flag this as we didn’t want a cleaning company entering the place whist we were still there. I have now noted that others flagged these kind cleanliness issues and can confirm that this has not changed.
Our stay was good enough but check out was a nightmare. Keys were to be left in a lock box at a 7/11 which was changed to another more distant lock box (due to a fire, which is fair) to which the road was closed code did not work. We were in a rush so wanted to leave the keys at reception but they would not take them. Hosts were initially helpful but heard nothing in terms of aftercare.
Disappointing experience.

Stay away from this place! The receptionist was grumpy, it seemed like she doesn’t want to work there. Very smelly and dusty and there was a leak in the ceiling in one of  the rooms that could anytime fall on you.

This was our 29th Airbnb stay. We booked 4 nights at Sarah's suite; canceled the last night and were reimbursed per cancellation policy. Perhaps with fixing some issues, unit will be of value for others, but it didn't work for us.
Things we LIKED:
location, hooks in front entry, lovely LR rug,hardwood floors, fireplace, vintage wood and windows, fresh coffee beans, bed ok, good storage, private entry, lamps
Things we DID'NT LIKE:
-noise in the water pipes was super annoying; woke us at night
-NO thermosat in unit though book said there was. Sarah told us to open windows, but on garden level and no screens felt unsafe and critters could enter. Opening front entry door and towels over radiators helped make it tolerable
-on day 2 mice droppings started appearing; we found/killed a mouse in kitchen drawer. Sarah called pest control for after our departure and gave us a partial refund; more refund when turds showed up everywhere
-not ready at check in time; got no response for 1-1/2 hrs

As a fellow host, I rarely leave bad reviews, but this stay was truly unacceptable. Both decks were under construction and completely unusable—one was covered in moss and overgrown grass, making it unsafe and unhealthy. The listing was misleading. The home was dirty upon arrival: stained sheets and towels, filthy oven, broken items, non-working lights, and windows that couldn’t open. The A/C and washer didn’t work. The parking spot was extremely tight and difficult to use—none of this was disclosed. Worst of all, communication with Tyson (owner) and Lindy (manager) was rude, dismissive, and dishonest. Lindy misrepresented our conversations and took no responsibility for the issues. When I developed a medical issue and we left 10 days early, they refused to refund us, even after initially suggesting we could leave. This was one of the worst stays I’ve ever had. The property is poorly maintained, the hosts are unreliable, and the experience was incredibly stressful. Avoid this listing.

Cam and Ida’s spot is extremely convenient if you’re looking for a place to stay around pacific central station. Just a little heads up the area is really sketchy so I don’t recommend checking in past 7pm. Cam and Ida were very responsive and once you make it inside the Airbnb they give you some helpful tips to avoid sketchy area. Overall very nice place!

Everything was just as described, including the outside neighborhood and the inside unit. I knew what to expect. The unit itself was super clean. It had everything we needed. I felt like I was at home. I felt very safe. I was able to cook some meals. The little patio was great to sit at in the evenings. The mattress was very comfortable. However the pillows were not of my liking. I have very sensitive ears and the ones there were horrible. But that’s just my preference. The host was responsive.
The neighborhood was exactly as the host described. There’s a map of what streets to avoid. Yes The homelessness in the area was overwhelming but I still didn’t feel unsafe. They all keep to themselves. I was able to catch the bus a few times just across the street with no problems. I also walked around to get food. Don’t make eye contact, mind your business and it will be ok. There is so much to do as see. There’s a really yummy breakfast place just around the corner. Loved it all.

Great to have a parking space, full kitchen, and private studio apartment. Mixed reviews on location: centrally located but near very sad addiction/drug scene. (I didn’t feel unsafe, just a real bummer and surprising).
Nice touches such as eggs in the fridge, kitchen basics (oils, butter, spices, filtered water, coffee, tea), and motion-sensing night lights. Super kind, responsive host. Good, clear instructions.
Tidy and well appointed little studio, but needs more thorough cleaning, for sure.
Ventilation is challenging; if you keep the bathroom fan and A/C fan on *all the time*, the musty smell of everything eventually subsides. Mattress is quite sagging and creeks a lot; I’m glad I was solo in this bed because I don’t think it would be comfortable for two tallish or slightly heavy folks (I’m 5’9”/175cm and 170lbs/77kilograms).
Relative to the crazy expensive accommodations in Vancouver, this was a pretty good deal.

The stay was absolutely terrible. This place was disgusting. STAY AWAY!!!
The room was not clean - there were big mice running in the room and eating trash at night.
The furniture in the room was falling apart - the bed made a terrible noise when sleeping in it and there was a big gap between the headboard and the main frame. The wall-mounted coat rack was loose, sticking out of the wall and could fall at any time.
The room walls were paper thin and we could clearly hear sounds from the hallway and other rooms.
The light switch at the kitchen was not working and we had to insert a card to hold the switch in place and keep the light on. A pot was missing one handle making it unsafe to cook as you could burn yourself. The gas stove didn't turn on properly and the host asked us to buy a lighter to ignite.
Also, one incident happened during our stay where two guests had a flight with knives and there was blood everywhere. 5-6 policemen showed up. It was such an unsafe place.

I had a terrible experience with this host. There were people in the house after the listed check-in time (3pm), & they did not even start cleaning until after one of us arrived at 5pm. The bathroom was used (dirty toilet seat), decorations from the previous reviewer’s bachelor party were still up, random items like contacts and hair ties were left in the rooms, & there was a very strong odor in one room. The neighbor actually told us that this is a drug house & they don’t clean between stays. We found someone living in the basement, which wasn’t in the listing. Construction workers asked to cut our power for a few hours, saying they already warned the owners. When I expressed concerns to the host, she didn’t apologize & just made excuses. I escalated this to Airbnb so she retaliated against me & sent 20+ incoherent, hostile messages about how we “damaged” her house and left a "mess" (she gave no checkout instructions so we left towels on bathroom floors), & charged a $1500+ damage fee

The apartment itself was great. Exactly what we needed. Clean and nice amenities. The location overall was convenient getting around, everything was close by.
Downsides were: the location is right downtown on a rather busy and sketchy street. There were a lot of people sleeping on the streets and drug use seen in the alley behind the apartment, where the windows face. The alley is also where you must drive through to get to the parking garage. It was also extremely loud at night from the people in the alley.
Picking up the keys you had to go to the 711 down the street, which was inconvenient.
Overall if you’re alright with a busy and fairly sketchy downtown area, the unit itself and location proximity wise are both great.

Due to some error, the unit was not cleaned before we checked in (sheets not changed, dirty towels strewn about, etc.). The situation was quickly resolved, but it was a pain to have to deal with (though the cleaning fee was partially refunded as compensation).
Other than that, the stay was good. Nice, quiet area and plenty of space for two couples.

The location of this two bedroom basement suite is great - adjacent to a large park, in an affluent, beautiful and quiet neighborhood. Amenities are within a short car ride - contrary to other reviews the unit is not walkable to shops and is nowhere near the airport. Jingyi is very responsive, but does not live in the home. Unfortunately, the unit could use some maintenance and had mold along the ceiling, tiles, and window frame in the bathroom. Finishings and kitchen items are very inexpensive, knives were stored over head height, coffee maker was missing the pot and was too grungy for my comfort, and one towel had a hole in it. Overall, the unit is not particularly comfortable or well finished and for the cost I would not recommend it. With more cleaning and much more care to the guest experience the unit would be worth staying at, given the location
