The price was seemingly a good value for 3 BR/3BA. The photos were misleading. The layout is odd 1 BR on ground floor, 2 upstairs. The BR furniture arrangement in 2 rooms would not allow the doors to fully open yet we were not supposed to rearrange furniture. When I arrived there were 5 broken chairs on balcony, 1 inside had the frame broken. It took 9 days, a lot of communication with AirBnB HQ, 2 visits from maintenence for host to address this. Surprise house rule of no shoes upon arrival. The floors were very dirty, the walls were heavily marked with damage from previous occupants and dirty finger prints and pet hair everywhere. I spent several days cleaning the unit. Items others mentioned have not been repaired, like damaged blinds. They do not provide enough basic supplies (laundry/dish soap, tp) for your entire stay. A maybe if you need Vancouver proper + 3 bedrooms and are willing to work + pay a premium. It was missing BnB. Nothing more than a basic rental flat with damage.

No major problems with our stay. The listing is somewhat misleading because it says "entire house", but it does not mention that the property  is separated into 2 spaces: there are people living right below the second floor. So in reality, we only got access to the entire unit (one of two units total in the house). Tried to use oven but was not cleaned properly, so pre-heating the oven produced a lot of smoke. House is next to the 25 bus route

We had originally booked with a different host, but they did not provide us with working keys and were completely unresponsive. After receiving our refund from Airbnb, we found this listing.
This host absolutely saved our trip. Her space was infinitely better than our original booking, incredibly easy to find and check in, and in a great location. We had coffee shops, restaurants, and convenience stores well within walking distance. We were also able to easily walk to BC Place stadium to watch a World Cup game.
We don’t have enough good things to say about this host and space! The directions and instructions were very clear and helpful and the space itself is adorable and cozy.

Unfortunately.. the place was not cleaned at all from previous person(s). i was told a few times not to arrive before 4 pm ( we arrived a 4:42pm). Trash on the counter, dirty dishes on the dishwasher… mail/packages on a table, beds were all messy.. and i had in filled with other water and wet towels.
Upon texting Vicki, I told her that we won’t be staying and I’d like a full refund. She understood and agreed to it. I had to look for another place to stay for the three of us after a long drive, She texted and offered us a bit of a discount if we could wait.. or the full refund. I was tired and had already booked another place, so again asked for a full refund.

Ahmed was always very responsive and provided very clear instructions for my stay. The apartment was easy to find, clean, and very homey. The area around it is a little bit sketchy and some homeless people around but I didn’t go out much late at night and never felt unsafe. There is air con in the room that is fairly noisy but works well. Overall I really enjoyed my stay! Thanks again ☺️

Ahmed’s apartment is conveniently located, but the hosting was disappointing.
Communication was poor: he ignored my first check-in query and finally sent an automated, confusing message. Then—just an hour before my flight landed after 10 hours in the air—he changed the check-in instructions, causing me to go to the wrong place and waste time.
Even worse, a “friend” he hadn’t mentioned shred this apartment and used my toilet, though I’d booked a private stay. (he sent me the message when I was in the plane).
Other issues included empty shampoo bottles, laundry left in the dryer, and a broken kettle. Despite living next door, Ahmed never checked in or offered help.
Overall, I felt unwelcome and disrespected, and would not recommend this apartment.

We are amazed at first when we checked in (we are also allowed to check in very early), the house is really modern and the neighborhood seems safe. But after everyone settled in we noticed that the house wasnt clean thoroughly, makeup stains in the bathroom, stain at the backdoor (looks like a vomit), a yellow stain on the bed in one of the bedroom (probably urine stain) and our friend got a hives from the bedroom on the 3rd floor. We were concerned about the smoke alarm when we came in because its covered and we messaged the host and didnt get any response. Early morning on our last day (4:00am) a stranger was banging at the door, asking for our door passcode shouting and threatening to call the police. We message the host right away and called the police.Fortunately, the police came and checked the whole area for us but the stranger is not there anymore. The place is nicely renovated but not cleaned from previous stays and our experience was a horror and disappointing.

For the price point its solid, place is exactly as described. Just alot of homeless on this side of town. (I’ve never seen someone actively smoke crack till now) although I’m somewhat responsible for not doing my own research and checking the reviews thoroughly, this spot wasn’t horrible at all. Wouldn’t recommend bringing kids. Will be going back to Vancouver. won’t be staying in Chinatown.

The location is great. Keep in mind this is an old building, there is a strong smell of mold in the apartment. We got the place, the bathroom was filthy, they sent cleaners; they did an half-assed job. later that day we turned the fan on, clumps of hair flew from under the bed.
Kitchen is very basic (no kettle). if it's hot, you have to deal with one small fan - and if you keep the windows open, the street is loud.
If you're not too picky it's ok - but feels overprices and minimally maintained.

The property is right across the skytrain and bus station, so travelling is convenient. But this also mean you can hear the bus and skytrain screeching noise all the time. It can get noisy at night.
Small shopping centre nearby, easy to stock up at supermarket and to grab a bite.
The place was not very well maintained. Carpet was stained all the way to the top. Only half of the windows have mosquitoes nets that are falling apart, the other half has none at all. Bugs kept flying inside. The bedside lamps does not work when plugged in. Baby high chair was filthy. The place was a bit dusty when we arrived.
We stayed for 15 nights. Washing machine was broken and was replaced after 5 days. The floor was dirty with shoe prints when we got back at night on the day of washing machine replacement.
Slow response after check in.
Kitchen is well stocked.
Not enough toiletries for 15 nights.
Would recommend if more effort is put into cleaning and maintenance.
PS. Construction site behind property

Unfortunately, our stay was disappointing. We paid $2,258 USD for a 2-night stay (Fri-Sun). We had hot water Friday, but from Sat morning until checkout Sun, there was NO HOT WATER, making showers unbearable. We were away all day Sat and reported the issue as soon as we returned that evening. I even offered for Don to inspect it Sun morning, but he said someone would come after checkout. He insisted someone in our group had adjusted the boiler, which was untrue, and offered only a $54 refund after I requested $200. There were also ants in the upstairs kitchen, counters, a broken patio egg chair that caused my sister to fall.
Rather than acknowledging the issue of no hot water, he keeps saying our family turned off the boiler which is not true. He also reminded me that he had allowed us to drop off our luggage early, which I felt is unrelated to the issue.
Problems can happen in any property, but blaming guests instead of taking accountability is not the level of professionalism!!

We were disappointed to find out that the swimming pool was unavailable during our stay, despite the host not mentioning it prior to our rental. The property did not meet our expectations, and we were charged more than outlined. When we reached out to the host for a refund, we did not receive a timely response.
Branden was a great host but I wouldn’t recommend the space due to noise, rude concierge staff and some cleanliness issues.

Andrea is a terrible host!!! I do not recommend. She listed a playroom but does not allow kids. When I questioned her about this, she refused to respond to me. I am grateful to Airbnb for fully refunding because Andrea is an extremely difficult person to deal with. I do NOT recommend her place to anyone ever!!

His business license expired Dec 2023. The place was dirty & dusty. The towels were few & raggedy. A candle melted on his balcony table & he left it like that. He rented us his place with a broken bathroom door preventing privacy knowing it was broken for 3 months. Previous reviews complained about that. His place was supposed to offer an iron and ironing board but it was locked in a closet as well as the clothes washer & dryer. So, we wore dirty clothes the last 3 days of our trip. I was given a small reimbursement for my trouble. Not worth suing this guy but beware.
My stay at David's Airbnb was a letdown. Despite the stylish decor and David's responsiveness, the rampant cockroach problem ruined the experience. Unacceptable.

David was very friendly and responsive. The neighbors upstairs were extremely loud, blasting music til 4am. The bath tub did not drain which meant I could only use it one night as it was filled with water from the night before. Check in instructions were sent separately and I missed this so just make sure you review and save that prior.
The address was listed as just the specific loft address so when getting dropped off it was confusing as to where I was going. I feel like it should be listed as 55 Cordova St apt 405 vs 405 Cordova St. The surrounding neighborhood did have some unhoused people but I felt mostly safe walking alone at night and during the day.
The blinds were hard to use and I struggled getting them both up/down. There is tons of natural light but in the evening it is very dark and it was hard to get ready in the dark. The stay was good but with the price of $800/night I felt disappointed. I asked for some sort of refund/discounted rate and this was not acknowledged.

Nightmare finding the parking because host instructions not clear even with map he provided and no parking in building. You must schlep your luggage from one building to other even in rain.   There was no toilet paper in apartment. Host suggested we go to a supermarket and buy our own. Host takes long time to respond and was completely unresponsive as well.   Save your time and money dont stay there !

Overall the stay was good and the owner was very responsive. The beds were really comfortable and clean. The kitchen has the basics. The water pressure in the kitchen is not very good though so it took longer to wash dishes.
There were no top sheets available which I found odd. The owner confirmed the comforters are cleaned after each stay which is great. There were times at night when I would get hot and would’ve preferred just a top sheet.
The location is very convenient and there is a train station close by. The Airbnb is a couple of blocks away from East Hastings so there are some transient people nearby. During the day I did not feel unsafe walking around.
The main thing I didn’t like was the state of the shower. The water pressure was great but there are a lot of mold stains in the grout between the tiles. The soap dispenser in the bathroom could be cleaner. For the price I paid I expected it to look nicer however accommodations overall in Vancouver seem to be expensive.

Stuart’s place was nice in a good location not too far away from some of the desirable locations. I would have stayed a bit farther north and west in the future, mainly because Chinatown has an awful amount of addicts which is terrible to see and depressing. There are a few people strung out around Stuart’s place. They don’t mess with you it’s just depressing to see. If you avoid traveling into Chinatown in the morning you avoid most of it. and I’m not sure there is anyplace to totally avoid it in Vancouver, they have an awful problem currently. There is a drug store and grocery close by. You are really close to Rodger or BC center if you are in town for a game or show. Tokyo in April had some excellent sushi.  We really enjoyed biking around Stanley park and trips to Capilano bridge and Lynn Creek Canyon all of those are easy Uber or Lyft rides or you could jump on some public transport.

Sorry to say this but as a last resort I would only recommend this place if it was a third of the price charged.  We don’t really watch TV but that that was the best feature. The shower was good but everything else was quite disappointing. Beds quite uncomfortable, extra room was very hot, place was very hot, air con too loud with ear plugs, run down and needing significant renovation. Bathroom quite dark. Lighting poor.  No side tables. Dishes were very dirty. Kitchen poorly set up for cooking.

1.Ants Beware, the whole room is an ant house. Ants can come up to bed, and they can even fit in your underwear and carrier. (It was like that when we were. It was Horrible.) Ants bite me and my fiancé so much that my wounds are still all over my body.
2. Beware of thieves, someone sneaks into the room and the item is missing. Make sure to install your personal camera on the counter and leave. (The door was locked well.)
3.The condition of the house was dirty, there was garbage, the bed sheet were dirty marks, the blankets were yellow contaminated, and the closet was dusty.
MUST ANTS BEWARE.
It's so messy and dirty there. I bought back all the blankets, pillows, all the condiments I use on my kitchen and kitchen utensils with my own money.
The host doesn't say sorry, and he doesn't know anything serious.
I really don't recommend this house. It was the worst I've ever been on an Airbnb.
However, Airbnb's response was the best, and if you have a problem,I recommend you to talk to Airbnb

I recently stayed at this apartment in Vancouver with two other people. The location is fantastic, right across from an Asian supermarket, and the check-in instructions were very clear. The hosts provided plenty of fans to keep the apartment cool.
However, the apartment is advertised as a true three-bedroom, but the third bedroom is basically a closet. No one in my party wanted to sleep in there because it felt very claustrophobic; the door couldn’t open fully, there were no windows or storage, and there wasn’t even room to open a suitcase. This was quite disappointing given the price of the listing. I also think the photos of this room on the listing are misleading.
Additionally, the bathroom off the main room wasn't very clean, with some hair in the drain and tub. Overall, while the location was excellent, the misleading description of the third bedroom and cleanliness issues were significant downsides. Future guests should be aware of these points.

I recently stayed at this Airbnb and was disappointed by several issues that impacted our stay. The most significant problem was the flat was advertised as having three bedrooms, but the third "bedroom" was not a proper room and did not offer the privacy or comfort expected.
Additionally no proper light in one of bedroom, which made it inconvenient, especially at night. The air conditioning unit was not connected properly to the outside, leading to subpar cooling, which was particularly frustrating during the warmer days.
The kitchen was also understocked, with not enough glasses or dishware for the number of guests the flat could accommodate. There was no drying rack available, and the dishwasher did not clean properly, so we ended up hand-washing most of our dishes.
Overall, the flat had potential, but these issues made the stay less enjoyable than anticipated.

I arrived for check in at 5, I was given check in instructions to go to this store and put a code in, code didn’t work, I tried messaging/calling host multiple times with no luck so I eventually walked back to my car.  Finally the host responded and said the unit wouldn’t be ready till 8. I explained that it was my daughter’s 16th birthday and we just drove into town and needed to get ready for her birthday dinner. She didn’t seem too interested in helping us; however she offered a $100 credit which did not seem fair considering the hassle and the fact that I paid $1200 for 2 nights. I called Airbnb and they properly apologized and sent me a $300 refund directly from them. The manager showed up 30 mins later and explained that the cleaners did not clean the unit. He was very kind and did his best to clean the unit quickly so we could get ready. Overall, the terrible check in process is the reason for my low review. The condo was very clean, beautiful, and in a good location.

The suite is in a funky and cool building that looks like it was made out of Sea-cans. There is a process to getting into the unit and parking, but the host explains it extremely well. It has one of the largest balconies in the building, which is nice for some fresh air. There were a couple minor maintenance issues, but no big deal and communication with the host is immediate.
It’s located in an up and coming neighborhood, which is within a 30 minute walk of Gastown, but along the way you’ll walk through a pretty sketchy area. We walked it during the day and never felt unsafe, but I’m not sure I’d walk it after dark.
If we’re in the area again, we’ll definitely consider this unit.
It’s a very secure building with a fob to get in and use the elevator as well as a gated underground garage for your vehicle included in the price.
In the end, it’s much cheaper than a decent downtown hotel and way more comfortable.

Andy was respectful & quick to respond. I left valuables behind & he communicated with me promptly to retrieve them, very trustworthy. AC works great. Bed is sturdy & comfortable. Extra amenities were appreciated. Nice balcony + view. Overall the place is cute.
The space needs to be deep cleaned and maintained. Dirty sponge in kitchen, baseboards dusty, grout is pink in shower, couch had large stains and smelled of hair oil including the pillows. Long black hair in many places. Walls need to be painted as there’s drywall patches. I wasn’t going to mention these things but I saw that other reviews did, meaning this must not be a priority for the host. Considering the price, it should be. The decor and layout is nice but was just not clean enough for Airbnb standard.
Hundreds of homeless about 2 mins walk down on the Hastings strip toward downtown. Although it’s not the hosts fault, this needs to be communicated bc it is a safety issue. Open wounds, actively using drugs, passed out.

Communication with the host was not good unfortunately. For Check-in information we had to ask the evening before ariving. Louis told us we could check in early which was not correct as the airbnb was still being cleaned.
Also the bathroom was not clean (hairs, sink not cleaned).
Otherwise we enjoyed our stay. Rest as on pictures and in description.

Beds were comfortable, but pillows have a smell. Kitchen is not well stocked: no scissors, no saran wrap, no oven mits, very few ladles or spatulas. Yuan did deliver bring over oven mitts & saran quickly when we pointed this out.
No filtered water provided, had to buy bottled water the whole stay or drink from tap.
Yuan said yes to an early check-in, then didnt deliver on that.
Front and Backyard was a mess, dirty and unkept. We couldn’t use the putting area or outdoor patio furniture because it was so filthy.

Stayed the long weekend. Easy to find, good instructions before you arrived AND in the Loft.
Loved the keyless entries to the building and to the Loft.
The hot tub was nice but I couldn’t figure out how to keep it hot for duration of stay. Steam shower was a bonus!
Comfy beds, great amenities, and very helpful owners.
Loft is above The Blarney Stone and many businesses for neighbours helps to feel fairly safe.
Rough area down the blocks to the east and south.
I walked to the Loft from Front Street Station with my luggage - not recommended because the neighborhood got stinky and dirty the last 2 blocks. Take Uber or cab when going out if you don’t have transportation.
We found paraphernalia on building entrance 2x but it was cleaned up by the time we came out the next day. This is nothing against the nice Loft or it’s owners. They can’t control what goes on outside.
You will get a good workout on the stairs from the street and from inside the Loft. I liked the exercise:)

Beautiful place. Great beds. Nice and clean. Spacious. Had air conditioning and nice deck.
Was a bit noisy (mainly on deck and if windows open). Area was a bit sketchy w lots of homeless on main streets but we never felt unsafe. And side streets were fine (with great food options). Parking in garage was fantastic!

I'm a Vancouver local as such but needed an apartment late night after a building pipe burst where I live. The host was excellent all along, quite responsive right from the booking request to the late night entry through buzzer upon arrival. He even accomodated late check-out request.
First impression - apt was clean & tidy but at the risk of being pedantic - few out of sight areas like under the dinning table or bed could use some love to imrpove overall hygiene.
The apt is quite spacious & had all the usual amenities & stocked supplies.
The locality isn't as great though. It's right next to a major arterial road & a sketchy part of Vancouver. Right below is also a pub & a restaurant, which in combination could be great or bad depending on who you ask. It gets really loud due to all the road traffic noise & a constant stream of emergency response vehicles throughout the night. Elevators are dark & unusually dim lit & the common areas look run down.
Overpriced all things considered.

My friend & I stayed here with my service dog. The location is great & parking was easy to find.
We had challenges with the door. Krista did send a message before check-in saying the door had been acting up the past few days & they’d hidden a key on the porch for emergencies, but didn’t say where. When the lock malfunctioned, she was unresponsive. We realized it was late, so didn’t want to knock right away or pry by searching for the key amongst their personal items. We messaged, called, & followed all guidelines with AirBnb support. AirBnb finally said we could in this case knock. In all, we were waiting 2 hours from 10pm-12am in the rain. They were friendly & apologetic when they answered & gave us the key; however, after, they became unresponsive when I asked if it would be possible to negotiate a partial refund for the challenges.
We also complied with all checkout tasks & were respectful, so it’s disappointing to have been left on read. It was otherwise a cute place & stay!

Honestly, very disappointed with the description vs reality. Not gourmet kitchen, cheaply built, cheap linens, etc. floors were very dirty. Not good for kids at all due to unsafe neighborhood (lots of homeless) and steep staircase. One of stairs was also broken. Absolutely NOT worth the price. Would not recommend. Only good thing was close to sea wall and restaurants etc.

Unsafe, Noisy, and Run-Down – Avoid for Long Stays
We lived here for two months, and our experience was terrible. While some issues may be less relevant for short stays, I would strongly advise against booking this place for an extended period.
The host gave misleading underground parking instructions, and my car was heavily vandalized. After investigating, I learned the host was previously warned not to offer that parking spot but ignored it. Only after escalating to Airbnb I was reimbursed for my insurance deductible.
The property itself has many issues: homeless people in the area add to the unsafe feeling, the unit is full of ants, and it gets very cold in winter. At night, there’s severe light pollution, and every morning, the extreme noise from trash bins, trucks, and shouting makes it impossible to rest. On top of that, everything in the unit feels and looks extremely old, from the furniture to the rugs, creating an overall run-down and depressing atmosphere.

I recently stayed at this place with my family and had a very disappointing experience. The smell of the house was filthy. The couch had dirty stains. The kitchen cabinets and stove were not wiped down. There was a used sponge and no clean hot pads. Only two small kitchen towels.
The backyard was nice but it needed cleaning. Lots is spiders and webs everywhere.
All the beds were made so we didn’t notice until we went to sleep that the sheets were all dirty. There were hair, crumbs, and stains all over. I was able to find one new duvet cover set and use it for the basement bedroom. We had to wash the rest of the bedding the next morning, except the bigger comforter because it wouldn’t fit into the washer. Plus the dryer does not work well so everything was still damp. On top of all this, the bedsheets were all worn out, some had holes and rips.
When I contacted the owner and told him he sent someone out with a new comforter the next day for the master bedroom. We were out all day

nice place, great view from balcony. alison and susan, they both were awsm host.
Only downside of this area is that you have to walk pass groups of homeless people on the walkways, on your walk to downtown from the apartment. They dont do anything, its just dirty walkways and it stinks on the walkways.
Just order uber, its cheap.

We were VERY disappointed! Gist of my email to Yu (less detail):
Cleanliness lacking all thru - shower esp bad with a slimy pink mold all round the base & even up the sides of the shower! (sent pics). Also black mold. Both can cause rash & hives, respiratory & intestinal problems & urinary tract infections! Experts say don't clean it yourself - toxins released in air can get into lungs. We did spray liberal amounts of foam cleanser on all areas later rinsing it away. It cleared some.
Cfmd Tue grd-dtr was staying & asked for 3rd towel. Got it Fri. Still, due to the mold she opted to shower at her own apt nearby. My wife & I wore our crocs to shower.
Rug in main room is very dirty! (photo sent) I rolled it up & hid it behind the coach along with a very soiled couch pillow.
Mid-wk, locked door opened by guest expecting empty suite. Glad he came in daytime when we were present (& awake!).
Walls thin - kept awake past 12.
Netflix not aval as billed (minor).
Etc.

This is was a horrible experience:
- host tried to charge for pet fee that was not on listing, claiming additional $20. I provided evidence for it not being listed and she approved with no fee. Upon checking out she tried to charge me $30 per dog ($60). I called her out on this — seems very scammer-like.
- host tried to charge fee to use laundry which was not stated in listing. Listing says to request time to use, when I reached out she told me a $10 fee would need to be paid.She eventually waived it. Beware that laundry is only allowed from certain times. Since we were only there one night we were not able use
- listing not accurate. Backyard is not private or fully fenced. “Unit” is easily accessed by bathroom door to others. The bathroom door is a normal interior door with no additional lock. It opens to other rooms/units. Very creepy and not as described.
- host continued to try to add charges after check out for a “stain” and pet fee.
There is more but it’s exhausting.

This “entire house” listing was false.
You have access to about 75% of a house. And there is a surprise IN HOUSE manager.
The dining and living room were blocked off/ locked and labeled private, this is unacceptable when listed as an entire house.
This leaves a family visiting with no where but the kitchen island for eating as a family.
Kitchen has a pretty fouls smell all the time. No where to relax in the evening as a family. Only a small den, not big enough for 7 or 8 people. No Tv. Had to contact the in house manager who lives in basement of house.
No working bathroom on main level, the door has a note posted on it that says under repair. This is unacceptable in the main/ only shared area for guests.
Leaving the AC on freezing, and leaving no way to adjust it is unacceptable because the owner didn’t want to leave remotes available.
Bath tub covered and labeled shower only, even tho the knob in shower is broken off and difficult to use. Not worth $500 a day.

Stepping into the apartment, we were met with a musty scent that seemed to cling to everything. By the second day, three of the four of us were feeling the effects, with stuffy noses and a general sense of 'aged' air.
The linens had seen better days. With more of the musty smell and a few stains that made us question how long they had been in circulation.
The hot water supply was a bit of a risk for the last of the 4 of us to take a shower.
Even when the sun was shining brightly outside, the apartment remained rather dark. It gave the space a bit of a gloomy feel, which wasn’t exactly what we were expecting from the photos.
And then there were the "closets". Covered with drapery instead of doors, revealing cleaning supplies and random storage behind them. It was clear these parts had been carefully cropped out of the photos we saw.
That said, the upsides were that the location is pretty great, close to a number of things and in quite a pretty neighborhood.

everything went well, the only thing was that the h water pot was so dirty with sediment that it could not be used. I was so disappointed that we could not make hot water at all as there was no kettle either.  it was a $

I booked this unit to stay as two couples for 5 nights. Right off the bat, we noticed that the space didn’t live up to its listing.
First and foremost, the space didn’t feel clean. There was dust and dirt in the bedroom carpet, and the vents, corners, and baseboards were visibility dirty. This was most pronounced in the bathroom, where there was a pervasive, lingering mildew smell, including on all of the towels. The bath mat was visibility dirty and unwashed since the prior guests, and there were prior guests hairs loose on the floor and drawers.
In general, the unit also could use some maintenance and TLC - there was a missing light fixture with exposed wiring, broken door locks, and torn and overused furniture.
Overall, didn’t feel worth what we paid. I will note that the hosts offered to send their cleaners in for touch ups, which we declined as we didn’t want folks coming in once we were unpacked.

When we arrived, the floor is dirty and sticky. There are no air-con which actually knew before but the place is really so hot and no fans or any portable air-con provided. The big problem is the pillows are so disgusting that there are hairs on top and the feathers inside the pillow had stink my fingers and made me bleed. Moreover, my daughter is allergic to the dirty pillows and made her coughing and vomiting in those four nights. At the day we checked out, there was an old man came to us and scolded to my kids, he was complaining we snapped the behind door but the fact is we are in the front. The last but not least, the surrounding areas are full of cigarettes smell. That’s a really bad experience to us. What a shame to this Airbnb!! It totally didn’t worth!!

The apartment is a dark and damp basement. Place was dirty and dusty on arrival. Host was not able to fix the issue so we had to wait for three hours. When we eventually left the place host refused to
give us any refund at all even though we had to stay at a hotel instead. Not the service you expect from Airbnb. This apartment needs cleaning and maintenance urgently.

It was a perfect location and walking distance from all downtown. We felt the floor was quite dirty and so was the cutlery - we didn’t use it, there was damp too. It was very hot and had a strange smell, also quite noisy from upstairs. we had trouble finding it as the address was different to the booking.
Perfect size for 2 people, do not recommended the sofa ‘bed’ it was very uncomfortable. Although we enjoyed our stay these are things that stood out to us.

This place is half under ground which was not disclosed. The futon bed which also was the coach to sit on was very very uncomfortable to sit or sleep on. ……The dishes were dirty. The hot plate was so so rusted and dirty. Not even one service dish or a decent knife.

The room and the place were fine, clean and as described, Nicolas was kind and friendly, however, I had the worst check in experience I've ever had and probably will have, even though I communicated my arrival time 2 times in advance, when arriving at the location and calling at the door, AS I WAS INSTRUCTED, a woman showed up with a awful rude attitude yelling at me for calling at the door around 11:30pm. The host wasn't in home and didn't communicate my arrival to whoever was in the house, I spent around 30 minutes trying to connect with him in order to get into my room. As I said, the host was kind but this was a big mistake on handling the check in

Good location!!!
Inside is clean but need attention to the exterior, dirty windows, dirty entrance, need new pillows

The apartment is very well located, with many cafes and restaurants nearby and in walking distances from many of the main areas and public transport options. The apartment was comfortable and well sized.
We did find the apartment needs a good clean, with the shower having black mould, yellow stains along the toilet base, and it was very dusty. For the price of the rental, we would have expected a higher standard of cleanliness.
We were also disappointed with the lack of response to messages we sent Faith in the lead up to our trip, which created a sense of worry that there would be issues when we arrived from overseas. This wasn’t helped by Faith not responding to our first 2 calls from the intercom when we arrived, however we did then get in contact with Faith and she let us in - it was lucky we had eSIMs or this would have been very problematic.

this listing is part of a management company, so be prepared to be managed!! there was a separate check-in process outside of airbnb with 10+ steps, ID upload, and either $32 nonrefundable damage fee, or $300 refundable damage fee.
the directions about parking and entering/exiting the building were very confusing. i was told by airbnb hosts that i could park anywhere, but someone left a note on my car saying angrily that i parked in their spot!
the apt itself was fine, it was clean and had enough amenities.
there is a nice speakeasy across the street and bus stop near by.
but if you do not like complicated instructions, this is not the place for you

We arrived in the evening around 10pm.  We were surprised to find out just how “sketchy” the location was, as other reviews mentioned; but sketchy is a benign way to describe what it was actually like. The front of the small house in the photos looked country-like or charming but those photos are deceptive. The outside of the house was run down and stuffed between a block of lower end houses in what appeared to be an industrial area at the end of town. We thought about parking in front but lots of sketchy folks hanging out there. We drove around to the back which is where we were told to park. This turned out to be an alley. The parking was in the open on gravel outside the back gate.  Realizing we would be gone all day each day attending a conference, we did not feel it was safe to leave our belongings there. What looked like transients were walking up and down the alley. This rental is mischaracterized in the descriptions provided.  We could not spend even one night there!!

Sadly, this was the worst Airbnb experience I’ve had, which was surprising given the positive reviews.
The issues began before check-in, when the host failed to send the access code on time, as stipulated by the instructions. We had to ask for it ourselves and were met with excuses.
Before arriving, we informed the host that we had a late flight and confirmed it would be okay. They assured us they would be available to buzz us in. However, when we arrived, they stopped responding completely. Multiple calls, messages, and voicemails went unanswered, leaving us stranded outside at night in the cold with our luggage in an area that felt unsafe. We eventually had to book a hotel and work with Airbnb to get a refund.
Vancouver is a wonderful city, but this experience was stressful and disappointing. If you stay here, I strongly recommend having a backup plan and extra funds in case they ghost you.
Happy Travels.

Scary street. Witnessed 2 ambulances picking up people who overdosed outside in our 2 days there. LOTS of drug use and homeless people in front of place and in back alley where you park. Would not recommend. Stains on comforter and hair on pillow. Pillows very flat. No hand towel in the bathroom, only shower and face towel which both had musty smell.

We booked Annie’s place for 8 nights w our 15-month-old crawling son & my mother. Annie is a Superhost w great reviews & the unit’s location is excellent, so we were excited for our stay.
Upon arrival, the beds were properly made, the counters were clean but we quickly realized our son’s hands & knees were covered in black filth from crawling on the floor. Shocking. We checked our socks & they were also covered in black. The floors had not been cleaned in a very long time. There was also hair & debris in the corners. Food splatter on the wall. We were baffled.
We contacted Annie & she apologized, offering to send the cleaners back. However, before that could happen, we found small shards of glass on the floor. At that point, we no longer felt the apartment was safe for our toddler & left for a hotel.
Although we left straight away w all these issues, Annie declined to refund us.
Thankfully, after a lot of stress & days of back & forth, Airbnb refunded us after a thorough review.

Although located in a great spot, the apartment is far from luxurious as the name says.
I asked for an early check in since our plane was coming in a couple of hours before, and he said that was okay, but he would have to charge me an extra $50 to speed up the cleaning process. I paid and when I got there the apartment hadn’t been cleaned. There were smelly leftovers in the fridge, trash not taken out from kitchen and bathroom, clogged toilet, dirty moldy bathtub. It wasn’t pleasing to see that.
About the clogged toilet, when I asked him, he asked if I had tossed paper towel in it (?), and then he followed saying that even toilet paper in chunks could clog it, as if it were my fault. There were two plungers there, so definitely something that wasn’t new.
Also the WiFi was not working at all and nothing was done about it besides suggesting to unplug the modem. All in all, Amir didn’t care to solve any problem after I checked in. I would not stay again.

The landlord was responsive, but we were disappointed in the unit and the location. It's on a noisy edge of Chinatown  and a block or two away of what surely must be the worse homeless/drug addict area in the city, which meant that there were ambulance sirens 24/7 going that direction.  A (really bad) saxophone player on the corner tortured us every afternoon/evening with more noise.  The building is an old concrete  behomoth and has low ceilings, a shoebox-like floor plan, and a cramped bathroom.  The deck is overcrowded with furniture and had a large rug that was crumpled and dirty.  The portable AC units must be vented through an open door or window and take up a lot of (needed) space, and the second bedroom is dark and can't have an AC since no window to vent it through.  The unit is hard to find once in the building.  Having to get the key from the convenience store down the street adds an unwelcome complication after a long day of travel.  For the price we expected so much more.

I would not recommend booking this and here are the reasons why:
1. Super loud- Especially in the summer time, there are 2 portable AC units in the apartment, which means that you have to keep the windows open to extreme noise from a high line train passing below the window. The AC units are also super loud, so in the summer you have to choose between being hot or have a super loud apartment
2. The building itself is outdated and relatively poorly maintained. The same for the apartment itself as some switches are broken and the overall wear and tear is noticeable
3. The garage parking is inconvenient as you have to go through 3 separate doors with a hallway including stairs (not accessible friendly) exit the building and enter through the lobby again
4. We had a fuse plug that popped and I had to spend 2h to personally fix it so we will have electricity after getting instructions from the owners- terrible experience
knowing all of this I would have chosen a different alternative

the place was very cute looked like the pictures. however it is only a double bed not a queen the couch is a futon and the cleanliness was unacceptable to me. I am also an Airbnb host and I know how spotless an Airbnb should be. There was hair and dust and debris on the bathroom counter the, baseboards were very dusty. I had to clean the bathroom counter as well as the kitchen counter before we could set anything on it and I also found hair in the bathtub and shower and the glass shower doors were grimy. The air conditioner did not work, we could not leave the door open to cool the place off as there was rats and mice running around outside and didn't want them to get in. Vicki and her husband were very polite and did try to fix the air conditioner however it was very very hot in there all night long and only one little tiny fan. I really wish I could have given it a better review but unfortunately due to the UNcleanliness I cannot. have to say very well updated and a great location

This place was dirty. The dishwasher didn't work, and obviously hasn't worked for some time because we had to wash every dish before we used it. The pans were filthy and greasy and old. The kitchen in general was filthy including the stove top, inside drawers, tile, floors. The kitchen is not well stocked including that it did not have drinking glasses. I guess if you are fine with drinking out of coffee mugs all the time, it would be fine. There weren't garbage bags. there's a 3 cup coffee pot (for 9 People)?
The bathrooms were all dirty. It says it sleeps nine but really, max should be seven. One of the couches is not usable as a bed and the other one would only sleep one person.
We only had six people and there were not enough towels for all of us. There were no supplies in the bathrooms only Head and Shoulders dandruff shampoo.
It seems like the dishwasher has been an issue in the past, we tried running it on heavy, santise, ran it 3 times, it's broken. Buy a dishwasher.

The house was big and had really good spaces for our stay. But when I first went in, the house was extremely dusty.  The house was not cleaned well, bedside tables and floors were covered in dust I had to mop around almost the entire house. Bathrooms were dirty with empty hand soap dispensers.  Kitchen really needs newer and more items stocked.  The owner was kind and responsive to problems and resolved quickly.  Location is close to UBC and some restaurant areas.

Everything was as described and the location was great. We loved Mount Pleasant!
We had a good stay in the airbnb although we were a little disappointed when we arrived. It was a bit dirty and we expected somehow more for the price (which was one of the most expensive accommodations on our trip trough Canada & the US). Yilding reacted very nicely to our complaints and took care of everything. Thank you very much for that!

The apartment was well located, but it was a bit different inside from expectations.
The pictures are wide angle so it is smaller than the photos. The bedroom doesn’t have any ceiling lights so is very dark.
When we arrived the oven was dirty, the dishwasher was full and the toilet hadn’t been cleaned under the rim which we could smell when we used the shower. There’s water damage to the floorboards in the kitchen which needs repair.
The bedroom was quite noisy even with ear plugs. It was hot as expected for the summer, but a fan was provided.
We were surprised there wasn’t a kettle or toaster in the kitchen as it was advertised as having a fully equipped kitchen. The host said the kettle had broken and she didn’t have time to replace it and suggested we boil water in a pan. We contacted airbnb support and the host explained that these aren’t included amenities on the listing. She did then provide us with both which was helpful. She provided a 1% refund due to the cleaning issues.

On the whole, the place was decent. Its best feature was the convenient location, with everything nearby. However, multiple issues detracted from the experience. The most significant was the shower and sink, which clogged after just a minute of use, causing the water to rise above my ankles to my shins. This was so unpleasant that I opted to shower at Goodlife Fitness instead. The apartment was dirty, with stains on the sheets, sofa, and walls, and an incomplete paint job in the bedroom. The fridge and freezer had an odd odor to it as well.
Additionally, when I contacted the host about an issue with the elevator at check-in, he responded rudely, raising his voice because he was upset that I had entered the building when someone else held the door open for me. He also came across as condescending in his text messages, when he started questioning my ability to lock a door.
Overall, it was an okay place, but for next time, I would much rather book a hotel than stay here again.

The place was great, the host was passice aggressive at times but I think thats just him being super busy idk though. only one key fob so if you have friends and yalls are separated you would need to meet up downstairs then go up together.
At first glance the place was clean but we saw cockroaches and we have pics to show. The Host did say he is getting an exterminator so it should be gone now! He did give us a partial refund.
The place I would say has one of the best city views in vancouver!
I reccomend it if yalls want lots to do, just dont go to east hastings.

The location was nice, but the apartment definitely needs a deep clean, we found a few small cockroaches, so we had to leave because we didn’t want to risk it bringing it with us, and luckily we slept for one night and found it the next morning, we messaged the host and he was very communicative with me, and was willing to refund me my remaining days. The downside was I had to find a place last minute stay, and hope I didn’t bring any cockroaches with me

The only amazing thing about this place is the host. AJ is very responsive and accommodated us when we asked for a place to store our luggage before check in, gave us early checking without us asking. The location is very walkable. However, it’s the dirtiest Airbnb I’ve stayed in. Sheets, towels, dishes provided in the on the bed and in the cupboards are smelly and sticky, clearly unwashed despite the dishwasher and laundry working well (we were forced to test them when trying to go to sleep and not being able to due to the smell of BO and getting hives from the sheets) there was black mold in the shower and the shower drain was clogged with other peoples hair before we got there so we had to plunge the shower. There was a stagnant pool of water in the kitchen sink upon arrival and mysterious brown stains and scuffing all along the walls. Flooring doesn’t reach the edge of the room. Contrary to listed amenities, no conditioner, coffee, napkins, paper towels, cleaning cloths, work room.

We stayed at this Airbnb in downtown Vancouver, and unfortunately, the condition of the unit made the experience very uncomfortable. While the host was friendly and communicative, the cleanliness of the space was a major issue.
The apartment was noticeably dirty throughout. The floors, furniture, and kitchen all felt unclean, to the point where nothing could be used without washing it first. Most concerning was the presence of mold, especially in the bathroom, which made it feel unhygienic and unpleasant to use. The overall condition of the unit made it difficult to relax or feel comfortable during the stay.
On top of that, the unit was extremely loud. The windows were very thin, and outside noise carried in all night, making it difficult to sleep.

Shawn's place was a really fantastic, home-like place to stay! As mentioned in a few other comments, and due to the location being quite close to East Hastings, there were a few homeless around. However - none that created a feeling of unsafe or uneasiness. There is a tim hortons across the street which is awesome, and I went every morning and never felt unsafe walking there. Shawn's location also has some really delicious restaurants right outside their front door!
The home was beautiful and it was lovely to have two bathrooms. Cozy and clean! Would stay here again and would recommend!

Unfortunately, this was one of the worst Airbnb experiences I’ve had. I booked this place as we needed 3 private bedrooms, only to find that the screen door for one of the “bedrooms” literally does not exist. As soon as I brought up my concern to the host - all communication stopped. They simply did not respond at all. My concerns were ignored.
The property itself is also poorly maintained. The balcony door would not properly close, creating both a security and comfort concern. On top of that, the kitchen faucet/tap was broken, and the freezer door doesn’t close.
I would not stay here again and cannot recommend it to others.

Do not stay here if you value safety.
This apartment is located in one of the most dangerous parts of Vancouver. The host’s description of a “homeless population that keeps to themselves” is extremely misleading. After an 18-hour flight, we arrived to find the entrance to the building physically blocked by someone openly injecting drugs. It took the help of a neighbor and a long wait to even get inside.
Throughout the night, we heard disturbing noises from outside and witnessed ongoing drug use directly beneath the apartment window. The next morning, another person was again blocking the entrance. We spoke to a police officer supervising nearby street work, who strongly advised us to leave the area due to ongoing safety concerns and reported incidents.
While I sympathize with the host’s financial situation, safety must come first. I would never stay here again and strongly urge others to avoid this listing.

unresponsive host, not clean at all- refused a partial refund. overall expensive for how small the space is, bed is loud, towels were stained, shower mirror and toilet were not cleaned. location was nice

When we walked in, there was a strong, unpleasant odor that smelled like damp, unclean towels. We opened all the windows, but the smell never completely went away. The bed was comfortable, although it was quite noisy. The top of the baseboards were covered in a heavy layer of dust, and the fridge was also dirty, so the overall cleanliness was disappointing. The host was very accommodating and let us check in an hour early, which we really appreciated. We only needed a place to sleep, but for the price we paid, I expected the space to be clean and free of unpleasant odors.

This basement suite was reasonably clean with fresh sheets and towels. However, mould in the shower, unfinished wall plastering, and windows that wouldn’t open were disappointing. The kitchen did include fridge, stove, microwave, and kettle, but I couldn’t find any cooking utensils, pots, dish towels, or coffee pot. Location was a real benefit: close to transit as well as nearby parks. Lots of noisy construction though.
Based on my experience, the suite would be best for short-term stay by someone who simply wants a place to sleep. The space is very small and lacks comfortable chairs or adequate lighting.

The neighborhood is beautiful and the property is beautiful. The apartment is slightly musty because it’s a basement. There’s no TV service. Giant TV…no service. There’s only one mirror. That makes getting ready tough if there’s more than one person. There were no bath mats or any rugs under your feet in the bathroom. More towels would have been nice. There was an oscillating fan in one of the bedrooms. It was filthy and covered with dust. The shower had this gross hair catcher in the drain with other people’s hair still on it when we arrived. Also, this is not one of those rentals where you are the only person present. In other words, it’s a space in a larger home that has a separate entrance, but other people will be around during your stay. Not a bad thing, but people should know. Closets and various other spaces were locked. That’s a weird vibe. It was good for the day, but I would never stay here again.

The location & space is great: stocked amenities, beautiful kitchen, clean bathroom & bedroom. The check-in itself was difficult - building entrance & garage is in an alleyway near the address listed and it was hard to communicate with the host without cellular service.
I saw a lot of reviews that praised the flexibility but unfortunately did not experience this - typical checkout I've experienced is 11am but you have to be out by 10am, no leniency. You also have to take out the trash down in the basement - if you leave anything outside of normal recyclables, you have to take it out to a recycling depot yourself (no directions given) or you will be charged.
For some reason, Christina's boyfriend was the liaison to figure out how to throw away an old suitcase that baggage claim broke and I was extremely disappointed by the way he reacted to the situation (criticized & spoken down to).
Would not recommend this airbnb for the reasons listed above. Current view is of construction.

**Please read this before you book*
Horrendous experience!!! Razy has currently refunded us $130 and Airbnb has refunded us $411 due to the condition of the condo immediately after seeing the pictures. . It really took away from our first experience in Vancouver.
The owner would not respond to any communication, just refunded money.
When we first got there, we were able to enter the lobby, but his instructions did not work to use the elevator. So after 30 minutes we finally connected with his sister to let us in. Upon finally entering the place, we saw an extremely unclean kitchen with open food in the cupboard, a dirty fridge with half an eaten cake inside, very dirty windows and mirrors, stained sheets to make the bed, and one stained washcloth to use. All the shelves were dusty, there were only 2 liquor glasses to drink from. We had to use water bottles instead.
Do not reward the owner with your stay.

Unfortunately, my stay at the apartment did not go as I had hoped. When I opened the door I was greeted by a large bag of trash and an unclean apartment. It was clear house cleaning had not been there with trash, unmade beds, dishes, and towels throughout the house. I contacted the host and was told the cleaners would be there shortly to fix all we went to eat and were not notified it was ready until after 11:00PM per the time stamp on Airbnb.  It was not until after getting ready for bed we discovered there were no flat sheets or sleeping pillows on the beds. We had only a Fitted sheet a comforter and decorative pillows on the beds and it is now 12:00 AM after traveling from Georgia tired and disappointed I went to bed with no covers or pillows. The makeshift portable AC is completely underwhelming and brings in more heat through the open window than it puts out cool air. Finally, the cleaners came in without knocking while we were still there and well before our check out time.

Our experience fell short of our expectations in several ways. Firstly, the property description was misleading as it turned out to be a garage home rather than a standalone house, which was not what we anticipated.
Communication with the host upon arrival was challenging and proved to be impossible, leaving us feeling stranded and unsure of how to proceed. This lack of responsiveness added unnecessary stress to our stay.
Moreover, the accommodation was ill-equipped for a family. There was an absence of basic amenities such as cutlery, plates, laundry and dish soap, which made daily routines inconvenient and forced us to adjust our plans unexpectedly.
Cleanliness was another issue as the space it did not appear to have been thoroughly cleaned between guests. It felt rushed and superficial, lacking the welcoming atmosphere crucial for a comfortable stay
Overall, our experience was disappointing and not reflective of the standards we typically expect from Airbnb accommodations.

Unfortunately this airbnb wasn’t as expected, the house it self was quite dirty and didn’t look very cleaned prior to checking in. Lots of hair on the floor and stains in places with dirty. The parking situation was quite confusing, we were told there was an overnight parking garage close and if we parked on the street we were at risk of getting a ticket. However when we went to the location of the parking garage provided it was a grocery store, so we searched for the easy park lot # and when we found it, there wasn’t over night parking. Only 2 hours or another garage had 8 hours. We were told there was a day pass for $14. This caused stressed and we ended taking the risk to park on the road. So be aware there isn’t parking at this Airbnb. We got lost getting in through a small alleyway in between houses to the back of the townhouse’s fence and through a gate into a backyard. Tv was really confusing to work, we were able to share our phone to it. More maintenance is needed to feel safe

The price payed was not worthy for the condition of the suite.
Unbelievable rules like Mopping floors.
shower dirty and rug full of dust.
Really a terrible experience and thankfully was only one night.

The photos were quite misleading. Chunks missing out of the kitchen floor, multiple patches on the wall, no bath mat for the shower, tiles cracking in the corners & and absolutely filthy bathroom fans.
For the price point, I would have expected much more attention to detail & not a place that was so run down. The place was incredibly hot & absolutely bakes in the afternoon heat. Even with the fan going.
The deck off the bedroom was great & the location was walkable to nearby cafes.
I would not stay here again, it is not worth the $$.

host sent message AFTER booking regarding parking being difficult. it cost me over $100 in parking for 3 days. it was difficult to find the unit, there were instructions but not very good ones. it took us over 2 hours and many calls and texts to get a response from host about issues checking in. the heat was on in the unit when we arrived and the tiny unit was a sauna. when we finally got the host on the phone, she said there was nothing she could do about the heat and she didn't know why we couldn't connect to the wifi. she did eventually call us back and advise us to open the door to cool the unit off, however sitting with a door open your whole vacation wasn't comfortable. the unit was dirty and the bed was broken. we had to contact air bnb for assistance because host was unhelpful. it was clear there was no care put into this rental by the host and it was disappointing having spent all that money on it

Check In
Julie’s communication was unclear; on the day of our check-in when we wanted to confirm some details about our check-in,
she was unresponsive.
Conditions of the unit
After we arrived, we realized the unit was not thoroughly cleaned. It did not seem like the floors had been mopped in a very long time. We did not feel comfortable walking barefoot in the unit because the floors felt dirty.
The bathroom does not have ventilation; there is no ventilation throughout the unit making it very humid.
We had read some reviews that the bed was uncomfortable and we felt the same. The bed would tilt if you moved from one side to the other.
Location
Julie’s place is in a great location (very walkable, good restaurants and cafes nearby, 5 min walk to the beach).
Overall
With proper cleaning, better communication, and a more comfortable bed, this unit would be worthwhile for a small group.
Note: we did not message Julie about these concerns during our stay.

The place looked tired and needs some fixing up. The lights in the washroom weren't working and we had to switch the bulbs. The laminate flooring was missing chunks in multiple places. We asked if laundry detergent would be available in which the host said yes to find out their wasn’t any left in the container. The only towels available were bunched up in the dryer. Shower door doesnt close
and the caulking and shower door seal were dirty and covered in black mold. This suite got the job done but due to the previously mentioned things, was not the greatest. The host was quick to respond about the bathroom lights not working and was ready to provide a solution but I told him it would be fine for the duration of my stay since I did not want to be bothered.

It was a terrible experience. First of all the instructions for check in are sooo complicated. We were lost and tried to reach out to the host. We were already late for our concert and the host failed to explain the check in instructions. Kept copy pasting the unclear instructions that were in description as if we couldn’t see in the listing already. Secondly, the place is literally the size of a box and overpriced with no AC or Tv. The laundry from previous people was left behind. It was so stressful and frustrating.

Title: Disappointing Stay – No Response from Host
Review:
Our first Airbnb experience was awful: black mold in the shower, water leaks, no towels, and no garbage instructions. We reported everything to the host, but they never responded—even to this day. Airbnb Ireland UC tried to help, but the silence and high cost made this an expensive, frustrating lesson. I cannot recommend this property.

Unfortunately, our stay was a very disappointing experience. The place is in urgent need of renovation and maintenance. As soon as we entered, there was a strong, musty and moldy smell throughout the house, which made us uncomfortable right away.
The bathroom is very small, old, and there is only one bathroom for the entire place. The kitchen is also quite outdated. The flooring was damaged, and the beds were not comfortable. The pull-out sofa was stained and had an unpleasant smell, so we decided not to use it because we were concerned about cleanliness and hygiene.
The backyard/parking area was also very dirty and not inviting. The property is located on a busy, noisy main road, and the curtains were poorly hung and didn’t fully cover the windows, which was another concern, especially for privacy.
Overall, the property did not feel clean, comfortable, or well maintained, and in our opinion, it was definitely not worth the amount we paid for our stay.

Nicolette's house is very charming. It's spacious with a large master and nice size bathrooms. There are a lot of places to sit. The dock is on a rather small stagnant body of water so it's not that useful. The kitchen is big and spacious but it was not clean. We spent a few minutes cleaning the counters and the fridge from spills and then we were very happy. She has tons of knicknacks that added to the charm but there was a lot of dust.  The outdoor patio is fabulous but like the other areas not clean enough. The linens and bathrooms were fresh and clean. She is very generous with her linen and towels and everything was well stocked. Overall we had a positive experience but I'd make sure that it is cleaned well before booking again.

We enjoyed the great view, the comfortable beds, the washer and dryer, and the local area. The host was responsive and friendly until an issue came up.
The bathroom floor was dirty at check in, and even after the cleaner came the next morning it was still visibly dirty — a quick wipe with damp tissue picked up dirt and hair. When we returned later that day, the front door had been left unlocked. The bathroom door was also very heavy and difficult to open, with scratch marks from prior attempts; adding a handle would help. Also, once you enter the building you have about thirty seconds to get on the elevator and press the button for the thirty fifth floor or it won’t work.
After I sent photos, the host said they had made every reasonable effort and directed me to Airbnb. I provided Airbnb with additional photos of other areas that weren’t clean, and Airbnb issued a partial refund. The situation took time away from our trip.

Unfortunately, this stay was extremely disappointing and the listing was very misleading. The space looked nothing like the photos or description. From the moment we arrived, there was a strong food odor throughout the home. The house itself was uncomfortably hot, and the bedroom had a damp, musty smell. The carpet in the room was in very poor condition and appeared not to have been properly cleaned ever!
Communication with the host was also a major issue he was largely unresponsive throughout the stay and did not provide assistance when we needed help finding things in the unit.
Additionally, the living room room was occupied overnight by someone sleeping on the couch and snoring loudly. Since our room was upstairs, we had to walk past this area repeatedly, which felt extremely uncomfortable and inappropriate for paying guests.
Overall, this experience did not meet basic expectations for cleanliness, comfort, or communication. I would not recommend this host or property.

The appartement was very clean, bed linens were fresh and the bathroom was tidy. All listed amenities were present. Check in was good, a staff member was waiting for us when we arrived. The area is very rough, and is unsafe even in the day time. At night, it is even less safe to walk outside. The building was very noisy at night. A lot of sirens and disturbances, making it hard to relax. An alarm when off at 1.30 am and stayed on for at least 10 minutes. It disrupted sleep and was very loud. As there wasn’t a safe area outside of the building, if the alarm was a real emergency evacuation would have been unsafe. This is a major safety concern. Check out was easy, and convenient.

Zero stars for host compassion, flexibility, and habitability.
We booked a 91-day off-season stay for my mother in this very old building. We found bugs throughout; host called them harmless and offered pest control, but we declined due to vacating requirements and managed with sprays instead. The stay was acceptable until circumstances changed.
We requested a two-week extension, then immediately asked to revert back due to my mother’s documented medical emergency. Host refused outright despite no business loss, no alternative bookings affected, and my immediate revert request—pure policy weaponization with zero humanity.
Forced to research my rights during this crisis, we discovered the listing likely violates Vancouver’s principal residence requirements. Filed formal City complaint while dealing with this heartless situation.
Made a genuine crisis far more stressful through rigid enforcement. Stay away unless you want technicalities over people. Would never book again.

We rented this apartment through Airbnb and were extremely disappointed with our stay. The cleanliness was unacceptable—there was urine in the toilet that had not been flushed, and the bed sheets were dirty, with visible stains and hair. Despite indicating that we were a group of four, only one towel was provided, and we couldn’t locate additional towels or sheets. The host informed us late at night that extra sheets were in the sofa bed, but by then, we had already gone to sleep, and no additional towels were ever provided.
The location was also problematic. It is situated above a subway and on a busy street, making it incredibly noisy, especially since the windows were not noise-insulated. None of us could sleep well.
While I have previously rented another unit in the same building that was fantastic, this one was a terrible experience. I would not recommend this place.

EXCELLENT location, directly across from Rogers Arena & within walking distance of restaurants, shopping and entertainment. Building security was a bit excessive but much appreciated. Very disappointed with the constant noise the skytrain directly outside the building made all day and night. Also disappointed that the feedback I provided on day 1 was not corrected: I explained that of the few hangers provided, most were broken and very flimsy and that the body wash bottle was empty, but no effort to come and replace either was made. Nor was there enough toilet paper provided for our 3 adult 7 day stay. Appreciated the parking space that came with the unit but it’s very small/tight. I’m glad we drove the sedan and not the SUV; that would’ve been problematic. The house rules were rigid but we adhered to them all, despite the neighbors disregard for us with their smoking and late night partying. The unit sleeps 3 at best: 2 adults/1 child. The living room sofa was very uncomfortable.

location was great. renter had caretaker communication.  unfortunately the cost of one night was through the roof, especially when we had to clean it in order to feel comfortable enough for our baby to stay. dirty AC, stick food on remnants on cupboards, crumbs in beds, dirty bathtub, unswept floors. aside from the cleanliness, the unit was very nice and super convenient.

✅ Strong points
- BEAUTIFUL view
- BEAUTIFUL rooftop access
- Great spot, not sketchy
- Easy access to transportation (there's a bus stop on the corner)
- Near a pharmacy, subway, McDonald's, little market, etc.
- Beautiful airbnb - big windows and amazing view, modern, great decoration
❌ Negative points
- If you're a neat freak like me, the small things will drive you crazy. The bathroom wasn't clean (hair in the tub, dust on the toilet) kitchen wasn't great either (dirty dishes inside the cabinets, streaks on the wall) and the bedroom was not perfect either (dust under bed, dust in the corners)... overall not very clean. I had to vacuum and clean everything myself

The place is conveniently located. It is walking distance to grocery store, Skytrain station , False Creek seawall and downtown with plenty of good restaurants around.
Checkin & checkout instructions are simple and clear. The hosts are friendly, responsive and flexible.
5 of us stayed comfortably in the unit. It has clean bedrooms, bathroom and kitchen. However the espresso machine was not cleaned and full of used pods. The dryer filter was not cleaned either. The patio door couldn’t close/lock.
Other than that, we had a good time staying at unit.

Unbelievable host! I was in a pinch and she was responding within seconds at 3am just to help me. Very accommodating! She saved my trip from being a complete nightmare with the horrible Airbnb I had booked earlier with Moshin in the same building (AVOID AT ALL COSTS!)

The place is great! It had all the appliances and was well maintained. We asked the host for an early check in as we were landing early morning in Vancouver and the host was kind enough to let us keep our bags till we waited for the scheduled time. We had a rough check in as the host was unresponsive, I believe he is in a different time zone and the host uses a portal of his own to manage the instructions for check in which was also unresponsive at the time we reached, so we had to find a coffee shop and carry our bags till we finally were able to access the portal and check in. Besides, we really enjoyed staying here and if we ever get a chance we shall book it again in the future.

The house is conveniently located near downtown and many other attractions, which was a big plus. However, we were disappointed with our overall experience.
There were no instructions about where to park. When I asked, the host simply texted, "Hi, here will be the garage key," without providing any additional guidance.
We also encountered several issues during our stay. The TV was not working, and only one light in the first-floor bathroom worked. The upstairs sleeping area had very low ceilings, and my husband hit his head on the ceiling several times. The shower was also extremely small and uncomfortable to use.
Basic supplies that we expected were not provided. The kitchen felt old and outdated, and the rug was dirty. In addition, there was a strong food odor coming from the ground floor throughout our stay.
Considering we paid $710.76 per night, we expected a much better-maintained property and a more comfortable experience. Unfortunately, the house did not meet our expectation

Beautiful and spacious home, great for 5 people! Although the sofa bed doesn’t extend, my friends and I all had a very comfortable stay. I enjoyed how the beds were on the firmer side and each room was equipped with AC which was quite optimal for sleep! The gasket of the washing machine was dirty and a bit smelly but can be resolved with a quick clean. Other than that, the showers had good water pressure and Summer was very helpful and responsive when we had issues with the alarm system. She was a great host and I would stay here again.

Very unclean with hairs in bath and sink, unhoovered floors, partially eaten food in fridge and freezer. Fridge had spilt food in it and all shelves were dirty. Oven was dirty, microwave was dirty, dish drying rack was very dirty. Armchairs were covered in crumbs, desk cup holder had moulded substance in it. Hairs on duvet.
We left soon after we arrived because of this.
Also, would like to say that Airbnb support were fantastic at dealing with the issue and were very timely with there response and help.

BEWARE of this Host (Lea)!
Our experience with this host was extremely disappointing and very stressful. Lea’s communication was rude and accusatory. She repeatedly misinterpreted Airbnb’s policies, insisting that even brief daytime visitors counted as “additional guests,” despite our booking being fully compliant.
During our stay, a couple of friends briefly stopped by, and Lea, who appeared to be monitoring her cameras, sent aggressive messages demanding explanations. I clarified that we understood “number of guests” to refer to overnight occupants. We did not host a party—we were traveling with our infant, and I was attending a research conference.
Lea also kept referring to our infant (under 2 years) as a guest, which added to the tension. Several basic amenities, such as a dish scraper and compost bags, were also missing. We just purchased them ourselves to avoid Lea.
If you value privacy, respect, and a stress-free experience, I strongly recommend avoiding this listing.

Very disappointing stay overall. First, the host accused me of breaking a cheap plastic piece that was already damaged before I arrived, wasting almost 2 hours of my trip dealing with messages and accusations instead of enjoying my stay.
The air conditioning also didn’t work, so the windows had to stay open the entire time. Unfortunately, the balcony is extremely close to the ground in an area where there were drug users and dealers constantly hanging around right outside. It did not feel comfortable or relaxing at all.
On top of that, the host kept messaging me all night accusing me of marijuana smells coming from the apartment. I rolled one joint and left the building, and with everything going on directly outside the balcony, the smell easily could have been coming from there as well.
Overall, the experience felt stressful, uncomfortable, and unprofessional. I would not recommend staying here.

Mauricio and Rich were very easy to communicate with when we had issues. The location and overall apartment size was great.
However, the only issues I had was that the apartment was very cluttered and also very dusty and dirty in certain areas. It was extremely dirty especially around the vents.
Everything else was good. Just for the dishwasher, we asked to get it fixed, but it never got fixed. That was another issue.

There were three problems. First, the faucet in the bathroom sink delivered only a small dribble of water, making it unusable. The manager acknowledged the problem and stated it would be fixed, but that was the last we heard until checkout when we received an automated massage to the effect of "we hope you enjoyed your stay." In sum, communication was great until there was a problem, then nothing. Also: how could the cleaning staff have not noticed this problem and reported it to management?
Second, the kitchen is basically unusable. It's good for making coffee (buy your own Keurig pods, there were only two in the kitchen), and microwaving leftovers. One could not actually cook a meal there. The frying pans were old, scratched, dirty non-stick pans that were way beyond their useable life - use at your own risk, but I wouldn't.
Third, a number of other maintenance issues: The bathroom fan needs repair, the ceiling fan is filthy, etc. It just looks like no one ever inspects.

We unfortunately had to check out early this morning due to our experience. The unit was extremely noisy throughout the night — noise from neighboring buildings and heavy traffic on busy roads made it impossible for any of us to sleep. This level of noise was not disclosed in the listing.
In addition, we encountered several cleanliness issues. There was a cockroach on the kitchen countertop, standing water accumulated in the dishwasher, the bed linens and comforter had an unpleasant odor, and there were food crumbs underneath the sofa bed.Because of these concerns, we decided to cut our stay short and checked out this morning instead of staying until tomorrow.That said, we appreciate that the host responded promptly and agreed to refund one full night and 30% of the first night. We are thankful for the resolution and hope the concerns mentioned above are addressed for future guests.
The apartment is a cool but very hard to get into and unclear. windows are dirty, toilet seat was broken and shower tap is partway stuck. Wanted a refund before staying here but wasn't available

What was good: We loved the location! There were so many fun places to go and everything was super walkable (even further places about a mile a way were easily walked to!) The nightlife was amazing, there was a club playing music that we could hear from the apartment, and it was just so lively once it got dark out! It also felt very safe when walking home late at night which was a really nice bonus! The view from the apartment was also amazing! Chan was kind enough to leave us towels and some books on vancouver! He was very responsive and very helpful throughout our entire stay.
What could use some work: The place was a little bit dirty, but by dirty I mean dirt on the windowsills, bleach stains on the bedding, a few stains on the couch, etc. Overall we felt pretty comfortable there! The instructions to get in the building and back to the parking garage definitely need to be more clear, it was very hard to find our way around the building.

I stayed at Nick & Tracy's place with 6 seniors over an August weekend. In general, their place is very nice and clean.

Unfortunately, there were a few issues noticed at check-in (only 4 mugs, pull-out couch not working, trouble finding enough towels).
