I let them know late in the evening of check-in, and although I didn't need a solution immediately, they did not respond to my messages until 7:30pm the NEXT night, and they showed up at the suite door at 11:15pm. In addition, the master bed broke the first night, and I would have appreciated some acknowledgement before the second evening. Honestly, better communication would have solved all of the distress we felt at the suite being not as advertised.
I will say that once they were able to--halfway through our stay--they worked hard to fix various issues that came up, but having to wait for so long for a response was disappointing. I do believe they are trying their best, but their lifestyle does not allow for prompt care of guests.

Not the warmest welcome as I was immediately told to pick up all of my luggage and shoes and walk them through the house to the back door. This could have been mitigated by her walking me around to the back door so I felt like less of an intruder with over-filled hands. Or, she could have offered to help. Some cleanliness challenges demonstrating the bathroom may not have been attended to since the prior guest (dirty glass, hair in sink and tub, thicker dust in some areas that haven't been addressed for some time), but Emily addressed these right away. The bedroom was tidy and sheets appeared clean. The view of the mountains were lovely and once the bathroom was tidied, I had everything I needed for a good night's rest.

Terry was such an amazing host. He was very responsive and all instructions were crystal clear. The appt has a breath taking view however, E hastings street is one of the worst streets in vancouver. Tens of homeless people doing drugs in broad day light. We did not feel safe at all. I wouldn’t recommend it to any solo travelers or any female travelers.
We loved the appt, our only take was that the washing machine and dryer are very loud.

Terry’s place is lively on the inside & had everything you need. However, the neighbor felt unsafe. I did not spend the night there. There were MANY drug users on the streets, the uber driver wouldn’t let us off in front of the building bc of safety. I booked another place and moved.
More concerning to me was Terry’s response when I texted him we were not staying- I didn’t ask for a refund bc it is my fault I didn’t look up the crime stats for the address. Terry called me and told me Vancouver handles the fentanyl problem differently- services are put on the streets & there is a drug check place within the block. That no guns are allowed like in the US. All of that may be true, but that doesn’t change how his conversation made me feel as a female traveler & how I felt about my safety staying in his place.

Extremely Disappointing Stay – Poor Standards and Misleading Advertising
My recent stay at Ralph’s apartment in Vancouver was highly unsatisfactory and fell well below acceptable standards for short-term accommodation.
Upon arrival, it was immediately apparent that the property was not as described in the listing. The apartment was not clean. The Crockery was dirty and had to be washed prior to us using them
Soiled dish rags had been left for guest use, which was both inappropriate and unhygienic.
The portable air conditioner provided was entirely inadequate, and as a result, the apartment remained uncomfortably hot throughout our stay. Despite being advertised as having blackout curtains, the windows were only fitted with old, unclean blinds that did not reach the bottom of the frame, offering neither proper privacy nor effective light.

Worst Airbnb experience I’ve ever had. We booked this place specifically for the pool and hot tub, and the host never mentioned they were out of service before our arrival. When we got there, the pool had actual human feces in it and the hot tub didn’t work at all.
Inside the apartment was filthy: hair, dust, bugs, blood on the bedsheets, and open, expired food left throughout the kitchen. Everything in the apartment felt cheap, flimsy, and looked like it was ordered straight off of Temu.
After I requested a partial refund, the host instantly became hostile and retaliatory. They made up false claims, including saying we “damaged” a chair when the wooden dowels literally just popped out from normal use. They also accused us of having “unapproved guests” even though our booking listed four people and we had exactly four.
The worst part was the host trying to blackmail us by saying they’d drop their bogus charges only if we left a positive review.
Avoid this listing completely.

This host is absolutely awful and completely unhelpful. I asked multiple times about accessing EV charging, after getting my messages ignored for several day, the only response I got was ‘P1’—for a massive parking lot. No specifics, no effort, nothing. Even after following up repeatedly, they clearly couldn’t be bothered to give a proper answer. Found out through other property staff that the charger is located in a restricted area, so this host was making a false advertisement.
The host says on the listing saying reach out so they can keep a 5 star review yet provides this kind of behavior. The lack of communication and basic decency is beyond unacceptable. If you’re looking for a host who actually cares about their guests, do yourself a favor and stay far away from this one. Worst hosting experience I’ve ever had, and I've also escalated this matter to the Airbnb.
Also not very well put together and did not place shampoo in the bathroom but rather 1 body wash and 2 conditioner.

Beware of false advertising on this listing. The apartment itself was fine despite a few broken things in the room (shower head, etc), but those were all manageable.
The host advertises that there is an EV charger and that there is a sauna and gym. Neither of these are true. The parking garage has 0 chargers. When asked, the host said that he said there are EV chargers available because they are in the neighborhood.
He also advertises that it comes with a full gym, sauna, pool. This is also somewhat false advertising, as these are not included. They are an additional $25 per person per day to use any of those amenities. You are locked out of there without paying that.
Deceptive advertising.

Thie bathroom in this Airbnb is COMPLETELY covered in mold. You can smell the strong mildew odour immediately when you walk in and see spores growing all over the walls and  window sills. There was a sinister attempt to cover it up by painting over it, which does NOT eliminate the health hazard. She also had a dehumidifier set up with a sign that says "don't turn off" which did absolutely nothing. When I reached out to the host about the issue, she chose to ignore me. It's pretty obvious that she was aware of the issue beforehand and chose to continue renting the place out. Clearly she puts making money above peoples' health and safety. Shameful. I brought my 17 month-old baby here and did NOT feel comfortable bathing him in that bathroom . My brother had lung irritation from breathing it in. We are beyond angry. The host's lack of care is disgusting. This listing needs to be taken down.

First of all the ad is listed as luxury apartment. Its Christmas so i paid 800$ for 2 nights. When i check-in and go to the bedroom, i notice a strong smell of vinegar. Clutter all underneath the couches with food and drink spilled. When i contacted the host, he asked me to clean up the mess that was left from other guests. I had to leave on Christmas day because the place was so dirty. I open a cabinet in the kitchen i see mold and hair aswell. Terrible host and terrible experience. Glad airbnb provide me a refund

1. Prospective Guests shouldn’t have to mine for details from reviews. The bed is not a true king size bed. It’s two twin size IKEA beds, which are substantially shorter than a king size. Previous guests have commented on the bed size mismatch and the hosts did not update the description accordingly. The hosts and I did discuss the bed size fit for me (6’1) well in advance. But, it turns out also, the mattress depth is rather thin and I found myself waking up in the middle of the night pressing against the frame. I wouldn’t recommend the bed for anyone taller than 6’1, or 185cm.
2. I was woken up at 3 AM in the morning by a CO alarm beep and and very loud low battery message. This is an appliance the hosts are responsible for maintaining, and the event was preventable. It’s not so much the alarm but how they responded: Upon letting them know they did not apologize (promptly) or offer at least a partial refund. I had to request compensation. All in all I enjoyed visiting Vancouver.

Great place.  Lovely top floor amenities.  Very walkable and amazing places to eat around.   Extra stop for the key wasn’t my favorite but not horrible.   Ankit was very responsive with questions or requests including flight delay issues.  Just know that if you have bad knees or other issues and getting up off something low the master bed is very low and difficult for this to get up out of.  The 2nd bedroom has only a full size bed which made our sleeping arrangements a challenge but not horrible

BEWARE of this listing.
This is my third time visiting Vancouver and staying at this apartment building. We had innumerable problems with this Airbnb. The “convenience store” to collect the keys is actually a filthy tobacco shop. They did not provide us with a parking garage opener or a second key. Had to park across the street for one day. Their parking instructions say spot 95 but they left out that there is also 95T. My car was towed from this spot. Ankit said this had happened before but they never provided the correct instructions. The stove did not work and they lied that the gas was off in the building.
Airbnb enforced their air cover policy to refund me 30% of the nights fee. They also had to refund me for the towing fee, Lyft to the towing lot, and the parking fee across the street. Ankit tried to intimidate me and say that if I told Airbnb about this he would not refund anything. I have screenshots to prove this.
We love Vancouver but would NEVER stay with Ankit again.

When we got there we had no towels - the pillows were flat and the room was stuffy . There was a fan in the space but it was very dirty and we couldn’t use it . Nothing in the space made it seem homey or beautiful . The yard was very unkept and to get inside we went down dingy cement stairs . It was not welcoming and difficult for us over 60 yrs .
I would not recommend this place sadly

Buyer Beware! This place should not be a short term rental. I wouldn’t let a family member stay here for free. What a dump! Janine and Harry seemed great, and I’m a sorry to mess with their side hustle, but this seems more for someone young, poor, and/or desperate. At least they’ll have seen it and know what they’re buying.
Main bed is terrible and the other (futon) is broken and stuck in the couch position. There are holes in the floor and walls, some patched, some not.
The shower had so much red bacteria and mold, we refused to use it.
All in all, the worst AirB&B stay experience I’ve ever had. If I’d had any other options, I would have left and stayed somewhere else.

We were disappointed by the lack of communication and several issues during our stay. The garage would not open when we arrived or later that evening, and it was often blocked by a tenant’s vehicle. The host said he would fix it, but never did. The alternate parking area also felt unsafe due to garbage,hornets and rats.Neighbors and tenants gave conflicting information about which garage was ours, and the tenants repeatedly asked for the access code, which made us uncomfortable. We were also not told the backyard was shared, and the tenants smoked hookah and left garbage there despite no-smoking signs. Overall, the parking problems, shared-space issues, and poor communication significantly affected our stay.

The apartment itself is fine on the inside.l with decent amenities. However, the location is terrible, surrounded by excessive amounts of homeless people and drug users injecting themselves right outside the entry door. Every morning the streets outside would be covered in used needles, garbage and reek of urine.  Additionally there was a night where the hot water turned off and neither the hosts or the caretakers we were in contact with knew about this or knew when the water was coming back on. We were given no prior notice and no solution to this issue was provided when in communication with them. When we entered the apartment there was a strong smell of mildew coming from the towels and the sheets were black with white stains on them, very disappointing. We had to wash the towels ourselves due to the smell with a practically empty bottle of washing detergent provided. The air conditioning unit is not built in, but is attached to the open window letting in excessive outside noise.

Wilson was helpful and quick to reply to our questions about the thermostat. Although the unit is on the smaller side, the size was good for two people and a small dog.
We did have some issues with the cleanliness of the place. The cutlery was dirty (had leftover food on it) on arrival which was pretty off putting. The blinds (especially in the kitchen) appeared dusty and had mold-like stains. For a large cleaning fee, we expected a cleaner living space.
Overall, a good smaller space in a good location.

Very noticeable smell throughout unit. Two boxes from tower fans but only one box, no AC (wasn’t mentioned at all in description), very moldy smell in bathroom. All window frames were filthy. Two fan boxes but only one fan for two rooms. Felix took forever to communicate back.

The most important thing to know is that this place is not worth the price.
I’ve stayed at many Airbnbs around the world, and this is my first negative review.
When we arrived, the shade wouldn’t go up, and since the view is a key selling point, this was a major issue. After spending half an hour trying to fix it, I messaged the host, who admitted he knew it was broken but didn’t tell us. He had no plans to fix it until I requested a partial refund, at which point he suddenly began trying to get it fixed.
The bathroom fixtures were falling apart, and only one towel per person was provided, which had to double as a pool towel—far from high-end standards. It was too hot and stuffy in the summer.
As noted in other reviews, using the elevator was a nightmare, often resulting in long waits and overcrowding.
This property does not justify the price being asked.

We were a bit disappointed in price versus decor and yard maintenance.
Basically compared to other higher end Airbnbs it felt like a college dorm.
Bits and pieces of IKEA dishes, sketchy kitchen utensils, no coffee mugs, no regular size coffee pot. Yard in back had broken putting green and visible mess under porch and dead plants in the front. No grill.
For $6900.00 3 nights - it was surprising to see old fake flowers etc.

Hello, you need to maintain your property - I had the most horrible experience in an air b and b. The dryer doesn’t work and your washer smells horrible. Overall your house had an smell that would not go away. Blankets and couch also was dirty and over used. I had to wash blankets and put it over anything I would sit on. Property is located in an scary area. All of the cutlery is so old and disgustingly over used. You need to take care of your place that was not right at all. The place was also freezing!!!!

There's mold stains in corners of the room, this host was reluctant to give me a key to place, toldd me I had to wait the next day for keys, also address give on Airbnb was not the exact address, when i tried to order my good the order went to another location with the same space. Also the bathroom is a shared bathroom,  shared as in the whole building is using the same bathroom. Nothing like it was advertised, it stated on airbnb that this was a 2 bedroom / 2 bed suite, well it was 1 bed/ 1 bedroom with mosquitoes in it. I was truly disappointed  ended  up leaving with an hour of check-in.

This was one of the few times I relied heavily on Airbnb’s recommendations and the many positive reviews. The building is modern, the apartment feels new, Fiona was always responsive and helpful, and the swimming pool is excellent.
Unfortunately, the apartment did not meet our expectations. The location is not among Vancouver’s best, with most attractions about a 25 minute walk away. The surrounding area is also visibly affected by the opioid crisis, making it feel uncomfortable at times.
We found several cleanliness issues, including used dental floss under the sofa, a cigarette in the bedroom, wrinkled sheets left in the washing machine, and two small cockroaches in the bathroom.
The apartment is also very noisy due to nearby trains and loud portable AC units. The curtains do not block the morning light well, and there were not enough pool towels.
Overall, I would not recommend this apartment, as it did not match the listing or the overwhelmingly positive reviews.

DO NOT STAY HERE AT ANY COST - airbnb gave us a refund bc of how bad it was
Multiple wasps in several different window sills all over the place. This place is genuinely infested.
Place smells like poop
Toilet has stains of poop on the seat, thus indicating that the place was most likely not cleaned
Place says that there's AC but there's only a small unit in the living room which is not as advertised and that unit itself blows air that smells bad. Additionally window is not closed properly where the unit is installed creating about a square foot sized hole in the house that cannot be closed. Thus letting bugs/possible intruders in easily
No toilet paper provided in one of the washrooms
No hand towels in washrooms
Place itself is in bad repair
There are spider webs in many of the window sills
3 people started breaking into hives upon sitting on the couch
Couch is stained
Under the beds have used paper towels/ toilet paper and one has a half drank Gatorade bottle undern

The host was kind and allowed us to check in before the official check-in time. However, although the apartment had been prepared for us, it was generally not clean. There was a bad smell, and the dishes and kitchen were dirty. There was mold in the washing machine and in the shower. The shower doors were broken, and the TV did not work. The doors did not close properly, so there was a lot of noise from the street.
Overall, the apartment was poorly maintained and did not meet our expectations in terms of cleanliness and condition.

I'd never recommend this place for two major reasons.
- BAD SMELL. The balcony faces a back alley full of awful mixed smell of human pee, heated trash, and marijuana. The room is filled with bad smell and 3 flies. We had to close the sliding door to prevent more smell and files getting into the room. There is not AC in the room for ventilation, so we had to suffer until our noses got used to the smell. All the 5-star ratings are from March and before, so be aware of the smell if you plan to book during warmer months.
- Unsafe. The neighborhood has a lot of homeless people and drug users on the street. A homeless knocked on the windshield and yelled while I was waiting in the car for my husband to return the fob to the apartment. I'm glad I have a good habit of locking up when the vehicle is idling.

Stayed at Vancouver for a weekend and the apartment was perfect for the trip. It was at a great location to walk to fun areas around downtown. However, the immediate area was a little sketchy so I don't recommend staying out too late around the area. That being said, I thought the whole experience was excellent for the price and the nice apartment. Kieran was an exceptional host. He provided very clear instructions, was quick to respond, and went above and beyond in service. We had a minor issue where the shower curtains smelled upon check-in, but Kieran was able to resolve it quickly. Would definitely stay here again next time I visit Vancouver.

The check-in ruined everything, I requested an early check in and received confirmation that it was approved.
I showed up shortly after the approved time and Flora became very upset with me saying that I was early, I explained to her that I requested the early check in time and would show her the approval.
She didn't want to see it, she was upset and was yelling at me and being very rude.
I told her that I would be happy to leave if she gave me my money back since I was so uncomfortable.
Her husband came over and they spoke in Chinese for a while and then finally she just told me to go to my room.
I was not allowed to use the bathroom for a while since they said it wasn't ready.
That was the only communication I had from them, it was very uncomfortable and I wish I had stayed in a hotel.
The room really needs a painting, the walls are kind of dirty gray with lots of scuff marks. The blinds do not keep out light and the door is very thin. Any noise from the apartment is heard

Firstly l want to express my disappointment on this place. The house was very dirty when l arrived showing that it was not even cleaned. There was a terrible smell in the kitchen which felt like something was rotten for ages. The fridge was not cleaned and it smelled very bad. The floors were very dirty with hair and stains everywhere. The bathroom was an utter mess! The toilet seat had urine stains that showed it had not been cleaned for days if not weeks, the bathroom rugs had stains and were smelling terrible, the shower was dirty that l couldn’t even stand showering in there.
I could not believe that someone could expect people to pay so much and come to stay in those unhygienic conditions.
I literally had to cancel my stay and moved to a new Airbnb as l could not stand the mess and the smell coming from the whole place.
However, l must say Anthony did allow me an early check-in which was very kind of him.

Beautiful apartment with incredible views. Would recommend if you plan for a quiet stay in the heart of the city. Would not recommend if you're looking for a stress-free check in and stay or if you are looking for two workable beds. The host was responsive and kind, but the check in process was lengthy, convoluted, and required going to a second location in the city to retrieve keys - a fun little scavenger hunt, but stressful to do without transportation. To be fair, check-in instructions are given a few days in advance with the option to receive a refund if found disagreeable. The apartment itself is ideal for a couple looking for convenience, unbeatable views, and to experience the hum and energy of the city. Not ideal for multiple people as the second bedroom is not as pictured and is difficult to maneuver in and the building discourages the presence of short term occupants so excessive noise is discouraged. Overall, the views were unforgettable.

The apartment was in a good location, and spacious. The kitchen didn't have a lot of basic things, such as drinking glasses. The back balcony was basically unusable because of a giant tarp coming from the roof of the building. Also, one of the main reasons I booked was for the fantastic view. Unfortunately, a building was built obstructing the view almost completely. Not the host's fault, but the listing mentioned the fantastic view and a photo taken before the building was built, so I feel like this is very misleading. It was also very hot in the apartment. Two portable A/C units we're provided for each room, but they were not installed, so we had to open the window and stick their exhausts out the window. A few other things I didn't like but ultimately didn't matter too much was the shower in one of the bedrooms and peeling tiles and looks terrible/dirty. And the patio door was cracked and fixed with duct tape.

I had a great time staying at the apartment for 2 weeks.
People here in the review talk about downtown being a sketchy area a lot and I feel like that is a bit unjustified.
Sure, there's addiction in the area and if you walk around, you will see open drug consumption but I never felt unsafe walking around the neighborhood.
If you don't want to run into that stuff just don't walk down the main road and you don't have to worry about it at all. Literally just the parallel road, 20m away from East Hastings and that's enough.
Worst thing that'll happen is someone asking for some spare change and if you give them a few bucks, you might just change their day for the better.
Anyways, fully recommend the flat, had a great time and communication was always super quick!
5/5 all the way!

Very nice apartment with fully equipped kitchen. Convenient parking. Fairly ok location.
Do not book if you’re very noise sensitive (busy road). We would not recommend walking downtown, because it felt unsafe. If you head into town via public transport take the R5 line, as the other lines tended to have scary people aboard.
But all in all, we enjoyed our stay and appreciated the spacious apartment.

We had a great stay here.
Communication about check in and check out was easy.
It’s a nice building, has a clean entrance, and it felt safe. The immediate area where it’s located is fine and safe.
The apartment itself was great for our needs. It is much smaller than what the pictures make it look like though, but it still worked well for us.
The kitchen well well stocked with utensils and some basic ingredients.
The bed frames were a bit wonky but still quite comfortable.
The apartment has a lot of natural light since it has huge windows and a wide view.
Things were mostly very clean, apart from small things like the stove top, which could have received a bit more love, and the kettle which was also a bit dirty. The thing that really bothered me though was the trash bin in the kitchen - it was very dirty. Had to disinfect the lid with detol as soon as we arrived.
Overall though, a positive experience, and would recommend.

I misread the listing and didn’t realize parking wasn’t included. When I messaged the host for parking info, she  said it wasn’t included. I mentioned it was unclear in the listing and suggested making it easier to find as it was in a long list of amenities. She responded by saying she contacted Airbnb to “teach me how to read,” which felt rude. When I told her she wasn’t being helpful, then she threatened not to let me into the unit for “abusive behavior.” Then didnt respond for 30 minutes. As a young woman this caused a lot of stress as I didn't know if I had a place to stay. I had to park two blocks away in a 2-hour zone and risk a ticket and it was very hard to find parking. On the second night, I parked behind the building in a back alley (where she suggested) and my car was broken into and the window was smashed. The apartment itself had dirty walls and a bad smell. Overall, I felt unsafe and disrespected. The host was defensive and sensitive about me voicing a concern.

The apartment was very clean, well setup and comfortable, with great communication. Would stay again if it was just with my wife. However the description of "fun with the whole family"  I wouldn't agree with, as we felt pretty unsafe trying to unload our luggage and struggle to get inside with our <5 kids with multiple drugged out homeless walking past us. Getting off the local bus 2 blocks away found us in the middle of homeless central with hundreds taking up the footpath. Would be fine for adults who weren't forced to use public transport because of car-seats. I'm a 6ft3 adult male who felt unsafe to go back to the Tim Hortons across the road after my first experience. Sirens going past every night. Also we frequently had marijuana smell coming in through the air conditioning and had to turn it off.

Check in instructions were good, easy to get in. Good location. The unit was clean and adequate. It was very warm during our stay, and the one portable A/C unit was inadequate for the bedrooms. Fans were provided for each bedroom which was helpful. Opening the slider door helped as evening came to help cool the unit down. We only found 2 top sheets available for three beds. The rooms are small and beds are firm. Lighted was inadequate in master bath. There was a light burned out. Different lighting option is needed....very yellow. We did not need the parking spot. The pool and hot tub were very nice and appreciated! There is an outside balcony, but it was very dirty....needs attention. Overall, this was adequate for our needs, however, for the price paid I was a bit disappointed.

On our last night there someone walked into the rental after 9PM. I used the call the host feature in the app, no one answered and it went to a voicemail box that was not setup by the user. She said she was supposed to check in after 4, her reservation was for the next day. Why did someone have a code to get into the unit while we were still there? The code should be changed between each rental. If she had a different code the door wouldn't have opened and she would have called the host and realized the mistake. We felt unsafe knowing someone could just walk into the unit potentially creating an unsafe situation. If we weren't there someone could possibly steal our belongings. It was just a mix up but this should not happen. There was also a plastic bag over the smoke detector. That is another safety issue. Overall we enjoyed our stay but because of the safety problems I rated this rental 1 star.

Unfortunately, our stay was disappointing. We found someone’s hair on the sheets of all the beds, and two beds were missing a top sheet. Towels and duvets were damp, and the floors were really dirty and sticky.
We reached out to the host, Franklin, about these issues—especially to request clean sheets—but received no response for hours. He didn’t check in on us proactively, which added to the frustration.
The noise from downstairs, apparently the “cleaners”, was very disruptive. There were kids yelling and running around late. Despite messaging Franklin after 10 PM, and being told he’d ask them to quiet down, the noise continued and was loud enough to drown out our movie upstairs. While many reviews are for the basement suite, our stay was on the main floor. The noise carried so clearly into our space upstairs, that it felt like they were in the same unit.
Overall, the experience didn’t reflect the price we paid and felt like poor value for the money.

Neighborhood was very sketchy and be aware that there is a whole family living in the bottom half of house (apparently his cleaning crew) before you book. That information is not included in the listing. Loud crying from a child and no lock on the door to have privacy. Had to leave in the night once we heard them. When we called he was very defensive and rude unfortunately.
House was clean other than what I write in review.
Bugs in house and by the bed. Underwear was found on the porch. A needle and gloves were found on grass in front of house and house next door was creepy.

The check in process went well & was able to get into the unit with ease.   Parking is a bit of a disaster.  The unit is behind a house off a main road.  The unit is located in an alley & no parking.   Parking was across the main road on College.   Me & my friend dropped off our bags & headed out.   When we got back to the unit, after midnight, I was getting ready for bed & noticed a piece of hair on the pillow case.  I pulled the sheets back and there was a lot of human hair in the bed as if the linen wasn't changed & dog hair on the comforter.  I contacted Hong & didn't get a response, so I reached out to Airbnb, to request clean sheets. The 1st rep was rude and told me to get a hotel and it's the host perogative to have a "clean property" and theyd refund me 30%. Hong finally reached out, told me there's nothing they could do until the morning & I can use the blanket.  Not acceptable.  I spoke to a supervisor and got a full refund.  0 stars and I DO NOT recommend..
Okay for a night. Wouldn’t recommend more than one. Host never responds. Linen and sheets smell used. Mould and grout on bathroom shower floor edges. No water bottles, no microwave.

Property was clean and located in a nice area. Spotted many people taking a stroll or walking their dogs in all times of the day, even past 11pm. Parking is by permit only directly in front of the property but there is free parking around the corner if you're lucky enough to get one. If not you may just have to park a couple blocks away.
Place itself is on the cleaner side but there was some black substance in the bathtub. Not sure if it was mold or not but I didn't bother getting close enough to check. Towels are a bit smelly. Either the washer may need a deep cleaning or the towels just need to be replaced. Bed was comfy and the location had plenty of space for two people.
Lastly, I'm sure if you've read enough reviews of this property you would know that there has been a lot of noise complaints. I decided to take the risk and sure enough there was music playing from upstairs from 11pm and even woke up to it at 6am the next morning. It was bearable but I'm a heavy sleeper. BEWARE.

Perhaps I didn’t read the listing conditions carefully. The title says “new,” but the housing condition is far from “new.” It is quite an old building.
The worst part is the location. The building is situated on a main street, and the bedrooms are just a wall away from the street. When a car drives by quickly, I was suddenly awakened by the noise and couldn't fall back asleep for a long time. The host does provide fans that produce loud white noise, which helps a little bit. However, if you are a light sleeper like me, don’t stay here.
The apartment does not have a washing machine (and, of course, no dryer). This is quite inconvenient if you are staying for more than a couple of days. no dishwasher (I assumed there would be one and didn’t read the listing carefully). When I washed dishes, the sink started to leak. The host sent a plumber here during our stay. the circuit breaker tripped when I used the hairdryer in the bedroom, and the shower water turned cold after a while.

We could not get into our room as the key was not left, so had to call airbnb for help. We ended up in a hotel at midnight and got into shirins place the next day. We never received a proper apology for this.
When we got in, the wifi did not work, there were no bedsheets, towels & only half a toilet paper roll. Shirin provided sheets and small towels quickly.
The bathroom and bedroom are nice light spaces.
The apartment is shared with three long term tenants who were welcoming and made us feel at home. However, staying in an airbnb within these residents' home made us feel uncomfortable.
Kitchen was unclean and had minimal equipment, dishwasher was mouldy. We informed Shirin of this, a week later it was cleaned. There is no communal space except the kitchen.
The listing mentions dedicated workspace but this is just a desk in bedroom.
The bed is extremely uncomfortable and pillows were paper thin. We requested additional pillows but Shirin declined.

This property is in a great location. The host is generally responsive and check-in/checkout instructions were clear.
However, there is a significant lack of attention to detail:
- living room area rug was very dirty and covered in hair
- most blinds did not open/close
- of the 4 types of cooking oils found in the kitchen cabinets, all were expired
- shower curtain had spots of mold and was slimy to the touch
- toaster had a foreign plug and was unusable
- holes in the bathroom wall where a ring for a hand towel used to be
- last but not least, the bed was broken. The box spring at the foot of bed was so bent, it was nearly touching the ground and we could feel that we were sleeping at an angle. We informed the host of this upon arrival but received no acknowledgement of that message.
We were disappointed to have spent this kind of money on a poor experience. We would have left early but didn't want to drag our infant through the city in search of new lodging.

First I'll explain why we have 4 stars as that's why people check reviews.
The host is clearly aware there is a damp smell and they are making efforts to help with that... lots of air fresheners around the place and an air purifier. However they are stuck down on surfaces in the rooms and can't be removed, the smell is quite strong when you are trying to sleep.
Secondly to this, the bathroom absolutely stinks of rot. We purchased a fridge odour eater to try and help. We did end up taking the towels to Sampans laundry 5mins away to wash them as they didn't smell very clean . They too had a musty smell.
The shower floor has been painted which is flaking off and is yellowing, I think along with the smell, it doesn't feel fresh in there.
Aside from this, the place is clean.
Great to have a parking spot.
They have just the right amount of utensils. Communication was great from the host.
TV was easy to use.
Good location.

PUBIC HAIR ALL OVER BATHROOM FLOOR
We arrived for my friends birthday. Broken sofa, litter everywhere, unwashed bed sheets, pubic hair all over the floor in the bathroom. The house had not been cleaned at all prior to our arrival. We immediately contacted the host no response. Contacted Airbnb, who say they can’t process a refund without the host responding to them. He’s ignored our messages and messages from Airbnb. Absolute SCAM, paid $990. The Host AMID is a scam artist, thief and awful individual.

After carefully choosing this place based on immaculate photos and modern, upgraded finishings, we were very disappointed with the cleaning. The living areas were decent, but the bathrooms were disgusting. Hair, toilets, soap scum, and used bars of soap left on window ledges. A professional cleaning and this place would be great, as it was, the standards for the bathrooms fell very short of expectations.

Pros:
Great location, convenient to most of the places
Street Parking available
Easy to communicate with host
Cons:
Most of the furniture is dirty and beaten down
Bathrooms not cleaned throughly
A/C takes a while to cool

This home has a lot of potential.  The space and lay out of the 2 floors are great to host a larger group.  It has 5 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms and a great open area on the main level to hangout as a large group.  Unfortunately, the home was very dirty and the cleaning was sub par.  There were some areas that looked like it had not been touched  in a long time and the basic cleaning was way below average.  Our group spent the first 30-60 minutes cleaning and then called the host and asked them to send someone to touch it up.  Also, the kitchen is wonderful but it had next to no stock for kitchen tools, pots and pans. We found one frying pan and one large spoon and that is all! They had a few plates and lots of utensils for eating.  It was very odd.  Again, it has a lot of potential and is a great space to have a large group but needs serious cleaning.  Stuff was tossed in cupboards and dirty linens were sitting in open areas. Leave on a positive, the home is located in a nice area :)

This rental was bright, clean and welcoming. The 3 beds were comfy and the place a good size for the six of us. The neighborhood is quiet and safe (left the car unlocked by accident and it was still ok by morning...don't recommend it, though). The location is close to lots of venues. We went to the PNE and it was great to have our retreat a short drive away. Not recommended if you have accessibility needs because of stairs, but highly recommend otherwise.

This penthouse itself it’s absolutely beautiful , the master bathroom is absolutely stunning. The kitchen is top tier with AMAZING views. The reason I deducted a star was due to the very poor management of our check in, which left my mom and i stranded at 2am in a rather sketchy neighborhood by day, so nighttime is very unsettling. Not only was it the hosts mistake , but we ended up needing to spend $500 + on a hotel, which they did not compensate us for. They only offered to cancel our 44 day booking the day of , which is extremely disappointing/ disrespectful as they were well aware our only reason for booking the air bnb was because my mother was receiving treatment at VGH.
For the price we paid , it was fair , as mentioned they neighborhood is a little dicey but they apartment itself is very stunning.

This place was great! Super clean and very safe. As noted by others, the area between here and downtown is pretty sketchy. The blocks around the condo felt safe, but would not recommend walking on Hastings between the condo and downtown.
Greg’s place had everything you need for the stay and the balcony was a nice addition. It was a convenient location to Uber around the city. I would recommend and stay here again!

We had a great stay overall and really enjoyed the apartment. The location was excellent — many things were within walking distance, which made getting around very convenient. The host was also wonderful to communicate with, always polite and quick to respond to any messages.
There were a few downsides worth mentioning. Unfortunately, the pool, hot tub, and sauna were closed during our stay, which was disappointing since we specifically chose this place for those amenities. The host did provide a small refund, which we appreciated. The building itself could have been cleaner, and the couch in the apartment was very soft and felt a bit unstable.
Despite these issues, the stay was pleasant, and the host’s communication made a big difference.

We know that the place was old but what we didn't know was how dirty the place was including sheets and towels at the apartment. Especially the towels. They were very old, they had hair on them, the sheets were smelling pretty bad. I paid over 1000 for the place and it was truly not worth it. Again, I knew that the place was old and that's not the problem. Also, I don't think I have to find the keys in a lockbox at the back of the apartment at night which was in the basement where people were living and they were looking at me when I was trying to figure out where the lockbox was and what the password was. I don't recommend it to anyone.

The host was responsive, however, the place was filthy, moldy, hair and liquid stuck on walls. The neighborhood is in a rundown and seemed unsafe. The building had broken windows in other units, the hallways smelled of urine, and the cost for a place like that was completely unreasonable. We ended up calling Airbnb support to cancel the reservation and had to find other accommodations. The host did agree to cancel immediately, thankfully. In the years we have been using Airbnb this is the first time we requested to cancel- which says a lot. We didn’t feel like the area was safe or that we could even sit in the furniture due to the stains and dirtiness of the place.

All in - I'd say the experience was ok. The airbnb is sort of a business with multiple rooms so the one I got did not match the picture shown and was smaller. I would suggest to update this so future guests would not feel misled. There was an issue with the window not being able to close but the host was responsive and addressed the issue by adjusting the lock. The kitchen was a little bit dirty, there were quite a few full cockroach traps and there was a dead cockroach on the dinning table for a week which made me hesitant to use the kitchen. The location I would have to say is amazing as it is right next to the skytrain station and in a very central location. Linda the host is a decent person and I've had some good conversations with her so I don't intend on this being slander of the host - Linda if you are reading this I hope you take some of this feedback and fix some of the issues noted because overall the property is quite impressive and in a very good location.

This was one of the worst Airbnb stays we’ve ever had.
The suite was extremely dirty. There were long black hairs everywhere, even though I am blonde and all of my children are blonde, so they clearly did not belong to us. The floors looked like they hadn’t been cleaned before our arrival.
The mattresses were stained and looked very unhygienic. The couch was in terrible condition—it looked old, filthy, and as if it had never been properly cleaned.
The kitchen sponge was absolutely disgusting and clearly should have been replaced a long time ago.
Overall, the level of cleanliness was completely unacceptable. We were very disappointed with our stay. I honestly don’t feel this place deserves even one star, but unfortunately that’s the lowest rating Airbnb allows.

Good location and host was very responsive. However, bathroom had lots of mold and was dirty, the lights in the bedroom didn’t work, and it seemed like every accessible outlet was too loose to hold any charger block. Other than that good place for what you pay

Only one night stay with my 70 year old mother and had issues getting in at end of night. Yoyo did come help us get in but with horrible attitude and then text me numerous times telling us to be quiet and not wake up neighbors. Mind you I was with my 70year old mother so really how are we loud! Not sure if the place is infested but did see 2 cockroaches and have photo to back up my stay. Really appreciate yoyo opening up her doors to my mother and I for one night but the communication was terrible and rude

The photos for the unit are misleading. It is shown as a bright and vibrant space. The reality is different. The kitchenette cannot even be qualified as that. We didn’t mind the size and the tiny mini fridge (where we found food remnants), but there was no heating element which made it impossible to even boil an egg. The toaster is a relic.The plates needed to be rewashed. There is a coffee maker and two different types of pods, but they do not match. Before we did laundry the first time and opened the lint filter, it was filled with lint and hair. The screen door at the entrance does not close or open. None of the bedroom windows open and when the doors to the bedroom are closed, the rooms are extremely hot with no air circulation. only two small windows open in the entire unit and the entrance door. Overall, the unit is uncomfortable and overpriced. We believe that a credit or compensation are in order. This was my first Airbnb experience and I found it disappointing

Zoe’s place was very cozy and quiet. We’ve stayed in many Airbnb’s that were not as pictured.  Zoe’s was not a disappointment. It was exactly as described. It was spotless and beautifully appointed. Loved that the TV was in the living room with a comfortable couch. The kitchen is pristine and has everything you need. Parking was great and loved the fact that there was a grocery store only a couple of blocks away. The neighbourhood is quiet and safe. I so appreciated that Zoe checked in with us to make sure everything was going good and to see if we needed anything. I cannot recommend Zoe’s  place enough and will definitely be returning. Zoe is a fabulous host. It was a 5+ experience.

Was really awesome that they allowed us to check in early BUT we noticed that there was some hair and food particles on the couch and a dirty paper towel on the bannister. Some of the rooms had a noticeable smell, it wasn’t that bad but it was a particular smell. First walking in is like oh what’s that? It kind of stinks but not really..
There was some wireless speakers in the living room built into the ceiling we could use BUT we could not adjust the volume, it was just loud. Unfortunately the Chen did not know how to fix it. Not a big deal but just unfortunate, would’ve been nice to use!
I think the host lives downstairs, which was not a problem but would’ve been nice to know ahead of time. I don’t think it was noted in the listing.
One thing disappointing was the pressure of taking out our trash and sorting it appropriately. The house rules say if you sort it incorrectly then you’ll get fined. We pay a cleaning fee but still have to take out our own trash.

Joanna was initially kind and responsive. We appreciate that refunded us for leaving early as we originally had booked for 30 days.
That said, there were several issues that made the stay shortened. She didn’t introduce herself until before we headed out from our 3 week stay. Additionally, we weren’t informed until the night of our arrival (around 10:30 PM) that she had two dogs, which my sister is allergic to. The place had a strong wet-dog smell, and we could hear the dogs running around above us throughout the days/ early evenings (not late but very loud). There was last-minute construction during our stay. Although she asked us what times might work best, the noise was super inconvenient and we would have to make plans to leave the place. I felt the work could have been scheduled after we had left.
Overall, conditions weren’t ideal but we are grateful she refunded us a week’s worth. Transparently wouldn’t recommend staying here long-term and believe the price was not reflective.

The Airbnb was nicely furnished and quiet. There were four of us traveling, and it was roomy enough for all of us.
The beds are very firm. If you like firm beds, you will enjoy it. I prefer soft beds, but that’s just personal preference.
Parking is not on premise, it is actually street parking, but we were able to find close parking.
It was not very clean. When you first walk in it looks clean, but upon staying there, we found a few things that were not good.
My sister found an old contact on her bedroom floor.
The drinking glasses in the cupboard were dirty.
There was what looked like dead skin in the bathtub drain catcher. The tub was dirty. There was an old used mascara tube still left on the back bathroom counter. Obviously left from some past tenant and not thrown out.
My bedroom did not have a top sheet, just a comforter.

okay stay but not worth revisiting. excessive requests for private information & noisy.
not at all in Metrotown area. location is misleading as are photos. not comfortable furnishing and not a kitchenette. dirty towels and dishes. points given as it was private and ling seems quite friendly which goes far in my books.

The apartment was dated and not clean. Blinds broken and didn't keep light from coming in at 5:30am.
Rooms extremely small and HOT! There was an odor that was being covered up by home fragrance. This section of town is sketchy! Internet didn't work....worst experience- I had to book a hotel last minute!

I’m not sure if this is true for Airbnbs in Vancouver or just this place, but this is the last time I’ll ever book one. The price was more expensive than a 4-star hotel and it was dirty, not professionally cleaned, worn and turn out, and just not fit for humans to stay at. I was very disappointed at the difference between the listing’s photos and the condition of the property in reality, and how unkept and dirty it was. We ended up not using the place because we felt nauseas from the smell/odor. There were stains on pillows, bathrooms were dirty and needed to be cleaned. We ended up vacating the property and saying at a hotel which was 20% cheaper and way cleaner. We were promised a refund if it gets occupied but didn’t hear again or get anything back!

Enjoyed. Communication  was excellent. Impeccable-directions.  If there is an event you can't park as advised. Cars were being towed.  Hubs dropped me off then waited in garage until I returned w/fob.  Our family of 4-stayed 3-nights, at a final cost $763.27 per night incl fees. For that price, I was very disappointed in the lack of kitchen basics.  The only items there are salt/pepper, box hot cakes, and k-cups. IMHO-the unit needs cooking spray, olive oil, spices, sugar, and creamer for the k-cups at minimum. Providing these items are so helpful when traveling. The Airbnb's I have stayed at even have pasta & sauce in case you arrive late and have no food. Every Airbnb I have been to has all those basics PLUS some. A guidebook would be thoughtful. Nice city location and views, there are very very sketchy areas close by so, building felt very safe and secure. Noisy unit if open, and the sky train starts early and RUNS very very late. Ear plugs provided. If you are a light sleeper.

Overall, my stay was good. It was a little difficult to get in at first and there was some confusion with the door code, which should be specified beforehand for those that might struggle with it. Additionally, lots of little gnats and flies which was a bit disappointing, which might be explained by either the cleanliness or the bathroom window that is constantly left open. I also found a huge spider in my room, which disrupted my overall experience. I’m not sure if this is common, but either way it would have been nice to have been informed of this beforehand or just clean more efficiently to avoid this. Lastly, the kitchen is limited to only 10 PM, which would have been nice if that was listed because that limited the options of what I could eat at night. It was nice to provide house slippers as well as towels. The laundry washer was also very handy. I’m not sure if I would stay here again because of the insects and bugs as that might mean the space was not as clean as it could be.

This place is okay but nothing more. You pay a cleaning fee but they want you to clean a lot of stuff to include taking your own trash bags out? Found a random dirty sock next to the closet with a lot of dust on it, looked like it had been back there a good while. Individual bedrooms were not clearly marked save for a piece of paper with a hand written number. The beds were the worst part though, they were extremely uncomfortable, there was a fitted sheet and duvet but no additional blankets, but worst of all they were extremely loud. I woke myself up multiple times with small movements, they were prohibitively loud and I'm a heavy sleeper.
The host communication is a little confusing and full of way to much fluff and niceties, but I suppose I can chalk that one up to cultural differences between us. It wasn't a problem just not a preference.
This place is ok and nothing more than that.

The host is responsive and very good at sweet talk.
House is disgustingly dirty and unhygienic and has not been cleaned from ages.
Kitchen - Has lots of expired foods which has fungus on it as well.
Bathroom - Full of hair. Never cleaned. No hand wash and No toilet paper provided. Clogged all the time. I asked the host to get it unclogged. This washroom was on the top floor and about 7 people were using it. The picture on the ad is of a different washroom from the one which was near my room.
Number of people - There are lots of people in the house which is not mentioned in the ad anywhere. It is shared by about 10 people all the time. It doesn’t feel like an AirBnB and looks like hostel. I would never come back here.
I left the house within a week and sadly you have to book this house for at least 30 days.
I had to look for other stay and only came back on the very last day to just return the keys as there was no refund available if I cancelled.

Bait and switch location.
This listing shows it at the Burrard Skytrain — a brilliant upscale location. Actual location is Tinseltown, 1.4km away, seedy. Non-refundable, location provided day of arrival — clearly intentional.
The day of arrival, the owner “upgraded” us a 5BR — but when I called out the location, she was offended and threatened to cancel my reservation (a busy weekend with no real alternatives). I was already en route; would have scuttled family trip. I begged forgiveness and bit the bullet on the awful location.
1/ the 5BR is a 3BR where the pantry and closet have beds. barely fits a twin.
2/ Fans. Portable AC units in some rooms (not the pantry!) but not installed, no hot air egress.
3/ decks unusable; were once nice
4/ “Free parking” mislabeled — she gave it but I had to press
The only positive is the owner messaged to return a stuffed animal we left behind. Grateful for that.
Shame; priced and described honestly, this place is OK
Happily checked out.

We enjoyed our week here, it was as described. Being in the city it was pretty walkable to places and if it wasnt the public bus and rail system was easy to navigate with stops all close by. The place itself was comfortable, albeit a bit noisy at times but its in a large city so nothing was a surprise there. There were many homeless but again, a large city so it comes with the territory so speak. It could benefit from some curtains to help with sleeping in because as soon the morning came rooms were bright. For us, we had a terrible time with the bed because the mattress was extremely firm. We tried to sleep on the pull-out couch but it was a very thin mattress and you could feel all the metal. So for us sleeping was terrible but might be fine for others. While it may not work for us for future visits because of the bed, it was an enjoyable visit overall and the host was helpful and the place was clean and stocked. There is also a drug and grocery store downstairs.

Spencer was an awesome host took the time to give recommendations and as well as some street wisdom on what areas to avoid.. (the area was a little sketchy but wasn’t too horrible up the way a little) A couple blocks up from location there was a lot of sights and food options . Super close to the port and super close to the steam clock. This place in gastown  has its charm

The location is very nice as is the lobby of the hotel it is located in. As for the unit itself, it was not clean when we checked in, so we did not stay. At first the host was very apologetic and promised to expedite us a full refund. However, he went back on his word and contested our refund claim even though we had photo proof. We spoke to him on the phone and he stated that he would only refund us the nightly rate (minus the cleaning fee) on the condition that we did not leave a bad review. This is dishonest and extortionary, and it violates Airbnb policy.

Positive: perfect location, large apartment as described, parking space perfect, on request you could extend check out by 1h, very good communication
Negative: wardrobe was not cleaned, kitchen cockroach came out of a cupboard

Good stuff: nice location, nice views from the apartment and good building with nice pool.
Overall we were disappointed with the apartment itself. There was trash in the tiny kitchen garbage when we arrived. There was a large hole in the fitted sheet on one bed and the beds only had comforters but no flat sheets. Owner gave us the code to replace the sheet from storage.
There were small ants in the kitchen and bathroom. Owner brought ant traps over. Not terrible but a bit gross.
Overall the apartment just felt tired as if they'd just furnished with whatever was available in the 2nd hand store. Fans and AC piled in the corners of the rooms.
The dishwasher started spraying water on the floor when we ran it. We told the owner but nothing was done or said. Hope someone doesn't run it and leave or it will be a big mess! Sad - it could have been nice but fell short in several ways.
Make sure you watch the parking video - the garage is quite large.

Our family was on a first visit to the city- wanted a central location- and the apt was accessible to all parts of the city- and offered beautiful views - which was the highlight.
Now for FACTS- If traveling during the summer- do NOT stay here. Host is aware of issues with the electrical system shutting all power if the 3 portable AC units are running and chooses NOT to upgrade/fix. Wish I read those reviews before spending over $700USD a night.
AC Units need windows open to run-brings in screeching train noises next to bldg. Water hoses filled up the small buckets provided overflowing all over the floor- must change daily.
Third “bedroom” is a converted storage closet with no ventilation/external window- -unbearable in summer as you can only run 2 AC units at once.
Sink disposal did not work- stench of fish from prior guest in hot apt all stay- host provided plug for drain to mask smell- but did not fix- nor speak English to explain why.
Worst experience in 5 yrs. Rip off.

be very careful. there are junkies everywhere.  made me feel unsafe. don't go towards Chinatown or Main Street. otherwise, building is secure. At times difficult to get in and out of elevator with a many people getting on and off. I missed Uber driver because of that. the host is new and needs to learn how to be a host. for example, the kitchen did not have cups, or a skillet, missing other utensils.  but the host did bring them after my request. biggest problem was ac.  during the summer even with closed shades, apt. gets super hot. small ac was placed inside an open window. not only it didn't work, it posed a safety issue. all the condensation from ac was deposited on the floor. making it unsafe. hopefully the host can fix issues.

The pros:
- Easy check-in process
- GREAT location!
- Clean space with plenty of beds
The cons:
- Not a true 2 bathroom. There were two toilets that were in the same room, with the single shower being the only thing between them. Two people could technically use the bathroom at the same time... but there is only a tinted shower door between you. This also means when someone is showering, you have to use the toilet RIGHT next to them as they shower.
- There were plumbing issues, totally understand it's not the owners fault, but the communication and lack of offering to make it right was very disappointing. We had 5 adults in the unit and we were out of a shower for the entirety of our stay. The host said "Hope it all works out" and then I had to follow up to get any updates on the shower being repaired. It wasn't during our stay and we had to take turns filling up the tub and draining it...for 5 adults that took a few hours to do every day. Very disappointed & would not stay again.

Unclean room with long black hairs all over the bed. Cigarette butt and more hairs in the corner of the bed frame. Stains on sheets. Stains on walls. Cramped room. No hook to secure shower hose on wall so would have had to hold hose while showering. Kitchen was dirty with smelly food left uncovered in fridge. Cupboards and fridge have not been cleaned. Couch seat in shared space was wet. Broken furniture in corner of room. We left immediately and got a refund for our stay. A lot of work needed to make this home stay worth paying for.

the room itself, you get what you pay for. the sheets had a certain smell it them, didn't feel very clean, and the bathroom for sure was not cleaned. i requested a partial refund and some lady came screaming at me over it at 7am, accusing me of lying about how dirty the place was, even after showing her the photos, she proceeded wag her finger at me. will most definitely not stay here again

She had dates available, took my money and then sent a message via text saying she had a burst pipe and I was lucky because a friend had a similar place down the road I could go to and that she would send a link with info within the hour. The link took out to some strange place and site outside AirBnB, I never got any communication from the host herself but some AI named Nicki.  I had to spend almost 2 hours in the middle of the night with AirBnB to get a credit so I could book a place elsewhere right away. This was a huge scam and very frustrating and stressful. Stay away from this place and host. I still have never heard a word from her. If you can’t host anyone then don’t leave your dates available!

I wouldn’t recommend this place. Be cautious of a message the host may send to you about a broken water pipe and that she will be switching you to a new place at her friend’s unit at “no additional cost”, (experiencing this is not only confusing for guests, this is likely a plot to prepare you for bathroom issues.) when I got to the unit, the bathroom in my en-suite did not function, toilet didn’t flush & tub didn’t work, the place wasn’t clean and there’s a musty smell throughout (probably a water / drainage problem that exists throughout the house itself as the person that greeted my and showed me around told me the flushing doesn’t work in any of the bathrooms) the whole time I was there I had no idea who my host was and how to get help. I got a refund - save yourself the headache, staying here one night I started to get really sick!

While Brigitte was very kind and welcoming she was not very responsive throughout our stay, with delayed replies that made it difficult to get timely help when needed. Unfortunately, the condition of the property was also quite disappointing.
The place needed better maintenance and cleaning. One bathroom light bulb was burnt out, dirty towels were provided, the shower had mold, and dishes were left in the sink from previous guests as well as garbage that wasn’t taken out. Overall, it did not feel properly cleaned or inspected before our arrival and felt unhygienic at times.
There were also several makeshift fixes, including tape throughout the home and handwritten notes attached to doors on pieces of kitchen paper towel. While likely intended to be helpful, these made the property look poorly maintained and unprofessional.
Overall, the cleanliness, maintenance, and communication issues significantly affected our stay. I hope this feedback helps improve future guest experiences!

Horrible, is a scam. Look at the comenta for a while and you’ll see, the people are reporting two type of experiences: the host reports that there is something wrong with a bathroom and she relocates you to another place or the host set you up in a basement that you didn’t pay for. This basement room has stains, weird smell and is totally different from the one on the picture. Don’t get this booking

• Pictures don’t match at all. I feel deceived by the published pictures.
• Unmowed backyard with tall weeds, no one has been taking care of it.
• Garbages were left on the floor in the backyard wide opened by some animals
• Bathroom requires maintenance
• Pillows were the worst thing ever, yellowish with saliva stains, not in good shape, condition or clean. They have been used for many many years.
• No outside lighting in front of the house, so dark to walk to the back of my unit. Only a motion sensor light on the side of the house, the light outside my unit was not working.
• Dishwasher is not working with a note on it.
• Street construction during my stay, couldn’t park overnight. Need to park at the back alley, needed to past through the dirty, not well maintained backyard.
• Feel like the owner doesn’t live in town, a helper lives in the property
• Not recommended to others
• No power outlet underneath the desk nor close to it, no extension cord can be found
• Disappointed

Hoist was responsive, was nice enough to give me a discount, probably because of how terrible it is.
Very noisy area, lots of homeless right outside the door.
Paid $215 for a cleaning fee and was told I had to take the garbage out (got lost in the underground maze doing so).
Was told I had to even do the dishes…
Tv didn’t work and shower leaks all over the floor. Very terrible accommodations.

Decent place to crash for the night if you are in Vancouver, would not recommend for longer term stay! The comforter was not warm enough for the winter and we could not adjust the heating in the room. The lamps in the room did not have bulbs!! The bathroom did not have bath towels or hand towels which was very surprising. Also, the room and bathroom was not cleaned before our arrival. Huge amount of dust, dirt, and hair in many places, hopefully the host will fix this for future guests!

We expected a nice place based on reviews. I guess most people are fine with blooms of black fuzzy mold on bathroom grout and in the washing machine, which also reeked, eyewateringly of mold. If the bedding is washed in that, well, gross.
We left and requested a refund for unsafe conditions and were told that's normal for bathrooms . Ya cool. Also, the ac is a floor unit in the living room that is extremely loud and doesn't reach the bedrooms which are around the corner and at the end of a long hallway. Both were stale and airless. Smelled like dog on the couch. Would have to take a bus through blocks of drug addicts to get downtown. Really don't understand the high rating. We left first thing in the morning after a late arrival the night before. Throats site and eyes red from mold in the air. Airbnb and host gave the runaround offering a 2 night out of 6 night refund. Shoddy and dishonourable. We paid for a hotel instead that didn't have black mold in the bathroom.

A lovely spacious AirBnB, sadly let down by :
1. Very basic kitchen equipment. ie. no teaspoons.
2. The upstairs especially was very dusty, with unswept floors, mirrors v dusty, all bathroom tapwear unclean. Other peoples hair on floor and bathroom surfaces.
The floors, skirting, windowsills, sink and taps all needed a good clean. Duvet cover dusty. Sheets & pillow ok though.
So I had to sweep the stairs and upstairs myself, and wear sandals as floor felt and was dirty.

When I arrived the kitchen was untidy and dirty. The living room table was dirty. I was woken up at 4.30 this morning by someone cooking a fall blown meal. She was slamming the kitchen doors, using the microwave and scraping frying pans on the gas hob. Whilst she was cooking she went to the bathroom and clearing her nose and spitting in the sink. All this was done with all the doors wide open. She had no consideration for any of the other guests. I will not be staying there again.

Awful price, awful host, I accidentally booked @ 1158 pm and I asked the host while I was in transition of getting an e-transfer, being from Calgary I am visiting Vancouver, if they could adjust my booking, and he denied me. So I was waiting OUTSIDE for 5 hours today because the host was trying to rip me off for a night that I paid for and didn’t stay at

The place was not as I expected, this is the worst airbnb I’ve been to. The place was extremely dirty. Moreover there was a junkie living in another room and one morning he had pucked in our side of the washroom.. all over. There is no bath Matt. There was someone who came to clean once I mentioned this to the host. The kitchen was messy and dirty. The house was smelling. Overall I did not like the place. It was not worth the money I paid.

false adress, only our sheets were clean, musky smell, lots of black mold in shower, VERY dirty bathroom with hair everywhere, key to room didn’t work and someone entered our room while out, residents having family dispute outside our door, someone who did not stay there came in off the street looking for someone, silver fish in bedroom, dusty dirty room, needs a lot of maintenance, not suitable for air bnb, host either does not live there to clean or maintain any quality, or neglects duties. you pay a $40 cleaning fee for a room that has not been properly cleaned for a long time before you arrive, shared spaces were disgusting.

Overall still a good stay, the house is at a good location on a quiet street, a walk to Kerrisdale city centre is only a few minutes, and the bus stop is also only a few minutes away.
The house itself is very clean, and professionally maintained, but there is a possible leakage on the heater as there is a smell of gas in the room, the worst part about this unit is it’s next to the entrance, and when people come in and out it’s very very loud, would recommend the other few rooms if you’re a noise conscious person, remember to stay away from room 1

Watch this video - go to YouTube and search 305T4Ol1TgU
We would not stay here again.
The property did not match the photos or the standard advertised. There was furniture missing, marks all over the walls, and the air conditioning setup was impractical because the door had to be left open for the vent, which defeats the purpose of having air conditioning.
The TV also did not work. We were initially told to go out and buy batteries ourselves. Batteries were eventually sent to us, but it was still an unnecessary issue.
The central heating did not work at all and we were very cold.
The biggest problem was the host’s response. When we raised concerns, we were essentially told to wear more clothes, use extra blankets, or leave.
A full refund was offered, but getting it processed took days and hours on the phone, and the host then blocked communication with us.
This property is not as advertised, and based on our experience, I would absolutely not recommend staying here.

Nice place but is older than the photos make it seem. It has a lot of space and would be very good for a large group. We only used the upstairs. Nice location and comfortable. Some of the furniture was quite cheap. A barstool kept falling apart, for example. The pots and pans were so old they were dangerous to use. The nonstick surface kept coming off. The homeowner did send us a small replacement pan. So that was good. I also took one star off because the Wi-Fi signal is terrible. You only get a signal when you are close to the modem. If you need to get worked done while you’re there, I would avoid. Otherwise a very decent place to stay.

Anna is a wonderful host and was very easy to communicate with. She was very kind and let us borrow some umbrellas.
Unfortunately the space was just ok - the bedrooms are quite tight, the apartment had a pretty strong musty smell, and some things were quite dirty (example: the rug in the tv room had lots of stuff in it). The back of the couch isn’t actually attached, so would slide off when we tried to lean on it, and the tv doesn’t actually have any streaming service- you have to stream through your own device. Last, the noise from above is noteworthy… probably not an issue if you’re not planning to be around during the day! But we had two small kids who were trying to nap and even with sound machines going the sound of footsteps from above was quite loud.

We didn’t realize the hosts belongings would be in the home, so we had no room to put any of our stuff. This also included the bathroom and the fridge and closet space by the entrance for shoes and coats. It does say it is a home, but I’ve stayed at bnbs where the space was somebody’s home however none of their stuff was still there. We found hair and dust, the top patio was lovely and the interior decoration was lovely as well however not worth the price to be living out of my suitcase. This felt like I was intruding into someone’s home, me and my sister felt uncomfortable with it. You have to buzz up and call her every time you want in or out. She also states she doesn’t answer past 11pm. We are two girls in an unsafe neighborhood so that wouldn’t have worked for us. Would not recommend to others.

the location is nice but the host and the house are both terrible first the host is anything but helpful they are slow to respond and when they do respond they never saying helpful for myself it was either rude or had nothing to do with the question at hand and the house was worse there is cobwebs everywhere there's bugs crawling around on the floor the house itself isn't even in good shape there cracked floor boards which stick up a little bit which could cut someone foot open the vents were taped shut in my room which made it extremely hot the door was constantly left open which made it feel slightly unsafe because someone could freely walk in and you would never know until it was too late all in all it was a horrible experience and I will never return to that Airbnb and I would recommend that others should avoid it as well

First of all, our mattress was filled with mold and bodily fluid stains from multiple past tenants. My partner got very sick while staying and we weren’t sure why because at first glance, the room looked clean. When checking out we stripped the bed and saw what we were sleeping in for an entire week. The hosts seem mentally unstable and would scream and slam things multiple times throughout every single day. (We were in the farthest room, on a separate floor) One of the days their small child screamed and sobbed for almost an hour to the point where we almost called the police. The main bathroom doesn’t lock properly, the kitchen counter is rotting (just covered up with huge tiles), the rooms are filled with bugs and the top shelf of the fridge leaks liquid all over your food. There was also a spoon with burn marks on the bottom side of it which we scrubbed with steel wool / lots of dishsoap and had to use since they had 2 forks, spoons and about 4 butter knives. Very unsafe stay.

We got to Lianne’s after a long travel day and quickly noticed the place was dirty. There was hair on the rugs and stove. There was dust everywhere. We opened the closet to store our suit cases and it was full of Lianne’s clothes and things. We checked the upstairs bathroom and it looked like it hadn’t been cleaned.   The fridge had some half used items sitting in the door and the freezer was unusable as it was full of repackaged meat. Traveling with a Vegan made this more uncomfortable. All this made us feel like our host was staying with us.  We tried to turn on the washer and it would not turn on. At that point we contacted Lianne. She said she would schedule a repair for the next day and to give our clothes to a stranger to wash. This was unacceptable. We told her we wanted to leave and would be requesting a refund. She asked us to stay and wait for her after being there for 2 hours. Maybe she wanted another chance to clean her home. Not sure how this host has good reviews.

host was very nice and checked in on us. it was a little dirty but nothing too bad. We saw a dirty sock that didn’t belong to us under a table. checking in and parking was a little rough the first time but overall was a nice place and close to the arena.

It is a very small (compared to the pictures) apartment and very clean surfaces and linen. It was very convenient for the airport and in a quiet neighbourhood but without amenities. It has a shared kitchen and entrance way with other apartments built in a double garage. The shared kitchen outside was not clean with dirty dishes left in the sink by other residents and would have been difficult to prepare a meal in. Cigarette smoke came into the apartment at different times which we reduced by placing a rolled up towel under the internal door to the rest of the building and closing the windows. The host did respond when we flagged this up and blamed neighbours but it seemed to be coming from a fellow guest or maybe the house above?
It suited our need to stay in town for a couple of nights at the end of our trip to BC but we wouldn’t have wished to stay any longer and a bit overpriced for what you get.

The only thing great about this flat is the location. From check-in (pages of instructions), nothing met expectations. It is VERY small. The marketing photos are misleading - no “Aesop” toiletries, no Dyson hairdryer, and the owners have interspersed photos of other rooms in building with photos of the flat. There is one small loveseat/futon and no other seating available in the tiny living room. There were holes in the wall in the secondary bedroom. The flat was dirty with other people’s hairs and stained and crunchy rugs throughout. One bath towel per person and no Kleenex. The kitchen didn’t have salt/pepper, food storage, or towels. When we asked for tissues and towels, the owners said they would send them, never did and stopped responding to us the morning after we arrived - for the next 6 days.
