We literally purchased kitchen and bath towels. The flat gets as bright as the surface of the sun by 4:00am, so if you come in the summer, bring sleep masks. Had to get AirBnb involved.

NOT WORTH IT!! It’s dirty, gross, and unsafe. The kitchen isn’t fully equipped, the bathroom doors don’t have locks, and both are always dirty. There’s mold in the bathrooms, nasty stains on the walls, and loud unpleasant guests.
I was personally confronted by an intoxicated stranger (not a guest) at 2 am who was in the hallway yelling, knocking on doors, and asking to stay. I’m still unsure as to how he got inside the house.
I booked 8 nights and stayed less 48 hours - because I couldn’t stand it and I never got a reply from the host. I had to deal directly with the Airbnb support team.

We were very disappointed with this listing. Exterior was shabby, peeling paint and tired entrance area, interior was old and in need of maintenance. Hand stains/grime on frequently touched surfaces, poorly finished paintwork on walls and cupboards. Old appliances, kitchen cupboard door binding on bench to open. Toilet seat too old and crazed to be clean, kitchen cupboard contents messy. Hazardous free standing large mirror. Couch tired and stained. Photos of listing do not show enough up close detail to alert guests to real status. Host denied these issues when we communicated them and we were unable to negotiate a refund.

I have used Airbnb around 100 times and this was the worst experience by far. We booked this place for 3 nights (~$700 USD), and after a 13 hour trip with a 1 year old, arrived at the place. We asked for early check in to drop our bags off, which was ok with the host. We arrived 25 minutes before checkin (4 pm) to get the key so we could park, and the place was clearly not cleaned yet - towels hanging, hair on counter, cans on table. I messaged host and did not get a reply. Additionally the stairs were missing pieces of flooring (trip hazard) and the railing missing the glass panel for half of it. I called Airbnb who insisted I negotiate with host and after first lying that the cleaners were almost done (none ever showed up), he sent us to a different property which we begrudgingly accepted. The next day he calls us that we have to move out again from that place for “toilet repairs”! So now we have to move for the third time in three days, with a toddler. Avoid this guy at all costs!!

Very disappointing stay. The property had a strong urine smell on arrival and no air conditioning or ventilation, making it very hot and stuffy.
The listing was misleading. It advertised sleeping six guests but only had four dining chairs, showed three toilets when there were only two, and pictured a backyard that was actually shared with another Airbnb. There was also only one roll of toilet paper provided.
The property was much smaller than expected, with very low ceilings that I hit my head on multiple times. The bathroom was dirty, the beds were uncomfortable, and I woke up with several bites on my neck that I believe may have been from bed bugs.
Although we respected the quiet hours, the hosts upstairs were noisy late at night and early in the morning. The stairs to the entrance were also very wobbly and felt unsafe.
Overall, I would not recommend this property for families, larger groups, or elderly guests due to the cleanliness, safety concerns, and misleading listing.

We do not recommend staying here. This place was extremely run down and dirty. It felt very unsafe. There were stain on the walls, someone's wet clothes laying on the bathroom floor, garbage bags on the kitchen floor and dirty dishes and food laying around. The ceiling had spider webs and exposed wires in areas. There was almost no furniture and what was there was run down, the closet doors were off the hinges. You could hear very loud hear music and voices coming from the basement and other areas of the house. We did not end up staying and immediately booked different accommodations. It felt very unsafe and terrible. This is not worth paying for at all. We were very surprised to see a place like this listed on Airbnb.

This AirBnB had some pros but unfortunately many cons.
Pros:
- Great area of the City. Walkable to Granville Island and Gastown. Close to lots of great restaurants, bars and shops.
- Condo is well laid out and has comfortable furniture and beds.
- Our host Elvin was very receptive to our questions.
- Check-in was super easy.
Cons:
- The location is very close to a hospital therefore there are alot of sirens through the night. This is not the fault of the hosts but ear plugs would be a good thing to pack.
- As mentioned by others, attention to detail is missing.
- Cleanliness was concerning. Ex. an old toothbrush and other items that had fallen between the vanity and shower in Bathroom 1 from previous guests.
-The shower curtain in Bathroom 2 is mouldy and stained as is the ceiling.
-garbage found under Murphy bed
-blinds in bedroom 1 were filthy
Biggest concern - no toilet paper is to be flushed in Bathroom 1! There’s a sign warning instead of having the issue fixed.
We were very disappointed and had to leave the place due to mold and bugs

We were unable to get in due to a broken elevator. The host was not on site. We connected him through the door buzzer, until he quit answering and it went to voicemail. We found an establishment to warm up and use the bathroom until he eventually reached out and had a neighbor let us in. Only in for one night, nearly missing our event due to this chaos. When we asked if there would be compensation, as this was less than ideal, we were provided this response:
“Unfortunately we will be unable to provide any refund as the issue was solved.
We would have happily refunded your entire amount if you were unable to check-in but in our case problem was solved.”
We understand things go sideways, and unforeseen issues arise. However, accountability is important. We didn’t even receive an apology.

Glad we only stayed for one night. Basics are provided but not as comfortable as other places. Disappointed and will be going back to using hotels when in Vancouver.
PROS: Pet friendly with no additional fee and lots of towels available.
CONS: Place is not as described. There is an unfinished wall on the entry of one of the bedrooms and an unfinished wall between 2 bedrooms. There's a review way back January 2025 about it, which means the hosts have gotten away with it for a long time! Took pictures for proof. No screens on any of the windows which sucks if you want fresh air but bugs can get in. The bed is hard as a rock. I had to sleep on top of the comforter just to make it somewhat soft. Dusty fan in the bathroom and some mold on edges of the bathtub. Cobwebs on the ceiling in 3 places. Some utensils have food stuck on them. Just expected the place to be thoroughly cleaned up.

This was a very disappointing stay. The host was not responsive in a timely manner when we needed assistance. The heater gave off a terrible smell when turned on, which made the place very uncomfortable. The beds were covered with dog fur and human hair, and the kitchen did not look like it had been properly cleaned. Overall, the cleanliness and responsiveness fell far below expectations. Would not recommend. We had to find a last minute place on our own, able to be settled at 3 am.

Disappointing stay. We tried to check in a bit early and were told it wasn’t possible due to cleaning, but we could leave our bags in the living room. When we arrived, no one was there—no cleaning staff either—so we had to leave our luggage outside, which felt unsafe. On Friday we were soaked from the weather; I asked to use the dryer and was told we could only use it the next day. We requested extra toilet paper and paper towels and got no reply. The only message came at checkout, to charge 100 dollars for a sofa stain that happened because our clothes were wet. We never met the host, which made the stay feel impersonal. Would not return.

TERRIBLE. The fact that I had to reach out, directly, to Airbnb TWO separate times, speaks volumes. The first was right after booking: Because my card was charged immediately, I thought I was being scammed, because of no response from Jeanine for over 24 hours(posted response time said within 5 hours). The second time being at check-in: I was at the flat, using the code provided, and there was no answer 3 separate times. This was extremely distressing.
Read the reviews carefully, as several issues I experience were addressed previously.

I would not recommend staying here and that is the first time I have ever stated that on a review.
He falsified his listing. It was for two queen beds with two photos of what appeared to be two beds with different bedding and decor. There is actually only one full-size bed. We were in town for a concert and there was very low availability, so we decided to stay there and one of us slept on the couch. We reached out to Airbnb after to let them know about the misleading listing. Airbnb’s customer service was great. They quickly responded and refunded a portion of our fees.
The check-in process was also very difficult. I had to download an app to unlock the door and it didn’t even work to get in and I had to call him. There was one fob for the building, so if you are with someone else you both have to be together anytime you want to get in and out of the building and garage.
I would not stay here again, or recommend it to anyone else.

Very nice, clean and comfortable space. Only issue is the way into anywhere downtown takes you right past the worst street in all of Vancouver full of homeless, and drugs. Even bussing takes you right through that strip into downtown, so for women and kids it’s not ideal. We ubered everywhere to avoid this. The apartment itself is very secure though and we felt safe in our building. Comfy bed, good amenities.

The apartment was perfect for staying in Vancouver to watch a World Cup game. It was very close to downtown and all the attractions we wanted to see during our stay. The apartment was very clean and had everything we needed! The host was great and responded to all of our inquiries. The bed was comfortable, apartment was well stocked and close to all amenities. As long as you’re prepared to be near the absolute worst part of Vancouver in terms of homeless people, then this apartment is perfect. We had no idea where we were in terms of location, so our first walk on day one was quite alarming. After we figured out how to avoid the east Hastings strip, it wasn’t as bad. Thankfully this apartment is tucked far enough away from the worst part that there is nothing to worry about immediately outside the apartment, just need to be careful when walking around at night.

Pros:
Beautiful neighborhood
Walking distance to grocery (5min)
Large
Indoor heated pool (but unsafe broken tiles, vents, camera watching)
Very comfortable bedding
Quiet
Kitchen was stocked
Cons:
Slow to respond to concerns
Very very outdated and old used furniture
Grimy bathroom shower
Hard cold leather seating for dining and living room
Must notify to heat hot tub with poor response 50% time
Several broken tiles around pool, electrical outlets, floor vents for small children
Camera video recording (filed claim)
VERY expensive, you’re paying for the # of beds and indoor pool - not the space/experience
Tried to claim we broke a sink (everything in the house was old broken)
We were really disappointed in the place for $1000/night we’d expect more out of Vancouver which has so much to offer.

Our weekend getaway was ruined by an ant infestation throughout the apartment—kitchen, bathroom, living room, and even the couch—making it impossible to relax. My friend is terrified of bugs, and their constant presence made the stay very uncomfortable. While the bedrooms seemed ant-free, the overall condition was unacceptable. We contacted the host almost daily, but he was unhelpful and dismissive to my questions. He denied our request for compensation and gave vague, generic responses, saying he’d contact “the team” and that a “second extermination” would happen after our stay—implying there had been a first one we weren’t told about. Other reviews confirm this has been an ongoing issue. The lack of transparency, poor communication, and refusal to take responsibility made for a very disappointing experience. I wouldn’t recommend this property or host until the ant problem is fully resolved. Unless you like ants—then enjoy

The place was good choice overall, considering our options/requirements. Location was good and met our needs (near downtown, although a bit sketchy, near E Hastings St, so thats a personal preference). The hosts were very quick and responsive to whatever we needed. However there were several small things that accumulated that led to unmet expectations (These aren’t deal breakers necessarily, just heads up to whoever wants to book this place).
- No fan is second bedroom, so it got a bit warm especially in that room (there’s a window but very small opening)
- Closet / storage spaces were very limited (they are full of various items, most probably the host’s personal things)
- Limited toiletries available (toilet paper, paper towels, tissue boxes)
- No extra linen/bed sheets (in case needed)
- A couple of plates in the cupboards were dirty (seemed uncleaned from previous use)
Again, this place was good choice overall, although above mentioned points that made our stay less satisfactory.

Terrible stay, would not recommend. I don't generally give bad reviews, but this one is needed. Host was quite rude and slightly neurotic, way too many airbnb messages and notes everywhere in the suite. Also, one of our vehicles got broken into on the second day (whole rear window broken). Looks like a nice neighborhood, but apparently not. The host gave us some plastic to cover the window, then physically went out to take it off herself before we left because she wanted it back. Also the suite only has one sink in the bathroom, might as well just stay at a hotel. We couldn't seem to lock the front door from the inside, which felt unsafe. The suite was very cluttered with little space to fit our things anywhere. All in all, just not worth it. Definitely will not be returning.

We felt the listing was inaccurate from what was advertised and the other reviews that were listed.  The suite smelled like cigarettes when we first entered.  When I went into the washroom to wash my hands, the hand towel appeared used and had a stain at the bottom. After exploring the space further,  the entire space seemed to not have been cleaned. There was dust and hair on the ground throughout. When pulling out the sofa, there were crumbs and a wrapper. The stove top was greasy and the sink had stains. There were also spots all along the walls.  Even the kitchen table had spots from someone spilling something and not cleaning it up. When I opened the toilet lid, there were spots all over, clearly indicating it had not been cleaned, and the shower stall also was dirty. The location, although only being 15 minutes away from downtown was noisy and not ideal. I would not recommend that anyone stay here.  We left after less than hour because of how unsanitary this place seemed.

Unfortunately, my experience at this Airbnb fell short of expectations, particularly when it came to cleanliness. There was visible dirt and buildup throughout the unit, which made me question the overall upkeep. If the visible areas weren't clean, it was hard to feel confident about the actual cleanliness.
I ended up booking a last-minute stay at the nearby Hilton, which was surprisingly more affordable and clean. I shared photos with Airbnb and, based on the evidence, they issued me a refund. That said, the host did not offer any compensation or take accountability for the condition of the space whatsoever.
While the location is convenient, I wouldn’t recommend this stay if cleanliness is important to you.

We had a very disappointing stay.
Before booking, we noticed previous reviews mentioning a strong smell and specifically asked the host about it. We were assured the issue had been resolved. Unfortunately, this was not the case.
The odor became very noticeable on the second night, particularly in one bedroom. We informed the host the next day, and while the response was prompt and someone was sent to check, it was confirmed that the smell was coming from dead rats inside the walls.
The smell spread across the second floor, became unbearable, caused headaches, and made it difficult to sleep. This was especially concerning as we were traveling with children.
However, two days have passed since then, and we have received no further response, solution, or compensation for this serious issue.
Overall, this significantly impacted our stay, and we cannot recommend this property unless the issue is fully resolved.

The place was exactly as described, accept that the pool and hot tub were out of service. This was unfortunate as it's one reason we selected this rental. Also, the place was uncleaned when we arrived. I brought this to Steven's attention and he offered to either have it cleaned or refund the cleaning fee, which I thought was acceptable. Overall it was still a great trip.

The location and the layout of the condo was amazing. It was close to lots of great stores (Costco, T&T), delicious restaurants, entertainment and the sky train.
Where it lacked was cleanliness and helpfulness of the host. Towels were smelly when we opened the closet to use them and bathroom vents were extremely dirty. We washed the towels but they still had a smell that remained.
We let the host know and there was no solution provided and his lack of thoughtfulness was unfortunate given how expensive it was.
The ensuite stand alone bathroom tub was difficult as it had a hand held hose which results in getting water everywhere, and so we ended up constantly wiping after each shower. We also saw that previous guests had dropped items into the cracks, and unable to retrieve or unwilling since it was so dirty there.
There were also a lack of bathroom counter space and hooks for towels.

The apartment is in a central location, close to everything. However, the railway tracks are right next to it, and the trains are very noisy, which makes it difficult to sleep.
Also, the apartment could use a little more maintenance and better cleaning. The oven was dirty, and the bathroom ventilation grilles were dirty as well.

Terrible experience – would not recommend. The room had a strong musty smell, possibly mold. The kitchen smelled like spoiled milk. The listing was misleading — no dishwasher as advertised. The house was very old and poorly maintained: broken bathroom door, broken shower door, nothing worked properly. Sheets didn’t feel clean and had hair on them. I reported it, and the host brought me a lint roller instead of changing the bedding. Towels and duvet covers weren’t white — something I’ve never seen in any decent hotel or Airbnb. It felt unhygienic and uncomfortable. None of the windows could be opened, making the space stuffy. Host communication was slow or nonexistent, and issues were never properly addressed. After this stay, we found many much better and even cheaper listings on Airbnb. This place is absolutely not worth the price.

This place needs quite a bit of work. I didn’t have high expectations going in but even then I was disappointed. The beds are uncomfortable and strangely super noisy. The windows are unsafe for kids and don’t keep the road noise out (and there’s a lot of road noise). There is no parking on the premises, just street parking, which is mostly fine but the neighbour awkwardly confronted us about parking in “her” spot when the spot in front of the place was taken. The living room furniture is basically unusable for adults. The mismatched fixtures and hardware all seem like they’re moments away from coming apart. The showers are tiny. I could go on but I’d rather not.

Sharu's listing is in a lovely part of Vancouver, walking distance to plenty of stores, cafes, and restaurants. The place was clean and spacious. The beds were comfortable, though slightly higher off the ground than usual. The suite also has a spacious patio at the back with benches to eat on when the weather is nice, which was a great addition.
Although our stay was mostly good, the oven/stovetop broke after the first day of our 6-night stay. Despite the host coming to look at it himself, we were told it would not be repaired during our stay. As such an integral part of the Airbnb experience, it was very disappointing that we were not able to cook any meals, causing us to spend more money than originally budgeted.
Sharu was great at communicating, but when we asked for a partial refund, we were offered only a fraction of what Airbnb support said was fair. The host also told Airbnb support that the stove was broken for only 2–3 days, which soured our experience somewhat.

Our experience was extremely disappointing. The listing describes "luxurious villa” but it was far from that. Upon arrival, we discovered a severe ant infestation in the home, making it uncomfortable and unsanitary.
When we notified the host, their only solution was to either have the home exterminated while we stayed (which posed health risks) or for us to vacate immediately for a refund. This would leave our large group of 20 displaced in a different city, causing major inconvenience and stress. Instead of working with us to find a reasonable solution such as a partial refund, the host refused to compromise. They still charged us full cleaning fee despite the unacceptable conditions.
For a property advertised as high end, we expected cleanliness, comfort, and proper maintenance. None of which were met. The lack of hospitality and unwillingness to work with us in this situation made this experience even worse.

It was an okay stay. Plenty of pros compared to a hotel, but plenty of cons also. We immediately had to wash all the towels as they smelled very musty and dirty (could seriously use a bleach)…and we were left with a dirty sponge in the sink to use which didn’t feel clean and made the kitchen stink. While it was easy to communicate via message and they were very kind, we felt the hosts made several very unnecessary trips to our unit and interrupted our stay (for example, all 3 hosts dropping off a decorative plant returning it to the Airbnb on our first night). Not well sound proofed between their upstairs house and the rental unit downstairs.

DO NOT STAY HERE. I had to leave after 1 night because I was concerned about a fire hazard-there are literal burn marks on the curtains where they contact the heater. Additionally, the appliances are gross, there is mold on the coffee maker. The host is completely unresponsive and seems to just send autogenerated messages and did not respond to my requests. Waste of money!

The Airbnb was accessible in central downtown Vancouver. It’s a 9 minute walk from the Vancouver City Centre SkyTrain stop which is convenient. Check-in was straightforward. The loft set up is spacious and comes with all the amenities necessary for a short term stay. Although the space was clean and tidy, certain things could be improved. The flooring by the bathroom had loose wooden planks and certain parts of the kitchen floor were starting to peel upwards. It’s a little unsafe especially since no shoes are allowed inside and my foot got caught on these areas a couple of times. The bathroom was also missing a toilet paper holder, which is a simple fix. The towels provided were clean but had a musty odor to them. Again these are all fixable things. Overall this is a solid place to stay in the city. It’s in a safe area and within walking distance to shops, restaurants, and other attractions.

During the third night of our stay there was a massive leak in the roof that soaked the entire third bedroom. The hosts offered no compensation, not even an apology. Also would not recommend this house if you want to be outside at all, you arent allowed to use the front porch or the backyard and they will be messaging you the moment you step outside. Very overbearing hosts, disappointing experience.

What a spectacular let-down this place was. The space was much smaller than advertised, and the so-called “double beds” were so tiny that calling them doubles is almost comedy. The sofa bed was just for show — no blanket, no comfort, nothing usable.
The heating system was a joke, leaving us and our babies shivering all night, but apparently guest comfort isn’t their concern. Their rigid check-in at 4pm and checkout at 10am is already unreasonable, yet they still refused any flexibility — cleaners clearly matter more than guests.
Overall, this was one of the worst stays we’ve ever had. Misleading, uncomfortable, and absolutely not worth the price. I wouldn’t recommend this place to anyone — unless you enjoy cold rooms, tiny beds, and zero hospitality.

Place is OK, with some annoyances. AC was not working (dingy backup solution was offered - owner did not advertise this) during a hot July week. Coffee grinder was not working. There are all the spices you can imagine, but not basics like pepper and olive oil. Place was not particularly clean: dirty BBQ grate, dirt on the second twin mattress, dirt on bowls, dirt on the kitchen scissors. I had a general sense of a profound lack of attention to detail, which I did not appreciate, especially for the high price we paid for this. Another thing is leaving fitted sheets for the two twin mattresses if people want to sleep separately instead of using flat sheets in lieu of fitted sheet. In some the place is fine/OK, but definitely overpriced.

Manraj was responsive, but I did not feel safe staying here as a solo female traveler. The apartment is on the ground floor, accessed via a dark, secluded side alley with no visibility from the street. It was pitch dark on arrival, which made checking in very difficult, as I could not see the keypad on the front entry door. The strong artificial air freshener made it hard to breathe. When I tried to open windows for air, I realized there were no screens or bars—making it unsafe to leave them open. Two interior doors led to other parts of the house and could not be secured from my side. I received no response when I raised concerns about security or asked for screens. The floors were also dirty, with visible hair. I left after one night and received no refund despite these concerns. I would not recommend this listing for solo female travelers.

Place is very nice and easy to find. Check in was easy. Only complaints are
- the bathroom sink faucet was dirty with toothpaste all over the faucet
- garbage left behind
- living room rug was dirty
- fingerprints all over glass door to one of the bedrooms
- lock in main bathroom wasn’t working very well

unfortunately, my stay at this property was very disappointing. When we arrived, it was immediately clear that the place was not properly prepared for guests. One of the bathrooms was leaking water, which caused a lot of inconvenience. On the first night, none of the outlets on the second floor—where all the bedrooms are—were working, making it extremely difficult to settle in.
In addition, one of the bedroom doors couldn’t be closed; it would slowly open by itself, which made it impossible to have privacy. We also found unpacked items and some garbage left on the floor, suggesting the place had not been cleaned properly. The carpet clearly had not been cleaned before our arrival either.
Overall, the condition of the home did not meet basic expectations for cleanliness or readiness. This was a very disappointing experience, and I cannot recommend this place based on what we encountered.

Hi
For 50$ a night that is what you pay for hotel elsewhere in Canada.
The place is well situated with a beautiful park close, nice and peaceful neighborhood , easy to resch the dowtown by transportation but inside no cleaning at all no furniture no welcoming basket no wifi the sheets were not clean carpet on the floor too dirty had problems closing the blinds no table to work no night table no lamp at night. The matress and the bed were ok. A lotbof dirtiness in the bathroom ans the other roomates smoke in the house. They were nice and helpful. In the kitchen no plate no nothing. Just for a good 50 $ at dollar store and monthly cleaning she can make that place great!

The host were really nice, friendly and welcoming. I really wanted to like the place but I was disappointed on arrival. The place was dirty when I arrived. The couch was a different color due to the dirt on it and I didn’t feel too comfortable. The bathroom and overall cleanliness was not good. The location is near a highway. So it can get noisy and stays busy most of the time.

We were very grateful that Bruce was accommodating to one guest’s feather-allergy and another guest’s sensitivity to artificial scents – making some changes to the place before our stay. The neighborhood is beautiful and is a pleasant walk to Dunbar.  Overall, though, we were disappointed in our stay. Past guests’ reviews said it was quiet and peaceful. Unfortunately, this was not our experience. Their dogs had the “zoomies” each night and there was a loud family gathering above us. 2 days with construction out our window. The overhead noise might be expected in a basement apartment, but the AirBnB description and reviews didn’t mention any sound carry.  We are hoping that our experience was an anomaly and normally it’s much quieter? Maybe the place is better for families who are making their own noise vs. a quiet trio of friends looking to relax in the evenings? We also alerted the host to the mildew/mold in the shower so hopefully that will be taken care of prior to future guests.

I appreciate Kiki for being accommodating and refunding us due to the heating system being broke. However, suggesting a space heater in 30 or below degree weather was mind blowing to say the least. Having to move to a different spot when my partner & I are from out of town was a major inconvenience. In addition, the cleanliness of the place was not suitable; from the dog food pieces on the floor once inside (we don’t have a dog), the various stains on the carpet, the dirty bannister near the sliding door, and the pink mold or other bacteria ring along the shower edges…The pictures look appealing but once inside, disappointed is an understatement. Again, Kiki was a great host in the sense of providing a refund. However, policing the space in regard to working amenities and cleanliness may need to be worked on.

THIS IS A HORRIBLE NIGHTMARE for US!
The host was horrible, there r at least 3 majors issues we would like to tell you & I will leave the rest for your imaginations.
We dont know how she did it but she sorted out the garbage and put all our garbage ALLEGEDLY into a smaller bin while we are the same number occupants to the rest of the property. The bin was full, of course not all our garbage and she put it in front of our door.
She entered the property without our consent and pushed my minor children away to enter the place after I told her that we dont have any issue for you to inspect but do it in the eve while we r home. We called 911 & police came & asked her to be out of the property & told her not to do that again. Airbnb does not allow such inspection neither.
The next day, she posted an eviction notice which is illegal under Airbnb & Residential Tenancy Act of BC which we are waiting for hearing.
My wife developed a major fear to step out of the house because of her.

We had a terrible experience, so please beware. My daughter and I were in Vancouver for the Taylor Swift show. The check in instructions said to contact host. I started reaching out at noon, then we landed, I started calling, messaging and texting Paul. No answer. I contacted Airbnb, who said they would try to reach Paul, no success. Hotels were booked, the few available were very astronomical. I worked with Airbnb to rebook, which was an ordeal and took about 6 hours. About 6 hours after the expected check in time, Paul wrote that he had a heart attack but that the place was already rebooked. If Paul had a heart attack, I truly hopes he heals. However, I’m not clear how he rebooked the place, while not being able to respond to us, while being in the hospital. It could have been a one time terrible situation and perhaps Paul will be a fine host to someone in the future. But, beware as there are no other reviews.

AirBnB REFUNDED US DUE TO HEALTH AND SAFETY ISSUE.
I would not wish my worst enemy to stay here!! Our body statted itching all over.
This was by far the DIRTIEST AirBnB I’ve ever seen. The entire place reeked of bleach mixed with overpowering perfume. It was hard to breathe.
The duvets were ripped (& smelly) and the floor was so greasy it turned my socks black in 5 min.
Every surface felt oily and unclean. The kitchen was disgusting — food residue on knives, cabinets, and walls. The ventilation above the stove looked like it had never been cleaned. There was mold in the kitchen and downstairs bathroom, and the bath mat was filthy. Sofa had crumbs and food between the cushions, and curtains had hair and residue. The AC’s were caked in dust/dirt, and the washing machine had smelly, wet laundry. We saw multiple spiders and silverfish within 30 min we were there before leaving.
Harjit refused to refund us directly and came with excuses. AirBnB refunded us due to of “health&safety issue”

The unit was as described, in a good location just off Fraser St with plenty of shops and food places nearby. It was easy enough to find, as was getting inside. In general, the property was pretty nice, with comfy beds, good aircon and clean bathrooms, although the kitchen could do with being a bit better kitted out with some more crockery and cutlery.
Unfortunately, our stay was let down a bit by a few basic things, which thankfully were easily fixed. We were missing washing-up liquid, sponges, bin bags etc., but Harjit was really prompt in responding and then bringing suppliers as soon as we got in touch with him. However, the floor was really pretty dirty - socks and bare feet were filthy after a few minutes of walking around, which was not pleasant. No doubt these issues are more to do with the cleaning arrangements, so hopefully based on feedback this will be addressed for future guests.

We had a disappointing experience at Khanh Linh's place. The outside noise and the heater turning on and off throughout the night disrupted our sleep, especially as we were already struggling with jet lag. When we brought this to the host's attention and requested an early checkout with a refund, he declined and instead offered a "future credit"—an option we had no intention of using given our poor experience.
When we suggested extending our stay in exchange for some free days to compensate(since he refused a refund), he initially agreed but then ignored our date change request for an entire week. We sent multiple messages and only received a single short reply over many days. By the time he finally responded, someone else had booked the dates we requested, and he abruptly backtracked, claiming there was "nothing they could do."
The lack of communication and accountability was incredibly frustrating, and we ultimately had to escalate the matter to Airbnb support to address the issue.

We arrived to Vancouver and called the phone number he gave us. After 4 tries with no answer we were nervous. We found a different number on airbnb site and got through.  He gave us insructions.
We  had communicated that we needed an air mattress b/c there were 4 of us (2 teens).  Months after booking, the listing went from accommodating 4 people to 3. When I asked him about this, he said we'd have an air mattress and it would be ok.  When we arrived, 1:30am in our heads, no air mattress/sheets/blankets for the couch. I called and he said our kids could sleep on the couch together.  He said I told him they were 3 & 4 years old.  Finally, he came to the apartment with a mattress.  I showed him our communications that I wrote there are 4 of us, 2 teens. I pointed out the missing blinds and broken ottoman/dryer button.  He said if I want a 4 star place I should pay $400. When I told him I did, he said he'd refund us 30% and gave my husband wine. 2 weeks later-waiting for a refund.

Great price point and location was what drew me to this location, however, after my stay, I did reach out to let the owner know that it needs a few more kitchen utensils stocked, bathroom sink and fixtures were not clean, and there were 3 cockroaches. I paid $359 for a cleaning fee and the home was not clean upon my arrival. The host was communicative, and refunded $50 lol

Would not stay there again, had to wait 2 hrs past 3pm ck in time that was published when booked.   Cinday argued w/me over this!  Closet door handles falling off, master shower had owners sponge in there - gross!  Windows were dirty, dishes and Silverware were dirty and gross.  Linens were like the owners and cheap unlike a hotel offers!  Beds way too low to the ground - house is made for midgets.  Front door and TV did not work with no instructions on operating TV. Garage barely fit our vehicle. House was hotter than hell!  Had to finally reach out to Cinday to find out they had to turn on remotely, I was not impressed, nor were the people saying either me!  This was a disaster in my humble opinion.

The kitchen was not well stocked, dirty dishes in cabinets, thick dust on top of appliances, front  and inside of cabinets are dirty. The pictures made the place look much larger than it was. Baths were wonderful... the bedding was described as quality and they were NOT... pillows looked ancient (flat and dingy), beds were hard as rocks and basically on the floor. Bedding looked like it was second hand. The only bed that was worth it was the king. No one slept well especially with the siting of cockroaches... one we killed and another was on a trap behind the fridge... this literally ruined our evening.... since there were traps I know she knew of them... should have been disclosed!! The floors were dirty and not swept... hairballs were in bedrooms, baseboards filthy. Kitchen was not well stocked... 1 drinking glass, no scissors, 1 tea towel, appliances were filthy.... The front yard a mess...This place has potential... but I felt like I was in a 3rd world country.

Cinday was responsive and worked with us to get issues with the air conditioner working. However, a family member was managing the unit for her and the communication was lackluster and he arrived hours after we were told he would be there. We also received multiple messages confusing our unit for another. While the space was nice and spacious for our group and we liked the clear expectations, it was not very well cleaned and a little awkward with the neighbors and shared spaces. We also were disappointed to see there are still cockroaches - an earlier review mentioned this, and like them, we did not reach out to them about this issue because what would the solution be, fumigation while we’re staying there? We also did not like the poor communication when dealing with the air conditioner issues, so it wasn’t worth it for us to message about the bugs.
House skipping not clean well 🫩and everything to used in kitchen was not clean 🤮 blanket and bed sheets smell like garbage 😮‍💨

When we got inside the house we were extremely disappointed with the quality of the house
Beyond our expectations we received from the advertising listing and photos on the Airbnb website
We were not able to stay even one night and we had to go to a temporary hotel till we find another alternative
This caused unexpected extra efforts and expenses for us
I do not recommend this place at all and should be offered for much lower price

Cinday’s property is in a very convenient location. I would give full marks for the check-in and check-out instructions, as well as Cinday’s responsiveness.
However, the cleanliness during our stay was very disappointing. There were clearly visible spider webs in the bathroom（I got photo to proof if needed) that had not been cleaned, and the floors were not clean either. We were not even comfortable letting our baby crawl on the floor.
We tried to communicate with Cinday about the cleanliness issues and asked whether cleaning could be arranged during our stay, but we were told that we would need to pay an additional fee.
The bathroom and kitchen facilities also felt quite old and dated, and they did not look as new as they appeared in the listing photos.
The property also did not feel very private. While getting in and out of our car, we encountered the basement tenants and delivery drivers on more than one occasion.

We’ve stayed in many Airbnbs over the years — and this was, by far, the worst experience we’ve had. I rarely leave negative reviews, but this weekend was truly unacceptable, and I feel it’s important to be transparent for future guests.
We arrived after the scheduled check-in time, only to find the cleaners still in the house. Not only that, but they asked us to leave and come back later. We were traveling with toddlers who were exhausted after a long day, so of course, we said no. The cleaner didn’t leave until 5:07 PM — more than two hours after our check-in time. Even then, the house was in an appalling state.
Here’s a small list of just some of the issues we encountered:
Garbage on the rooftop terrace
Hair in the bathtubs, pillows and bedsheets
Cigarette butts and beer cans outside
Beer cans under the couch
Eggs left in pots and pans
Dirty oven and filthy floors
Food left in cupboards
No wifi
No garbage bins!
No hand towels
Strong smell of drugs
Noisy
And lots and lots more…

Our stay from May 2–5 was extremely disappointing and frustrating. The listing was completely misleading and did not reflect the reality of the property. We arrived with a group of 10 and immediately had to spend over 2 hours cleaning just to make the space somewhat livable.
The bed sheets were stained, cookware was so filthy it was unusable, and the place in general was neglected and dirty. We found boogers on the wall in the kids’ room, fingernails on the floors, and various other unhygienic conditions that made us incredibly uncomfortable.
The listing claimed this was the “entire home,” but that was false. There were clearly people living downstairs, and we were told we couldn’t use the front or backyards freely despite that being part of the appeal of booking a full property.
This was honestly one of the worst Airbnb experiences we’ve ever had. I hope the host takes this feedback seriously and either updates the listing to accurately reflect what’s being offered.

The only reason why it isn’t a terrible stay is because the place wasnt dirty and horrible. But, for starters, you are greeted with a sign saying quiet hours are from 9pm-9am and if you were to get a complaint you were fined 300, yet the security alarm beeped throughout the entire night, that is honestly quite ridiculous, I couldn’t even set my morning alarms without possibly breaking this a rule. Second, this spot is not near the city, if you don’t have a car, it’s not a feasible option, it’s about a 20 min drive to the city. My last and biggest issue with this place, is I awakened by a bright light coming from the room that was locked, someone trying to open one of the doors, and two people arguing (loudly). Am i at a hostel? I couldn’t even get a decent nights rest (not counting the rock hard beds). Overall, this place should not be an AirBnb, there’s more than just a “host” living there, instead it’s about 4 other people or families that you have to tiptoe around to not get fined

Checked in and water heater was not working with a E430 error which resulted in no hot water.
Pinged the host Monika and she stated to reset the heater. So anytime someone is in the shower the hot water would shut off and I would have to walk down stairs and reset the water heater. Pinged her 3 additional times and no plumber was sent.
Average response time is 4 hours per the app.
Traveling with two young kids and no hot water, I had to book another hotel at 2am and left the following morning.
Monika stated “Airbnb is not a hotel” and we should have waited for the plumber who never came.
- Second bathroom shower you cannot adjust the water temperature.
- you cannot securely close the kids room window (latch is broken)
The current rating does not accurately reflect the home.
After checking out in less than 24 hours, Monika refused to refund our stay. I guess hot water is not right for guests.
I would not recommend staying here.

🚨 Avoid Yun’s Place at All Costs – Misleading Listing & Unlivable Conditions 🚨
I strongly advise against booking Yun’s Place. The listing is completely misleading, and the actual conditions are unhygienic, unsafe, and unacceptable. The room was filthy, smelled of pet urine and incense, and was infested with cockroaches and spiders. Worse, there were holes in the walls near the window, making the room freezing cold—impossible to stay in, especially in winter.
The host attempted to upsell us another room for $100-$200 extra, despite already falsely advertising a private attached bathroom. This is a scam and part of a pattern of fraud. Similar negative reviews on Google and TripAdvisor confirm that others have faced the same deception.
❌ DO NOT BOOK THIS PLACE! ❌ We can provide photos/videos upon request to prove how bad it was.
Save yourself the trouble and stay elsewhere! 🚫

Tala was responsive prior to check in. When we reported there were many ants in the apartment, Tala responded the next morning, saying that she and her team would come up with a solution. However, neither did she offer me a solution nor did she give us the insect repellent. We had no choice but to kill ants manually during our stay. Though Airbnb issued me coupons as compensation, Tala did nothing to the inconvenience caused by the unhygienic conditions in her apartment. This is the second time we choose an apartment managed by Tala’s team. Considering the awful experience this time, I do not recommend this apartment to other Airbnb guests unless you are OK to have ants patrolling in the apartment during your stay or you like removing them manually.

Terrible experience. We booked one night at this apartment. After arriving, the host was unresponsive for one hour and half. We had to wait outside for a while until we were expecting to look for another place. Communication with host was very poor, and he was very uncooperative. Also, the neighborhood is really bad. Dirty, with a lot of homeless people and sketchy surroundings. I DO NOT recommend staying at this place.

The best thing about the house was the amazing view. From the upstairs porch you could see the skyline across the water. It was beautiful! There was enough bedding and towels for everybody. There was enough seating for meals but not enough for leisure.
The home was reasonably clean, but the dishes were all filthy. The kitchen was lacking in basic necessities, and the oven was broken. We were disappointed because we had planned our whole vacation around baking our meals at home. There was dirty corners/baseboards/details, and also some major stains on the furniture. There was not enough tableware to accommodate our group, and we were not even at the maximum number of allowed guests. There were signs all over saying that quite time was from 9 AM to 9 PM and that we would be fined $300 for each noise complaint. That was nerve-wracking since we had 6 kids with us and that seemed like an unreasonably long quiet period! There were cigarette butts all over outside on the premises.

On a positive note, the location was excellent and the beds were comfortable. However, there were several issues. The common areas of the building were rundown, dirty, and smelled unpleasant. Inside the unit, the walls, baseboards, and some other surfaces appeared unclean. It also seemed that the dishes hadn’t been properly washed, because we found stickers still on the bottoms of some plates and glasses.
Partway through our stay, another group was mistakenly given our access code and entry instructions. Fortunately, we were in the unit at the time. We had to cancel our evening and morning plans while we waited for the door code to be changed.
We also had multiple encounters with a mouse inside the unit on the last night, which ultimately forced us to pack up late at night and find a hotel, as we no longer felt comfortable staying there. Communication with the host was minimal, but thankfully Airbnb stepped in to assist.

Terrible unit and should not be an Airbnb. No closets or drawers to store anything. Unit so small it was difficult to open suitcases. No airflow. Very claustrophobic unit. No window in one bedroom. Beds were so soft I almost fell over the side as the mattress was so old. Leaking fridge with water all over floor. Nice hosts but this unit was probably not even a legal unit. Host indicate we could likely have early check in (check in of 5pm is unusual). Host then ended up allowing previous guest to checkout two hours late and therefore we were unable to check in.
Worst unit I have ever rented on Airbnb. Not worth it. So bad we considered checking into a hotel.
Hard to believe this was recommended by Airbnb.

Place wasn’t ready to be rented out. Master mattress and box spring broken. No compensation for 2 nights w/o master bed. Shower curtains unbearably smelly, kitchen not cleaned well, streaked with dried food on counter and food on floor. Hand prints all over windows.
Listing claims “premium” bedding/linens. Only polyester linens. Pillow filling crumbled/disintegrated. Beds stiff.
Listing claims ac. Actually no ac. Only heat, 3 fans. Noisy train with windows open. Stuffy. (Twice inquired. No response/resolution.)
Building amenities nice, building secure but the neighborhood not ideal for sightseeing on foot (borders homelessness, mental illness, urine, drug use). Train nearby, convenient.
Garage directions wrong & insufficient.
Midweek, host canceled our booking and rebooked for one less night with no refund for lost night. Sam told us to rebook lost night with additional charge. Blamed airbnb for the mix-up.
Host Runjun was prompt and always polite and responsive (but not w/ac).

The stay was great. The only thing very disappointing was we were told we could drop off our luggage early and explore the town. We planned for that. When we arrived we were told that option was not available. That really ruined our first day as we could not do much in the city with our luggage in the car. That's fine if that's not an option, but to be told it was and then denied that option was disappointing.

Our stay here was very disappointing.
1. There was a large spider and other insects in the room. When we informed the host, they dismissed it as “normal” and told us to handle it ourselves.
2. Before booking, we confirmed with the host that the air conditioning worked. In reality, it didn’t function at all, and we were only given a small fan, which made the room unbearably hot.
3. The listing claimed the property was for “private use,” but we discovered other tenants sharing the laundry facilities.
Overall, the experience was far from what was advertised, and we cannot recommend this place.

It’s a bit disappointing that the room is not clean. For example, there are some paint stains on the sofa. Also, there are 2 doors and I cannot lock one of them from inside - even if the neighborhood looks peaceful to me, I won’t say it makes everyone feel safe. Last but not least, the room is not sound well-insulated, and I heard voices from other rooms in the midnight from time to time.

Unfortunately, there were too many issues with this stay for us to recommend it.
The bedroom had no ventilation or window to the outside. With the door closed, there was no fresh-air ventilation and it was very hot. The windows opened only into the living room and could not be locked from the bedroom.
The bathroom could not be locked from inside, and the host opened the door while we were using it. It was also dirty on arrival.
The fridge was dirty and nearly full, and the overflowing garbage had fruit flies on arrival. The kitchen was left dirty after the hosts cooked during the stay, with dirty dishes and rice on the counter.
The floor was sticky, under the bed was very dirty, and no top sheet, extra pillows, or blankets were provided. The second bed was off-limits. Four people in this small room would not be safe given the limited space and lack of ventilation.
Homeless people were blocking the entrance, with apparent drug paraphernalia nearby.
We would not stay here again.

My partner and i were in vancouver with two friends for a wedding, we would of found another place to stay if we had the time. Jannifers place was much smaller than we expected from the photos, mainly the one bedroom and living room/kitchen.  The best part about the suite was the bathroom, although the tub doesnt drain.  The mattresses were gross, and she even split one sheet set between two rooms.  It appeared to have black mold on the blinds in the bedroom, kitchen utensils and plastic inside the oven, smoke detectors removed from their locations, and 4 pairs of dirty ripped slippers left for you to use 🤣🤦‍♀️ in one bedroom you can barelly walk around the bed its so small, and the pillows are rock hard. Thank god we only had to sleep there which was unfortunately horrible but im just glad we didnt spend more time there. Ive never had an experience where it just kept getting worse. Very unimpressed.

Private, walkable location with comfortable bed and pillows, but unfortunately the cleanliness of the space fell well below expectations.
We checked-in late at night and immediately noticed spiders, dirty and dusty floors, and mold/rust in the bathtub. The bathroom appeared poorly maintained, and overall it did not seem like the unit had been thoroughly cleaned before our stay. Since we were only staying two nights for a World Cup match and arrived very late, we cleaned the floors ourselves with the supplies available and stayed.
The host did provide a credit for the inconvenience, which I appreciated. However, given the premium nightly rate during the World Cup, I expected the property to be clean and well maintained. Based on this experience, I would not choose to stay here again.

All the horrible reviews are accurate. There's bed bugs!! I stayed 3 weeks in a room here out of desperation. There was black mold in the room around the windows. The window doesn't seal. No heat in the house. Bedding unwashed from previous person who stayed, floors filthy. Bathroom full of black mold and tub disgusting. Also cora is a thief and will steal your deposit they promised to return, when you deal with them outside of air bnb.. Never stay here. On top of every other lovely amenity mentioned the washing machine stopped working with my clothes in it. Full of water. Cora did nothing to have it fixed or rectified. I left the room better then I got it in. I washed the bedding and tidied up the room. They still stole my deposit. This is the lowest quality hostel you could stay in. Aside from the location. Beware!!

Very upset. The place was dirty, messy, loud, cold, lacking repairs, and her family lives in the house. They are very rude and disturbing. My clothes were also remises from the washer mid was and thrown into a dirty bin. Completely Discussed in this place.

We give the first night 5 stars. Next night the occupants upstairs were home – footsteps / voices were acceptable. What wasn’t acceptable was the noise of the air con system for the upstairs area which you can’t off. It was on for the whole night, and we did not sleep at all even with the earplugs provided! It was so bad that we left 2 days early and went to a hotel. The host could not guarantee it would get better. We were offered a refund on the unused nights, but it was withdrawn the next day before we could finish talking with Airbnb. Still had no refund. The listing describes “mild operating noise”, but we describe it as a loud continuous noise which you cannot turn off. The air con unit is located right by the bedroom door along with a natural gas fired hot water cylinder. We could not even close the bedroom door because every window is sealed shut in the apartment and it became too hot to sleep with no ventilation in the bedroom. We had the good and bad in this property.

Centrally located and everything is within walking distance. The Host sent several messages owing us know he was available if needed.
The home is suitable for 4 people. There are 2 bedrooms with a Queen bed in each. The kitchen has a large closet with a single bed that is squeezed in. It works for a kid, or a teenager, but most adults would probably have an issue with it. The sofas in the living room would fit a child, but not an adult.
The home was clean, other than one bathroom had mold in the grout and around the shower surround, and the shower curtain in the other was moldy at the bottom. The bathrooms seemed well cleaned, but the mold made them appear not to be.
It is a good place to stay and needs only a little more attention to cleaning.

Absolutely disgusting and disgraceful.
All bad reviews are real as hell.
Mold, Unclean beds, no heat or internet.
It's like staying in a broken treehouse that is rotten.
This house should be demolished immediately or inspected by air bnb and the owners criminally charge for negligence.
Please read reviews before you book any stay anywhere 99% of the time any bad review is so true so just be careful
It was not clean. I got one stained towel.  And there is a musty smell.

Terrible host and and even worse experience. I normally never leave reviews, but given this was a new listing I think a fair warning to any new guests is necessary!!
I rented this unit under the impression I had rented the “entire home”. Instead, the host has individuals who live in the basement and didn’t disclose it in the listing. They tried accessing the space I was in and I thought a break in was occurring. When I confronted the host he tried to deny everything.
I chose to relocate due to safety concerns and the host wouldn’t issue take my concerns seriously or issue a refund. Luckily Airbnb support investigated the case and authorized compensation (against the host’s wishes!) because they found the host was violating Airbnb policy and had a misleading listing, as well as an unsafe environment.
In short, stay FAR away from this host and this listing…

First of all, we wanna to review for the next guest- whoever makes a big mistake thinking this place is for 2? NO, it is NOT. It is so tiny, and tiny... Even I understand that in BC NOTHING is cheap! We paid from Aug 2 to Aug 9, for a total of $1,490 CAD. We arrived in BC sometime on Aug 2nd, around 5 or 6 pm, because WestJet's flights were on strike. Having said that, we requested cancellation because we did not know when we would get to BC. This Airbnb's owner is so terrible; he (they), because more than one owner) did not let us cancel the place. When we arrived late on August 3rd, 2026, we asked for no services during our stay. We asked to transfer to another place(unit), but they said NO because they said nothing was available; Or whatever the reason! This place was a nightmare for us.
Those are for the next guest! Even IF, it is free to stay, sorry, I won't stay in this dumpster! Thank you, but NO thank you!

Booked a 1 night stay prior to a cruise. The location is perfect for this as it is walking distance to the port and views of the apt are great. I rated the experience 2 stars though for 3 reasons: 1. AC was broken when we arrived and we were not informed. The owner responded quick but they did not know either. They did refund me $70 for this as it could not be fixed. Is AC worth $70 USD (~15% total booking cost) or is it worth more to you? Not sure but it was uncomfortable in the rooms.  2. The jacuzzi was broken and had no water in it. Not informed of this until we went up to look ourselves. 3. We met 2 diff groups of residents of this building. Both were rude to us for literally no reason on our parts. 1 person explained to us that they, the residents, are upset with the Airbnb situation in the building and that’s why the other resident made remarks to my family and I in the elevator. We did not feel welcome here.

First of all I've been in the hospitality business for over 40 years so I've seen it all and understand what it takes to make people happy. Second the host will somehow turn this around on the guest which you will notice in previous reviews. We arrived at check in at 3 pm to a 77 degree condo and soon noticed the AC wasnt working.  We then messaged Greg about the issue. Greg was very short and said he was just notified about problem and nothing he could do. He quickly refunded us $425 of our $2200.   This somehow gets him off the hook for any future refunds.  We then ventured to the W club where the hot tub, fitness area and top floor deck is.  Hot tub was also broken. We were able to only get there this time as we were with a resident of condo. Future attempts failed as this floor is only for people that live there full time. After reading previous reviews we noticed the AC issue along with other problems has been going on for some time, not just a recent problem.

We would not recommend this property. We booked specifically because it advertised central AC, but it was not working. The co-host later admitted it would not be fixed during our stay. Even more concerning, reviews posted after we booked showed the same AC issue had existed about 3 weeks earlier, and the co-host had already acknowledged it as a building problem, we were never warned before arrival. We were even encouraged to adjust the AC to our comfort level in the welcome message.
With the windows open it was very noisy.
The unit was also dirty, the master shower wouldn’t drain, the second shower had very poor pressure, there were drain flies throughout, some smashed on the walls.
When we raised our concerns, the co-host became defensive and dismissive, even comparing the situation to his $2 million home not having AC and saying he and his 65-year-old mother were fine without it. Airbnb ultimately refunded us and gave us credit to relocate. I would strongly caution future guests.

This place is awful. Do not book. Dirty upon arrival, and no actual human host. Every response I got when I messaged the “host” was clearly an AI generated response and was sent within seconds of my message being delivered. There were weird handymen doing unnecessary work on the outside of the house, peering inside the front windows.

The Level was very comfortable for 4 of us and all the staff were friendly and helpful, from desk staff to cleaners and maintenance men. The Level was very accommodating with visitors who came to visit us. We loved our location on the 8th floor, looking out at a huge patio. The pool and the hot tub were great! Excellent market nearby for daily groceries.
We found the rent was expensive and were disappointed when our request for a change to our reservation was non-refundable. We were there so I could have a kidney transplant and I was discharged earlier than the time we had booked.
A very nice place to stay, if you can afford it!

This downtown condo and the building require updating. We hadn't expected that most of the cupboard and drawer space would be taken up by the owner's belongings, so we had to live out of our suitcases during our three-day stay. We flat was not clean to a generally acceptable standard.
The biggest issue is that the noise from a construction site a half block away made it impossible to work in the flat the day I had meetings. The tall buildings in the area created a canyon effect; the whirring/whining of the drills and cutting tools was not tolerable. The owner should have disclosed that there was a large building construction taking place.
Overall this is the worst AirBnb experience we have experienced in the ten years we have used AirBnb.

Honestly pretty accurate of a listing. The best thing of this place is the bed and the towel. Ive been in over 20+ aribnbs and I am not a high standard person. As long as its clean.
Washroom was dirty right (hair and dust on the floor, in the tub, and nasty mat) when I arrived, bugs everywhere on the floor, very VERY basic and old furnitures. The location was 14 min walk away from the skytrain, right beside 12th avenue and not much to do around that area (unless you go north commercial).
Asked Renee to modify trip before the modification deadline and he starts ghosting. Like bruh if you don’t agree, say you don’t agree. But it’s fine and I didn’t get refund anyways. I was gonna leave a good review if the room was clean. Welp too bad.

Amy is a great host and very helpful.
Amazing views!
Glad we had a car to get around neighbourhood felt unsafe and dirty.

My wife and I stayed for two nights in late July, along with 3 of our adult children. On the positive side, Amy was responsive to  questions. Unfortunately, many negatives... the space was uncomfortable and extremely small . We found mold in both showers. Terrible air circulation throughout; the air was always musty. Fans located in every room didn't resolve this. The in-room AC in the master had a open basin to catch runoff water, located next to electric cords. The master platform bed oversized so one couldn't walk around the bed. Two "bedrooms" were located in closet-size spaces. There were no kitchen towels or sponge, and no laundry detergent. There were only about half dozen mismatched drinking glasses in the kitchen. The Goodwill-like furniture was old and cheap. The sofa/futon was uncomfortable. There were no chairs except 4 folding chairs and 4 bar stools that had no purpose. Heavy drapes covered the windows. For the outrageous price charged, this space offered horrible value.

The only good thing is that the bed is super comfortable, so you can rest well, but… the house itself is dirty. Don't expect a clean place, much less the bathroom. The towel was dirty, so we had to buy a couple of extra towels. The house is quiet, which is good for resting.

Location of the unit is great but that’s about it. Place was not cleaned before we checked in and it was dirty and filthy. Surprising since we had stayed at the same unit a few months ago and found it good enough to book again. But this time apart from the (ill) condition of the unit certain amenities were missing. The host was slow to respond and since it was a short stay was hoping that we didn’t make much of an issue about it. The host sent a cleaner in the end who did not do much and left. If you want to stay at a clean place, best to avoid this listing.

The house has a musty odor that becomes noticeable every time we enter, likely due to its being unoccupied for an extended period. On our first day, after checking in and parking our car, we noticed another vehicle in the backyard. However, by the next day, that car was gone, which made us feel unsafe . This unusual occurrence made us feel wary, as it suggested someone might have been on the property or the house area while we were out during the day. While the house is otherwise clean, the persistent smell remains a concern.

Location is easily walkable and close enough to multiple forms of public transportation. The individuals present outside the building leave others alone. I appreciated the accommodations for early check-in. The pictures presented of the place are slightly inaccurate. The couch is not the couch pictured and is more of a patio/outside couch than something anyone wants to actually use. The place needed to be cleaned better. Cobwebs were present in the windows. Dusty shelves near the bed, including a used pair of contacts (not mine). A piece of garbage was lying underneath the island. Shelves for storing clothes were dusty. I do not recommend using the wash machine as it was filthy and left marks all over my clothes. The area around the wash machine and dryer units was dirty. Non-contact check-in and check-out was awesome and easy. Comes with a parking stall.

Not a horrible place to stay,  but had quite a few quirks that made it less than ideal. The unit gets very warm at night. There are fans provided, but none of the windows have screens in them which makes opening the windows a bit sketchy. The faucet in the kitchen isn't attached properly and the entire fixture rotates when you try to turn the water on/off. If you plan on doing laundry there is a 2 in 1 washer/dryer but it is unreliable. Our clothes ended up locked in there overnight and in the morning they were still wet. If you plan on using the couch as a bed bring some extra sheets and pillows. None of these things are really huge issues on their own, but combined they left the place feeling a bit soulless and carelessly put together. All that being said it is in a pretty nice neighborhood so if you are just looking for a place to sleep and don't mind it being a bit warm at night it is alright.

My stay was nice overall. When I was inside the place it felt safe. Although I didn’t quite love the neighbourhood as it’s located in east Hastings and that’s also where all the drug addicts live. It was my mistake for not doing more research. The view was nice yes but it’s also located right in the shipping yards and right beside a train so it’s very noisy and sometimes smelly. Considering the whole centre is the “beautiful view” it would make sense for the balcony to be more cozy and inviting, comfier chairs. Only provided 2 large towels, the walls are all scuffed up pretty bad and maybe dirty as well couldn’t really tell. There were also dirty dishes left in the dishwasher. This place was definitely not horrible, but I do think there were nicer options for similar prices. I did enjoy my stay regardless and the host was very friendly and inviting. My main quarrel is the price isn’t too ideal considering all things.

The location of this apartment is very close the the problematic areas of East Hastings in Vancouver. Upon arriving there was a druggie leaning against the entrance of the apartment. I had a three year old traveling with me and I was not comfortable staying at the apartment. I left at once and got a hotel! Of course Airbnb does not disclose the exact location but I would think twice before reserving this place if you consider safety! The host was not responsive in getting a refund even though I did not stay at all! The pictures of the inside of the apartment matches but the location is horrible.

Great views and clean apartment. The area is on the edge of the downtown east side, which means you will see and hear the social problems around you. Sirens and yelling on the street are constant.
Apartment is well appointed. Like other reviewers, I found the mattress and pillow rock hard.
The listing shows access to the hot tub, which has amazing views and is a great space. The fob to access was not in the apartment. Upon asking, the co-host interrogated me about why I had not sought preapproval and that generally it was not part of the stay. After a few hours, fob was hung on the door and access granted.
Checking out, I had an issue that caused damage to a piece of furniture. I messaged the host right away with a photo. Cohost berated me for misusing the furniture (I had placed my bag on the coffee table) and rudely told me my behaviour was unacceptable.
Overall, a good place to stay but rude cohost and misleading listing means I won’t come back

Mandy’s place was in a great location, we walked to some great spots, easy check in and secure parking,  however the apartment was not clean when we arrived, very dusty, dirty countertops, dirty toilet etc. but when I let Mandy know she apologized and returned some money which was appreciated! I would consider Mandy’s place again in the future!

The Airbnb was nice and in a good location, but for a place advertised for 4 but could sleep up to 6, there weren’t enough basics like towels and toilet paper, and only one fob was provided. The bigger issue was the host, Chen, who was rude and unhelpful. She ignored requests for access, even sending a laughing emoji instead of assisting, and one night would not buzz us  in leaving my sister, who needs time-sensitive medication, locked out in the rain at 11 p.m. This was unprofessional, stressful, and made the stay very disappointing.

Chen is extremely rude and cares more about the other guests reviews than basic needs like eating food. She told me to eat faster so I could leave the dining room, she told me that I was done eating when I wasn’t. Which as a young man could lead to eating disorders. I also have to meal prep because I was there to attend Ballet BC and she told me that I took too long in the kitchen (which she knew why I was there.) She also was upset that I had to get up at 7:15 am and make breakfast which was out of my control due to the ballet program. I do not recommend staying with her unless there are no other options available.

I've never given a bad Airbnb review.  The listing says that 4 people fit in this condo. Before we rented, we asked about the size of the lay-down couch as we had a 14 and 20 year old.  The response was, "they should."  When we got there we quickly learned that it was NOT a full - as described.  Plus, when you put any weight on the part that was the back of the couch, it just tipped over.  When I reached out to Wang, the answer was that there was a foam pad in the closet - so clearly they had a different plan for the 4th person (it was a terrible pad).  When I told them this wasn't sufficient, I was offered a 15% discount ONLY if I would give a 5 star review.  Since I'm not a person that can be bribed to lie, I turned this down and contacted Air bnb.  Wang did offer to refund the second night if we didn't want to stay, but we couldn't find a place to move that was affordable at this late notice.  The main bed is very uncomfortable, too.  My husband and I both struggled as well.

Great location, comfy bed, and bright space. Parking is a plus. Generally clean though the bathroom has a bunch of black mold around the bathtub, and the towels provided were smelly like they’d been left wet in the washing machine for several days.

The home itself was beautiful and had great potential. Love the space. and it was easy to get around town from the spot. However, not as clean as we would’ve hoped.
Here are some examples:
Hair in shower and around baseboards
Ice maker with old ice/bin dirty
Some flatware dirty
Suede sectional with visible dirt/stains, musty which was the biggest disappointment because we did not have comfortable seating as a result.
All that being said, we brought these things to the attention of the host and he was grateful for the information. Said he would follow up with his cleaning people. Would love to rent the place again under different circumstances.

We paid nearly $1500 to stay at a property that was too far from all the attractions. I believed we had booked the entire house for private use, but there were occupants in the basement that were not disclosed in the listing, which made us feel unsafe. The house had a strong, unpleasant odor that was noticeable immediately upon arrival.

We were also not permitted to wear shoes inside, a house rule that was not mentioned at the time of booking. For the price of $1,500, the stay was not worth it given the location and issues.

Additionally, the property did not have the channels to watch the World Cup matches during the tournament, which was another major drawback. As a result, we had to go to watch parties to see the games. The host who greeted us was also rude.

Misleading, Cramped & Not Worth Your Money
Don't be fooled by the photos — clearly taken with a wide-angle lens to make the space appear larger and more appealing than it actually is. In reality, the apartment is small, cluttered, and feels like someone is still living in it. The host claims to be an interior designer, but there is absolutely no evidence of that here. The interior is tired, uninspired, and well below the standard you'd expect.
The second bedroom is a windowless box — completely unacceptable and something that should be clearly disclosed in the listing. The bathroom door has no handle, which is as ridiculous as it sounds, and the sink drains so slowly it's clearly blocked and long overdue for maintenance.
If that weren't enough, the apartment sits directly next to a train station. Trains rumble past constantly, making rest and relaxation virtually impossible — day or night.
This stay was a disappointment from start to finish. Mi
The location is very good, the place is nice with good space. There are a few blocks close by that are sketchy. We didn’t feel unsafe, but it was unpleasant to walk through and see.

I would not stay here again.
There is another unit on site in the basement. It sounded like I was sleeping with a loud snoring man one night in an adjoining room. Another night I kept hearing the beeping of what sounded like a door lock so I got up at least five times to check someone hadn’t entered our unit from the adjoining interior door. Another night there was someone drilling all night long!?
Most beds (which all 9 people in our party commented on immediately being the hardest they had ever felt) came only with the pillow sham pillows. The hosts were gracious to bring us 4 additional pillow cases that we were able to use for those with decorations to be able to sleep.
The kitchen did not have enough plates and silverware to service our party for a meal. We had to rewash the dishes we did have available as they were not clean.
There were drawers with personal toiletries / medicines like someone lived there, but did a quick move out?
Not clean to our standards.

Great area; Responsive host but terrible place to stay;
The unit did not match photos and was way rusted than what was depicted.
There was strong bothering smell upon arrival.
There was no curtains for blocking the blinding light coming from the street, making it impossible to sleep during night as it was right into the eyes.
The depicted couch in the photo was convertible to bed, but not the real one in the unit.
The floor was sticky and terrible feeling when walking with barefoot.

I would not recommend staying here. We booked this stay and the photos and address did not match the place that we were instructed to go to. Completely misled and not what we paid for at the end of the day. Had to find a new place super last minute and it was a total nightmare.

Not the Unit Advertised – Completely Misleading and Host Knew It
This listing was blatantly misleading. The photos shown are not of the unit you receive. The space is smaller, the layout and furniture are completely different, and it’s even in a different building/neighbourhood.
The listing gives the impression of a modern, spacious unit with parking. That’s not what we got.
When addressed, the host admitted the photos were from a previous owner and had never been updated. She offered a full refund only if we left immediately - which was unreasonable, as I was very pregnant and unable to relocate on short notice.
This was not a minor oversight. As a host myself, I consider it a serious failure in honest representation - I couldn’t imagine knowingly doing that to guests. We’ve submitted a formal complaint to Airbnb with photo and video evidence.
