Do not book this listing unless the photos and description have been fully updated.

Cons;
Big construction front of the house which has not been told in advance and host was aware of that. Started on weekdays 7am with LOTS of noise.
Couple dirty towels.
Not enough kitchenware at all for 9 persons, and listing is for 12. Two BIG broken fridges in kitchen. Working fridge quite small for 9.
Bad smell in the house when arriving, did not get away even many hours of airing.
Master bedroom AC unit was really noisy. Upstairs separate bathroom ventilation system was really noisy. Front yard was dirty (cigarette butts and others), and was not taken care at all. Plants/grass was growing recklessly and there was no any kind of seats outside.
Living room sofas should be bigger, as the listing is for 12 persons. Was really hard to sit together in one place.
From the listing pictures rooms did look really bright, but that was not the case. Really dark inside even in the daytime.
Plus;
Rooms were large and beds were comfortable. Bathrooms were overall good.

Don’t waste your time, listing says 3 people. But there is only one bed no bed rooms. I got charged for adding an extra guess so I went from 2 to 3 which is still within the reasonable limit but they couldn’t even stay with me. Due to the lack of place to sleep. Misleading advertisement, not the spot I paid for. Possible scam.

Don t book this place. It s describe at 1 bedroom but it is definitely not. They built fake wall around the bed and call that a room.
The entire electricity is trash, the fridge broke two time. There is literraly nothing inside so you cannot cook.
There are many homeless searching the trash day and night. Once there was a racoon. The neighboor are really noisy, there was a party in the street 3 times while I was there. Couldnt sleep.
It was already 28 degres celcius outside and you don t know why there is heater on in the bathroom so the place is basically an oven...
It s overpriced, I would not recommend.

This is a basic room in a good neighbourhood. Unfortunately the shared kitchen and bathroom were really dirty…. Hair and cotton buds in basin, bathroom just off shared kitchen, mouldy shower over bath, same bath mat in place for 3 days. Cooking smells pervaded from 6-7 am all day. Family living upstairs (? Also tenants) were polite and accomodating but their cooking dominated kitchen… leaving benches dirty and food on sink and food waste smelling. The noise from upstairs was unavoidable for them (kids running around) but not great. They were a lovely family, so no criticism of f them (other than that they should wipe down kitchen after use).
Room was adequate with clean linen but no mirror, no bin, one chair. No plug in bathroom so hair drying etc in room with no mirror.
Fence outside bedroom had broken latch and blew noisily in wind all night…. We had to secure it with a tied t shirt in middle of night.
Overall … adequate given that Vancouver accommodation is a nightmare!

+ Great location
+ Nice view
+ Atousa quickly responded. The answers were clear and seemed like copy and paste answers. If so many guests have asked the same questions, why not send them with the uninformative check in email?
+ Road noise was much quieter than expected. I have sound issues and the outside noises including the train did not bother me at all
- Zero information in the ‘check in’ instructions on how to park and get from the parking garage to the unit
- Zero information on how to access the amenities listed as features
- The view is the top reason I chose to stay at this unit and it can’t be enjoyed while inside the unit as the windows were very dirty
- Dirty walls some spots were gross
- There are many things needing minor attention that they all started to stand out after a while and made the unit less enjoyable
There's nothing that would make me suggest someone not to stay here, however the next time I am in Vancouver, I will more than likely choose a different unit

Unfortunately, I really regret booking this Airbnb. We felt extremely unsafe in the area, and at one point someone followed us back toward the property while threatening us. It got serious enough that we had to call 911.
Communication with the host was also terrible responses would often take 5–6 hours, which is especially frustrating when you’re dealing with an urgent situation. The whole experience left us shaken and completely ruined our stay. Had I known what to expect, I would never have booked this place and definitely wouldn’t stay again.
Adding to that it is really not worth the price we paid. Would never recommend anyone ever.

We’ve had some terrible experiences with Air BnB in the past few years. It seems like every booking we find filthy, used bedsheets, dirty suites, even injury!  I am elated to report that Carlos’ place was just what we needed. He was also one of the most responsive hosts I’ve dealt with, which is definitely appreciated, especially when we’re on the 615 ferry to Vancouver and trying to book a suite! Suite is clean and modern, bathroom is nice and bright with a great shower.  We had our reservations about the bed, as it was neither a king nor a queen, but my wife and I were immensely comfortable and slept very well indeed. Carlos offers guests a discount if they book with him again, so he can definitely count on us coming back…cheers, Carlos!

The location was wonderful and very walkable to a lot of places. However, the unit itself was dirty with mold and stains and overall felt pretty unclean. The bed is also a pullout mattress, which wasn’t very comfortable since it was sagging in the middle. The pictures made the unit seem like it was bright and refreshed, but it’s actually pretty dated.

The photos of this place are obviously doctored and Photoshopped. It's an old building without any elevators or working ventilation. There are no fans and no AC. There is no washer or dryer. There are just a lot of smoke stains, old dirty carpets that soak up marijuana odour, and dirty walls. The host, which is a property management company, was very slow to respond and do anything about the situation. I sent them videos and pictures and was mostly ignored. I would not spend hard earned money on this place that is not clearly advertised. I recommend staying somewhere else and away from Artin Properties.

DO NOT BOOK HERE. It was filthy. The only "preparation" was the bed. Within the first hour, a mouse passed by my leg. It didn't take longer than 2 minutes to find a mouse trap, insinuating SOMEONE knew about the rodent infestation/activity. We immediately left. We spent 1 hour out of the planned 3 nights, and Brandon was no help at all. He claimed he had "no idea" there was a mouse trap in the unit, which was either a blatant lie or he has absolutely no knowledge of what goes on in this unit. Not only that, but he refused a refund. Absurd. Because of this incident alone, I will never be using AirBNB ever again.
Save yourself the trouble and pay the extra $100 for a hotel nearly, instead of wasting $300 to this blatant scam artist. We recommend The Victorian Hotel.

It's close to everything and we like that. But, if you're sensitive to party noise then either use a sound machine app or don't stay here. The host was responsive and the key cafe she used made it easy to check-in.
The fridge was dirty upon check-in and all the cups and dishes were still in the dishwasher...not a huge deal for us. The furniture is cheap Ikea quality but worked okay.
Although the temps were in the 70 degree range, we still appreciated that there was a portable A/C unit in the living room to help cool it off more.
The bed was comfortable but we were disgusted when we saw the gross mattress...it was beyond filthy and stained. Looked like it was straight from a dumpster. Had we seen it beforehand, we would have left immediately.
If the owner purchases a new bed then we could recommend staying here.

Ryan was a very friendly host. We had a large group of 8 so we needed a bigger space. There wasn’t much seating so we had to rearrange some of the couches. The tv also was broken so we couldn’t use it & luckily, Ryan gave us a new one the following day. The house itself is definitely older & had an interesting smell upon entering. The kitchen was rather dirty & the drawers had food scraps/crumbs in them. The floors also felt dirty/dusty (socks were dirty after walking on the floors). There were also tons of spiders which I guess is normal for a house near greenery. The beds were comfy. This house is good for a big group, as there are a lot of rooms but it’s huge. Would come back & stay but would recommend bringing slippers. 7.5/10 overall.

We enjoyed our stay for 5 days. Ryan was a great host, always available and ready to help whenever we had questions about the place.
We only had a few negative points during our stay, more like small disappointments. Everything looked good and clean in the pictures, but when we arrived, we found some garbage underneath the bed and nightstand in the master bedroom.
Second, we weren’t able to use the back deck/patio during our stay because both the floor and the patio set (table and chairs) were dirty and not properly arranged, unlike what was shown in the photos.
Lastly, the house and furnitures are a bit old as well, but this wasn’t a big deal especially if this is a newer Airbnb unit.
Overall, we still had a good stay. If this unit gets a renovation in the future, we would love to stay here again the next time we come back to Vancouver.

Pros:
The apartment is in a great location. It’s only a few minutes to Gastown and Chinatown. There are sketchy areas, but luckily not at this building. The place was pretty large and accommodated my friend and me very comfortably. The beds were comfortable and the kitchen was equipped.
Cons:
There were some minor issues with cleanliness. I had to clean my nightstands and drawers before using them because they were dirty and had hairs on and in them. Lots of areas on the walls and baseboards are clearly either old or have had damage (with some of the baseboard under the window being ripped apart). The guest bathroom door was wonky and the latch would get stuck. You have to lift the door from the bottom to prevent you from being locked out or in.
Overall, it was comfortable to stay, mostly for the location, and we had a great time, but it needs a bit of TLC.

so as I mentioned place needs upgrades, no flooring just cement, not enough blankets, coat hangers, beds very hard and cheap, so I feel the ad is misleading, I expected much from what the ad said, was disappointed.

We were booked into the AirBnB for July 2-5 but only stayed one night.
The apartment is on the 35th flr and there being no A/C the place was stifling hot. The absence of A/C is noted in the listing but we missed that as it is at the very bottom of the listing.
The apartment is literally steps from the SkyTrain as it says in the listing, so there is constant noise from the trains and with no A/C, the windows were open all night, and the noise from the train made it impossible to sleep.
The underground parking is a nightmare, best to unload at the ground floor loading dock.
AirBnB was employing “surge” pricing due to events in the city, and the condo just wasn't worth the price.
There were a number of other issues that will hopefully get addressed as we pointed them out to Cong.
Having said all that, Cong was very responsive to our messages, sent fans and ear plugs and refunded the rest of our stay which he didn't have to do, and we ended up staying at a hotel for the rest of our stay.

The location is quiet and in a nice neighborhood with easy street parking, which we appreciated. However, the room was very disappointing. The key system is old and hard to use we struggled to get in. The basement room smelled strongly of cooking, and the space was unclean with dust, pet hair, and stains on the bedding. We couldn’t sleep the first night due to the poor condition. I appreciate that Jing refunded one night and provided clean sheets the next day, but overall, the cleanliness and setup were far below expectations.

Overall, I was happy with my stay — the place itself was clean, comfortable, and matched the photos. The host was responsive and check-in was easy. However, the surrounding area was quite loud at night and felt a bit sketchy, with quite a few homeless people around. It didn’t feel unsafe, but it’s something to be aware of. The couch could also use a deep clean or maybe even a replacement, as it’s seen better days. Aside from that, the inside of the unit was nice and had everything I needed.

The house is beautiful and in a fantastic neighborhood. The family lives in the home and they keep pretty much to themselves in their own private areas. There is an adorable little girl who's always miling and waving hello.  Our room was huge and very nice. One of the recent reviews I read mentioned the shared fridge and I thought they were exaggerating. Unfortunately it was worse than mentioned. You would not be able to put even a can of pop in the fridge or freezer if you wanted. As a matter of fact a lot of the fresh fruit and veggies get kept outside on a table as there is no room in the fridge. We ended up having to leave our food on the porch as we had nowhere to put it. The worst was the  bed.  Squeaky is an understatement, you couldn't move without it making terrible noise.  There were no face cloths or hand towels, we went and bought our own. No TV in bedroom and only garbage in room was in the bathroom. A few small touches and a carpet cleaning would make the room much better

This was one of the worst Airbnb stays I’ve had. The listing was misleading—after booking, the host changed the room for the first night without prior consent. The room had a bad smell, spiders, and was missing basic essentials like paper towels. I notified the host, and she promised me a free night to make up for the issues, but never followed through. The place was extremely dirty and not well-maintained. I would not recommend this property to anyone.

Only positive thing about the accommodation is the location, convenient to town and attractions.
The ad said quiet nrighbourhood, true but didnt say it was on a busy road and as the property was old and the wooden windows in a bad stage traffic was heard all night long.
The property was older but filthy isn’t acceptable. As soon as we opened the front door we were hit with it. The blinds on the door had dust from years gone by. And the skirting boards certainly haven’t see a duster either with mold growing on the bathroom skirts. Then to make matters worse the dust pan and brush that was sitting by the fridge, which I assume was for us to use in the event that we created a mess, was vile!
Message a couple of times to say couple things weren't working but never herd back till after we left.
Worse accommodation on our 2 week Canadian holiday.
Compare it to a dirty cheap student accommodation.
Won't recommend at all.
I wouldn’t recommend this place, it had bugs all over the place. It was disgusting. I had to cancel.

We stayed here with my husband and parents visiting from abroad. The apartment was comfortable for four adults. Clean, well-equipped kitchen, and very good beds.
The main drawback was the lack of central AC. Opening the windows was noisy, but the portable unit in the living room and fans in the bedrooms kept things manageable at this time of year.
The shower was excellent. The bathtub in the master, however, felt unsafe to use - too easy to slip without handholds, so I wouldn’t recommend it for older guests.
I also appreciated the small, well-equipped gym and the many restaurants within walking distance.
Overall, a great stay and I’d happily return.

We were very disappointed with our stay. While the location is convenient to shops and restaurants, the surrounding area felt unsafe (especially with children) due to the large homeless community nearby. The unit did not meet basic cleanliness standards, with visible stains/hair from previous guests on the linens, damage to the walls/floors, broken glass on the balcony, and mold in one of the showers. We had to clean the linens/shower ourselves before use. After contacting the host, her only solution was to send someone to clean (something that should have been done prior). With such a short stay and busy schedule, this was very inconvenient, and we were not comfortable with someone entering the unit while we were out. She then shifted blame on us and sent a man to the unit without notice, which further added to our discomfort. For about $600 for two nights, we expected a much higher standard. The parking situation and add’l fees for linens was ridiculous as well. We do not recommend!

The name of the unit is Woodland House, but the unit is a musty, rundown, two room basement, unlike the pictures on the site. Kitchen is dirty with crumbs left on the stove and counter, stains on the duvet covers. There’s also roach and ant spray left out. We walked into the unit entryway which was filthy with dirt. We could not stay, instead we had to scramble to find a hotel last minute. I do not recommend this unit.

William is a good host, responsive and gave us great food recommendations. This particular listing is decidedly a work in progress. The bedding and appliances were clean and the water filter was a nice touch. We found a lot of dirt, evidence of bugs, dirty kitchen towels, and what looked like mold in the bathroom. The place gets hot in the summer, but opening the window lets all the bugs in so it's a bit of a trade-off. Nice to have a well-stocked kitchen!

Property has cockroaches in the kitchen and I got my full refund waiting to have it comeback to my account but Airbnb support and host wasn’t helpful providing another arrangement for terrible mess up and hassle situation. After midnight couldn’t book another place last minute had to sleep in my car until morning from midnight 6-7 hours spent in my car. Host left me homeless after midnight and nothing comparable was available. Not happy with my stay here.
nice host. nice home, however there is a cockroach infestation. airbnb did refund me my money back in full.

This property is not in a safe location of town.  It was described on one section of the posting that it provides “secured parking”, but ended up being a paid parking structure ross the street.  It also described itself as being conditioned.  The reality is there was just a portable AC in the living room.  The bedroom and bathroom are not properly cooled in hot days.  “Host not only deny refund request due to misleading description page, I received a message asking me to contact him directly instead of giving bad rating on Air BnB if I have negatives to say.  I ended up swallowing my loss and ended up not staying there for even more than 15 minutes.  I will never stay in any of the property from this host.

Overall, the Airbnb stay was okay. The bed was clean and comfortable, and the room was relaxing. The host was also responsive whenever we needed assistance.
However, there were a few issues that should be improved. The toilet walls and sink were not properly cleaned, and on the first day the kitchen sink was also dirty.
The biggest concern was the guests staying on the lower level at the time of our stay. Twice, they tried to open our room door with a key while we were inside. This made us feel unsafe, especially because there were clearly sounds coming from inside the room. Please speak with them to prevent situations like this from happening again, as other guests may decide to report this kind of behavior.

Great area for the neighborhood and the transit line as the station is a two minute walk away. The bedroom and bathroom were not clean though. There was garbage and dust under the bed, as well as random lash clusters from a different guest. The carpets in the bathroom were very dirty and the bathroom sink. You can tell no one has vacuumed or cleaned the floors in a long long time. Also dealt with several bugs such as fruit flies and ants on the kitchen counter. We were only here for a quick stay but regardless it should not be this dirty. Hosts were very communicable and responsive.

I don’t recommend. The place was dirty with hair, dust, crumbs, and an ant infestation in the kitchen. There were no other guests there when we checked in so it seems the standard of cleanliness is just low.
The room was hot (no AC) and the bed was very hard. Made it very difficult to sleep.
The wifi doesn’t work well.
Overall it was an uncomfortable stay, and certainly not worth the price we paid.

I was only there for about half an hour before needing to contact the host. The space was dirty, furniture was broken, TV didn’t work and another guest had let in a man/visitor. Within minutes of arrival they were having sex. The space is really small so I was within 3 feet of this happening. I could even use the bathroom because the man had gone into it and left an awful smell. I contacted the host and told them of the issues and that I wanted to refund so I could leave as I didn’t not feel safe. It was refused so I dealt directly with air bnb. Total visit time was about an hour.  I was disgusted at the filth of the space and behaviour of the other guest and how the host did nothing to remedy it. My comfort meant nothing. This place is nothing but a money grab. I’ve stayed in many places, mostly shared space and have never encountered such an awful and dismissive host, guests lacking in morals nor such a filthy space. Do not stay here.
Mattress and bedding were stained. Closet in master bedroom had a horrible feces like smell. Unit was not clean when arrived and had to wait.

We do not recommend this home. On arrival, outside the home looked abandoned and we didn't recognize it from the listing pics. Inside were cobwebs, spiders, egg sacs, bugs. There is mold in the bathrooms. Wall lighting and door jambs above 2m are caked in grime. LR lighting is a paper lantern stapled to a beam. There are a few lamps, one missing on/off knob. Home needs major repairs. Other guests mention a sloping floor. This seems to be because the house is leaning to one side, there seems to be a structural issue. The back door and several windows don't align. In the kitchen, you can see the fridge is plugged into a surge protector extension cord that is caked in grime. Other guests have mentioned the back door not securing properly. So a door chain lock was installed. This door chain lock does not secure the door. However the door can be locked, it is an old style locking mechanism. Host later provided a video on how to lock the door, after concerns were raised. Why not at check in?

Unfortunatly, the pictures on the listing do no represent the state of the house accurately. Hopefully we just had a one-off situation and the house hadn’t been cleaned after a dirty previous guest. The sliding door in the kitchen does not lock properly and slides open by itself, TV’s are not connected to power, remotes don’t work with the TV, dirty floors and hand rails, screaming upstairs sink because it’s leaking, and felt more like a male college frat house. Unfortunately this is the worst eperience with the house we have had with AirBNB so far, but grateful we at least had a roof over our heads for the rainy weekend we stayed. Fortunately, the host was very kind and communicative before and after the stay.

Alexander let us drop our bags off eariler than check in which was super helpful. Although the place was not cleaned upon check in, he was proactive on solving the issue, was apologetic and refunded us a portion. We were impressed with the loft. Great location, lots of trendy restaurants and shops nearby. The coffee shop downstairs was awesome! The beds were comfortable and we loved the huge couch with TV and fireplace. It was a cool space to hang out in. Little bit of noise at night, but what else would you expect being right downtown. It was fun to people watch through the windows. We ate out but the kitchen looked well equipped. Little bump in the road but altogether it was a fabulous stay and we would come back again!
Thanks again Alexander 😊

Srini was a responsive host for a home that looked on the inside more like a poker/ bachelor gathering place than a home for families. Every bedroom had wires exposed and holes in the walls from TVs removed and some of these wires were below waist level where children could access.  There was a pack and play bed covering the main coax cables in the master bedroom.  The next issue was cleanliness, there was thick dust on the return air grill in upstairs hallway and visible dust around every air return on the ceilings.  When we went looking for bath towels some were dirty some clean.  When we stripped the master bedroom we found out we were sleeping on the bed bug mattress cover, no fitted sheet and under that were large mattress stains.  This place needs a team of cleaners and paint to cover up all the poker/ bachelor brawl fights.  Fix the exposed wires, holes and clean the front of the house too.  When you walk up the house looks neglected and abandoned.

Great location in Yaletown. Close to restaurants and active part of town.
Apartment was quaint - fine for a party of 2. Floors were noticeably dirty and unclean. Had to wear shoes inside otherwise had to wash feet multiple times to get off gunk from floors.
No AC- very hot during summer. Kept single window open through night but exposed us to noise / sirens / etc. apartment did not cool easily.
Towels were a gym towel- poor quality and very small.
Host was nice but kept one key once got us inside upon our arrival. Was a bit sketchy knowing someone else had one and could enter at any time. We ended up putting chairs against door at night just in case. Would not recommend for solo travelers because of this.
Pillows were very thin. Only provided 2. Bed was squeaky all night when anyone moved so we kept waking each other up.
Provided 1 fan which didn’t keep us cool with 80* heat and light coming in windows from day.
Great location, the set up needs some work.

Great location and views, but the property needs maintenance. It is close to the train station, a drug store, and an Asian supermarket, with beautiful creek views. Check-in instructions were helpful, and the host provided good food recommendations.
However, guests should note a few major issues:
-Noise & Space: There is noticeable street and train noise. Photos are misleading; multiple rooms contain large portable AC units that significantly reduce the usable floor area.
- Cooling: The AC exhaust vent was faulty, pushing warm air back into the bedroom and making it uncomfortably hot.
- Electrical: Outlets are limited, and the ones in the master bedroom frequently cut in and out of power completely.
- Communication: The host was very slow to respond to a broken window and completely ignored messages about the AC. No resolutions were offered.
An April 2026 review mentioned these exact same mishaps. It is disappointing that these recurring issues have not been fixed.

The place was nice, clean and great views of the city.
Although a pool and hot tub were listed, but they were unavailable during our stay. When this was brought up to the host with a request for a partial refund they attempted to put the blame on me for not inquiring leading up to my stay if the pool and hot tub were still going to be available during my stay (unreasonable suggestion) this added with inconsistency’s as to the timing of when they were notified from management at the building as to the shut down of the pool and hot tub. Unfortunately this could not be resolved without having to involving Airbnb customer support for my partial refund.
The place is great and I would like to say I would stay here again, but the way the host has handled this would make me not recommend host and their property.
great location and walkable to everywhere however you can tell the place is old and needs maintenance . the bathroom was not clean, the shower curtain was full of mould and the floor had dust

Beautiful old house in a great walkable neighborhood! For the most part it was clean and comfortable.
However, ventilation is poor with old windows that don’t open and no AC. One window has a screen but it gets direct sun in the afternoon/evening. Cooling off the house on just a mildly warm day requires opening the front door and several windows without screens.
Couch was dirty under cushions and someone left an Invisalign / retainer set and case on the counter.
Listing included a photo of bikes in the basement, implying they can be used by guests. I msgd hosts to confirm but they said no bikes are available. They agreed to remove the photo and clarify the listing a week ago yet the photo is still on the listing. Seems misleading.

I would NOT recommend this AirB&B at all. First off, the photos on the listing are very deceiving and misleading.. And it has you go to one side of the house when in fact it was on the other side of the house. WiFi was not working and the lack of communication from the owner was astounding. Was offered another WiFi but the password never worked. And the place is all banged up with obvious damage to the walls and A LOT of doors so in a sense it does not feel VERY private even though it is. And you can hear EVERYONE upstairs so it’s very difficult to sleep. I’m a heavy sleeper and I definitely woke up a handful of times to them walking around. This is definitely one of those “last resort” AirB&Bs if it’s an emergency. Besides that, I would not recommend. Definitely will not be back. Besides that surrounding area was the only decent thing coming out of this AirB&B.

Place was clean and exactly as described! Unfortunately the floors were sticky in some areas which made it uncomfortable to walk around and the neighbor sleeping next to me rudely knocked loudly against the wall because I was talking “too loud.” It was only because the walls were thin and I was on the phone. But this isn’t the host’s fault, just keep in mind the bedrooms are close to each other so I wouldn’t recommend more then 2 people staying here even though rules says 3 people maximum.

PROS:
Area - seemed a bit sketchy at first but ended up being quiet and walkable…great little 24hr bakery right on the corner!
Shower - had good pressure and good hot water
Bed - fairly comfortable and soft sheets
CONS:
Safety - Entry door looks like it was broken in before…, could be pushed in a bit from outside…made me feel unsafe
Window to bedroom was unlocked and would have given someone super easy access on ground level if I hadn’t checked & locked it when I got there
Cleanliness…
There was still water in the kettle from previous guest. That makes me wonder what else wasn’t checked.
Bathroom - looks dirty…baseboards, door, and light switch looked dirty
Space - sleeps 4 but only 1 couch that seats 2 comfortably (the picture w/ fireplace is the entire living room)…and, fireplace not operational.
I love going to AirBnBs and heavily rely on feedback from other people. Don’t like giving negative feedback, but I wish someone had mentioned some of these things

The suite itself was spacious but unfortunately the windows didn't lock so we felt unsafe sleeping there. Not having the option to open all of the windows was disappointing as it was extremely hot inside when we arrived and only one fan. After discovering we could open a small window in the kitchen and one in the farthest bedroom, we realized the windows didn't lock. We were on the ground floor so we had to put some kitchen items in the window frames in order to feel safe. Also, the photos uploaded to this listing are AI unfortunately. The cupboards in the kitchen are not new and white, they are dated and pink and not a single cupboard has a handle/knob. It is the same situation in the bathroom, I believe AI was used to upgrade the photo and make it look newer than it actually is. The last thing we noticed was that there was no lids for the pots and pans, so cooking was difficult. There was a huge hairball in the shower drain that made it drain slowly. But the beds were satisfactory.

Horrible experience with Carlos. He refused to give us keys to both the main door AND the room door, despite us asking several times. Because of that, we got locked out of the house 4 times in the rain without any way of entering.
Constant noise and indecency from the long-term roommate. Always shouting and yelling in Arabic all day long until late at night, having loud intercourse with his girlfriend, and walking around the house half naked. He's also friend with the owner so be prepared to be gaslit.
It got so bad that we were forced to cancel prematurely.
Avoid this place like the plague.

We chose this property partly because the listing emphasized professional cleaning, but our experience did not reflect that standard. The bathrooms were dirty, with unclean floors, cobwebs, a broken fan, broken fixtures, and visible mold in the shower. Our room also appeared not to have been professionally cleaned, with dirty surfaces, a dirty lamp, no top sheet, and missing advertised items. The kitchen cupboards were dirty and disorganized, there was a noticeable garbage/mold odor, several doors were difficult to operate, and the advertised hot tub did not appear functional.
To Ellna’s credit, when I sent her a message about the issues, she responded promptly and provided a fan, tissue box, and lamp the next day. She did say she would address the issues, however, the cleanliness and maintenance concerns remained unresolved during our stay. I also noticed multiple new listings for this property, which made me think listings may be being deleted after a negative review.

The sleeping setup was nothing like the pictures. What was described as a bed was actually a sofa and felt like sleeping on wood, making it extremely uncomfortable. The room was dark, stuffy, and had a strong musty smell. The kitchen was not functional, the bathroom was old, and the floors were dirty. Overall, a disappointing stay.

Finding and entering the building was such a hassle, you need to call the host to buzz you in and if he doesn’t respond on time you will be waiting with your luggage on the streets. As we entered the apartment we all took our shoes off as instructed, to our surprise all of our socks got really dirty from the dust on the floor. The sheets did not look clean, the pillows had stains on them and each bathroom had one roll of toilet paper. It was disgusting we had to use kitchen napkins in the bathroom. The view is very beautiful but not worth this headache. Luckily, we only stayed there for one night but I def feel bad for anyone staying more than a night.

Our first Airbnb experience was disappointing. We booked this listing because it advertised air conditioning, but when we asked how to use it, the host told us there was no AC.
Parking was also frustrating. We were not informed that the road in front of the building was blocked due to FIFA-related events, and the garage entrance was difficult to find until we requested a diagram. The parking space itself was very tight.
The check-in instructions could have been clearer. As first-time visitors to a downtown apartment, we did not know building and elevator access could take several attempts. Thankfully, the host was responsive throughout.
Inside the unit, we found stained and torn bedding, stains in the bathtub, several non-working outlets, and no in-unit AC. The kitchen was well-equipped, and extra towels and pillows were provided.
Overall, the inaccurate AC listing, parking difficulties, and cleanliness concerns made our stay disappointing.

I booked this room because I had read all the amazing comments from previous travellers: Room and kitchen impeccable, hosts very welcoming, comfortable room and very central place from where you can reach any place in Vancouver… Well, given the 5 stars, I had expectations. And my stay at A & H’s place did not disappoint. It went really beyond what I could imagine!! Everything you read is true. And the hosts give their 200% to make you feel welcomed and ensure your stay is to remember. Thank you A for everything, you were right: We build great friendships at this house 🙏🏻  I cannot recommend this place enough!!

Check-in instruction wasn't provided until we asked (which was 3hours after check-in time), and place was dirty. So much dust on bed that one of us developed allergic reaction the first night, dead bugs on the bed, empty toilet paper rolls were on random places, used dirty towels in dryer, big orange stains on couch, and not enough towels were provided. Although we asked for bed sheet changes the next day, they just placed a new one in the living room. Location was decent, but considering very expensive deal, it was not worth it.

Unfortunately, we did not have a good experience. The biggest issue was the lack of privacy. Although there is a separate entrance for another ground-level unit, the two units are connected inside with only a curtain separating them. There is no locked door, so someone from the other unit could easily enter your space.
Noise was also a major problem. We could hear conversations from upstairs, and footsteps at night sounded like people stomping, making it hard to sleep.
The bathroom was dirty and frankly disgusting when we arrived, and towels were missing.
The TV never worked because it wouldn't connect to Wi-Fi. We contacted the host, who said they'd look into it, but never followed up. The internet was also unreliable and frequently disconnected our devices.
The fridge water dispenser didn't work either. Overall, the privacy issue alone is enough that we would not stay here again.

NO SCREENS ON WINDOWS. And no A/C. We had to choose sweltering in the heat or bugs.
Host provided a mattress for 5th guest with huge disgusting stains on it. We weren't going to use it so asked for it to be removed. Host neither removed it nor supplied dishwasher pods. Said they couldn't access the suite?!?
There is no table to eat on in the kitchen. We had to take the dirty patio table inside and buy a cover for it from the dollar store.
There is an electrical wire sticking out next to the light switches by the front door. If you move it, the lights flicker. It's not taped off at the end. Is that live??
I could go on but bottom line we paid a lot of money for two nights and did not have a good experience with this suite. Thank goodness we didn't need to spend much time in this suite while in Vancouver.

The view and top floor lounge/hot tub were very nice, and the barebones amenities were as advertised, not an issue.
However, we came in to a wide open window, apparent rodent or bird droppings on the window pane, a half-used sexual stimulant in the bathroom and a terrible smell from the dishwasher.
For the price, and especially for someone asking for more money for early check in/late check out (supposedly because of the time needed for cleaning), the cleanliness was unacceptable. There appeared to be minimal if any cleaning done prior to our arrival.

I use Airbnb often as I work remotely, and this is the only time I've ever had to contact Airbnb for a refund. Great location, but that's about it. The apartment had a strong cigarette smoke odor and the bed sheets and pillows smelled like smoke mixed with body odor. It was disgusting. My throat was burning from the odor so I had to keep the windows and balcony door open the entire time to air the place out. Tried to wash the pillow cases to get the smell out, but there was no laundry detergent (only bleach?). I tried to address the odor with host and she completely ignored the multiple messages I sent about it and instead responded with a random message offering late check out for a fee? Safe to say I contacted Airbnb after checkout and got a partial refund.

Never book this property.
At first glance, everything looks great in the photos, but the actual experience was very disappointing. The host was extremely difficult to reach. Different phone numbers were provided during the booking process, and none of them were answered when assistance was needed.
Parking is also a major issue. Finding a suitable parking spot was very difficult and added unnecessary stress to the stay.
Communication from the host was poor throughout. Calls went unanswered, and responses were either delayed or unavailable when help was required.
What surprised me the most was that there was no toilet paper available upon check-in. I had to wait approximately 4–5 hours before it was finally provided, which made even basic use of the washroom difficult.
Overall, the lack of communication, parking problems, and missing basic necessities made this a very frustrating experience. I would not recommend this property to others.

This was a serviceable place to stay for what we needed and for the price. We were allowed to check in early which was helpful and the location is great. It’s close to UBC and the waterfront.
It was described as having a kitchenette, pots and pans, and a toaster. The kitchenette is debatable as there is no counter or kitchen sink so dishes need to be washed in the bathroom. There was no cookware or toaster so some of the food we bought before arriving went to waste.
It was generally clean enough; however there were a few things not cleaned that stood out. The bedding had a large stain, there were crumbs around on places like seat cushions and the floor. The main thing was that the coffee maker had a used filter with coffee in it that had grown some mold and the carafe had used coffee that was covered in mold.
Also, at one point we went out for the evening and the gate to get in was locked when we returned and there was no response when we rang the bell or messaged through the app
Wouldn’t recommend, they just scam you and say you need a credit card to stay here and won’t refund you

Warning: Unsafe Behaviour by staff and unsafe environment
1. No private bathrooms in the rooms but I’ve stayed in hostels before so I figured no big deal. I check out the bathroom and noticed they were all gender neutral. These bathrooms are shared with EVERYONE in the floor. Men and women. I don’t know what would possess a hotel to think having a space where women will be naked and vulnerable is okay to share with every single strange and unknown man in the hallway. I started feeling extremely uncomfortable
2. A few minutes later I’m back in my room and I hear my door unlock. A female staff member walks into my room UNAUTHORIZED!!. She unlocked my door, did not knock, or announce herself. She just entered. I was laying in my bed and when she saw me she got scared, apologized and walked out the room. Ive NEVER in my life had someone unlock my door and enter my personal space that way.
This hotel is not safe. My privacy was violated and I felt extremely uncomfortable. DO NOT BOOK!

The worst Airbnb experience I’ve ever had.
The sheets were dirty and stained.
There’s a nightclub right across from the residence, which made it impossible to sleep.
The air conditioner in the bedroom couldn’t be turned off with the remote control.
There was a power outage that lasted all morning, which prevented us from charging our devices, a major problem since our flight was scheduled to leave just a few hours later.
The shared shower and restroom were dirty.
No mention was made of the $200 security deposit we had to pay, I’ve never seen anything like it and they said the deposit would be returned within 48 hours, but I still haven’t received anything even though I left the room in very good condition.
Very disappointed, I strongly advise against staying here!

This was the most poorly maintained Airbnb I’ve ever stayed at. Super dirty, shower curtain held in place with tape, holes in the wall covered with tape, dirty pans, sticky kitchen surfaces, etc. On top of that the host neglected to admit his faults and isn’t providing any compensation.

We were disappointed overall with this basement Airbnb. For the high price we paid, there were insufficient dishes for five people (3 bowls, 2 plates)… One pot and nothing to cook in the oven. No salt, pepper, oil which would have been nice. Dishwashing soap provided with a dirty scrub brush. One roll of toilet paper for 5 people for two days. We had to buy these basics (including a baking pan). Old furniture, responsive host but despite promising they would deliver an iron (listing said they had one - they knew in advance we were there for a wedding), they did not. Not really a three bedroom. One “bed” was simply foam over a base (an old hot tub?). Only kids could sleep there and not for long. Other beds were comfortable. Really not at all as advertised.

Unfortunately, I cannot recommend this stay.
The host confirmed the apartment was ready for check-in and asked what time I would be arriving. I advised I was on my way and arrived shortly after 9 PM. At no point was there any indication of a check-in cutoff time.
When I arrived, I was unable to access the property and repeatedly attempted to contact the host through Airbnb. Despite multiple messages, I received no response. I waited outside with my luggage for over an hour before being forced to leave.
As a solo female traveller, this left me in an unsafe situation late at night without access to the accommodation I had booked. Despite contacting Airbnb for assistance, I was ultimately left without a place to stay that night.
The following morning, the host informed me that they had gone to bed and missed my messages. When I later contacted the host regarding some of the costs that resulted from the situation, I received no response.

Location was easily walkable to many restaurants/activities and half a block from the Skytrain and other transportation options.  (Be aware that Vancouver does have a homeless problem and while some wandered near the Skytrain station, we did not have any issues.) Apartment itself was roomy and surprisingly quiet with a lovely view to an enclosed courtyard. Host was very responsive to all our questions.  'Did knock one star off the review because the cleaners seem to have stopped halfway through their process and left the bathroom floor dirty, a quilt in the dryer and wet dishes in the diswasher.  Host planned to follow up, so future guests will likely not have the same issue.  Would definitely return if possible in the future.

Very lovely space and the host was quite helpful. The only issue we had with the rental was that the outdoor space, in particular the rooftop patio was incredibly dirty and did not match the listing pictures. It was unusable, which was incredibly disappointing given its potential and the fact that it is so prominent on the listing (ie, it was the amenity that maxed us choose this listing over others). The pool and hot tub were great, as was the children’s play area, which was a nice surprise.

The location of and view from this place were incredible. However it lacked some basic maintenance and amenities that would go a long way. The first floor had a strong odor, possibly mildew or other grime coming from the kitchen and laundry room. Other parts of the house had a lesser odor. There was mold growing on some of the windows. The cooking implements in the kitchen were not as advertised especially for a house of this size where you may need to cook for a group. There some missing amenities and maintenance items (missing soap, dirty sponges, missing light bulbs, peeling paint, items not picked up) that would take minimal effort to address. Some of the bathrooms and hall lights either flashed or turned on randomly (on a sensor) throughout the night, waking people up at night. Some beds and were more comfortable than others. The living space was good for hanging out and had a great view over the water.

Unfortunately, the condition of this home fell well below basic expectations for cleanliness and guest readiness. Upon arrival, multiple areas were cluttered with personal belongings and trash. The garbage disposal and dishwasher were also not in working order. Outdoor common areas were not clean or usable, and the home did not appear to have been prepared for guests.
Due to these conditions, we contacted Airbnb and requested a cancellation and full refund within 30 minutes of arrival, as the space was not suitable to stay in. Airbnb handled the situation promptly. This was not a minor issue—it impacted the usability of the entire home. We would not recommend this listing unless significant cleaning and decluttering improvements are made prior to hosting guests.

this was one of the worst places i have ever stayed. The minute u came in the front door the smell in the hall was terrible i almost threw up. the apartment was dirty and cluttered with furniture. Ot was not worth what we paid for it
After check out we get a message from the host asking for a five star rating because he is new.I was totaly disgusted with the place

When we arrived, the unit was not cleaned from the previous guests. There was garbage left behind, the bedsheets weren't cleaned and had hair in them, and used towels were left everywhere. After NUMEROUS follow-ups with the host, the cleaner showed up after almost 18 hours from my first message to the host. We could not sleep the first night. On the second day, the host provided inaccurate information on when the cleaners would arrive and we spent most of the day waiting for the cleaners to arrive. This severly affected the senior citizens in my group and the remainder of our vacation.
The situation was handled so poorly that we checked out early. Additionally, the host refused to provide a full refund.
Furthermore, the host did not provide compensation for this incompetence even though they mentioned they would. This situation was handled terribly and I would avoid this Airbnb if I could.

Overall decent. It is a nice home, but furniture is not too comfortable. We were a family of 6 and it was enough space. There were a lot of leftover food, im not sure if from previous visitors. AC didn’t really work well and no airflow upstairs, even with windows open. However there are electric fans in each room which helped. The towels and sheets were a bit smelly upon arrival so we washed them. Washer and dryer were great to have. Host provides detergent. I feel like there needs to be just a smidge more of deep cleaning as the bathrooms and sinks were a bit dirty, but overall a good stay.

Overall the location of the air bnb was great, and amount it slept was great. However, upon arrival it was evident that the space was not completely clean. There was an ant infestation in the kitchen area that was not disclosed to us before hand. There was an ant trap we found under the kitchen sink showing that the hosts knew about this problem. We bought food and snacks to eat and had to throw some of it out because we found ants in our food. There was black mold in the shower along the floor grout. The window sills were dusty. The lint in the dry wasn’t removed from whoever used the dryer before our stay. This was NOT worth the price that we paid. It overall felt unclean and not well-kept. The fan in the bathroom was clearly very dirty so the bathroom also held moisture and smelt damp. There were also only 2 towels provided, and there were some random trash/items just outside the side doors. For $500/night is not worth it. Cheap hotels have been/felt cleaner.

We stayed here for one night while attending a concert at BC Place, and it worked fine for what we needed. However, I would not recommend it for an extended stay. When we first booked the home was new to Airbnb and did not have any reviews so we knew that we were taking a risk.
There was a noticeable mildew/mold smell throughout the space, and there was visible mold in the shower. The unit was also very hot, with no air conditioning or fans. There are no screens on the windows, so opening them to let in some cool air also meant letting bugs inside.
There are also some concerns with the exterior. The banister at the front entrance is visibly rotting it appears that it could crumble or break if someone were to lean on it. There is also no outdoor space or seating available to sit outside.
Overall the place is fine, but the issues with the smell, heat, bathroom cleanliness, and exterior would make me hesitant to stay here again.

On the Airbnb website it states to follow hotels check in instructions when it clearly should state that if you do not have a cc, you will not be refunded the money you paid. I paid $450 to stay at a hotel I didn’t get to stay at. Then they wouldn’t let my partner back in to check as I was not there yet. Worst customer support experience. Wasted money.

The location of the hotel was great, the room was clean and spacious, the check in process was smooth and easy too. The only issue I ran into was adjusting my stay due to a last minute change of dates by my company, since it was booked through AirBnb I was unable to refund my last night. Not necessarily a problem, but had I booked directly, the hotel would've been able to refund the cost of the last night.

This was my first negative experience with a facility on Air BNB three hour wait to access, the amount of junk in the yard while accessing the unit should have been the signal.  The facility was not clean, zip ties and mold in shower and shoer curtain, toilet paper holder missing, tank of toilet broken.  The security was questionable as the keys were left hanging in the door and we were told just drop off our luggage and come back later.  The emergency escape plans posted one of the doors was dead bolted!  We had no access to the washer and dryer as advertised.  We texted several times with no response. We are lucky we had sleeping bags with us as the bed was made but questionable if linen had been cleaned or replaced.  The towels provided were no better than large hand towels with zero pilling to either absorb or soften against skin again glad we had our own towels with us but disappointed to not be able to access washer or drier. NOT everyone should be Air BNB hosts......

Samuel mentioned a few hours before check in that the couch cushions had to be thrown out so there was an uncomfortable couch, the towels provided were too small, 3 feet by 3 feet, not for an adult. The floor was dirty, white socks got dirty within half hour, no tops sheets on the bed. Could have been cleaner and more comfortable.

The apartment was very nice and well-located. Couldn't hear the neighbors at all. We didn’t do any cooking and only used a few cups, so I can't speak to how well the kitchen is stocked. The view of the water is lovely, and the parking spot was excellent—very spacious. Check-in was smooth with clear and detailed instructions. The location is super convenient, with a liquor store, drug store, grocery store, and Costco all very close by. The pull-out couch mattress was also surprisingly comfortable. It was appreciated that they do not have a cleanup checkout list.
The only minor feedback is that the apartment could use a little more polishing in a few areas. The carpets were slightly dirty, the shower could have been cleaned a bit more thoroughly, and the window AC units had a mild musty smell. The bedrooms also felt a bit tight, with furniture that seemed slightly large for the space. Overall though, these were small things and didn’t take away from an otherwise pleasant stay.

Nice view is my only positive comment.
Was disappointed in the unit. Challenging to access the building, unit and garage stall.
Lots of difficulty operating the blinds. Had to have someone come in twice to do so.
Patio furniture was very dirty/dusty. The person who came to help operate the tv did not know how but eventually figured it out. Hair in one of the shower walls. No soap at the sink in the bathroom.
Very noisy location. Train came by constantly especially during the very early morning hours, which made it hard to sleep.

So far from downtown. No amenities close by, the home was so dirty the light switches were so dirty, as a professional cleaner, I was appalled at the state of cleanliness. There were urine drips on toilet seat, the hand towel looked dirty and smelled really bad. Fridge wasn't clean. Walls were horrendous. Bathroom was also gross. The tap wasn't even cleaned.

I chose this accommodation as it was 10 minutes walk from the Skytrain. Super convenient !
The neighborhood is quiet and nice.
Lucy was always available when I had a question and she was kind enough to let me drop my luggages before the official check-in time.
The appartment is in a semi basement so you can hear some noise from above. But it's very quiet during the night.
The bed mattress is very firm, which was not an issue for me.
The TV was not connected to the internet so I did it.
I was disappointed with the general state of the place: stains on the ceilings as well as on the wall next to the entrance door, moldy joints in the bathroom...
These did not appear on the pictures.
Some refurbishing would really make a big difference inbthe overall experience .

I was very disappointed with the overall presentation. Even if it had been carefully cleaned I could have overlooked the need for maintenance and care-which was verging on the urgent with obvious water leaks, dirty carpets and drywall repairs and painting needed. Bedding in upstairs bedroom did not fit and thus revealed a massive yellow stain- leaking skylight? ( I sure hope so!!!). The location is beautiful, quiet, busable…. Very high potential with repairs done and hosting details in place.

looked like it was still under construction, misleading as no relaxation area, TV, sofa, etc.
definitely over priced for what was available
I rented a similar 2 bedroom a few blocks away, and it had everything, cleaner, longer stay(3days) and cost less per day
this place looks like they have tried to jam in a two bedroom into a garage, with two extremely small bathrooms, which lacked everything required to be comfortable...can't believe airbnb allows this place on the market.
definitely misleading and over priced.

Avoid this property entirely. We were forced to evacuate after just one night.
The "4BR" listing is false: two rooms are a tiny den and a storage closet entirely filled by a bed.
The unit has severe hazards and pests:
- Shower floods the floor
- Toilet runs loudly all night.
- Sink was clogged.
- Unit is infested with silver bugs.
- A heavy, loose closet door was unfixed with just a warning sign.
- Our assigned parking spot was occupied.
- Constant SkyTrain noise makes sleep impossible.
At midnight, a person impersonating building staff harassed us at our door for having a normal conversation. The host later confirmed this person was not actual building staff.
We reasonably proposed a fair partial discount to make the best of our trip. Instead, hosts Cong and Sharon were highly combative. They blamed us for pre-existing plumbing failures, offered unacceptable workarounds (like "close the bathroom door" for the broken toilet), refused repairs, and aggressively demanded we leave.

We paid $920 for 2 nights, choosing a pricier option for a comfortable family trip. However, the house was old and dirty, featuring cobwebs, a rusted bathroom, and scratched walls. Worst of all, a bedroom door was missing, and the AC was broken.
The host disrupted our trip on the second day, rushing us back to meet their repair schedule. It is ridiculous that we had to alter our vacation for their issues. Furthermore, the staff claimed a shoulder injury and made my husband carry the heavy portable AC from her car upstairs. It was too heavy to lift alone, forcing us to sleep in the heat. It wasn't even central AC, just a single-room unit.
The issues were "fixed" only 12 hours before checkout, which was pointless. When I asked for a refund for these severe inconveniences, they told me to discuss it after checkout. Now, they are shamelessly offering a mere $50 because it was eventually "resolved." This is unacceptable, and I demand a proper refund.

I booked this stay specifically to catch a World Cup game which started at 1pm. I asked if it’d be possible to extend checkout time until 5pm since the game would not be over until 3pm. They told me checkout time was at 11am.
I offered to pay 50% extra of the stay’s cost ($300 USD) to be able to check out at 5pm — this was rejected. I asked if the reservation could be cancelled, asking for a 50% partial refund understanding it was a late cancellation — this was rejected.
After “reviewing with their team” the only solution they offered was that I pay $500 CAD ($350 USD, more than the cost of my stay to begin with and also more than just booking a whole other night) to check out later.
The later check out time was absolutely necessary for me so I had to find other accommodations.
I was more than polite in our communications and offered multiple solutions, all of which were rejected. Ultimately they offered no refund at all, not even the cleaning fee, for a place I never stayed at.

Overpriced for staying in the ends.
Felt so sketchy coming in / out of location
Was so overpriced for what it was
Wouldn’t recommend

We stayed for a month. The hostess was kind , but the living conditions were not what we expected, especially for the price.
Firstly in general: the people who lived there ( more than 7 with us), did'nt really care about the rules. Noise late at night, calling someone and watching series in the kitchen. Cleaning staff just cleaned superficially, after two hours it was a mess again.
Secondly
The bedroom(double bed): Fine for sleeping, but the carpets felt quiet worn down.
The bathroom: Mold spores on the ceilings, shaved hair or normal hair left around the sink, shower and floor.
The kitchen: horrible. The fridge: we had a compartment in the refrigerator and it wasn't clean: leftover food and hair.
Kitchen utensils were not really usable, plates, bowls and cultery pieces were visibly dirty. The pots/pans had burnt residue and rust on the bottom and sponges were ruined , therefore we had to buy our own. Restovers on kitchen island, constant mess, food scraps around sink. Took photos

This place is overpriced for what it offers. The front steps are broken, and it appears that people are living in the basement, which made the property feel overcrowded. The house is already set up to accommodate up to 12 guests, yet they still charge extra fees for additional guests. Overall, the unexpected charges and the condition of the property were very disappointing.

The photos are misleading, the bottom of the stairs are open to the rest of the house. The suite does not have its own lock, so no way to secure the suite from unwanted access.
Bedroom door with the crib did not latch properly, can only be secured from the inside with a second latch. Not ideal for childproofing the room. Open staircase, down to the suite door with no gate.
A good selection of plates and utensils was provided along with the coffee maker and microwave. But no table to sit and eat at.
A nice selection of small snacks provided, including enough coffee k-pods for two days.
Overall clean, but the refrigerator was not clean. Food left by a previous guest, we found a tub of melted ice cream in the freezer.
Check in instructions were incorrect, a door code was not provided until specifically requested. The door code was eventually provided, but it was incorrect.
Checkout instructions were incomplete. We had to ask the host for instructions on dishes, linens, and towels.

First ever negative review on Airbnb. DO NOT STAY HERE. The host and his property management company are dishonest and lack integrity. I showed up at the unit and it wreaked of cigarettes. I informed them immediately and told them I’d need to stay elsewhere, as they can’t “clean up the smell” quickly when it’s on textiles like the couch and carpet. They (unclear exactly who, as there are 4+ hosts in the Airbnb chat and they send messages from each others’ accounts) called me and guaranteed a full refund. I then booked another Airbnb and left, and as soon as I inquired about the refund’s processing, they denied the smell and refused the refund they’d promised. Their poor cleaner was extremely kind and helpful, but feared he would lose his job for not being able to make me stay. Both the host’s behavior and the space itself reflects their orientation towards profit, and not towards providing a positive experience for their guests. Sad.

The neighborhood and location were absolutely perfect, and the place suited our needs fine. I was disappointed that the pull out couch-to-bed was so uncomfortable and that none of the sheets really fit it right, and that the kitchen was not very well supplied, and that the bathroom seemed so dirty (mildewed shower curtain, rusty shower curtain rod, hair on the wall). Overall the communication was great and the place was a fine place to stay.

Do not book. they took really good pictures but the entire place is filthy. cobwebs everywhere, kitchen grease all over the ceiling and cabinets, the place had a weird smell, mould in the bathroom tile, trash and old food left behind and dirty dishes. we immediately requested a refund and we got multiple calls from the property manager begging us not to leave a bad review and insisted on sending cleaners. they gave us a sob story on how it would be bad for their business if we reported them to Airbnb. sorry not my problem

One of the worst accommodation experiences we’ve ever had. When we arrived, we immediately told the host that the electronic locks were not working properly, but we were assured that everything would be fine.
One night, the lock completely fell off and we were stranded outside the property at around 1am. The host did not respond, there was no physical emergency/spare key available, and with no hotels available nearby, we were left with nowhere to stay for the night.
We were not able to regain access to the property until around 1pm the following day. As all of our belongings were locked inside, we ended up missing the event we had specifically travelled for.
Being locked out overnight with no emergency way to access the property and no response from the host was completely unacceptable. It turned what should have been an enjoyable trip into an awful experience. I would strongly recommend avoiding this property.

The carpeting throughout the apartment is disgusting - old and stained everywhere - and I actually tripped on one of the many ridges while walking to the dining area.
The sofa was stained, uncomfortable, and dirty (including hair on the cushions).
Many of the walls are stained and paint is chipping everywhere - radiators, sills, etc.
The placemat on the dining table is stained.
The bathtub is stained.
The particleboard cabinets and doors are frayed on the tops and bottoms due to moisture.
The remote is Scotch taped.
The 4th floor elevator lobby smelled and was filthy.
All of this was documented in photos.
When I complained to the host, I got a boilerplate response starting with “Dear [NAME], …” and alleging surprise that the condition of the apartment “wasn’t up to standard”.
After tripping on the carpet on the second day, I requested and received a refund and left.
The apartment was immediately placed back on Airbnb for rent with no apparent fixes.
Very disappointed!

The place was okay! When I looked at the pictures it looked a lot different! They had 2 fans running at all time and the building inside was a lot hotter than outside! The place looked and felt dirty! It was fine for the meantime, but I would not recommend.

Overall a nice stay, and most issues seem easily fixable.
Pros:
Great, quiet neighborhood, easy check-in, good family space, lots of baby toys, quality crib/high chair, and responsive host.
Cons:
Cleanliness was the biggest issue, especially since prior reviews mentioned it.
The upstairs bathroom was not thoroughly cleaned: behind the toilet seat was extremely dirty, mildew/possible mold on the shades, shower mat and shower. Under the couches also wasn’t vacuumed—not ideal with a crawling baby.
Upstairs gets quite warm with limited airflow. The only wall AC is adjacent to the crib room.
There are also several AC/heat restrictions that should be disclosed before booking.
Vancouver has strict trash/recycling/compost rules, yet there aren’t 3 indoor bins to properly sort. Guests should understand these rules clearly, especially if penalties can be passed on. Ironically, the home’s outdoor bins had city warning tags for improper sorting.
Lastly, the microwave didn’t work.

The hosts were super helpful and responsive whenever we have any issues.
We really liked the airbnb and our stay there as it felt like a home/felt homey.
The only issues were the cleanliness as it was quite dusty where we see there are stains still on the floor which could easily be cleaned and also the rooms had dusty underbeds with things rolled under the shelves which were not cleared and also tabletops/countertops. There were some cockroach issues at the beginning that was pretty bad which the hosts were fast to respond and helped call pest control for which we appreciate.
The last week at the house was much much better when we saw way less cockroaches than in the beginning.

First the good things. Its a big, extremely well located place near all you need in vancouver. Its a charming house as well and the rooms, bathrooms and size as described. The place had a nespresso which was great.
The bad: the photos look new but the place badly needs new carpet and the floor sanded, as both are badly stained ( not necessarily unclean). The bad part really was the general cleanlyness, the floors had dust/ dirt, the downstairs bathroom floor had a layer of dirt in the corners it didnt give you confidence. Windows were extremely dirty, even to open your hands were dirty. The kitchen utensils we rewashed as well as plates. The bedding on one bed didnt have a duvee cover, which we discovered on stripping the beds at checkout and the general cleanlyness didnt give us confidence about bedding etc.
Conner, the downstairs neighbor you need to ask to use the washing machine and dryer is friendly and accomodative.

Actually, we found this place last minute and the host not only accommodated for us, but also really helped us in every way possible and I cannot recommend a better host, a more responsive Airbnb host, and most of all extremely accommodating and simply wonderful cannot recommend more. I said that again, and I mean it.. 15 out of 10 stars and I literally don’t know this person. I’m not doing this because they’re my friend. I really am telling you right now that a summer I’ve been stayed in Airbnb’s periodically when guest and friends came from out of town so I’ve seen basically all of the different types of hosts and what games some of them play, etc. etc. and this one did none of that. It was top-notch. I recommend this place to any friends that come from out of town. The suite itself and a king size bed, and was very clean. It’s obviously not a mansion, but definitely worth what you pay for.

The house itself is beautiful, spacious, and looks just like the photos, but our overall experience was disappointing. The 6:00 PM check-in is unusually late. Despite requesting an early check-in a month in advance, we still couldn't enter until around 7:00 PM due to cleaning delays. After the long wait, the home still wasn't fully prepared. The floors appeared dirty, we found broken glass in the master bedroom, and basic essentials like hand soap and toilet paper were missing. We had to contact the host to find out the extra toilet paper was stored in the garage. The basement is rented separately, and people coming and going initially made us think someone was entering our Airbnb. The kitchen and dining room windows had no blinds, offering little privacy, and the sliding patio door lock was broken, raising security concerns. The property has great potential, but better preparation, maint, and communication are needed.

Our experience at this property fell well below expectations due to multiple cleanliness, maintenance, and safety concerns.
The kitchen was noticeably unclean, with surfaces that appeared not to have been properly cleaned between guests. We also found used, dirty napkins left in a closet and the bathroom upstairs also reeked strongly of urine which raised concerns about the overall standard of housekeeping. There were multiple dead bugs throughout the property.
The most serious issue involved the gas stove. None of the burners would ignite. Turning any of the burner knobs released gas and produced a noticeable gas odor, making the stove unsafe to use. We immediately stopped trying to operate the stove and reported the issue to both the host and Airbnb. The stove remained unusable throughout our stay. The kitchen was also not fully equipped as advertised with 2 glasses for water
We ended up having to rebook our stay due to all of the issues and host lack of accountability

Check in is 6 pm, which seems late. I checked at 5:45 if the house would be ready, he said yes. I messaged him after 7 to finally get the door code. Host did provide an extra hour at checkout for this. I arrived at the house and it seemed very dirty. I noticed there was sugar and coffee all over the counter in the kitchen, bathrooms have build up on the tiles, long hairs all over the house randomly, the bathroom sinks had water & toothpaste residue. The host messaged prior to arrival that the house is clean and kitchen counters are not dirty but have ‘etching’ on it, but after looking, they hadn’t even been given a quick wipe.
All the comforters were also still wet & in dryer at arrival. I checked the dryer after an hour, there were 2 large comforters stuffed in the dryer soaking wet still. took well over an hour to completely dry out. The second took another few hours. there are no extras anywhere to use. House is gorg but needs work.

The location is great. K-cups were not provided at check in, but the host was able to drop some off later. Although initially they only wanted to give us 8 K-cups for a 2 night stay with 4 adults. The floors were dirty and our lightly colored socks were dirty after walking in the floors. A light was not working in the bathroom- the host sent someone to fix it when dropping off the K-cups. Overall, it did not feel like home as certain things were not provided (eg, dryer sheets, dry rinse aide for the dishwasher). Would not stay here again- I think the main plus is the location and view.

This property feels more like a crowded hostel than a traditional Airbnb. I didn’t realize how many different groups would be staying here at once (it was a big house partitioned into >7 rooms), and the sound insulation is incredibly poor. I could hear every footstep on the stairs, and a loud rushing noise every single time the upstairs room turned on their tap. Another party arrived at 2:00 AM and kept me awake for two hours. Additionally, one of the shared bathrooms was dirty with water pooled all over the floor. Would not recommend if you value a quiet night's sleep.

The location is very good, especially if you need to get to the airport. It's quiet, but the soundproofing in the building is terrible. A softer-closing door would be nice. The description says there's body wash, but there wasn't any, and the shower wasn't clean enough to be worth washing in. The small kitchen smelled awfully of old grease, and the refrigerator had a strong odor. The floor could also use a good wash. The bed linens in the room were clean, which was nice.

Sal was a good communicator, the house location in a great quiet neighborhood and bed was comfortable. The house is old and is in need for some TLC. Room could have been cleaned better, doors are thin and you'll hear when anything gets open and closed. Lastly the bathroom smells very musty and there is mold on the ceiling, and window, that should get fixed.

Check in was smooth and communication with the host was great. Location was great and parking convenient. The room was fine. However, I wouldn’t recommend it for more than a night. The shared facilities (e.g., bathroom) were not clean. The place had a strange smell.

The property was clean over, but there were several inconveniences during the stay. The hallways were long and confusing, with very little signage or clarity about which doors led where. One Having to rely entirely on a phone to access the building and rooms felt inconvenient and risky — if your phone battery dies, you could easily be locked out. Traditional key cards would make the experience much more practical.
We also did not receive the room that was shown in the advertisement. The actual room was noticeably smaller than expected and did not match the impression given by the photos online.
Another disappointment was the outdoor area. The listed photos gave the impression of a private patio space overlooking the city, creating the expectation of a quiet and relaxing balcony area. In reality, the outside deck was shared, and other guests could sit and talk just a few feet from the bed, which greatly reduced privacy and comfort. Several of the marketing photos felt misleading.

Unfortunately, despite its great location and good communication from the host this airbnb was musty smelling, it was dusty, floor needed work and there were items under the bed and dried out contact lens on the bedside table! Very overpriced and lack of. cleanliness really soured our experience.

This was the worst stay I’ve ever had at an Air BnB. We had to relocate to Vancouver as my daughter was diagnosed with Leukemia which was disclosed to the host on multiple occasions. initially they wanted to host us for the duration of our stay on the lower mainland (6-9 months) and we had discussed a monthly price within our budget. A couple of days after initially booking, the company asked that I extend by a few weeks on short notice,  I was under a lot of stress and the new cost wasn’t clear. The next day I realized that they had charged me nearly double the daily rate and were resistant to refund me. I had to get Airbnb involved and they eventually canceled the extension but I had to pay a $200 booking fee. The final straw was numerous safety issues; no smoke alarms, possible black mold on walls, gaps under exterior doors, extreme low spots on the ceiling (under 6 feet). We had to leave at that point. The BnB was managed by a company and I had deal with multiple ppl (challenging!)

We stayed at the Sunset with a 2 year old and 2 adults. Upon checkin I was disappointed to see that our unit was not the same as was pictured in the photos for the unit we booked. This is fairly normal for hotels, I suppose, but less the standard on AirBnB. We had requested a toddler cot/pack n play be set up already upon arrival, but it was not. The bedroom could not accommodate the playpen without moving furniture out, which meant we were sleeping in a more cramped room than I had imaged upon booking.
With that said, the manager was very helpful in moving things around to accommodate the toddler bed, and refunded our early check in fee.
The overall room felt a bit worn and dingy - the rug in the living room could be replaced and the floors were quite dirty and should be mopped - our socks were dirty after walking around in the suite.
On the plus side, all the staff we interacted with were kind and helpful, and the stay was fine. We might stay again at a lower price, without kids.
