We had a deal to extend and got bumped last minute, very disappointed..
Tough to communicate…
The place was dirty , dust, candy left on couch, hair left ..
The view was beautiful, overall disappointed .
Okay for a short stay if you’re desperate. Would not recommend or stay again. Very smelly and cluttered, always noticeable walking into the building.

Good location, but too many maintenance issues.
Host was responsive and tried to help, which I appreciated. But the property had several issues:
AC: Listing puts “AC” clearly in the headline but it’s just one portable unit that doesn’t cool the bedrooms. Not what I was expecting, a bit misleading.
Electrical: Second bedroom has 2 dead outlets next to the bed, plus many loose outlets throughout the house. Electronic lock glitched mid-stay and we got stuck outside for 5-7 minutes.
Cleanliness: Spiders, moth, dust, and a musty smell in one bedroom that came back when windows closed. Beds were uncomfortable.
Host offered solutions but nothing got fixed during our stay. Too many things not working for a 5-night rental.

I sent this message to the host who didn’t respond so I’ll just post it here for her to read.
The apartment building & location was great. Walkable to everything and beautiful area. We were disappointed with the condition of the Airbnb, especially considering what we paid for a two-night stay ($860). Unfortunately, the property was not in the condition we expected based on the listing and the price. There were no hand towels, washcloths, or paper towels available. The shower handle was broken, and there was a half-used bar of soap left in the shower. The bath towels were heavily stained and appeared dirty. Stains on doors, dirty window sils, hair in so many places, dirty hairy drawers. The home was clearly lived in and felt like she left that morning without a professional deep clean.
The bedding was wet when we tried to go to bed so we had to stay up for another hour (till midnight) trying to dry the linens ourselves to finally sleep.

Unfortunately, this stay did not meet basic cleanliness standards. Mold was visibly present throughout the bathroom shower, and the kitchen floorboards appeared warped and discolored, consistent with a moisture or water damage issue. The floors throughout the unit had noticeable dirt and grime, and a musty, mold-like odor was present near the washer/dryer, at times masked with heavy air freshener rather than addressed. We reached out to the host, who offered to send someone to clean; however, a surface cleaning would not resolve an underlying mold issue. Given the health and hygiene concerns, we can’t recommend this listing until these issues are properly and professionally remediated.

Our check in time was at 4pm and my group and I got there around 4:45pm. When we got inside the bnb was a mess (crumbs and food left out on the table, beds undone, dirty towels in the bathroom,  dirty laundry/trash in a trash bag in the living room). Host was responsive and sent over a cleaner but we couldn’t leave our stuff since doors needed to be left unlocked and we couldn’t check back in until 8pm.. super inconvenient for my group since we just drove for 3hrs and wanted to relax for a little and we had a bday dinner scheduled and none of us could change or freshen up beforehand. We basically just used the bnb to sleep and left the next morning.

The home is nicely decorated. The host was responsive initially. The house smells of cat urine, must and mold. The main floor bathroom shower flooded onto the floor, the 4 of us used the one shower for the week. This is a chronic issue as noted by the damage on the baseboards. The toilet was backed up after the first flush and required plunging. We tried to relocate with Airb&b but there was apparently nothing close to the area that we needed to be in for a family wedding. The home is advertised as pet-free, but as explained to us the family that lives there, relocate for rentals and they have a cat. We assumed the house was cat free, a misunderstanding I guess. All outside patio areas have mold spots on the house trim, I do not recommend this house if you have allergies to cats or mold, or if you do not want to pay a lot of money to stay in a home that smells of cat urine. The property manager did not note any of our concerns. Our group of 4 found the smell awful, as did our family.

Highly Disappointing Stay — Avoid This Property
I had an incredibly frustrating and uncomfortable experience at this property and strongly advise others to look elsewhere.
⚠️ Serious Health & Allergy Hazards: My sons and I left the property covered in painful bed bug bites, requiring us to see a doctor for medical treatment. Additionally, despite our lifelong, severe allergies to cats, the host's two cats entered our rooms and got onto our beds, triggering extreme allergy symptoms that made us miserable.
🔊 Constant Noise & Poor Amenities: This is an underground first-floor unit. Every single morning at 5:00 AM, loud walking and stomping from the upstairs occupants woke us up, severely impacting our sleep and ruining our travel plans. To make matters worse, there is no washer, dryer, or microwave in the suite.
💸 False Damage Claims: Immediately after we checked out, the host filed false and fraudulent damage claims asking for $251.03. It feels like a complete scam to squeeze more.

We were very disappointed with the place. It was not clean at all as if they skipped on cleaning before checkin. Problem started with check in itself. No clear instructions were provided and had to wait 40mins for the person to arrive to give us the key. AC in the unit did not work both days and even after we reported right at checkin, it was never fixed during our stay. Host was not responsive at all and blamed us after checkout on why AC was not working. They even tried to bribe us with $30 credit to get 5 stars rating. Very unprofessional. Will certainly look for a different place next time.

It’s a good size room as shown in the pictures and fine to sleep in for a couple night.
The shared bathroom was disappointing as it had black mould in the shower

I cannot recommend this property, and this was one of the most disappointing accommodations I have ever stayed in.
The property was very different from how it was presented in the listing. When we arrived, there was still trash left under the kitchen sink that had not been cleaned. The home had three bedrooms, yet only three towels were provided for our entire stay.
Finding the property was unnecessarily difficult because the house number was not clearly visible from the street. In addition, ladders and other equipment were left in the access area, making it difficult and unsafe to carry our luggage into the house.
The listing advertised air conditioning, but there was only one portable air conditioner upstairs. It was so loud that it was impossible to keep it running at night while trying to sleep. One of the bedrooms did not even have a door, making it impossible to have any privacy.
The kitchen was poorly equipped. There were only two pots and one frying pan, and the frying pan

We could not stay in this house. The house was very dirty, not well maintained at all. We noted many safety hazards. Every bathroom, bed, pillow had hairs all over it. The basement is unliveable, most likely why there’s no pictures of basement in the ad, spiders everywhere, overwhelming smell of mildew, half basement is unfinished besides the outdated and dirty bedroom. Carpet in upper bedroom had staples, nails, and a safety pin stuck in it. Kitchen drawers and cupboards had crumbs and old food, oven was not clean and had food bits. TV in living room does not have cable and is not a smart TV so it was unusable. We were very disappointed with this Airbnb.

We had a mixed experience during our stay.
The host was very responsive and friendly, which we appreciated. I took off 1 star due to all the problems we faced. I only took off 1 star because I think we may have just been unlucky.
Unfortunately, the first night the smoke detector kept going off, and we didn’t get much sleep.
The induction stove in the unit only had one unlabeled pan that worked. It took me over an hour and a half to figure out how to use the induction stove and which pan worked. So we ended up ordering food the first night. Early the next morning, they brought over a bunch of pots and pans that can be used on the induction stove, so future guests should not have that problem.
We had to deal with laundry that was left in the dryer by a permanent tenant.
Lastly, we had problems with the shower: cold water only a few times.
Overall, we appreciated the host’s kindness and promptness in dealing with problems, but these issues did affect our comfort.

Not sure if common in Vancouver but did not enjoy our stay here. There were people living upstairs our entire stay and it was quite uncomfortable and we weren’t told that. They blocked our parking one night as well and was a struggle to get our car in. Be prepared to BRING EVERYTHING as essentials are not provided.
Cons:
-very thin walls - can hear EVERYTHING people are doing
-no AC
-not great water pressure in hallway shower
-you cannot raise your voice/make noise or everyone will hear - not a good place for kids to play or run around
-Can also hear people upstairs
-master bed creeks every time you move or lay down and it was SO uncomfortable to sleep on
-cheap linens, beds, mattresses, and pillows
-pillows and blankets limited —If you have issues sleeping with back or neck problems I don’t recommend staying here as the beds are not comfortable
-no towels or hand soap
-one of the mattresses they used was disgusting with STAINS and there was a lingering odour in the room

We had a wonderful stay at Kat’s place in Vancouver. The accommodation was very clean and we appreciated the fresh, good-quality linens and towels.
We were a group of four and were very grateful for Kat’s hospitality, kindness, and helpful restaurant recommendations. The washer and dryer located at the entry were also a great convenience, especially after my friends returned from their Alaska cruise.
A few things to note for future guests: as this is a basement suite, the ceilings are lower but not problematic. There is also a small laundry room at the entrance with a noticeable musty/mold smell. Thankfully, the room has a door that can be closed, so the smell did not affect the main area of the suite.
Overall, we had a comfortable stay and appreciated Kat’s thoughtfulness and welcoming nature. Would recommend to others for sure.

Elena's place is at a wonderful location with excellent view.The apartment is nice but needs to kept clean and requires lot of maintenance. The blinds are broken, the bathroom are stinking with bad smell.The apartment was absolutely dirty when we entered. Host was responsive for the cleaning after we send her the pictures of everything dirty.But that wasted our next half day of the holiday. Non accommodating for even 1 hour late checkin or keeping our luggage for sometime. Not happy with the stay.

The home is in a great location. Easy walk to Starbucks/Tim Hortons in the morning for coffee. Street parking is very easy to find, always a spot in front of house. Listing says no dryer but there is one, it was nice to get laundry done on the trip. I recommend having the owner(s) do a walkthrough with the cleaning crew to make sure the home is being cleaned properly. There was hair on the floors in the bathrooms & showers (also found a dead bug next to toilet). I ran clorox wipes on the kitchen, livingroom, & bathroom hard surfaces and the wipes were very dirty afterward. The couch had food crumbs on it. The listing states Modern kitchen with high end appliances, not sure if this was an AI writeup because it wasn't. I didn't book the home based on a high end kitchen (I wasn't planning to cook anyways) I just think its misleading and should just be labeled as a kitchen. In conclusion, a good deep cleaning between guests & adjusting the info of the house on Airbnb will fix the issues.

This was one of my worst experiences in an Airbnb. The listing said we could check in at 3 and we didn't get to check in until 4:30. The place smells like wet dog. The comforter in one of the rooms smelt like mold and when I asked for a different one she said I could look in the closet. Well all the blankets were in a pile not folded and damp. The shower curtain had mold on the bottom of it. One of the beds was HARD as the floor. The key didn't really work for the lock. You can hear EVERYTHING happening from the people above us..... I don't usually leave bad reviews like this but this place was not worth the price.

It’s a fine place but felt a little misleading. No towels provided, a queen bed frame with a double bed on it…. Heard lots of noise from the upstairs till at least midnight. No extra pillows for the pull out couch.
The tv didn’t work with any services and wouldn’t let us log out and use our own.
If you bring everything you need it is fine but I would not stay here again and would not recommend staying more than a night or 2

I continue to be astounded by the declining quality of rentals in Vancouver. For almost $600/night one would expect at least a CLEAN rental. This one was dirty, smelly, damaged, and did not match the listing at all. To the hosts credit they were apologetic, friendly and responsive, they also refunded 50% of our payment due to our numerous issues, which I appreciate. Even though I cannot say this is a safe place to stay. From trash and bugs and dirt, to broken and mouldy furniture and lighting that the upstairs people control. Bedrooms with no windows, the furnace being turned on early in the morning and awakening to a sweltering situation. The host and their team say they will address all the concerns I raised, but I would avoid this place at all costs.

This apartment has an excellent location, with easy access to many of Vancouver’s great restaurants, interesting neighbourhoods, and attractions, and the pool and hot tub were wonderful amenities to have. We did experience some issues with the condition of the suite, including a dirty bathroom rug and kitchen counters on arrival, a broken bed, and an air conditioner that required repair. Guests should be aware that the bedroom is very close to the SkyTrain track, with noticeable train noise.
The host was responsive once we raised these issues, offering a cleaner, repairs, an alternative suite, replacing the bed, and providing a refund for one night and the cleaning fee.
With the maintenance items addressed and clearer expectations about the SkyTrain track proximity, we would consider staying again because the location, amenities, and overall convenience are excellent.

let's start off with I don't believe there was good directions how to access the Airbnb, took several attempts to access the floor. I showed up 2 hours later than check in and the place was still not cleaned, bedroom was a mess, piled up linens on the bed and the bathroom was filthy. had to leave the apartment so the cleaning lady could clean, waited to hear back for when she was done And I went back in hour later and she still wasn't done. It was smoking hot and a small AC unit could not keep up. no AC unit in the bedroom, the exhaust was taped onto the back of the unit, which the tape came off and heated up the apartment worse. I had to find tape to fix it, and noticed the filters were completely 100% caked in dust and dirt, I took them out and washed them myself, which then helped with air flow. next morning cleaning lady walked in on me without knocking while I was sitting on the toilet before checkout time. very unhappy about this! I will contact corporate

The building and unit itself was good. The surrounding area is sketchy but that can't be helped. The host was responsive and nice. Only downside for us was the smell in the unit. One of the bedrooms was extremely sour/musty smelling. After we ran a load of laundry using their washer, our clothes got the same smell. I'm guessing the sheets were washed in that washer and it needs to be cleaned. Overall a good stay.
Horrible location no parking downstairs was dirty with drywall all over unsafe location nothing was locked to keep people from coming in upstairs

The location was convenient with access to public transport, and the host was responsive. Unfortunately, the property did not match the description or photos in many ways.
The room was very dated, shabby, and had a noticeable musty smell. There was no table or chairs despite basic kitchen appliances. A TV was listed but not present. I was told I could watch the one in the main house, which was not a suitable alternative.After check-in, the listing was updated to remove amenities including the TV, though they were included when I booked. The washer and dryer were not readily accessible. They were behind a locked door, need request for access, which was not disclosed. The pillows were old, lumpy, prickly, uncomfortable. The host didn’t have replacement, we were given sofa pillows, not suitable for sleeping. Bathroom was also worn, blinds dirty. Overall, the condition of the property did not meet expectations, and the price felt high relative to its condition. I would not book it again.

The location does not have air conditioning. The ad does not list AC so it is not misleading and the apartment has some nice windows (no screens). The location however has unrelenting noise at night. Saturday night the sirens and bar noise was non-stop until at least 4 am. Making my Sunday garbage. So tired. Sunday's noise slowed down maybe by 2 am. Even with the windows closed it would have been too noisy to sleep. But in August or any hot month you have a choice of loud unrelenting noise or sweating.
We were too tired to enjoy our short stay in Vancouver and the price was outrageous when you received no sleep
The apartment was a good space with a kitchen, bath, bedroom and living room.
Having a full kitchen was nice and there were some nespresso pods with spices and such for cooking. However every single dish, plate, or cooking item I wanted to use had food specs on it like someone put dirty dishes in a dishwasher and ran it without pre-cleaning.

The host communicated well and was really responsive. I appreciated being able to check in early. It was fairly close to certain things and public transportation.
The place needs some major updates and maintenance. Many of the walls are peeling and chunks of the crown molding were lifted. It seemed like some of the walls had black mold., which is a safety concern. There was dust under the beds and if you walked barefoot, your feet would be black. The beds were uncomfortable - one of them the springs were popping out. The “sofa bed” was actually a futon and there were no linens for it. There were no extra linens or extra towels. There are also really steep stairs leading up to the main floor, which was a safety concern with kids. The only seating area for socializing or tv is the futon, which only sat 3 people, and the dining table. I don’t feel like the place was worth the price in the condition that it is in.

The location of this Airbnb was great and the unit itself was in a really convenient area. Unfortunately, the overall experience was much more frustrating than it needed to be.
The listing advertised free parking, but free parking was only available for two days of our stay. After that, we had to figure out parking ourselves, and the host was not able to clearly tell us where we could park for free. This became a major hassle and was disappointing considering parking was one of the advertised amenities.
Check-in was also a nightmare. We had to text the person listed on Airbnb, who then gave us another number to contact. After contacting that person, we still had to wait for someone to come down and let us in. The process was confusing and unnecessarily complicated.
There were also some basic amenity issues. Only two towels were provided, and there were no actual paper towels—only tissue/toilet paper to use instead.
The parking situation was supposed to be reimbursed, but we still h

Would never recommend anyone to stay here. Bathroom was disgusting, a random person sleeping in what was supposed to be the common area???? We got locked in/out of our room because the latch wouldn’t work. Someone doing loud laundry until 4:30am… I never give bad reviews but this one needs it to warn others to stay away.  Very bad and I do not have high standards when it just comes to a place to sleep at night. We left after one nite.

The home itself is modern and nicely finished, and the beds were comfortable. However, we felt the listing was somewhat misleading in terms of the size and type of property. There was no clear indication that this was a laneway home, and the wide-angle photos made the space appear much larger and more like a typical full-size home than it actually is.
The property is very compact and cramped for a 3-bedroom, and some areas have extremely low ceilings that made them difficult to use comfortably. We also found hair inside the refrigerator, which was disappointing from a cleanliness standpoint. The host was responsive, but overall, the actual space did not match the impression given by the listing photos and description.

The apartment is in a great location and the building has good amenities (gym, library/lounge area, outdoor bbq, laundry, pool table).  Was disappointed with the hair on the floors and the dirty walls in the bathroom, but other than that everything else was clean.  The parking was inconvenient as it took about 10-15 minutes to get to it, but it's in a secure location, which is important. Probably the biggest issue that Ted took care of was figuring out which parking spot could be used for the whole stay. Overall it was a fine place.

We booked only to cancel upon check in at 7:00 pm. At the very entrance we were put off by the smell of urine, upkept from porch and filthy patio furnitures. No lights at the gate and live wires running across the lobby. The house if darn old and even with the renovation, the fowl pungent smell didn’t leave the premises.
Construction tools left in a corner, hazardous when you have kids. The only washroom is an ensuite at the end room so it’s super inconvenient for others living in the second room.
It’s was off putting, we cancelled, got our refund from AirBnB when I shared the pictures of the condition. But it wasn’t easy finding a place for 7 people at 8:00 pm in Vancouver so ended up spending way way wayyyyy more for one night at a Lux AirBnB which was totally not crushing in every sense possible only to check in at 12:00 and leave at 10:00.
Unless the owner addresses these issues, I wouldn’t recommend this to anyone expect for Lil Philly. Philly deserves to live here, for sure.

I ended up not even staying 5 minutes when I tried to enter the house. The key wasn't where the host had instructed me to be, the door was wide open, and people were going in and out, apparently under the influence of drugs. It looked like a party. The house was horribly dirty and smelled terrible. I went up to the room to check if it was at least decent enough to rent, and oh no! It smelled worse than the rest of the house. The photos Rene has in the post are not the same as the room I saw. I felt extremely unsafe in that place. I traveled from the United States to have a good experience here in Canada, and I'm leaving completely disappointed. The host was very rude when she answered me; she takes forever to reply. I asked for a refund, and she completely refused. Don't waste your money or time staying in that dirty and unsafe house. Your safety and well-being come first.

Our stay was an extremely negative experience. We were not expecting a lot because of the price we paid, but this was just beyond.
It started badly off the get-go; the address led us to the back of the house, as vehicles could not access the front. The path to the front was covered with roof shingles and exposed fibreglass insulation. When we arrived in the middle of the night, we found the entire house unlocked.
The house itself was jarring: the floors were disgusting, a damp towel was left outside our bedroom, there were bleach stains on the bed sheets, and we found a large spider in the washroom. The entire room was so dusty we couldn't place clothes on any surface.
We were two guests, but only one towel (with bleach stains) was provided. We requested another towel and received no response for the entire stay. Toilet paper ran out on the first day, and it took the host over 8 hours to refill. Overall, this was an unacceptable stay and we would not recommend this property.

Unfortunately, we left after the first night of our two-night stay due to multiple issues. The access instructions did not work, and after ~30 minutes of messaging, we had to rely on another resident to access the 12th floor.
That night, both bedrooms had electrical problems. The portable AC units repeatedly tripped the breaker. At the host’s direction, we repeatedly tried resetting it, but it would not stay on. The bedrooms were extremely hot, and because the AC units were zippered into the windows, we could not close them. Outside noise kept all four of us awake much of the night.
The next morning, we discovered the primary bathtub had no running water and checked out early. Checkout instructions failed to mention we needed the fob to exit the garage, leaving us trapped until another vehicle opened the gate.
The host did not respond to our requests for a refund for the unused second night, requiring us to escalate to Airbnb. Unfortunately, this was a very disappointing stay.

Worst stay of my life. The home had not been cleaned after previous guests stayed 2 weeks: urine/pubic hair on toilets, overflowing garbage, old food in fridge, on counters and horrible smell throughout, broken glass dining table, and no toilet paper, trash bags, clean towels or bedding. Rooftop deck was unsafe, with garbage and loose lumber/exposed nails. We paid $3,774.23 for 3 nights.
I contacted the host immediately, but he lives in Kelowna and was unable/unwilling to resolve it. The promised cleaner finally arrived at 9:30pm and stayed until midnight, leaving my family unable to use the bathrooms or beds to prepare/rest for our event.
I escalated to Airbnb but was extremely disappointed with their response and failure to provide the promised solution/alternative accommodation. Many years using Airbnb, I've never left a negative review until now. I have photos/video documenting everything. Cannot recommend—this property was unsafe and unsanitary. Please don't risk your stay here.

Easy check-in and good access to public transport, but the room and shared bathroom were filthy with dust in the corners and stale-smelling bedsheets. No bath mat, bathroom was not cleaned in 3 days, and the bin was not emptied. Only one teaspoon and one tablespoon for 3 occupied rooms. Another guest was typing loudly on his computer at the dining table all night (last day) and the noise kept us awake.

Unfortunately, our stay was quite disappointing. There were several maintenance, cleanliness, privacy, and communication issues throughout the house. The toilet seats were broken and coming off when used, about half the lights did not work, and the washroom fans made a loud clanking sound that caused the ceiling to vibrate.
One bedroom had broken blinds, leaving it exposed to the main road. After I sent the host a photo, I was told to avoid using the room. The fridge also had a terrible smell, making it uncomfortable to store food inside, and the kitchen blinds did not close at all.
The host confirmed that an 11:30 AM checkout was acceptable, but the cleaner arrived at 11:00 AM and watched us while we rushed to pack until I had to ask her to give us just a few minutes. When I contacted the host, I was asked to try to leave as soon as possible, despite the confirmed checkout time.
Overall, there were too many basic issues for a comfortable stay.

We were honestly very disappointed. From the photos, we expected a clean and spacious home but were met with uncleanliness. Hairs stuck on walls and towels, stains on the ceiling, excessive grime in the shower, yellow stains on pillows and bedding. Too many spiders to count; almost every corner of the place. Although the location was in a great neighborhood, we just didn't feel comfortable with the uncleanliness of the airbnb. We left in the middle of the first night and didn't continue our four days stay. After discussing with Airbnb support, we were able to receive a full refund.

This place was nothing like I expected. As soon as I walked in, I was hit with a strong smell of mold, and the bedding smelled the same. For what I paid, the cleanliness was very disappointing.
I politely asked Cora for a refund because of the hygiene concerns and because I did not feel comfortable staying there with strangers living right next door and only a thin old door separating the rooms. I understand that a same day refund is not always possible, but her response was what really changed my opinion. Instead of showing any understanding, she told me I could not expect the place to be different and kept asking if I was staying the night before even considering a refund. Her attitude felt dismissive and disrespectful.
I would not recommend staying here.

The location was acceptable, but the condition of the accommodation requires significant attention. The mattress was heavily stained, and I had to request several extra bed sheets just to feel comfortable sleeping on it. It was also old and uncomfortable, with exposed springs. The refrigerator was very dirty upon arrival, and the floor in my room was dirty enough that I ended up cleaning it myself. The kitchen was poorly stocked, with only one spoon, two forks, one old sponge, and no dish soap. I had to ask for these basic items during my stay.
The property also felt overcrowded at times, with people frequently coming and going, which was not ideal for a family stay.
I would like to note that Cora was very kind and responsive whenever I raised concerns. However, I believe she should check on the condition of the house more frequently and ensure that cleanliness, maintenance, and essential supplies meet a reasonable standard. Unfortunately, based on my stay, I would not recommend.

Airbnb beware. Inaccurate description in that the place was listed as entire place but it was two bedrooms rented out separately with shared amenities. On top of that the place was very dirty and the bedding and towels were stained looking like they were not washed. After contacting Airbnb right at check in saying I wasn’t staying and this wasn’t the accurate listing of the place the host tried to lie and say I stayed there even though the address listed on Airbnb was not what the host sent in messaging. Red flag! Look up Cora’s place on Google for additional reviews. Looks like this host has been scamming for years. Save yourself the stress and just book somewhere else!

Very disappointing stay. Our stay from August 19–26 was frustrating. When we arrived, there was no AC. We asked Iris for fans, but she initially refused. After going back and forth, she eventually gave us one fan, but entered the home without my permission while I was away to leave it. The kitchen was poorly equipped, with limited cutlery. The pots and pans were rusted and unusable, so I had to buy my own. One night, the heater stopped working. Her husband came the next morning but could not fix it. When I contacted Iris around 10 AM, she said she would come at 12:30 PM, which was inconvenient. There were no extra tissues, towels, blankets, or pillows. There was no drying rack initially, and one was only provided three days before checkout. I had to purchase an extra fan, pots and pans, and tissues myself. When I requested reimbursement, Iris refused and offered only $50 for the inconvenience. The home was not properly prepared for guests and it was unacceptable! I would not recommend.

All the rooms are located next to the sewer pipe with terrible noise which happens every 2 to 3 minutes. I could not sleep and got out of this room after the first night with full refund for the remaining dates. Also, the host did not willingly give me refund and I needed to contact Airbnb for the refund

Neighborhood seems cute and looks very accessible to areas around Vancouver.
One thing that isn't obvious is that this space is poorly lit. Had we stayed here, we would've been working remotely and this space isn't a good work space.
We unfortunately couldn't stay here. When we arrived, the unit smelled quite bad. Like mold and mildew. There were also mice in the unit.
Thankfully Tuan was responsive and did give us a full refund.

Multiple serious issues forced us to cut our stay short:
• Listing advertised 3 bedrooms, but one was a small windowless space with no airflow—unusable.
• No working in-unit AC. The portable unit vents through the window, but a train runs constantly outside. window open means nonstop noise, closed means unbearable heat. Sleep was IMPOSSIBLE.
• Area felt unsafe, with significant visible homelessness a block away.
• Chair and couch in the unit were noticeably dirty.
• Host communication was terrible. We messaged in the next morning saying conditions were unbearable and trying to see if we can possibly check out early with a refund. Host didn’t respond for hours, then just kept deflecting to “contact Airbnb support” instead of taking ownership.
• We were effectively forced to stay a second night while the host falsely claimed we hadn’t communicated in time to deny. Eventually we only got the final night refunded after a long back-and-forth.
WORST AIRBNB EXPERIENCE. DONT STAY.

I would ABSOLUTELY STAY AWAY from this property and host. The listing is extremely misleading.
We booked for 4 people, yet there was NO refrigerator/mini-fridge (only a wine cooler), and the “kitchen” had no stove/oven and only 3 plates and 3 sets of forks/spoons. The cabinets were otherwise nearly empty.
There is also an internal door connecting the unit to the main floor that the host can lock/unlock, which made us uncomfortable regarding privacy and access.
Worst of all, the bed sheets, pillowcases and duvet were WET, as if freshly washed. We had just arrived jet-lagged, and my kids fell asleep on the wet bedding while I tried to resolve it with Matt.
When I reported the wet bedding, he asked for photos/video as proof. When I asked how he could detect wetness from a photo or video, he became defensive and his tone changed noticeably.
We requested a partial refund; he rejected it. Airbnb then reviewed the situation and issued us a substantial refund. SO, I guess we were right!
